PSALM 22 — 3D ANIMATED PORTRAIT FILM: COMPLETE SOURCE CODE
===========================================================
How this video was made (for another AI/chatbot to learn from):

TOOLS: Blender 4.5 (EEVEE renderer, headless via xvfb, CPU only), MPFB2 / MakeHuman (CC0 realistic humans),
Poly Haven (CC0 skies, textures, rocks), Objaverse/Sketchfab (CC-BY animals), Kokoro TTS (narration voice),
FluidSynth + MuseScore_General soundfont (procedural orchestral score), RIFE (frame interpolation), ffmpeg.

PIPELINE (run in this order):
 1. text/psalm22.json      - the text split into caption phrases, grouped in blocks
 2. text/shots.json        - creative blueprint: one visual scene per block of text
 3. audio/tts.py           - narration per phrase -> narration.wav + exact phrase timings
 4. timeline.py            - turns phrase timings into frame ranges for every shot (24 fps)
 5. blender/shots/<id>.py  - one Blender Python script per shot: def build(ctx) builds the scene + animation
    blender/lib/*.py       - shared libraries: core (camera/light/sky/materials), characters (people, poses,
                             faces), wardrobe (robes), assets (animals/props), env (Golgotha, hills), sets
                             (interiors), fx (fire, water, Red Sea, Earth, dust)
    blender/render_shot.py - renders one shot; render_queue.py renders all shots in chunks (resumable)
 6. comp/interp.py         - renders slow shots at 12 fps and fills in-between frames with RIFE (halves render time)
 7. audio/music.py, sfx.py, mix.py - original score, sound effects, final mix ducked under the voice
 8. comp/composite.py, captions.py, encode.py - colour grade, transitions, captions, title, two-pass
    H.264 encode sized to stay under 15 MB, with a bright first frame (social-media thumbnail)

KEY LESSONS: render portrait 540x960 and upscale to 720x1280; keep render cost ~5-10 s/frame on CPU;
never use a world volume in EEVEE (blacks out the sky) - use finite fog boxes; use frame interpolation
for slow shots; make frame 1 bright; size the bitrate from the duration to hit the file-size limit.

Files follow, each starting with a "===== FILE: path =====" line.

===== FILE: psalm22/DEV.md =====
# Psalm 22 — production pipeline (developer notes)

Goal: a lifelike 3D-animated portrait (9:16) short film of the crucifixion that visualises Psalm 22
(NIV) block by block — flashbacks and symbolic scenes, not talking heads. Style target: realistic
CG like *The Polar Express* / *Final Fantasy: The Spirits Within*. Narration (AI voice) + captions
+ score. Final file: MP4 under 15 MB. The first frame must be a bright, readable shot (it's the
social-media thumbnail), never black.

## Layout
```
psalm22/
  text/psalm22.json      caption blocks/phrases (exact NIV text)
  text/shots.json        creative blueprint: 40 shots, description per shot
  timeline.json          generated: frame ranges per shot + phrase timings (python3 psalm22/timeline.py)
  audio/tts.py           narration (Kokoro, voice am_michael) -> $WORK/audio/narration.wav, phrases.json
  blender/
    run.sh               headless render wrapper (xvfb + Blender 4.5 EEVEE Next)
    render_shot.py       shot runner
    lib/core.py          shared helpers (camera, lights, sky, materials, terrain, cross, fog, dust)
    lib/polyhaven.py     CC0 asset downloader/cache (HDRIs, textures, models)
    lib/*.py             feature modules (characters, wardrobe, assets, env, sets, ...)
    shots/<id>.py        one script per shot: def build(ctx)
  comp/                  compositor: grading, transitions, captions, encode
```
Large/derived data lives outside git: `$WORK=/opt/work/psalm22` (frames, audio, caches),
`/opt/assets` (Poly Haven cache, TTS model, downloaded models).

## Tools on this machine
- Blender 4.5 LTS: `/opt/tools/blender-4.5.14-linux-x64/blender` (CPU only; EEVEE runs on Mesa llvmpipe under xvfb).
- MPFB 2 (MakeHuman for Blender) installed as extension `bl_ext.user_default.mpfb` with the CC0 MakeHuman
  system assets in `~/.config/blender/4.5/extensions/.user/user_default/mpfb/data` (skins, hair long01/short*,
  eyebrows, eyelashes, eyes, teeth, proxies). Python API: `from bl_ext.user_default.mpfb.services.humanservice import HumanService`.
- Python venv for non-Blender tools: `/opt/venv/bin/python` (numpy, scipy, pillow, soundfile, kokoro_onnx, faster_whisper).
- ffmpeg, ImageMagick (`convert`, `montage`), apt-get, pip. Network: PyPI, HuggingFace, GitHub releases,
  raw.githubusercontent.com, Poly Haven, download.blender.org are reachable.
- 4 CPU cores, 15 GB RAM, no GPU. Be considerate: run at most ONE Blender render at a time per agent.

## Rendering a shot
```
psalm22/blender/run.sh --shot s01a --quality preview --frames sheet6   # 270x480, 3 spp, 6 frames + contact sheet
psalm22/blender/run.sh --shot s01a --quality draft   --frames 1,60       # 540x960, 3 spp
psalm22/blender/run.sh --shot s01a --quality final   --frames 1-4        # 540x960, 8 spp (or ctx.samples)
```
Output: `$WORK/frames/<shot>/<quality>/NNNN.png` (+ `sheet.png`). Look at the PNGs with the Read tool.

## Shot script contract (`shots/<id>.py`)
```python
from lib import core as C
def build(ctx):
    # ctx.nframes (timeline frames), ctx.render_frames (incl. dissolve tail), ctx.fps = 24
    # ctx.phrases: [{"text","start","end"}] seconds relative to shot start; ctx.phrase_frames(i)
    # ctx.u(frame) -> 0..1 progress; ctx.frame(sec); ctx.seed
    # ctx.samples = 6            # final-quality EEVEE samples override (default 8)
    # ctx.render_opts = {...}    # kwargs for core.configure_render (raytracing, volumetrics, motion_blur, look, exposure)
    # ctx.post = {...}           # hints for the compositor (see comp/)
    # ctx.needs_bake = True      # if it uses particles / cloth / rigid bodies
```
Frames are 1-based. Animate with `C.animate_camera(cam, fn)` / `C.key_fn` / `C.keys`; always parameterise
timing by `ctx.nframes` / phrase times so timing changes don't require edits.

## Render budget (important)
Final quality on this CPU costs ~3–6 s/frame. The whole film is ~6400 frames. Target ≤ 4 s/frame
(measure with `--quality final --frames 1-3`, ignore the first frame which includes shader compile).
Levers: `ctx.samples` (6 is usually fine), `ctx.render_opts["volumetrics"]="low"`, fewer/larger fog volumes,
avoid `raytracing=True` unless reflections matter, decimate distant meshes, keep subdivision levels low.

## Look
- Colour management: AgX, look "AgX - Medium High Contrast" (default). Compositor adds bloom, vignette, grade.
- Portrait composition: subject in the centre square (thumbnail crop); captions sit in the lower third, so
  keep critical detail out of the bottom ~25% where possible.
- Lifelike: real-world scale, PBR textures (Poly Haven), soft area/sun light, atmospheric depth (fog boxes),
  shallow DOF for close-ups (`C.camera(..., fstop=2.0)`), slow motivated camera moves, subtle handheld noise.
- NEVER use a world volume (EEVEE Next makes it infinite → black sky). Use `C.atmosphere()` / `C.fog_box()`.
- Taste: reverent, no gore. Suggest violence (shadows, cut-aways, a single drop of blood).

## Ownership
Each module/shot belongs to one agent. Only make backwards-compatible bug fixes to `lib/core.py` /
`render_shot.py` and mention them in your report. Don't commit or push — the lead integrates.

===== FILE: psalm22/README.md =====
# Psalm 22 — a 3D-animated portrait film

**Deliverable:** `Psalm22_portrait.mp4` — 720×1280 (9:16 portrait), 24 fps, 4 min 19 s, H.264 + AAC, 14.3 MB.
The first frame is the bright golden title shot of Golgotha (no dark preview square).

Psalm 22:1–31 (NIV) narrated (AI voice, Kokoro `am_michael`) with on-screen captions, an original score and
sound design, over CG scenes rendered in Blender 4.5 (EEVEE) that visualise each block of the text:
Golgotha and the darkened sun, Gethsemane, the Holy of Holies, the Red Sea, the nativity, Mary at the cross,
the bulls and lions of Bashan, water poured out, a melting candle, the potsherd, dogs and soldiers, the casting
of lots, the light breaking through, the beasts turning to dust, the empty tomb, the scarred hand, the risen
face, the Earth at sunrise, the story passed to the next generation, and the empty cross at sunrise.

## Required notice when posting
Scripture quotations taken from The Holy Bible, New International Version® NIV®. Copyright © 1973, 1978,
1984, 2011 by Biblica, Inc.™ Used by permission. All rights reserved worldwide.

Some animal models are CC BY 4.0 — see `CREDITS.md` (credit them in the post description).

## Rebuild
See `DEV.md` (pipeline), `docs/*.md` (module APIs). Order: `audio/tts.py` → `timeline.py` →
`render_queue.py` (Blender renders, hours on CPU) → `audio/music.py`, `sfx.py`, `mix.py` →
`comp/composite.py` (grading, captions, encode < 15 MB).

===== FILE: psalm22/audio/tts.py =====
"""Generate the Psalm 22 narration with Kokoro TTS and write phrase timings.

Usage: /opt/venv/bin/python psalm22/audio/tts.py
Outputs (in $WORK/audio, default /opt/work/psalm22/audio):
  narration.wav      48 kHz mono narration track on the final timeline
  phrases.json       per-phrase start/end seconds on the final timeline
"""
import json, os, re
import numpy as np
import soundfile as sf
from scipy.signal import resample_poly
from kokoro_onnx import Kokoro

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
WORK = os.environ.get("WORK", "/opt/work/psalm22")
OUT = os.path.join(WORK, "audio")
os.makedirs(os.path.join(OUT, "phr"), exist_ok=True)

VOICE = os.environ.get("VOICE", "am_michael")
SPEED = float(os.environ.get("SPEED", "0.84"))
SR = 48000

INTRO = 5.0          # title shot before the first words
OUTRO = 8.0          # after "He has done it!"
GAP_BLOCK = 1.8      # between blocks
GAP_EXTRA = {"b14": 2.6, "b15": 3.4}   # longer breath before the turn / resurrection
GAP_PUNCT = {",": 0.22, ";": 0.42, ":": 0.38, ".": 0.55, "?": 0.6, "!": 0.6, "—": 0.3}

# pronunciation helpers (display text is unchanged)
RESPELL = {"Bashan": "Bayshan"}
# phoneme fixes applied after espeak phonemization
PHONEME_FIX = [("lˈaɪv fɚɹˈɛvɚ", "lˈɪv fɚɹˈɛvɚ"), ("həznɑːt", "hˈæz nˈɑːt")]


def speakable(text):
    t = text.replace("“", "").replace("”", "").replace("’", "'")
    t = t.replace("—", ",")
    for k, v in RESPELL.items():
        t = re.sub(r"\b%s\b" % k, v, t)
    return t.strip()


def trim(x, thr=0.006, pad=0.03, sr=24000):
    idx = np.where(np.abs(x) > thr)[0]
    if len(idx) == 0:
        return x
    a = max(0, idx[0] - int(pad * sr))
    b = min(len(x), idx[-1] + int(pad * 2 * sr))
    return x[a:b]


def main():
    data = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, "text", "psalm22.json")))
    k = Kokoro("/opt/assets/tts/kokoro-v1.0.onnx", "/opt/assets/tts/voices-v1.0.bin")
    t = INTRO
    pieces, phrases = [], []
    for bi, block in enumerate(data["blocks"]):
        if bi > 0:
            t += GAP_EXTRA.get(block["id"], GAP_BLOCK)
        bstart = t
        for pi, text in enumerate(block["phrases"]):
            cache = os.path.join(OUT, "phr", "%s_%02d_%s_%.2f.wav" % (block["id"], pi, VOICE, SPEED))
            if os.path.exists(cache):
                y, _ = sf.read(cache)
            else:
                ph = k.tokenizer.phonemize(speakable(text), "en-us")
                for a, b in PHONEME_FIX:
                    ph = ph.replace(a, b)
                s, sr = k.create(ph, voice=VOICE, speed=SPEED, is_phonemes=True)
                y = resample_poly(trim(np.asarray(s, dtype=np.float64), sr=sr), SR, sr)
                sf.write(cache, y, SR)
            dur = len(y) / SR
            pieces.append((t, y))
            phrases.append({"block": block["id"], "index": pi, "text": text,
                            "start": round(t, 3), "end": round(t + dur, 3)})
            t += dur
            if pi < len(block["phrases"]) - 1:
                last = text.rstrip("”\"")[-1]
                t += GAP_PUNCT.get(last, 0.3)
        for p in phrases:
            if p["block"] == block["id"]:
                p["block_start"] = round(bstart, 3)
    total = t + OUTRO
    track = np.zeros(int(total * SR) + SR)
    for start, y in pieces:
        i = int(start * SR)
        track[i:i + len(y)] += y
    peak = np.max(np.abs(track)) or 1
    track = track / peak * 0.89
    sf.write(os.path.join(OUT, "narration.wav"), track[: int(total * SR)], SR, subtype="PCM_16")
    json.dump({"voice": VOICE, "speed": SPEED, "intro": INTRO, "outro": OUTRO,
               "total": round(total, 3), "phrases": phrases},
              open(os.path.join(OUT, "phrases.json"), "w"), indent=1)
    print("total %.1f s, %d phrases" % (total, len(phrases)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

===== FILE: psalm22/timeline.py =====
"""Build timeline.json: global frame ranges for every shot, synced to the narration.

Usage: python3 psalm22/timeline.py   (after audio/tts.py)
"""
import json, os

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
WORK = os.environ.get("WORK", "/opt/work/psalm22")
FPS = 24
LEAD_BLOCK = 0.6      # cut this many seconds before a block's first phrase
DISSOLVE = 14         # frames of overlap for dissolves (rendered as tail of the previous shot)


def main():
    ph = json.load(open(os.path.join(WORK, "audio", "phrases.json")))
    shots = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, "text", "shots.json")))["shots"]
    # shots without a script are folded into the previous shot (it simply runs longer)
    have = lambda sid: os.path.exists(os.path.join(ROOT, "blender", "shots", sid + ".py"))
    dropped = [s["id"] for s in shots if not have(s["id"])]
    if dropped and os.environ.get("KEEP_MISSING") != "1":
        print("folding shots without scripts into the previous shot:", " ".join(dropped))
        shots = [s for s in shots if have(s["id"])]
    phrases = ph["phrases"]
    total = ph["total"]
    by_block = {}
    for p in phrases:
        by_block.setdefault(p["block"], []).append(p)

    cuts = []
    for s in shots:
        if s["block"] == "intro":
            cuts.append(0.0)
            continue
        bp = by_block[s["block"]]
        i = s["from"]
        if i == 0:
            cuts.append(bp[0]["start"] - LEAD_BLOCK)
        else:
            cuts.append((bp[i - 1]["end"] + bp[i]["start"]) / 2 - 0.08)
    total_frames = int(round(total * FPS))
    starts = [int(round(c * FPS)) for c in cuts]
    out = []
    for k, s in enumerate(shots):
        f0 = starts[k]
        f1 = starts[k + 1] if k + 1 < len(shots) else total_frames
        nxt = shots[k + 1]["transition_in"] if k + 1 < len(shots) else None
        tail = DISSOLVE if nxt == "dissolve" else 0
        t0 = f0 / FPS
        rel = [{"text": p["text"], "start": round(p["start"] - t0, 3), "end": round(p["end"] - t0, 3)}
               for p in phrases if p["end"] > t0 and p["start"] < f1 / FPS]
        e = dict(s)
        e.update({"start_frame": f0, "nframes": f1 - f0, "tail": tail,
                  "render_frames": f1 - f0 + tail, "seconds": round((f1 - f0) / FPS, 2),
                  "phrases": rel})
        out.append(e)
    tl = {"fps": FPS, "total_frames": total_frames, "total_seconds": total,
          "dissolve_frames": DISSOLVE, "render_resolution": [540, 960],
          "final_resolution": [720, 1280], "shots": out}
    json.dump(tl, open(os.path.join(ROOT, "timeline.json"), "w"), indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
    for e in out:
        print("%-5s %5d +%4d (%5.2fs) tail %2d  %s" % (e["id"], e["start_frame"], e["nframes"], e["seconds"], e["tail"], e["title"]))
    print("total frames", total_frames, "render frames", sum(e["render_frames"] for e in out))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

===== FILE: psalm22/render_queue.py =====
"""Final render queue: renders shots at final quality in memory-bounded chunks, resumable.

    python3 psalm22/render_queue.py                    # all shots in timeline order
    python3 psalm22/render_queue.py s00 s20c s01a      # just these
    python3 psalm22/render_queue.py --quality draft    # e.g. a draft pass
    python3 psalm22/render_queue.py --workers 2        # two shots at once (LP_NUM_THREADS split)

Per shot: renders frames with `--frames auto:a-b --skip-existing` (12 fps when the shot sets ctx.interp),
then runs comp/interp.py for interp shots. Progress + timings: $WORK/logs/queue.log
"""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time, threading

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
WORK = os.environ.get("WORK", "/opt/work/psalm22")
RUN = os.path.join(ROOT, "blender", "run.sh")
CHUNK = int(os.environ.get("CHUNK", "48"))
LOG = os.path.join(WORK, "logs")
os.makedirs(LOG, exist_ok=True)
lock = threading.Lock()


def log(msg):
    line = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S ") + msg
    with lock:
        print(line, flush=True)
        open(os.path.join(LOG, "queue.log"), "a").write(line + "\n")


def frames_dir(sid, q):
    return os.path.join(WORK, "frames", sid, q)


def meta(sid, q):
    p = os.path.join(frames_dir(sid, q), "meta.json")
    return json.load(open(p)) if os.path.exists(p) else None


def missing(sid, q, n, interp, keep=()):
    d = frames_dir(sid, q)
    want = sorted(set(range(1, n + 1, 2)) | set(keep)) if interp else range(1, n + 1)
    return [f for f in want if not (os.path.exists(os.path.join(d, "%04d.png" % f)) and os.path.getsize(os.path.join(d, "%04d.png" % f)) > 0)]


def run_chunk(sid, q, a, b, env):
    t = time.time()
    lf = open(os.path.join(LOG, "%s_%s.log" % (sid, q)), "a")
    r = subprocess.run([RUN, "--shot", sid, "--quality", q, "--frames", "auto:%d-%d" % (a, b), "--skip-existing"],
                       stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env)
    return r.returncode, time.time() - t


def render_shot(shot, q, env):
    sid, n = shot["id"], shot["render_frames"]
    t0 = time.time()
    m = meta(sid, q)
    if m is None:  # first chunk tells us interp / bake needs
        rc, dt = run_chunk(sid, q, 1, min(n, CHUNK), env)
        m = meta(sid, q)
        if m is None:   # a crash at Blender exit (rc 139) after rendering is harmless
            log("FAIL %s first chunk rc=%s (see logs/%s_%s.log)" % (sid, rc, sid, q))
            return False
    interp, bake = m.get("interp", False), m.get("needs_bake", False)
    keep = [f for f in m.get("interp_keep", []) if 1 <= f <= n]
    tries = 0
    while True:
        todo = missing(sid, q, n, interp, keep)
        if not todo:
            break
        tries += 1
        if tries > 6:
            log("FAIL %s still missing %d frames after retries" % (sid, len(todo)))
            return False
        a = todo[0]
        b = n if bake else min(n, a + CHUNK - 1)   # bake shots: one process (bake once)
        rc, dt = run_chunk(sid, q, a, b, env)
        done = len(todo) - len(missing(sid, q, n, interp, keep))
        log("%s %s frames %d-%d rc=%d %.0fs (%d new, %.1fs/frame)" % (sid, q, a, b, rc, dt, done, dt / max(1, done)))
        if done:
            tries = 0
    if interp:
        t = time.time()
        r = subprocess.run(["/opt/venv/bin/python", os.path.join(ROOT, "comp", "interp.py"), "--shot", sid, "--quality", q],
                           stdout=open(os.path.join(LOG, "%s_%s_interp.log" % (sid, q)), "a"), stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        log("%s interp rc=%d %.0fs" % (sid, r.returncode, time.time() - t))
    log("DONE %s (%d frames, interp=%s) in %.1f min" % (sid, n, interp, (time.time() - t0) / 60))
    return True


def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    q = "final"
    workers = 1
    if "--quality" in args:
        i = args.index("--quality"); q = args[i + 1]; del args[i:i + 2]
    if "--workers" in args:
        i = args.index("--workers"); workers = int(args[i + 1]); del args[i:i + 2]
    tl = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, "timeline.json")))
    shots = [s for s in tl["shots"] if not args or s["id"] in args]
    if args:
        shots.sort(key=lambda s: args.index(s["id"]))
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env["RENDER_SLOTS"] = env.get("RENDER_SLOTS", str(max(workers, 1)))
    if workers > 1:
        env["LP_NUM_THREADS"] = str(max(1, 4 // workers))
    log("queue start: %d shots, quality=%s, workers=%d" % (len(shots), q, workers))
    pending = list(shots)

    def worker():
        while True:
            with lock:
                if not pending:
                    return
                s = pending.pop(0)
            if os.path.exists(os.path.join(ROOT, "blender", "shots", s["id"] + ".py")):
                render_shot(s, q, env)
            else:
                log("SKIP %s (no shot script)" % s["id"])

    th = [threading.Thread(target=worker) for _ in range(workers)]
    for t in th:
        t.start()
    for t in th:
        t.join()
    log("queue finished")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/run.sh =====
#!/bin/bash
# Render a shot headless: psalm22/blender/run.sh --shot s01a --quality preview --frames sheet6
# Waits for one of RENDER_SLOTS machine-wide Blender slots (see slot.sh).
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
BLENDER="${BLENDER:-/opt/tools/blender-4.5.14-linux-x64/blender}"
source "$HERE/slot.sh"
exec xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1280x1024x24" "$BLENDER" -b -noaudio -P "$HERE/render_shot.py" -- "$@"

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/slot.sh =====
#!/bin/bash
# Counting semaphore for Blender processes (shared by all agents). Source this, then exec your command.
# RENDER_SLOTS (default 3) concurrent Blender renders machine-wide; waits for a free slot.
SLOTS="${RENDER_SLOTS:-3}"
while :; do
  for i in $(seq 1 "$SLOTS"); do
    exec {SLOT_FD}>"/tmp/psalm22_render_slot_${SLOT_PREFIX:-}$i.lock"
    if flock -n "$SLOT_FD"; then export PSALM22_SLOT=$i; break 2; fi
    exec {SLOT_FD}>&-
  done
  sleep 3
done

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/bl.sh =====
#!/bin/bash
# Run any Blender python script headless (EEVEE-capable) inside the shared render semaphore:
#   psalm22/blender/bl.sh my_test.py [script args...]
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
BLENDER="${BLENDER:-/opt/tools/blender-4.5.14-linux-x64/blender}"
SCRIPT="$1"; shift
source "$HERE/slot.sh"
exec xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1280x1024x24" "$BLENDER" -b -noaudio -P "$SCRIPT" -- "$@"

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/render_shot.py =====
"""Render one shot. Run through ./run.sh (wraps xvfb-run + Blender):

    psalm22/blender/run.sh --shot s01a --quality preview --frames sheet6
    psalm22/blender/run.sh --shot s01a --quality final   --frames all
    psalm22/blender/run.sh --shot s01a --quality final   --frames 1-120

--frames: 'all' | 'sheet<N>' (N evenly spaced frames + contact sheet) | '1,40,80' | 'a-b'
          | 'odd' / 'odd:a-b' (odd frames only = 12 fps; fill the evens with comp/interp.py)
          | 'auto' / 'auto:a-b' (= 'odd[:a-b]' if the shot sets ctx.interp = True, else 'all' / 'a-b')
--skip-existing: only render frames whose PNG doesn't exist yet (resume). Writes meta.json (interp, needs_bake).
--quality: preview (270x480, 3 spp) | draft (540x960, 3 spp) | final (540x960, ctx.samples or 8 spp)
--save-blend: also write the built scene to WORK/blend/<shot>.blend for inspection.
Output: WORK/frames/<shot>/<quality>/NNNN.png (NNNN = 1-based shot frame) + post.json (+ sheet.png)
"""
import bpy, sys, os, json, time, importlib

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
from lib import core  # noqa: E402

argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:] if "--" in sys.argv else []
opts = {"--quality": "preview", "--frames": "sheet6", "--save-blend": False, "--skip-existing": False}
i = 0
while i < len(argv):
    a = argv[i]
    if a in ("--save-blend", "--skip-existing"):
        opts[a] = True
        i += 1
    else:
        opts[a] = argv[i + 1]
        i += 2
shot_id = opts["--shot"]
quality = opts["--quality"]

tl = json.load(open(os.path.join(core.ROOT, "timeline.json")))
shot = next(s for s in tl["shots"] if s["id"] == shot_id)
ctx = core.Ctx(shot, quality, tl["fps"])
core.reset_scene(ctx)
mod = importlib.import_module("shots." + shot_id)
t0 = time.time()
mod.build(ctx)
core.configure_render(ctx, **ctx.render_opts)
print("BUILD_TIME %.1fs" % (time.time() - t0))

spec = opts["--frames"]
if spec == "auto" or spec.startswith("auto:"):
    # the shot decides: ctx.interp = True -> half-rate render, evens filled by comp/interp.py
    rng = spec[5:] if ":" in spec else ""
    if getattr(ctx, "interp", False):
        spec = "odd:" + rng if rng else "odd"
    else:
        spec = rng if rng else "all"
    print("AUTO_FRAMES", spec)
N = ctx.render_frames
sheet = None
if spec == "all":
    frames = list(range(1, N + 1))
elif spec.startswith("sheet"):
    k = int(spec[5:] or 6)
    frames = sorted(set(max(1, min(N, round(1 + (N - 1) * j / (k - 1)))) for j in range(k)))
    sheet = frames
elif spec == "odd" or spec.startswith("odd:"):
    # half-rate render (odd frames only); comp/interp.py synthesises the even frames afterwards
    a, b = spec[4:].split("-") if ":" in spec else (1, N)
    frames = [f for f in range(int(a), min(N, int(b)) + 1) if f % 2 == 1]
    # in-shot hard cuts: RIFE can't bridge a cut, so a shot lists the even frame(s) next to the cut in
    # ctx.interp_keep and they are rendered too (interp.py only fills frames that are missing)
    frames = sorted(set(frames) | {int(f) for f in getattr(ctx, "interp_keep", ()) if int(a) <= int(f) <= min(N, int(b))})
elif "-" in spec and "," not in spec:
    a, b = spec.split("-")
    frames = list(range(int(a), min(N, int(b)) + 1))
else:
    frames = [int(x) for x in spec.split(",")]

out = os.path.join(core.WORK, "frames", shot_id, quality)
os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
json.dump({"interp": bool(getattr(ctx, "interp", False)), "needs_bake": bool(ctx.needs_bake),
           "interp_keep": sorted(int(f) for f in getattr(ctx, "interp_keep", ())),
           "render_frames": N, "samples": ctx.samples, "render_opts": ctx.render_opts},
          open(os.path.join(out, "meta.json"), "w"), indent=1)
if opts["--skip-existing"]:
    have = lambda f: os.path.exists(os.path.join(out, "%04d.png" % f)) and os.path.getsize(os.path.join(out, "%04d.png" % f)) > 0
    todo = [f for f in frames if not have(f)]
    print("SKIP_EXISTING %d of %d frames already rendered" % (len(frames) - len(todo), len(frames)))
    if not todo:
        core.save_post(ctx, os.path.join(out, "post.json"))
        sys.exit(0)
    if spec.startswith("odd") and todo != frames:
        spec = "list"   # fall back to per-frame renders for the remaining odd frames
    frames = todo
if ctx.needs_bake and (frames != list(range(1, N + 1))):
    tb = time.time()
    core.bake_all(ctx)
    print("BAKE_TIME %.1fs" % (time.time() - tb))
if opts["--save-blend"]:
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(core.WORK, "blend"), exist_ok=True)
    bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=os.path.join(core.WORK, "blend", shot_id + ".blend"), copy=True)

sc = bpy.context.scene
tr = time.time()
if frames == list(range(frames[0], frames[-1] + 1)) and len(frames) > 1:
    sc.frame_start, sc.frame_end = frames[0], frames[-1]
    sc.render.filepath = os.path.join(out, "####")
    bpy.ops.render.render(animation=True)
elif spec.startswith("odd") and len(frames) > 1 and frames == list(range(frames[0], frames[-1] + 1, 2)):
    # every other frame via the animation path (random access -> baked above when ctx.needs_bake)
    sc.frame_start, sc.frame_end, sc.frame_step = frames[0], frames[-1], 2
    sc.render.filepath = os.path.join(out, "####")
    bpy.ops.render.render(animation=True)
else:
    for f in frames:
        sc.frame_set(f)
        sc.render.filepath = os.path.join(out, "%04d.png" % f)
        bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
dt = time.time() - tr
print("RENDER_TIME %.1fs for %d frames (%.2fs/frame)" % (dt, len(frames), dt / max(1, len(frames))))
core.save_post(ctx, os.path.join(out, "post.json"))

if sheet:
    import subprocess
    files = [os.path.join(out, "%04d.png" % f) for f in sheet]
    dst = os.path.join(out, "sheet.png")
    labels = []
    for f, p in zip(sheet, files):
        labels += ["-label", "f%d" % f, p]
    subprocess.run(["montage", *labels, "-tile", "%dx" % min(len(files), 6), "-geometry", "+3+3",
                    "-background", "#222", "-fill", "white", "-pointsize", "14", dst], check=False)
    print("SHEET", dst)

"""Non-human asset catalog + loader for "Psalm 22": animals (rigged, with procedural gait / roar cycles)
and period props (procedural or Poly Haven / Objaverse models), all in real-world size.

    import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/home/user/game1/psalm22/blender")
    from lib import assets as A
    A.names()                         # every asset name; A.names("animal") / A.names("prop")
    A.info("gladius")                 # catalog entry: description, size, variants, source, credit
    sword = A.load("gladius", loc=(0, 0, 0), rot_z=30)            # -> root object
    lion = A.animal("lion", "walk", loc=(0, 6, 0), rot_z=0, start_frame=1, speed=1.0, move=True)
    A.list_actions("lion")            # ['idle', 'walk', 'stalk', 'run', 'roar', ...]

Conventions (every asset):
- metres, Z up, origin at the base (on the ground plane z=0 when loc z=0), "front" faces -Y
  (i.e. toward a default camera standing at -Y looking +Y). rot_z is in DEGREES (like core.py).
- props return an EMPTY root with the parts parented to it; animals return the ARMATURE object.
- anchors are stored on the root as custom properties in root-local coordinates, e.g.
  root["grip"], root["tip"], root["flame"] (wick tip for lamps/candles), root["mouth"].
- materials are Principled BSDF tuned for EEVEE Next and shared between instances (A_* names).
- downloaded / converted model files live in /opt/assets/models (cache/ holds normalised .blends,
  rebuilt automatically when missing).
Full reference: psalm22/docs/assets.md.
"""

def names(kind=None):
    """All catalog names (optionally only kind='animal' / 'prop')."""
    return sorted(k for k, v in CATALOG.items() if kind is None or v["kind"] == kind)


def info(name):
    e = dict(CATALOG[name])
    if name in ANIMALS:
        a = ANIMALS[name]
        e["variants_detail"] = [dict(uid=v["uid"], title=v.get("title"), author=v.get("author"),
                                     license=v.get("license")) for v in a]
        e["actions"] = list_actions(name)
    return e


def credits():
    """List of (asset, title, author, license, url) for every non-CC0 model the catalog can load."""
    out = []
    for n, vs in ANIMALS.items():
        for v in vs:
            out.append((n, v.get("title"), v.get("author"), v.get("license"),
                        "https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/" + v["uid"]))
    return out


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Public loader
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def load(name, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot_z=0.0, scale=1.0, coll=None, variant=0, **opts):
    """Create an asset instance. Returns the root object (EMPTY for props, ARMATURE for animals).
    name: catalog name, a PH alias ('ph_jug') or 'ph:<polyhaven_asset>'.
    loc: base position; rot_z: degrees about Z; scale: uniform multiplier of the real-world size."""
    if name.startswith("ph:") or name in PH_ALIASES:
        root = _load_polyhaven(PH_ALIASES.get(name, name[3:]), coll, **opts)
    elif name in ANIMALS:
        root = _animal_instance(name, variant, coll, **opts)
    elif name in CATALOG:
        key = (name, variant, json.dumps(opts, sort_keys=True, default=str))
        src = _PROP_CACHE.get(key)
        try:
            ok = src is not None and bpy.data.objects.get(src.name) is src and src.users > 0
        except ReferenceError:
            ok = False
        if ok:
            root = _copy_hierarchy(src, coll)       # linked duplicate: shares meshes/materials
        else:
            builder = globals()["_build_" + name]
            rnd = random.Random(zlib.crc32(("%s|%d" % (name, variant)).encode()))
            root = _new_root(name, coll)
            parts = builder(variant=variant, rnd=rnd, coll=coll, root=root, **opts)
            for p in parts:
                if p.parent is None:
                    p.parent = root
            _PROP_CACHE[key] = root
    else:
        raise KeyError("unknown asset %r; see assets.names()" % name)
    root["asset"] = name
    root["variant"] = variant
    root.location = loc
    root.rotation_euler = (0, 0, math.radians(rot_z))
    s = scale if isinstance(scale, (tuple, list)) else (scale, scale, scale)
    root.scale = s
    return root


_PROP_CACHE = {}


def _copy_hierarchy(src, coll):
    """Duplicate an asset hierarchy (objects copied, mesh data shared) keeping custom properties."""
    def cp(o, parent):
        d = o.copy()
        d.animation_data_clear()
        C.link(d, coll)
        if parent is not None:
            d.parent = parent
            d.matrix_parent_inverse = o.matrix_parent_inverse.copy()
        for c in o.children:
            cp(c, d)
        return d
    r = cp(src, None)
    r.location = (0, 0, 0)
    r.rotation_euler = (0, 0, 0)
    r.scale = (1, 1, 1)
    return r


def _new_root(name, coll):
    r = bpy.data.objects.new(name, None)
    r.empty_display_type = "PLAIN_AXES"
    r.empty_display_size = 0.1
    C.link(r, coll)
    return r


def _obj(name, me, coll):
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    C.link(o, coll)
    return o


def children_recursive(root):
    out = []
    for c in root.children:
        out.append(c)
        out += children_recursive(c)
    return out


def set_visible_frames(root, f_in=None, f_out=None):
    """Keyframe render/viewport visibility of a whole asset hierarchy (shown from f_in, hidden from f_out)."""
    for o in [root] + children_recursive(root):
        if f_in is not None:
            o.hide_render = True
            o.keyframe_insert("hide_render", frame=f_in - 1)
            o.hide_render = False
            o.keyframe_insert("hide_render", frame=f_in)
        if f_out is not None:
            o.hide_render = False
            o.keyframe_insert("hide_render", frame=f_out - 1)
            o.hide_render = True
            o.keyframe_insert("hide_render", frame=f_out)


def bounds(root):
    """World-space (min, max) Vector bounds of all meshes under root (evaluated, posed)."""
    dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    mn = Vector((1e9, 1e9, 1e9))
    mx = -mn
    for o in [root] + children_recursive(root):
        if o.type != "MESH":
            continue
        for c in o.evaluated_get(dg).bound_box:
            p = o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)
            mn = Vector(map(min, mn, p))
            mx = Vector(map(max, mx, p))
    return mn, mx


def anchor(root, key):
    """World position of an anchor stored on root (e.g. 'flame', 'grip', 'tip', 'mouth')."""
    return root.matrix_world @ Vector(root[key])


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mesh helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _bm_to_obj(name, bm, coll, smooth=True):
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    if smooth:
        for p in me.polygons:
            p.use_smooth = True
    return _obj(name, me, coll)


def _lathe(name, profile, seg=48, coll=None, smooth=True, wobble=0.0, seed=0, ellip=(1.0, 1.0),
           uv=True, axis_offset=(0.0, 0.0)):
    """Surface of revolution around Z. profile: [(r, z), ...] in order; r==0 at an end -> cap to a
    point. wobble adds hand-made irregularity (fraction of r). ellip scales x/y."""
    bm = bmesh.new()
    rings = []
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    ph1, ph2 = rnd.random() * 6.28, rnd.random() * 6.28
    for (r, z) in profile:
        ring = []
        if r <= 1e-7:
            ring = [bm.verts.new((axis_offset[0], axis_offset[1], z))]
        else:
            for i in range(seg):
                a = 2 * math.pi * i / seg
                w = 1.0 + wobble * (math.sin(2 * a + ph1 + z * 9) * 0.6 + math.sin(3 * a + ph2 - z * 5) * 0.4)
                ring.append(bm.verts.new((axis_offset[0] + math.cos(a) * r * w * ellip[0],
                                          axis_offset[1] + math.sin(a) * r * w * ellip[1], z)))
        rings.append(ring)
    bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
    # cumulative length for v
    L = [0.0]
    for i in range(1, len(profile)):
        L.append(L[-1] + math.hypot(profile[i][0] - profile[i - 1][0], profile[i][1] - profile[i - 1][1]))
    tot = L[-1] or 1.0
    faces = []
    for k in range(len(rings) - 1):
        a, b = rings[k], rings[k + 1]
        if len(a) == 1 and len(b) == 1:
            continue
        if len(a) == 1:
            for i in range(seg):
                faces.append((bm.faces.new((a[0], b[i], b[(i + 1) % seg])), k, i))
        elif len(b) == 1:
            for i in range(seg):
                faces.append((bm.faces.new((a[i], b[0], a[(i + 1) % seg])), k, i))
        else:
            for i in range(seg):
                faces.append((bm.faces.new((a[i], b[i], b[(i + 1) % seg], a[(i + 1) % seg])), k, i))
    if uv:
        lay = bm.loops.layers.uv.new("UVMap")
        for f, k, i in faces:
            for lp in f.loops:
                v = lp.vert
                # find ring index
                z = v.co.z
                kk = k if abs(z - profile[k][1]) < abs(z - profile[min(k + 1, len(profile) - 1)][1]) else k + 1
                ang = math.atan2(v.co.y - axis_offset[1], v.co.x - axis_offset[0]) % (2 * math.pi)
                u = ang / (2 * math.pi)
                if i == seg - 1 and u < 0.5:
                    u += 1.0
                lp[lay].uv = (u, L[kk] / tot)
    bm.normal_update()
    o = _bm_to_obj(name, bm, coll, smooth)
    _recalc_normals(o)
    return o


def _recalc_normals(o, inside=False):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bm.from_mesh(o.data)
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces)
    if inside:
        bmesh.ops.reverse_faces(bm, faces=bm.faces)
    bm.to_mesh(o.data)
    bm.free()


def _loft(name, sections, coll=None, cap_start=True, cap_end=True, smooth=True, closed=True):
    """Loft through cross-sections: list of lists of 3D points (same count). Caps with n-gons."""
    bm = bmesh.new()
    rings = [[bm.verts.new(p) for p in s] for s in sections]
    n = len(sections[0])
    for k in range(len(rings) - 1):
        a, b = rings[k], rings[k + 1]
        for i in range(n if closed else n - 1):
            j = (i + 1) % n
            bm.faces.new((a[i], a[j], b[j], b[i]))
    if cap_start:
        bm.faces.new(list(reversed(rings[0])))
    if cap_end:
        bm.faces.new(rings[-1])
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces)
    return _bm_to_obj(name, bm, coll, smooth)


def _tube(name, pts, radius, coll=None, seg=12, cap=True, radius_fn=None):
    """Mesh tube along a polyline (radius or radius_fn(t))."""
    pts = [Vector(p) for p in pts]
    secs = []
    up = Vector((0, 0, 1))
    for i, p in enumerate(pts):
        t = i / (len(pts) - 1)
        d = (pts[min(i + 1, len(pts) - 1)] - pts[max(i - 1, 0)]).normalized()
        a = d.cross(up)
        if a.length < 1e-4:
            a = d.cross(Vector((1, 0, 0)))
        a.normalize()
        b = d.cross(a).normalized()
        r = radius_fn(t) if radius_fn else radius
        secs.append([p + (a * math.cos(2 * math.pi * k / seg) + b * math.sin(2 * math.pi * k / seg)) * r
                     for k in range(seg)])
    return _loft(name, secs, coll, cap, cap)


def _apply_mods(o):
    """Apply all modifiers (context-free)."""
    dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(o.evaluated_get(dg), preserve_all_data_layers=True, depsgraph=dg)
    old = o.data
    o.modifiers.clear()
    o.data = me
    if old.users == 0:
        bpy.data.meshes.remove(old)
    return o


def _remesh(o, voxel, smooth=True, adaptivity=0.0):
    m = o.modifiers.new("remesh", "REMESH")
    m.mode = "VOXEL"
    m.voxel_size = voxel
    m.adaptivity = adaptivity
    m.use_smooth_shade = smooth
    return _apply_mods(o)


def _join(objs, name=None):
    """Join mesh objects into the first one (context-free via bmesh)."""
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    base = objs[0]
    bm = bmesh.new()
    mats = []
    for o in objs:
        me = o.data
        tmp = me.copy()
        tmp.transform(base.matrix_world.inverted() @ o.matrix_world)
        # remap material indices
        remap = []
        for m in me.materials:
            if m not in mats:
                mats.append(m)
            remap.append(mats.index(m))
        if remap:
            for p in tmp.polygons:
                p.material_index = remap[p.material_index] if p.material_index < len(remap) else 0
        bm.from_mesh(tmp)
        bpy.data.meshes.remove(tmp)
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name or base.name)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    for m in mats:
        me.materials.append(m)
    old = base.data
    base.data = me
    for o in objs[1:]:
        d = o.data
        bpy.data.objects.remove(o)
        if d.users == 0:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(d)
    if old.users == 0:
        bpy.data.meshes.remove(old)
    if name:
        base.name = name
    return base


def _noise_displace(o, amp, scale, seed=0.0, along_normal=True, fn=None):
    """Displace vertices by mathutils fbm noise (deterministic). Normals are sampled once up front
    (accessing v.normal while editing coordinates would recompute them every time)."""
    import numpy as np
    me = o.data
    n = len(me.vertices)
    co = np.empty(n * 3, np.float32)
    me.vertices.foreach_get("co", co)
    co = co.reshape(-1, 3)
    nr = np.empty(n * 3, np.float32)
    me.vertices.foreach_get("normal", nr)
    nr = nr.reshape(-1, 3)
    off = Vector((seed * 13.1, seed * 7.7, seed * 3.3))
    fr = noise.fractal
    if along_normal:
        vals = np.array([fr(Vector(c) * scale + off, 0.5, 2.0, 4) if fn is None else fn(Vector(c)) for c in co],
                        np.float32)
        co += nr * (vals[:, None] * amp)
    else:
        nz = noise.noise
        d = np.array([(nz(Vector(c) * scale + off), nz(Vector(c) * scale + off + Vector((5.2, 1.3, 2.8))),
                       nz(Vector(c) * scale + off + Vector((1.7, 9.2, 3.4)))) for c in co], np.float32)
        co += d * amp
    me.vertices.foreach_set("co", co.ravel())
    me.update()


def _assign(o, m):
    o.data.materials.clear()
    o.data.materials.append(m)
    return o


def _smooth(o, angle=None):
    for p in o.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth = True
    if angle is not None:
        try:
            m = o.modifiers.new("autosmooth", "NODES")
            m.node_group = _smooth_by_angle_group()
            m["Input_1"] = math.radians(angle)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return o


def _smooth_by_angle_group():
    g = bpy.data.node_groups.get("A_SmoothByAngle")
    if g:
        return g
    g = bpy.data.node_groups.new("A_SmoothByAngle", "GeometryNodeTree")
    gi = g.nodes.new("NodeGroupInput")
    go = g.nodes.new("NodeGroupOutput")
    g.interface.new_socket("Geometry", in_out="INPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketGeometry")
    s = g.interface.new_socket("Angle", in_out="INPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketFloat")
    s.default_value = math.radians(30)
    g.interface.new_socket("Geometry", in_out="OUTPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketGeometry")
    ea = g.nodes.new("GeometryNodeInputMeshEdgeAngle")
    cmp = g.nodes.new("FunctionNodeCompare")
    cmp.data_type = "FLOAT"
    cmp.operation = "GREATER_THAN"
    ss = g.nodes.new("GeometryNodeSetShadeSmooth")
    ss.domain = "EDGE"
    nt = g.links
    nt.new(ea.outputs["Unsigned Angle"], cmp.inputs[0])
    nt.new(gi.outputs[1], cmp.inputs[1])
    nt.new(gi.outputs[0], ss.inputs["Geometry"])
    inv = g.nodes.new("FunctionNodeBooleanMath")
    inv.operation = "NOT"
    nt.new(cmp.outputs[0], inv.inputs[0])
    nt.new(inv.outputs[0], ss.inputs["Shade Smooth"])
    nt.new(ss.outputs[0], go.inputs[0])
    return g


def _bevel(o, width, segments=2, limit="ANGLE", angle=40):
    m = o.modifiers.new("bevel", "BEVEL")
    m.width = width
    m.segments = segments
    m.limit_method = limit
    if limit == "ANGLE":
        m.angle_limit = math.radians(angle)
    m.harden_normals = False
    return m


def _subsurf(o, levels=1, render=None):
    m = o.modifiers.new("subsurf", "SUBSURF")
    m.levels = levels
    m.render_levels = levels if render is None else render
    return m


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Materials (shared per scene by name)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _new_mat(name):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    return m, m.node_tree.nodes, m.node_tree.links, m.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]


def _pmat(name, c1, c2=None, scale=10.0, detail=6.0, rough=0.5, rough2=None, metal=0.0, metal2=None,
          bump=0.0, bump_scale=None, bump_dist=0.002, sss=0.0, sss_radius=(1.0, 0.5, 0.25), sss_scale=0.01,
          spec=0.5, coat=0.0, coat_rough=0.1, sheen=0.0, ramp=(0.3, 0.7), c3=None, c3_scale=2.0, c3_amount=0.0,
          c3_rough=None, c3_metal=None, stretch=(1, 1, 1), ior=1.45, voronoi_bump=0.0, voronoi_scale=40.0,
          emission=None, emission_strength=0.0):
    """Procedural two/three-tone Principled material in object space (no UVs needed).
    c1/c2 mixed by fbm noise (ramp positions), optional c3 patches (large-scale noise), bump from noise."""
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name)
    if m:
        return m
    m, N, L, b = _new_mat(name)
    tc = N.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
    mp = N.new("ShaderNodeMapping")
    mp.inputs["Scale"].default_value = stretch
    L.new(tc.outputs["Object"], mp.inputs["Vector"])
    nz = N.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
    nz.inputs["Scale"].default_value = scale
    nz.inputs["Detail"].default_value = detail
    nz.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.6
    L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], nz.inputs["Vector"])
    cr = N.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
    cr.color_ramp.elements[0].position = ramp[0]
    cr.color_ramp.elements[1].position = ramp[1]
    L.new(nz.outputs["Fac"], cr.inputs["Fac"])
    fac = cr.outputs["Color"]

    def mixf(a, bb, f):
        n = N.new("ShaderNodeMix")
        n.data_type = "FLOAT"
        n.inputs[2].default_value = a
        n.inputs[3].default_value = bb
        L.new(f, n.inputs[0])
        return n.outputs[0]

    def mixc(a, bb, f):
        n = N.new("ShaderNodeMix")
        n.data_type = "RGBA"
        if isinstance(a, tuple):
            n.inputs[6].default_value = (*a[:3], 1)
        else:
            L.new(a, n.inputs[6])
        if isinstance(bb, tuple):
            n.inputs[7].default_value = (*bb[:3], 1)
        else:
            L.new(bb, n.inputs[7])
        L.new(f, n.inputs[0])
        return n.outputs[2]

    col = mixc(tuple(c1), tuple(c2 or c1), fac)
    rgh = mixf(rough, rough if rough2 is None else rough2, fac)
    mtl = mixf(metal, metal if metal2 is None else metal2, fac)
    if c3 is not None and c3_amount > 0:
        nz3 = N.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
        nz3.inputs["Scale"].default_value = c3_scale
        nz3.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 8
        L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], nz3.inputs["Vector"])
        cr3 = N.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
        cr3.color_ramp.elements[0].position = 1.0 - c3_amount
        cr3.color_ramp.elements[1].position = min(1.0, 1.0 - c3_amount + 0.12)
        L.new(nz3.outputs["Fac"], cr3.inputs["Fac"])
        f3 = cr3.outputs["Color"]
        col = mixc(col, tuple(c3), f3)
        if c3_rough is not None:
            rgh = mixf(0, c3_rough, f3) if False else _mix_sock(N, L, rgh, c3_rough, f3)
        if c3_metal is not None:
            mtl = _mix_sock(N, L, mtl, c3_metal, f3)
    L.new(col, b.inputs["Base Color"])
    L.new(rgh, b.inputs["Roughness"])
    L.new(mtl, b.inputs["Metallic"])
    b.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value = spec
    b.inputs["IOR"].default_value = ior
    if sss:
        b.inputs["Subsurface Weight"].default_value = sss
        b.inputs["Subsurface Radius"].default_value = sss_radius
        b.inputs["Subsurface Scale"].default_value = sss_scale
    if coat:
        b.inputs["Coat Weight"].default_value = coat
        b.inputs["Coat Roughness"].default_value = coat_rough
    if sheen:
        b.inputs["Sheen Weight"].default_value = sheen
    if emission:
        b.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (*emission, 1)
        b.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = emission_strength
    hgt = None
    if bump:
        nzb = N.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
        nzb.inputs["Scale"].default_value = bump_scale or scale * 4
        nzb.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 8
        L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], nzb.inputs["Vector"])
        hgt = nzb.outputs["Fac"]
    if voronoi_bump:
        vo = N.new("ShaderNodeTexVoronoi")
        vo.feature = "DISTANCE_TO_EDGE" if False else "F1"
        vo.inputs["Scale"].default_value = voronoi_scale
        L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], vo.inputs["Vector"])
        mth = N.new("ShaderNodeMath")
        mth.operation = "MULTIPLY_ADD"
        mth.inputs[1].default_value = voronoi_bump
        if hgt is not None:
            L.new(hgt, mth.inputs[2])
        L.new(vo.outputs["Distance"], mth.inputs[0])
        hgt = mth.outputs[0]
    if hgt is not None:
        bp = N.new("ShaderNodeBump")
        bp.inputs["Strength"].default_value = min(1.0, bump if bump else 0.5)
        bp.inputs["Distance"].default_value = bump_dist
        L.new(hgt, bp.inputs["Height"])
        L.new(bp.outputs["Normal"], b.inputs["Normal"])
        if coat:
            L.new(bp.outputs["Normal"], b.inputs["Coat Normal"]) if False else None
    return m


def _mix_sock(N, L, a_sock, bval, f):
    n = N.new("ShaderNodeMix")
    n.data_type = "FLOAT"
    L.new(a_sock, n.inputs[2])
    n.inputs[3].default_value = bval
    L.new(f, n.inputs[0])
    return n.outputs[0]


def mat_clay(kind="terracotta"):
    """Fired clay: 'terracotta' (orange-red), 'buff' (pale), 'grey' (grey-buff), 'dark' (sooty brown),
    'break' (fresh broken edge, lighter), 'slip' (burnished red slip). Includes fire-clouding, throwing
    rings (bump bands along Z), and grime toward the base (object z < 8 cm)."""
    name = "A_clay_" + kind
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name)
    if m:
        return m
    P = {"terracotta": ((0.36, 0.14, 0.065), (0.50, 0.23, 0.11), (0.13, 0.065, 0.04)),
         "buff": ((0.45, 0.30, 0.18), (0.58, 0.42, 0.27), (0.20, 0.13, 0.08)),
         "grey": ((0.27, 0.23, 0.19), (0.38, 0.33, 0.27), (0.10, 0.09, 0.08)),
         "dark": ((0.20, 0.10, 0.055), (0.29, 0.155, 0.085), (0.06, 0.045, 0.035)),
         "break": ((0.55, 0.30, 0.16), (0.66, 0.40, 0.22), (0.42, 0.23, 0.12)),
         "slip": ((0.32, 0.085, 0.04), (0.42, 0.13, 0.06), (0.12, 0.05, 0.03))}[kind]
    m = _pmat(name, P[0], P[1], scale=9.0, rough=0.8 if kind != "slip" else 0.5, rough2=0.92,
              bump=0.35, bump_scale=110.0, bump_dist=0.0006, c3=P[2], c3_scale=2.2, c3_amount=0.3, c3_rough=0.95,
              voronoi_bump=0.12, voronoi_scale=220.0, spec=0.35, ramp=(0.25, 0.75))
    N, L = m.node_tree.nodes, m.node_tree.links
    b = N["Principled BSDF"]
    tc = next(n for n in N if n.type == "TEX_COORD")
    # grime toward the base
    sep = N.new("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ")
    L.new(tc.outputs["Object"], sep.inputs[0])
    mr = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
    mr.inputs["From Min"].default_value = 0.0
    mr.inputs["From Max"].default_value = 0.09
    mr.inputs["To Min"].default_value = 0.55
    mr.inputs["To Max"].default_value = 1.0
    L.new(sep.outputs["Z"], mr.inputs["Value"])
    src = b.inputs["Base Color"].links[0].from_socket
    mul = N.new("ShaderNodeMix")
    mul.data_type = "RGBA"
    mul.blend_type = "MULTIPLY"
    mul.inputs[0].default_value = 1.0
    L.new(src, mul.inputs[6])
    cmb = N.new("ShaderNodeCombineXYZ")
    for i in range(3):
        L.new(mr.outputs["Result"], cmb.inputs[i])
    L.new(cmb.outputs[0], mul.inputs[7])
    L.new(mul.outputs[2], b.inputs["Base Color"])
    # throwing rings: wave bands along Z added to the bump height
    bp = b.inputs["Normal"].links[0].from_node if b.inputs["Normal"].links else None
    if bp is not None and bp.type == "BUMP":
        wv = N.new("ShaderNodeTexWave")
        wv.wave_type = "BANDS"
        wv.bands_direction = "Z"
        wv.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 40.0
        wv.inputs["Distortion"].default_value = 2.0
        wv.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 1.0
        L.new(tc.outputs["Object"], wv.inputs["Vector"])
        add = N.new("ShaderNodeMath")
        add.operation = "MULTIPLY_ADD"
        add.inputs[1].default_value = 0.6
        L.new(wv.outputs["Fac"], add.inputs[0])
        L.new(bp.inputs["Height"].links[0].from_socket, add.inputs[2])
        L.new(add.outputs[0], bp.inputs["Height"])
    return m


def mat_iron(rust=0.5, scale=60.0):
    """Hand-forged iron: dark metal with rust patches (rust 0..1). scale = noise frequency in object space
    (use ~60 for nails/small parts, ~25 for larger pieces)."""
    key = "A_iron_%02d_%d" % (int(rust * 10), int(scale))
    return _pmat(key, (0.085, 0.080, 0.076), (0.15, 0.135, 0.12), scale=scale, rough=0.42, rough2=0.66, metal=0.8,
                 metal2=0.55, bump=0.5, bump_scale=scale * 7, bump_dist=0.0003, c3=(0.24, 0.085, 0.03),
                 c3_scale=scale * 0.6, c3_amount=0.12 + 0.5 * rust, c3_rough=0.9, c3_metal=0.0,
                 voronoi_bump=0.3, voronoi_scale=scale * 12)

                 c3_scale=10.0, c3_amount=0.14 * worn / 0.3, c3_rough=0.75, c3_metal=0.5)


def mat_gold(tone="yellow"):

def mat_gem(kind="ruby"):
    c = {"ruby": (0.45, 0.005, 0.02), "emerald": (0.01, 0.30, 0.08), "sapphire": (0.01, 0.04, 0.45),
         "amethyst": (0.22, 0.03, 0.35), "pearl": (0.85, 0.82, 0.76), "garnet": (0.25, 0.01, 0.015),
         "topaz": (0.8, 0.45, 0.05)}[kind]
    name = "A_gem_" + kind
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name)
    if m:
        return m
    m, N, L, b = _new_mat(name)
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*c, 1)
    if kind == "pearl":
        b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.25
        b.inputs["Coat Weight"].default_value = 0.6
        b.inputs["Sheen Weight"].default_value = 0.4
        b.inputs["Subsurface Weight"].default_value = 0.3
    else:
        b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.03
        b.inputs["IOR"].default_value = 1.77
        b.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value = 1.0
        b.inputs["Coat Weight"].default_value = 1.0
        b.inputs["Coat Roughness"].default_value = 0.0
        b.inputs["Subsurface Weight"].default_value = 0.6
        b.inputs["Subsurface Radius"].default_value = c
        b.inputs["Subsurface Scale"].default_value = 0.004
        b.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (*c, 1)
        b.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = 0.15
    return m

def mat_wood(kind="boxwood"):
    """Small-prop woods from Poly Haven scans (box-projected, no UVs needed):
    boxwood (pale), ash (light brown), olive (warm, figured), dark (dark brown)."""
    P = {"boxwood": ("fine_grained_wood", 5.0, (1.05, 0.88, 0.62)), "ash": ("fine_grained_wood", 3.5, (0.78, 0.66, 0.52)),
         "olive": ("fine_grained_wood", 3.0, (0.62, 0.48, 0.34)), "dark": ("dark_wood", 3.0, (0.8, 0.7, 0.6))}[kind]
    name = "A_wood_" + kind
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name)
    if m:
        return m
    try:
        return C.mat_pbr(P[0], scale=P[1], tint=P[2], name=name, blend=0.3)
    except Exception:
        return _pmat(name, (0.40, 0.29, 0.18), (0.52, 0.40, 0.26), scale=4.0, detail=10, rough=0.55, rough2=0.7,
                     bump=0.25, bump_scale=120.0, bump_dist=0.0004, stretch=(1, 14, 14), spec=0.4)

    return C.mat_pbr(asset, scale=scale, tint=tint, name="A_wpbr_" + asset)
