def _expand_units(d):
    out = {}
    for k, v in d.items():
        if k == "jaw":
            continue
        if k in UNITS:
            out[k] = out.get(k, 0) + v
            continue
        head, rest = k.split("-", 1)
        hits = [u for u in ("%s-left-%s" % (head, rest), "%s-right-%s" % (head, rest)) if u in UNITS]
        if not hits:
            _log("unknown expression unit", k)
        for u in hits:
            out[u] = out.get(u, 0) + v
    return out


def _unit_race(p):
    sk = ETHNICITY.get(p.spec["ethnicity"], ETHNICITY["judean"])["skin"]
    return {"african": "african", "asian": "asian"}.get(sk, "caucasian")


def _proxy_maps(p):
    """mhclo correspondence for proxies that must follow face shape keys (brows, lashes)."""
    if getattr(p, "_pmaps", None) is not None:
        return p._pmaps
    M = _mpfb()
    p._pmaps = {}
    for key, kind in (("eyebrows", "eyebrows"), ("eyelashes", "eyelashes")):
        o = p.parts.get(key)
        if not o:
            continue
        name = p.spec["eyebrows"] if key == "eyebrows" else ("eyelashes01" if p.spec["gender"] >= 0.5 else "eyelashes02")
        path = _asset_path(kind, name)
        mh = M["Mhclo"]()
        mh.load(path)
        n = len(o.data.vertices)
        idx = np.zeros((n, 3), np.int32)
        wt = np.zeros((n, 3), np.float32)
        for vi, mp in mh.verts.items():
            if vi < n:
                idx[vi] = mp["verts"]
                wt[vi] = mp["weights"]
        p._pmaps[key] = (o, idx, wt)
    return p._pmaps


def _ensure_units(p, units):
    TS = _mpfb()["TS"]
    body = p.body
    new = [u for u in units if u not in p.expr_keys]
    if not new:
        return
    if body.data.shape_keys is None:
        body.shape_key_add(name="Basis", from_mix=False)
    race = _unit_race(p)
    basis = _coords(body.data)
    pm = _proxy_maps(p)
    for u in new:
        path = os.path.join(MPFB_SYS, "targets", "expression", "units", race, u + ".target.gz")
        kb = TS.load_target(body, path, weight=0.0, name="ex-" + u)
        p.expr_keys[u] = kb.name
        co = np.zeros(len(basis) * 3, np.float32)
        kb.data.foreach_get("co", co)
        delta = co.reshape(-1, 3) - basis
        for key, (o, idx, wt) in pm.items():
            if o.data.shape_keys is None:
                o.shape_key_add(name="Basis", from_mix=False)
            pk = o.shape_key_add(name="ex-" + u, from_mix=False)
            pc = _coords(o.data)
            pd = (delta[idx] * wt[:, :, None]).sum(1)
            pk.data.foreach_set("co", (pc + pd).astype(np.float32).ravel())
            pk.value = 0.0


def _shape_objects(p):
    out = [p.body]
    for key in ("eyebrows", "eyelashes"):
        if key in p.parts and p.parts[key].data.shape_keys:
            out.append(p.parts[key])
    return out


def _set_units(p, weights, frame=None, only=None):
    _ensure_units(p, [u for u, w in weights.items() if w > 0.0])
    for o in _shape_objects(p):
        if o.data.shape_keys is None:
            continue
        kbs = o.data.shape_keys.key_blocks
        for u in p.expr_keys:
            if only is not None and u not in only:
                continue
            kb = kbs.get("ex-" + u)
            if kb is None:
                continue
            kb.slider_min = -1.0
            kb.value = max(-1.0, min(1.0, weights.get(u, 0.0)))
            if frame is not None:
                kb.keyframe_insert("value", frame=frame)


def _jaw_q(p, deg):
    pb = p.rig.pose.bones["jaw"]
    b = pb.bone
    axis_local = b.matrix_local.to_3x3().inverted() @ LEFT
    q = Quaternion(axis_local, math.radians(deg))
    # sign check: the tail (chin) must move down
    t0 = b.matrix_local @ Vector((0, b.length, 0))
    t1 = b.matrix_local @ (q.to_matrix().to_4x4() @ Vector((0, b.length, 0)))
    if t1.z > t0.z and deg > 0:
        q = Quaternion(axis_local, -math.radians(deg))
    return q


def expression(person, name="neutral", weight=1.0, frame=None, extra=None):
    """Set a facial expression (name in EXPRESSIONS or a dict of units, incl. 'jaw': deg).
    weight scales it; frame keys it (blend between keys over time). extra: dict added on top."""
    p = person
    d = dict(EXPRESSIONS.get(name, {}) if isinstance(name, str) else name)
    if extra:
        for k, v in extra.items():
            d[k] = d.get(k, 0) + v
    units = _expand_units(d)
    units = {u: v * weight for u, v in units.items()}
    # keep blink/closure state outside of expressions? expressions own the closure keys too
    _set_units(p, units, frame)
    p._expr = units
    p._jaw = d.get("jaw", 0.0) * weight
    pb = p.rig.pose.bones["jaw"]
    pb.rotation_quaternion = _jaw_q(p, p._jaw)
    if frame is not None:
        pb.keyframe_insert("rotation_quaternion", frame=frame, group="jaw")
    return units


def _apply_face_bones(p):
    pb = p.rig.pose.bones["jaw"]
    pb.rotation_quaternion = _jaw_q(p, getattr(p, "_jaw", 0.0))


def eyes_closed(person, amount=1.0, frame=None):
    """Close both eyelids (0 open .. 1 shut), optionally keyed."""
    p = person
    w = dict(p._expr)
    for u in ("eye-left-closure", "eye-right-closure"):
        w[u] = amount
    _set_units(p, w, frame, only={"eye-left-closure", "eye-right-closure"})
    p._expr = w


def blink(person, frame, duration=5):
    """Key a natural blink centred on frame (lids return to the current expression)."""
    p = person
    base = p._expr.get("eye-left-closure", 0.0)
    eyes_closed(p, base, frame - duration // 2)
    eyes_closed(p, 1.0, frame)
    eyes_closed(p, base, frame + duration - duration // 2)


def eyes_look(person, target, frame=None, limit=28.0, up_limit=12.0, down_limit=22.0):
    """Aim both eyes at a world point (call after posing; uses the evaluated pose). Yaw is clamped to
    `limit`, pitch to up_limit / down_limit degrees (the lids do not follow the eyeball, so looking
    far up would hide the iris - tilt the head instead)."""
    p = person
    p.update()
    mw = p.rig.matrix_world
    tgt = mw.inverted() @ Vector(target)
    for s in "LR":
        pb = p.rig.pose.bones["eye." + s]
        b = pb.bone
        par = pb.parent
        M0 = par.matrix @ (par.bone.matrix_local.inverted() @ b.matrix_local)
        y0 = M0.to_3x3().col[1].normalized()
        want = (tgt - M0.translation).normalized()
        # clamp in the head frame: yaw about the head's up, pitch about its left axis
        Hm = p.rig.pose.bones["head"].matrix.to_3x3().normalized()
        hup, hleft = Hm @ (p.rig.pose.bones["head"].bone.matrix_local.to_3x3().inverted() @ UP), None
        hfwd = y0
        hleft = hup.cross(hfwd).normalized()
        hup = hfwd.cross(hleft).normalized()
        x, yv, z = want.dot(hleft), want.dot(hfwd), want.dot(hup)
        yaw = max(-math.radians(limit), min(math.radians(limit), math.atan2(x, yv)))
        pitch = math.atan2(z, math.hypot(x, yv))
        pitch = max(-math.radians(down_limit), min(math.radians(up_limit), pitch))
        want = (hfwd * math.cos(yaw) + hleft * math.sin(yaw)) * math.cos(pitch) + hup * math.sin(pitch)
        q = y0.rotation_difference(want.normalized())
        R = q.to_matrix() @ M0.to_3x3().normalized()
        basis = M0.to_3x3().normalized().inverted() @ R
        pb.rotation_quaternion = basis.to_quaternion()
        if frame is not None:
            pb.keyframe_insert("rotation_quaternion", frame=frame, group=pb.name)


# ============================================================================================
# Cross helper
# ============================================================================================
def _box_dims(o):
    co = _coords(o.data)
    return Vector(co.min(0)), Vector(co.max(0))


def place_on_cross(person, cross_root, head="up", strain=0.6, knee_side=1.0, hands="cross", feet_z=None):
    """Hang a person on a core.wooden_cross (root empty returned by C.wooden_cross): hands meet the front
    of the crossbeam, back against the upright, feet together/overlapping against the upright.
    Returns dict of world contact points {'hand_L','hand_R','foot_L','foot_R','nail_feet'}."""
    p = person
    up = beam = None
    for ch in cross_root.children:
        if ch.name.endswith("_upright"):
            up = ch
        elif ch.name.endswith("_beam"):
            beam = ch
    umin, umax = _box_dims(up)
    bmin, bmax = _box_dims(beam)
    y_u = up.location.y + umin.y            # front of the upright (cross-local)
    y_b = beam.location.y + bmin.y          # front of the beam
    z_b = beam.location.z
    half_beam = beam.location.x + bmax.x
    # pass 1: pose in rig space to measure the shoulders
    p.rig.matrix_world = Matrix.Identity(4)
    P1 = _Pose(p)
    _pose_crucified(P1, p, head=head, strain=strain, knee_side=knee_side)
    sc = p.height / 1.75
    th = math.radians(14 + 16 * max(0, min(1, strain)))
    R = {s: P1.an["ua_len" + s] + P1.an["fa_len" + s] + P1.an["hand_len" + s] * 0.5 for s in "LR"}
    S = {s: P1.head("upperarm01." + s) for s in "LR"}
    # the back of the torso (rest mesh) -> distance from the rig origin
    co = p._co
    torso = co[(co[:, 2] > 0.55 * p.height) & (co[:, 2] < 0.8 * p.height) & (np.abs(co[:, 0]) < 0.1 * sc) & (p._w["body"] > 0.5)]
    y_back = float(torso[:, 1].max())
    off_y = y_u - y_back - 0.008
    sz = (S["L"].z + S["R"].z) / 2
    off_z = z_b - (sz + R["L"] * math.sin(th) * 0.97)
    hand_half = 0.016 * sc
    ht = {}
    for s in "LR":
        x = S[s].x + _lateral(s).x * R[s] * math.cos(th) * 0.97
        x = max(-half_beam + 0.06, min(half_beam - 0.06, x))
        ht[s] = Vector((x, y_b - hand_half - off_y, z_b - off_z + 0.005))
    # feet: ankles in front of the upright, knees bent and turned to one side
    ank_rest = (P1.head("foot.L").z + P1.head("foot.R").z) / 2
    raise_ = (0.10 + 0.1 * strain) * sc if feet_z is None else (feet_z - off_z)
    fy = y_u - off_y - 0.07 * sc
    ft = {"L": Vector((0.03 * sc * knee_side, fy, ank_rest + raise_)),
          "R": Vector((0.005 * sc * knee_side, fy - 0.045 * sc, ank_rest + raise_ + 0.03 * sc))}
    P = _Pose(p)
    _pose_crucified(P, p, head=head, strain=strain, knee_side=knee_side, hands=hands,
                    hand_targets=ht, feet_targets=ft)
    p.rig.matrix_world = cross_root.matrix_world @ Matrix.Translation((0, off_y, off_z))
    P.write()
    p._pose = P
    p._pose_name = "crucified"
    _apply_face_bones(p)
    p.update()
    mw = p.rig.matrix_world
    return {"hand_L": mw @ P.head("wrist.L").lerp(P.tail("metacarpal2.L"), 0.5),
            "hand_R": mw @ P.head("wrist.R").lerp(P.tail("metacarpal2.R"), 0.5),
            "foot_L": mw @ P.head("foot.L"), "foot_R": mw @ P.head("foot.R"),
            "nail_feet": mw @ ((P.head("foot.L") + P.head("foot.R")) / 2 + Vector((0, -0.03, -0.04)))}


# ============================================================================================
# Baking & crowds
# ============================================================================================
def _objcolor_material(m):
    """Copy of a material whose Object Info colour (e.g. wardrobe fabrics: colour = obj.color) is
    replaced by the 'obj_rgb' colour attribute written at bake time."""
    if m is None or not m.use_nodes:
        return m
    oi = [n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.bl_idname == "ShaderNodeObjectInfo" and n.outputs["Color"].is_linked]
    if not oi:
        return m
    name = m.name + ".baked"
    if name in bpy.data.materials:
        return bpy.data.materials[name]
    c = m.copy()
    c.name = name
    nt = c.node_tree
    for n in [n for n in nt.nodes if n.bl_idname == "ShaderNodeObjectInfo"]:
        at = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeAttribute")
        at.attribute_name = "obj_rgb"
        for l in list(n.outputs["Color"].links):
            nt.links.new(at.outputs["Color"], l.to_socket)
    return c


def bake_static(person, name=None, delete=True, coll=None, decimate=None):
    """Freeze a posed (and dressed) person into ONE mesh object (pose + modifiers applied, materials
    kept, world transform baked into the object transform = the rig's). Hair curves (beard) are kept
    as a child curves object with the deformation applied. Returns the mesh object."""
    p = person
    p.update()
    dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    rig_mw = p.rig.matrix_world.copy()
    inv = rig_mw.inverted()
    coll = coll or (p.rig.users_collection[0] if p.rig.users_collection else bpy.context.scene.collection)
    temps = []
    curves = []
    for o in p.objects():
        if o.hide_render or o == p.rig:
            continue
        if o.type == "MESH":
            oe = o.evaluated_get(dg)
            me = bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(oe, preserve_all_data_layers=True, depsgraph=dg)
            if len(me.vertices) == 0:
                bpy.data.meshes.remove(me)
                continue
            me.transform(inv @ o.matrix_world)
            # keep per-object colours (wardrobe fabrics use obj.color) as an attribute
            if any(m and m.use_nodes and any(n.bl_idname == "ShaderNodeObjectInfo" for n in m.node_tree.nodes) for m in me.materials):
                ca = me.color_attributes.new("obj_rgb", "FLOAT_COLOR", "POINT")
                ca.data.foreach_set("color", np.tile(np.array(o.color, np.float32), len(me.vertices)))
                for i, m in enumerate(me.materials):
                    me.materials[i] = _objcolor_material(m)
            t = bpy.data.objects.new(o.name + ".tmp", me)
            coll.objects.link(t)
            temps.append(t)
        elif o.type == "CURVES":
            curves.append(o)
    if not temps:
        return None
    base = temps[0]
    with bpy.context.temp_override(active_object=base, object=base, selected_objects=temps,
                                   selected_editable_objects=temps):
        bpy.ops.object.join()
    base.name = name or (p.name + ".baked")
    base.data.name = base.name
    base.matrix_world = rig_mw
    if decimate and decimate < 1.0:
        dm = base.modifiers.new("decimate", "DECIMATE")
        dm.ratio = decimate
        with bpy.context.temp_override(object=base, active_object=base):
            bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=dm.name)
    keep = []
    for cobj in curves:
        oe = cobj.evaluated_get(dg)
        try:
            cv = oe.data.copy()
        except Exception:
            cv = None
        if cv is None:
            continue
        cv.surface = None
        nc = bpy.data.objects.new(cobj.name + ".baked", cv)
        coll.objects.link(nc)
        nc.parent = base
        nc.matrix_parent_inverse = Matrix.Identity(4)
        nc.matrix_basis = inv @ cobj.matrix_world
        keep.append(nc)
    if delete:
        delete_person(p)
    return base


def delete_person(person):
    objs = person.objects()
    for o in objs:
        try:
            bpy.data.objects.remove(o, do_unlink=True)
        except Exception:
            pass


def _instance(src, loc, yaw, scale, coll):
    o = src.copy()
    coll.objects.link(o)
    o.location = loc
    o.rotation_euler = (0, 0, yaw)
    o.scale = (scale, scale, scale)
    for ch in src.children:
        c = ch.copy()
        coll.objects.link(c)
        c.parent = o
    return o


class Crowd:
    def __init__(self):
        self.sources = []
        self.instances = []
        self.people = []
        self.collection = None

    def __repr__(self):
        return "<Crowd %d instances of %d variants>" % (len(self.instances), len(self.sources))


def crowd(n, positions=None, area=None, seed=0, variety=6, pose="stand_relaxed", pose_fn=None, lod="mid",
          presets=("CROWD_MAN", "CROWD_WOMAN"), face=None, yaw=None, yaw_jitter=25.0, ground_z=0.0, height_fn=None,
          spacing=0.65, name="Crowd", outfit=None, colors=None, women=0.4, hide_sources=True, **spec):
    """Build `variety` unique dressed people, bake them, and scatter n linked duplicates.
    positions: [(x,y[,z]), ...] or area=(cx, cy, width, depth[, angle_deg]); face: world point every
    instance turns towards (else yaw deg, else random); pose: name or list of names (random per
    variant) or pose_fn(person, i). lod 'near'|'mid'|'far'. Extra spec keys pass to make_person.
    Returns Crowd (.instances, .sources, .collection)."""
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    cr = Crowd()
    coll = C.collection(name)
    cr.collection = coll
    src_coll = C.collection(name + "_src")
    lodmap = {"near": "hero", "mid": "mid", "far": "far"}
    # unique people: a deterministic share of women (round(variety * women)), shuffled by the seed
    nw = int(round(variety * women)) if len(presets) > 1 else 0
    if len(presets) > 1 and women > 0 and variety >= 2:
        nw = max(1, min(variety - 1, nw)) if 0 < women < 1 else nw
    kinds = [1] * nw + [0] * (variety - nw)
    rng.shuffle(kinds)
    for i in range(variety):
        pr = presets[min(kinds[i], len(presets) - 1)]
        sp = dict(spec)
        sp.update(seed=seed * 100 + i, lod=lodmap.get(lod, lod), pose=None, expression=None)
        if outfit:
            sp["outfit"] = outfit
        if colors:
            sp["outfit_colors"] = colors[i % len(colors)] if isinstance(colors, list) else colors
        per = make_person("%s_v%d" % (name, i), pr, **sp)
        if pose_fn:
            pose_fn(per, i)
        else:
            pn = pose[i % len(pose)] if isinstance(pose, (list, tuple)) else pose
            if isinstance(pn, tuple):
                globals()["pose"](per, pn[0], **pn[1])
            elif pn:
                globals()["pose"](per, pn)
        ex = per.spec.get("expression")
        if ex and ex != "neutral" and lod != "far":
            expression(per, ex)
        b = bake_static(per, name="%s_src%d" % (name, i), coll=src_coll, decimate=0.4 if lod == "far" else None)
        if b is None:
            continue
        b.location = (0, 0, -500)   # sources live far below the set
        cr.sources.append(b)
    if hide_sources:
        for o in src_coll.all_objects:
            o.hide_render = True
            o.hide_viewport = True
    # placements
    pts = []
    if positions is not None:
        pts = [tuple(q) for q in positions][:n] if n else [tuple(q) for q in positions]
    elif area is not None:
        cx, cy, w, d = area[:4]
        ang = math.radians(area[4]) if len(area) > 4 else 0.0
        tries = 0
        while len(pts) < n and tries < n * 60:
            tries += 1
            lx, ly = (rng.random() - 0.5) * w, (rng.random() - 0.5) * d
            x = cx + lx * math.cos(ang) - ly * math.sin(ang)
            y = cy + lx * math.sin(ang) + ly * math.cos(ang)
            if all((x - q[0]) ** 2 + (y - q[1]) ** 2 > spacing ** 2 for q in pts):
                pts.append((x, y))
    # balanced use of the variants (every source appears before any repeats), shuffled by the seed
    order = []
    while len(order) < len(pts) and cr.sources:
        blk = list(range(len(cr.sources)))
        rng.shuffle(blk)
        order += blk
    for i, q in enumerate(pts):
        x, y = q[0], q[1]
        z = q[2] if len(q) > 2 else (height_fn(x, y) if height_fn else ground_z)
        if face is not None:
            yw = math.atan2(face[0] - x, -(face[1] - y))
        elif yaw is not None:
            yw = math.radians(yaw)
        else:
            yw = rng.uniform(-math.pi, math.pi)
        yw += math.radians(rng.uniform(-yaw_jitter, yaw_jitter))
        src = cr.sources[order[i]]
        inst = _instance(src, (x, y, z), yw, rng.uniform(0.95, 1.05), coll)
        inst.hide_render = False
        inst.hide_viewport = False
        for c in inst.children:
            c.hide_render = c.hide_viewport = False
        cr.instances.append(inst)
    return cr


def clone(person, loc=(0, 0, 0), yaw=0.0, name=None, action_offset=0):
    """Animated linked copy of a person: new rig object sharing the armature + meshes (cheap), with
    its own transform. The rig action is shared (offset with action_offset frames via NLA)."""
    p = person
    name = name or p.name + "_c"
    coll = p.rig.users_collection[0]
    rig = p.rig.copy()
    rig.name = name
    coll.objects.link(rig)
    rig.location = loc
    rig.rotation_euler = (0, 0, yaw)
    if action_offset and rig.animation_data and rig.animation_data.action:
        act = rig.animation_data.action
        rig.animation_data.action = None
        tr = rig.animation_data.nla_tracks.new()
        st = tr.strips.new(act.name, int(1 + action_offset), act)
    mapping = {p.rig: rig}
    for o in p.objects()[1:]:
        c = o.copy()
        coll.objects.link(c)
        mapping[o] = c
    for o, c in mapping.items():
        if o is p.rig:
            continue
        c.parent = mapping.get(o.parent, rig)
        for m in getattr(c, "modifiers", []):
            if m.type == "ARMATURE":
                m.object = rig
        if c.type == "CURVES":
            c.data = o.data   # shared; surface stays the original body (fine for static distance shots)
    q = Person(name, rig, mapping[p.body], {k: mapping.get(v, v) for k, v in p.parts.items()}, p.spec)
    q.height = p.height
    q.lm = p.lm
    q.garments = [mapping.get(g, g) for g in p.garments]
    return q


# ============================================================================================
# Head hair strands (grown along the MPFB hair shell, bound to it by UV so they follow it)
# ============================================================================================
def _shell_data(shell):
    me = shell.data
    me.calc_loop_triangles()
    nt = len(me.loop_triangles)
    tv = np.zeros(nt * 3, np.int32)
    me.loop_triangles.foreach_get("vertices", tv)
    tl = np.zeros(nt * 3, np.int32)
    me.loop_triangles.foreach_get("loops", tl)
    uv = np.zeros(len(me.loops) * 2, np.float32)
    me.uv_layers[0].data.foreach_get("uv", uv)
    co = _coords(me)
    return co, tv.reshape(-1, 3), tl.reshape(-1, 3), uv.reshape(-1, 2)


def _tri_grad_v(P3, UV):
    """Per-triangle 3D gradient of the UV v coordinate (direction of increasing v on the surface)."""
    e1 = P3[:, 1] - P3[:, 0]
    e2 = P3[:, 2] - P3[:, 0]
    du1 = UV[:, 1] - UV[:, 0]
    du2 = UV[:, 2] - UV[:, 0]
    det = du1[:, 0] * du2[:, 1] - du1[:, 1] * du2[:, 0]
    det = np.where(np.abs(det) < 1e-12, 1e-12, det)
    # dP/dv = (-du2.u * e1 + du1.u * e2) / det
    dPdv = (-du2[:, 0:1] * e1 + du1[:, 0:1] * e2) / det[:, None]
    return dPdv


STRAND_VERSION = 6


def _hair_cache_path(key):
    d = os.path.join(C.WORK, "cache", "characters")
    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    return os.path.join(d, "hair_%s.npz" % key)


def make_hair_strands(p, count=None, points=16, length_scale=1.0, depth=(-0.001, 0.006), clump=0.55, frizz=0.0012,
                      seed=None, color=None, grey=None, flyaways=0.006):
    """Hero head hair: hair-curve strands that flow along the MPFB hair shell (root -> tip = UV v
    direction), bound per point to the shell's UV so they follow its armature deformation exactly.
    The shell stays as a dark under-layer. Returns the curves object (p.parts['hair_strands'])."""
    s = p.spec
    shell = p.parts.get("hair")
    if shell is None:
        return None
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed if seed is not None else s.get("seed", 0) + 101)
    co, tv, tl, uv = _shell_data(shell)
    N = int(count or (11000 if s["hair"] == "long01" else 7000))
    key = hashlib.md5(co.tobytes() + uv.tobytes() + str((STRAND_VERSION, N, points, depth, clump, frizz, length_scale, flyaways)).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    cp = _hair_cache_path(key)
    if os.path.exists(cp):
        dat = np.load(cp)
        pts, bidx, bw, pdep, rad = dat["pts"], dat["bidx"], dat["bw"], dat["pdep"], dat["rad"]
    else:
        pts, (bidx, bw), pdep, rad = _grow_shell_strands(p, shell, co, tv, tl, uv, N, points, length_scale, depth, clump, frizz, rng, flyaways)
        np.savez(cp, pts=pts, bidx=bidx, bw=bw, pdep=pdep, rad=rad)
    K = points
    cv = bpy.data.hair_curves.new(p.name + ".hair_strands")
    cv.add_curves([K] * len(pts))
    cv.position_data.foreach_set("vector", pts.astype(np.float32).ravel())
    if "radius" not in cv.attributes:
        cv.attributes.new("radius", "FLOAT", "POINT")
    cv.attributes["radius"].data.foreach_set("value", rad.astype(np.float32).ravel())
    for i in range(3):
        a = cv.attributes.new("bv%d" % i, "INT", "POINT")
        a.data.foreach_set("value", bidx[:, i].astype(np.int32))
        a = cv.attributes.new("bw%d" % i, "FLOAT", "POINT")
        a.data.foreach_set("value", bw[:, i].astype(np.float32))
    a = cv.attributes.new("shell_depth", "FLOAT", "POINT")
    a.data.foreach_set("value", pdep.astype(np.float32).ravel())
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(p.name + ".hair_strands", cv)
    for c in shell.users_collection:
        c.objects.link(ob)
    ob.parent = p.rig
    mod = ob.modifiers.new("follow_shell", "NODES")
    mod.node_group = _follow_shell_group()
    _set_mod_input(mod, "Shell", shell)
    hc = hair_color_rgb(color or s["hair_color"], 0.0)
    mat = curve_hair_material(p.name + ".strand_mat", hc, grey if grey is not None else s.get("grey", 0))
    cv.materials.append(mat)
    p.parts["hair_strands"] = ob
    p.mats["hair_strands"] = mat
    for m in list(shell.modifiers):          # strands are bound by vertex index: keep the shell topology
        if m.type == "SUBSURF":
            shell.modifiers.remove(m)
    # the shell becomes a darker, matte under-layer that fills the gaps between strands
    _shell_underlayer(p, 0.7, rough=0.6, spec=0.25)
    return ob


def _shell_underlayer(p, value=0.6, rough=0.65, spec=0.2):
    """Make the MPFB hair shell a darker, matte under-layer below hair curves (keeps its alpha)."""
    m = p.mats.get("hair")
    if m is None or m.get("ps22_under"):
        return
    nt = m.node_tree
    b = nt.nodes.get("Principled BSDF") or next((n for n in nt.nodes if n.bl_idname == "ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled"), None)
    if b is None:
        return
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    b.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value = spec
    ln = b.inputs["Base Color"].links
    if ln:
        mx = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMix")
        mx.data_type = "RGBA"
        mx.blend_type = "MULTIPLY"
        mx.inputs["Factor"].default_value = 1.0
        nt.links.new(ln[0].from_socket, mx.inputs[6])
        mx.inputs[7].default_value = (value, value, value, 1)
        nt.links.new(mx.outputs[2], b.inputs["Base Color"])
    m["ps22_under"] = 1


SHORT_HAIR = {   # MPFB short shells -> strand length (m), wave amplitude, lift (rad), count
    "short01": dict(length=0.022, wave=0.0010, lift=0.22, count=22000, fringe=0.0, sweep=0.3),
    "short02": dict(length=0.040, wave=0.0018, lift=0.16, count=24000, fringe=-0.15, sweep=0.55),
    "short03": dict(length=0.050, wave=0.0040, lift=0.20, count=24000, fringe=-0.1, sweep=0.5),
    "short04": dict(length=0.030, wave=0.0015, lift=0.18, count=20000, fringe=0.25, sweep=0.35),
    "afro01": dict(length=0.035, wave=0.0060, lift=0.55, count=24000, fringe=0.0, sweep=0.2),
}


def make_short_hair(p, length=None, count=None, points=6, seed=None, color=None, grey=None, part_side=1.0):
    """Short hero hair: hair curves rooted on the scalp (hair-bearing mask), combed along a crown-whorl
    direction field, lying in a layer up to the MPFB hair shell (which stays as a dark under-layer that
    gives the haircut its volume). Deformed with the body (Deform Curves on Surface), like the beard.
    Returns the curves object (p.parts['hair_strands'])."""
    s = p.spec
    shell = p.parts.get("hair")
    cfg = dict(SHORT_HAIR.get(s["hair"], SHORT_HAIR["short02"]))
    L = float(length or cfg["length"]) * (p.lm["io"] / 0.062)
    N = int(count or cfg["count"])
    K = int(points)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed if seed is not None else s.get("seed", 0) * 17 + 3)
    co, lm = p._co, p.lm
    sc = lm["io"] / 0.062
    hm = p.masks["hair"]
    tv, tl, area, uv, vn = _surface_data(p.body)
    inb = p._w["body"] > 0.5
    key = hashlib.md5(co.tobytes() + str((STRAND_VERSION, "short2", s["hair"], N, K, L, sorted(cfg.items()),
                                           part_side, seed, s.get("seed", 0))).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    cp = _hair_cache_path(key)
    if os.path.exists(cp):
        dat = np.load(cp)
        pts, ruv = dat["pts"], dat["ruv"]
    else:
        tm = hm[tv].mean(1) * inb[tv].all(1)
        sel = np.nonzero(tm > 0.05)[0]
        wts = area[sel] * tm[sel] ** 1.5
        ti = sel[rng.choice(len(sel), N, p=wts / wts.sum())]
        r1, r2 = rng.random(N), rng.random(N)
        s1 = np.sqrt(r1)
        bary = np.stack([1 - s1, s1 * (1 - r2), s1 * r2], 1)
        roots = (co[tv[ti]] * bary[:, :, None]).sum(1)
        ruv = (uv[tl[ti]] * bary[:, :, None]).sum(1)
        nrm = _norm((vn[tv[ti]] * bary[:, :, None]).sum(1))
        rm = (hm[tv[ti]] * bary).sum(1)
        # hair layer thickness at the root: distance from the scalp to the MPFB shell along the normal
        thick = np.full(N, 0.006 * sc)
        if shell is not None:
            sco = _coords(shell.data)
            sbvh = BVHTree.FromPolygons([tuple(c) for c in sco], [tuple(pl.vertices) for pl in shell.data.polygons])
            for i in range(N):
                hit = sbvh.ray_cast(Vector(roots[i]) + Vector(nrm[i]) * 0.0005, Vector(nrm[i]), 0.05)
                if hit[0] is not None:
                    thick[i] = min(0.03 * sc, max(0.002, hit[3]))
        thick = np.minimum(thick, 0.012 * sc) * (0.55 + 0.45 * np.clip(rm, 0, 1))
        # crown whorl + parting: radial from the whorl, combed down by gravity, fringe forward + to the side
        E = np.array(lm["eyes"])
        W = np.array([0.012 * sc * part_side, E[1] + 0.105 * sc, lm["head_top"] - 0.018 * sc])
        rad_ = roots - W
        grav = np.array([0.0, 0.0, -1.0])
        fwd = np.array([0.0, -1.0, 0.0])
        frontness = np.clip((E[1] + 0.06 * sc - roots[:, 1]) / (0.06 * sc), 0, 1)       # 1 = front of the head
        d = _norm(rad_) * 0.7 + grav * (0.45 - 0.3 * frontness * (cfg["fringe"] < 0))[:, None] + \
            fwd * (cfg["fringe"] * frontness)[:, None]
        d[:, 0] += cfg["sweep"] * part_side * frontness
        d = d - nrm * (d * nrm).sum(1, keepdims=True)
        d = _norm(d)
        me = p.body.data
        polys = [tuple(pl.vertices) for pl in me.polygons if all(inb[v] for v in pl.vertices)]
        bvh = BVHTree.FromPolygons([tuple(c) for c in co], polys, all_triangles=False)
        pmask = np.array([hm[list(pv)].mean() for pv in polys])
        stop_at_hairline = cfg["fringe"] < 0.1
        layer = rng.random(N)
        seg = L / (K - 1)
        pts = np.zeros((N, K, 3))
        pts[:, 0] = roots
        pos = roots.copy()
        dirs = d.copy()
        lift = cfg["lift"]
        phase = rng.random(N) * 6.283
        lens = np.clip(rng.normal(1.0, 0.15, N), 0.55, 1.3) * (0.6 + 0.4 * np.clip(rm, 0, 1))
        if cfg["fringe"] < 0.1:      # men: the front is shorter (no curtain over the forehead)
            lens *= 1.0 - 0.35 * frontness
        for k in range(1, K):
            t = k / (K - 1)
            for i in range(N):
                q = pos[i] + dirs[i] * seg * lens[i]
                loc, nn, fi, dist = bvh.find_nearest(Vector(q))
                if loc is None:
                    pos[i] = q
                    continue
                if stop_at_hairline and pmask[fi] < 0.2 and lens[i] > 0.05:
                    lens[i] = 0.04          # reached the forehead / face: stop (no curtain over the brow)
                    q = pos[i] + dirs[i] * seg * lens[i]
                    loc, nn, fi, dist = bvh.find_nearest(Vector(q))
                nn = np.array(nn)
                h = 0.0006 * sc + thick[i] * (0.55 + 0.6 * layer[i]) * min(1.0, t / 0.35) ** 0.8 + lift * 0.004 * t
                newp = np.array(loc) + nn * h
                tdir = newp - pos[i]
                nd = np.linalg.norm(tdir)
                if nd > 1e-9:
                    # keep combing along the field, re-projected to the local tangent plane
                    dd = dirs[i] - nn * dirs[i].dot(nn)
                    dl = np.linalg.norm(dd)
                    if dl > 1e-9:
                        dirs[i] = dd / dl * 0.8 + (grav - nn * grav.dot(nn)) * 0.2
                        dirs[i] /= max(1e-9, np.linalg.norm(dirs[i]))
                side = np.cross(dirs[i], nn)
                newp = newp + side * math.sin(phase[i] + t * 5.0) * cfg["wave"] * t
                pos[i] = newp
                pts[i, k] = newp
        fz = rng.normal(0, 1, pts.shape) * 0.0004 * sc * (np.linspace(0, 1, K) ** 1.5)[None, :, None]
        pts += fz
        pts[:, 0] = roots
        np.savez(cp, pts=pts, ruv=ruv)
    cv = bpy.data.hair_curves.new(p.name + ".hair_strands")
    cv.add_curves([K] * len(pts))
    cv.position_data.foreach_set("vector", pts.astype(np.float32).ravel())
    rad = np.tile(np.linspace(1.0, 0.5, K), len(pts)) * 0.00011 * sc
    if "radius" not in cv.attributes:
        cv.attributes.new("radius", "FLOAT", "POINT")
    cv.attributes["radius"].data.foreach_set("value", rad.astype(np.float32))
    a = cv.attributes.new("surface_uv_coordinate", "FLOAT2", "CURVE")
    a.data.foreach_set("vector", ruv.astype(np.float32).ravel())
    cv.surface = p.body
    cv.surface_uv_map = p.body.data.uv_layers[0].name
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(p.name + ".hair_strands", cv)
    for c in p.body.users_collection:
        c.objects.link(ob)
    ob.parent = p.rig
    ob.modifiers.new("deform", "NODES").node_group = _deform_on_surface_group()
    hc = hair_color_rgb(color or s["hair_color"], 0.0)
    mat = curve_hair_material(p.name + ".strand_mat", hc, grey if grey is not None else s.get("grey", 0))
    cv.materials.append(mat)
    p.parts["hair_strands"] = ob
    p.mats["hair_strands"] = mat
    if shell is not None:
        # the painted scalp + strands replace the MPFB card shell (it read as a rubber cap); the shell object
        # stays (hidden) because head garments are fitted over it
        shell.hide_render = True
        shell.hide_viewport = True
    return ob


def _set_mod_input(mod, name, value):
    for it in mod.node_group.interface.items_tree:
        if getattr(it, "in_out", None) == "INPUT" and it.name == name:
            mod[it.identifier] = value
            return


def _grow_shell_strands(p, shell, co, tv, tl, uv, N, K, length_scale, depth, clump, frizz, rng, flyaways):
    P3 = co[tv]
    UV = uv[tl]
    gv = _tri_grad_v(P3, UV)                     # +v direction per triangle
    area = 0.5 * np.linalg.norm(np.cross(P3[:, 1] - P3[:, 0], P3[:, 2] - P3[:, 0]), axis=1)
    tn = _norm(np.cross(P3[:, 1] - P3[:, 0], P3[:, 2] - P3[:, 0]))
    # orient normals outwards (away from the head centre)
    hc = np.array(p.lm["eyes"]) + np.array([0, 0.07, 0.02])
    flip = ((P3.mean(1) - hc) * tn).sum(1) < 0
    tn[flip] *= -1
    # root -> tip direction: v decreases from roots (top) to tips; check against gravity statistically
    down = -gv
    if (down[:, 2] * area).sum() > 0:            # majority would point up: flip
        down = -down
    # connected shell islands (layers / strips): strands stay on the island of their root
    par = list(range(len(co)))

    def _f(a):
        while par[a] != a:
            par[a] = par[par[a]]
            a = par[a]
        return a
    for t in tv:
        a, b, c = _f(int(t[0])), _f(int(t[1])), _f(int(t[2]))
        par[b] = a
        par[_f(c)] = a
    tri_isl = np.array([_f(int(t[0])) for t in tv])
    isl_ids = {r: i for i, r in enumerate(np.unique(tri_isl))}
    tri_isl = np.array([isl_ids[r] for r in tri_isl])
    cl = [tuple(c) for c in co]
    bvhs, tmaps = [], []
    for i in range(len(isl_ids)):
        ti = np.nonzero(tri_isl == i)[0]
        bvhs.append(BVHTree.FromPolygons(cl, [tuple(tv[t]) for t in ti]))
        tmaps.append(ti)
    # roots: points on the shell near the top of each UV column = high "v rank".
    vt = UV[:, :, 1].mean(1)
    if (down[:, 2] * area).sum() > 0:
        vt = -vt
    # root region: triangles whose v is within the top 12% of the island's v at that u column
    ucol = np.floor(UV[:, :, 0].mean(1) * 64).astype(int)
    rootw = np.zeros(len(tv))
    for c in np.unique(ucol):
        m = ucol == c
        vv = vt[m]
        lo, hi = vv.min(), vv.max()
        rootw[m] = (vv > hi - 0.12 * (hi - lo)).astype(float)
    wts = area * rootw
    G = max(60, N // 18)
    gi = rng.choice(len(tv), G, p=wts / wts.sum())
    r1, r2 = rng.random(G), rng.random(G)
    s1 = np.sqrt(r1)
    bary = np.stack([1 - s1, s1 * (1 - r2), s1 * r2], 1)
    groots = (P3[gi] * bary[:, :, None]).sum(1)
    gisl = tri_isl[gi]
    sc = p.height / 1.75
    Lmax = {"long01": 0.62, "ponytail01": 0.4, "braid01": 0.45, "bob01": 0.25, "bob02": 0.25}.get(p.spec["hair"], 0.12) * sc * length_scale
    seg = Lmax / (K - 1)
    E = p.lm["eyes"]

    def _in_face(q):   # keep strands off the face (forehead / cheeks in front of the ears)
        return abs(q.x) < 0.064 * sc and q.y < E.y + 0.06 * sc and p.lm["chin_bot"] - 0.04 * sc < q.z < E.z + 0.05 * sc
    guides = np.zeros((G, K, 3))
    gnorm = np.zeros((G, K, 3))
    alive = np.ones((G, K), bool)
    for i in range(G):
        pos = Vector(groots[i])
        bvh, tmap = bvhs[gisl[i]], tmaps[gisl[i]]
        for k in range(K):
            loc, nn, fi, dist = bvh.find_nearest(pos)
            if fi is not None:
                fi = int(tmap[fi])
            if fi is None:
                alive[i, k:] = False
                break
            nrm = Vector(tn[fi])
            guides[i, k] = loc
            gnorm[i, k] = nrm
            dvec = Vector(down[fi])
            if dvec.length < 1e-9:
                alive[i, k + 1:] = False
                break
            dvec = (dvec - nrm * dvec.dot(nrm)).normalized()
            nxt = loc + dvec * seg
            # stop at the shell's boundary (the tip edge): projecting jumps far or v stops changing
            loc2, nn2, fi2, d2 = bvh.find_nearest(nxt)
            if fi2 is None or d2 > seg * 0.8 or _in_face(loc2):
                alive[i, k + 1:] = False
                break
            pos = loc2
    # guide length = number of alive points
    glen = alive.sum(1)
    ok = glen >= 3
    guides, gnorm, alive, glen, gisl = guides[ok], gnorm[ok], alive[ok], glen[ok], gisl[ok]
    G = len(guides)
    # children around guides
    owner = rng.integers(0, G, N)
    kk = np.arange(K)
    T = kk / (K - 1)
    # each child: root offset on the surface (tangent), depth layer, own length fraction
    tang = rng.normal(0, 1, (N, 3))
    n0 = gnorm[owner, 0]
    tang = _norm(tang - n0 * (tang * n0).sum(1, keepdims=True)) * rng.uniform(0, 0.012 * sc, (N, 1))
    dep = rng.uniform(depth[0], depth[1], N) * sc
    fly = rng.random(N) < flyaways
    dep[fly] += rng.uniform(0.003, 0.01, fly.sum()) * sc
    lfrac = np.clip(rng.uniform(0.55, 1.02, N), 0, 1)
    cl = clump * rng.uniform(0.6, 1.2, N)
    pts = np.zeros((N, K, 3))
    surf = np.zeros((N, K, 3))
    pdep = np.zeros((N, K))
    for k in range(K):
        # sample the guide at fraction lfrac * (glen-1)
        fk = T[k] * lfrac * (glen[owner] - 1)
        k0 = np.clip(np.floor(fk).astype(int), 0, K - 2)
        a = (fk - k0)[:, None]
        g = guides[owner, k0] * (1 - a) + guides[owner, np.minimum(k0 + 1, K - 1)] * a
        nn = _norm(gnorm[owner, k0] * (1 - a) + gnorm[owner, np.minimum(k0 + 1, K - 1)] * a)
        t = T[k]
        offs = tang * (1 - cl[:, None] * t ** 0.8)
        d = dep * (1.0 - 0.5 * cl * t) + (fly * (t ** 1.5) * 0.01 * sc)
        pts[:, k] = g + offs + nn * d[:, None]
        surf[:, k] = g + offs
        pdep[:, k] = d
    fz = rng.normal(0, 1, pts.shape) * frizz * sc * (T ** 1.3)[None, :, None]
    pts += fz
    # bind every point to a shell triangle (vertex indices + barycentric weights) on its root's island,
    # found from its surface foot point; depth along the triangle's winding normal
    flat = (surf + fz).reshape(-1, 3)
    fpts = pts.reshape(-1, 3)
    nP = len(flat)
    bidx = np.zeros((nP, 3), np.int32)
    bw = np.zeros((nP, 3), np.float32)
    fdep = pdep.reshape(-1).copy()
    pisl = np.repeat(gisl[owner], K)
    wn = _norm(np.cross(P3[:, 1] - P3[:, 0], P3[:, 2] - P3[:, 0]))
    for i in range(nP):
        loc, nn, fi, dist = bvhs[pisl[i]].find_nearest(Vector(flat[i]))
        if fi is None:
            continue
        fi = int(tmaps[pisl[i]][fi])
        a, b, c = P3[fi]
        bc = np.clip(_bary_np(np.array(loc), a, b, c), 0, 1)
        bc /= max(1e-9, bc.sum())
        bidx[i] = tv[fi]
        bw[i] = bc
        fdep[i] = (fpts[i] - bc @ P3[fi]).dot(wn[fi])
    puv = (bidx, bw)
    pdep = fdep
    rad = np.tile(np.linspace(1.0, 0.55, K), (N, 1)) * 0.00009 * sc * rng.uniform(0.8, 1.25, (N, 1))
    return pts, puv, pdep, rad


def _bary_np(pt, a, b, c):
    v0, v1, v2 = b - a, c - a, pt - a
    d00, d01, d11 = v0.dot(v0), v0.dot(v1), v1.dot(v1)
    d20, d21 = v2.dot(v0), v2.dot(v1)
    den = d00 * d11 - d01 * d01
    if abs(den) < 1e-18:
        return np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
    v = (d11 * d20 - d01 * d21) / den
    w = (d00 * d21 - d01 * d20) / den
    return np.array([1 - v - w, v, w])


def _follow_shell_group():
    """GN: every strand point = barycentric point of its bound shell triangle (by vertex index)
    + depth * triangle normal, evaluated on the deformed shell."""
    ng = bpy.data.node_groups.get("PS22_FollowShell2")
    if ng:
        return ng
    ng = bpy.data.node_groups.new("PS22_FollowShell2", "GeometryNodeTree")
    ng.interface.new_socket("Geometry", in_out="INPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketGeometry")
    ng.interface.new_socket("Shell", in_out="INPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketObject")
    ng.interface.new_socket("Geometry", in_out="OUTPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketGeometry")
    N, L = ng.nodes, ng.links
    gi = N.new("NodeGroupInput")
    go = N.new("NodeGroupOutput")
    oi = N.new("GeometryNodeObjectInfo")
    oi.transform_space = "RELATIVE"
    L.new(gi.outputs["Shell"], oi.inputs["Object"])
    pos = N.new("GeometryNodeInputPosition")

    def attr(name, kind):
        a = N.new("GeometryNodeInputNamedAttribute")
        a.data_type = kind
        a.inputs["Name"].default_value = name
        return a.outputs["Attribute"]

    def vm(op, a, b=None, scale=None):
        n = N.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
        n.operation = op
        L.new(a, n.inputs[0])
        if b is not None:
            L.new(b, n.inputs[1])
        if scale is not None:
            L.new(scale, n.inputs["Scale"])
        return n.outputs[0]
    P = []
    for i in range(3):
        si = N.new("GeometryNodeSampleIndex")
        si.data_type = "FLOAT_VECTOR"
        si.domain = "POINT"
        L.new(oi.outputs["Geometry"], si.inputs["Geometry"])
        L.new(pos.outputs[0], si.inputs["Value"])
        L.new(attr("bv%d" % i, "INT"), si.inputs["Index"])
        P.append(si.outputs[0])
    acc = vm("SCALE", P[0], scale=attr("bw0", "FLOAT"))
    acc = vm("ADD", acc, vm("SCALE", P[1], scale=attr("bw1", "FLOAT")))
    acc = vm("ADD", acc, vm("SCALE", P[2], scale=attr("bw2", "FLOAT")))
    nrm = vm("NORMALIZE", vm("CROSS_PRODUCT", vm("SUBTRACT", P[1], P[0]), vm("SUBTRACT", P[2], P[0])))
    final = vm("ADD", acc, vm("SCALE", nrm, scale=attr("shell_depth", "FLOAT")))
    sp = N.new("GeometryNodeSetPosition")
    L.new(gi.outputs["Geometry"], sp.inputs["Geometry"])
    L.new(final, sp.inputs["Position"])
    L.new(sp.outputs[0], go.inputs[0])
    return ng

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/lib/core.py =====
"""Core helpers shared by every shot script (runs inside Blender 4.5, EEVEE Next).

Conventions
- Units: metres. Z is up. A standing adult is ~1.75 m. Ground at z=0 unless a terrain says otherwise.
- Portrait frame: render 540x960 (final), 270x480 (preview). Compose for 9:16 - keep key subjects in
  the centre square (the social-media preview crop) and leave the lower ~30% calm-ish for captions.
- Animate with explicit per-frame keys (`key_fn`) or a few eased keys (`keys`). Everything must be
  parameterised by ctx.nframes / ctx.render_frames so the timing can change without edits.
- Frames are 1-based: the shot's first frame is 1, last rendered frame is ctx.render_frames.
"""
import bpy, math, os, random, json
from mathutils import Vector, Euler, Matrix, Color, noise
from . import polyhaven as ph

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
BLENDER_DIR = os.path.dirname(HERE)
ROOT = os.path.dirname(BLENDER_DIR)
WORK = os.environ.get("WORK", "/opt/work/psalm22")
ASSETS = "/opt/assets"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Context
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Ctx:
    """Shot context handed to build(ctx)."""

    def __init__(self, shot, quality="preview", fps=24):
        self.shot = shot
        self.id = shot["id"]
        self.fps = fps
        self.quality = quality
        self.nframes = shot["nframes"]              # frames on the final timeline
        self.render_frames = shot["render_frames"]  # nframes + dissolve tail
        self.phrases = shot.get("phrases", [])      # [{"text","start","end"}] seconds relative to shot start
        self.seed = sum(ord(c) for c in self.id)
        self.samples = None          # override EEVEE samples for final quality
        self.post = {}               # hints for the compositor (grade, bloom, vignette, ...)
        self.needs_bake = False      # set True when physics/particles need baking
        self.render_opts = {}        # passed to configure_render
        self.interp = False          # True: final render at 12 fps (odd frames) + RIFE fills evens (see docs/interp.md)
        random.seed(self.seed)

    @property
    def end(self):
        return self.render_frames

    def frame(self, seconds):
        """Seconds (relative to shot start) -> 1-based frame."""
        return 1 + seconds * self.fps

    def sec(self, frame):
        return (frame - 1) / self.fps

    def phrase_frames(self, i):
        p = self.phrases[i]
        return self.frame(p["start"]), self.frame(p["end"])

    def u(self, frame):
        """Normalised progress 0..1 across the timeline part of the shot (tail continues > 1)."""
        return (frame - 1) / max(1, self.nframes - 1)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Scene / render
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def reset_scene(ctx):
    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
    sc = bpy.context.scene
    sc.render.fps = ctx.fps
    sc.frame_start = 1
    sc.frame_end = ctx.render_frames
    sc.frame_set(1)
    w = bpy.data.worlds.new("World")
    sc.world = w
    w.use_nodes = True
    sc.render.engine = "BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT"
    sc.view_settings.view_transform = "AgX"
    sc.view_settings.look = "AgX - Medium High Contrast"
    sc.unit_settings.system = "METRIC"
    return sc


def configure_render(ctx, samples=None, raytracing=False, volumetrics="medium", vol_shadows=True,
                     motion_blur=False, gtao=True, shadow_scale=1.0, film_transparent=False,
                     look=None, exposure=0.0, fast_gi=False):
    """Final render configuration. Called by the runner after build(); shots pass options through
    ctx.render_opts (same keyword names)."""
    sc = bpy.context.scene
    r = sc.render
    if ctx.quality == "final":
        r.resolution_x, r.resolution_y = 540, 960
        n = samples or ctx.samples or 8
    elif ctx.quality == "draft":
        r.resolution_x, r.resolution_y = 540, 960
        n = 3
    else:
        r.resolution_x, r.resolution_y = 270, 480
        n = 3
    r.resolution_percentage = 100
    r.film_transparent = film_transparent
    r.use_motion_blur = motion_blur
    r.motion_blur_shutter = 0.5
    ee = sc.eevee
    ee.taa_render_samples = n
    ee.use_raytracing = raytracing
    if raytracing:
        ee.ray_tracing_method = "SCREEN"
        ee.ray_tracing_options.resolution_scale = "2"
    ee.use_fast_gi = fast_gi
    ee.use_gtao = gtao
    ee.gtao_distance = 0.8
    ee.use_shadows = True
    ee.shadow_ray_count = 1
    ee.shadow_step_count = 6
    ee.shadow_resolution_scale = shadow_scale
    ee.use_volumetric_shadows = vol_shadows
    q = {"low": ("16", 32), "medium": ("8", 48), "high": ("4", 64)}[volumetrics]
    ee.volumetric_tile_size, ee.volumetric_samples = q
    ee.volumetric_shadow_samples = 12
    ee.motion_blur_steps = 1
    r.filter_size = 1.5
    sc.view_settings.view_transform = "AgX"
    if look:
        sc.view_settings.look = look
    sc.view_settings.exposure = exposure
    r.image_settings.file_format = "PNG"
    r.image_settings.color_mode = "RGB"
    r.image_settings.color_depth = "8"
    r.image_settings.compression = 15


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Animation helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def smoothstep(x):
    x = min(1.0, max(0.0, x))
    return x * x * (3 - 2 * x)


def smootherstep(x):
    x = min(1.0, max(0.0, x))
    return x * x * x * (x * (x * 6 - 15) + 10)


def ease_in_out(x):
    x = min(1.0, max(0.0, x))
    return 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(math.pi * x)


def ease_out(x):
    x = min(1.0, max(0.0, x))
    return 1 - (1 - x) ** 3


def ease_in(x):
    x = min(1.0, max(0.0, x))
    return x ** 3


def lerp(a, b, t):
    if isinstance(a, (tuple, list, Vector)):
        return type(a)([a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * t for i in range(len(a))]) if not isinstance(a, Vector) else a.lerp(b, t)
    return a + (b - a) * t


def keys(target, path, pairs, interp="BEZIER", index=-1):
    """Insert keyframes: pairs = [(frame, value), ...]. Bezier with auto-clamped handles = eased."""
    for f, v in pairs:
        _set_path(target, path, v, index)
        target.keyframe_insert(data_path=path, frame=f, index=index)
    _set_interp(target, path, interp)


def key_fn(target, path, fn, f0=1, f1=None, step=1, index=-1):
    """Key every `step` frames from f0..f1 with value fn(frame). Linear interpolation."""
    f1 = f1 if f1 is not None else bpy.context.scene.frame_end
    f = f0
    while f <= f1:
        _set_path(target, path, fn(f), index)
        target.keyframe_insert(data_path=path, frame=f, index=index)
        f += step
    _set_interp(target, path, "LINEAR")


def _set_path(target, path, v, index):
    if index >= 0:
        getattr(target, path)[index] = v
    else:
        try:
            setattr(target, path, v)
        except (AttributeError, TypeError):
            # node socket default_value etc. accessed by path_resolve
            target.path_resolve(path)
            exec("target.%s = v" % path)


def _set_interp(target, path, interp):
    ad = target.animation_data if hasattr(target, "animation_data") else None
    if ad is None and hasattr(target, "id_data"):
        ad = target.id_data.animation_data
    if not ad or not ad.action:
        return
    for fc in _fcurves(ad.action):
        if fc.data_path.endswith(path):
            for kp in fc.keyframe_points:
                kp.interpolation = interp
                if interp == "BEZIER":
                    kp.handle_left_type = kp.handle_right_type = "AUTO_CLAMPED"


def _fcurves(action):
    if hasattr(action, "fcurves") and len(action.fcurves):
        return action.fcurves
    out = []
    for layer in getattr(action, "layers", []):
        for strip in layer.strips:
            for cb in strip.channelbags:
                out.extend(cb.fcurves)
    return out


def shake(f, amp=0.01, freq=0.6, seed=0):
    """Smooth handheld noise vector for frame f (add to a camera location/rotation)."""
    t = f * freq / 24.0
    return Vector((noise.noise(Vector((t, seed, 0.3))), noise.noise(Vector((seed, t, 1.7))),
                   noise.noise(Vector((2.1, seed, t))))) * amp


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objects / camera / lights
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def link(obj, coll=None):
    (coll or bpy.context.scene.collection).objects.link(obj)
    return obj


def collection(name, parent=None):
    c = bpy.data.collections.new(name)
    (parent or bpy.context.scene.collection).children.link(c)
    return c


def look_at(obj, target, roll=0.0):
    d = Vector(target) - obj.location
    q = d.to_track_quat("-Z", "Y")
    obj.rotation_euler = q.to_euler()
    if roll:
        obj.rotation_euler.rotate_axis("Z", math.radians(roll))
    return obj.rotation_euler.copy()


def look_rot(loc, target, roll=0.0):
    e = (Vector(target) - Vector(loc)).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
    if roll:
        e.rotate_axis("Z", math.radians(roll))
    return e


def camera(loc=(0, -6, 1.6), target=(0, 0, 1.5), lens=35, name="Camera", fstop=None, focus=None,
           sensor=36, clip_end=20000):
    """Create + activate a camera. fstop enables DOF; focus = distance (float) or object."""
    cd = bpy.data.cameras.new(name)
    cd.lens = lens
    cd.sensor_fit = "VERTICAL"
    cd.sensor_height = sensor   # vertical sensor so lens values feel like full-frame on a portrait frame
    cd.clip_start = 0.02
    cd.clip_end = clip_end
    cam = link(bpy.data.objects.new(name, cd))
    cam.location = loc
    look_at(cam, target)
    if fstop:
        cd.dof.use_dof = True
        cd.dof.aperture_fstop = fstop
        if isinstance(focus, bpy.types.Object):
            cd.dof.focus_object = focus
        elif focus is not None:
            cd.dof.focus_distance = focus
        else:
            cd.dof.focus_distance = (Vector(target) - Vector(loc)).length
    bpy.context.scene.camera = cam
    return cam


def animate_camera(cam, fn, f0=1, f1=None, step=1):
    """fn(frame) -> (location, target[, roll_deg[, lens]]). Keys every frame (smooth, exact)."""
    f1 = f1 or bpy.context.scene.frame_end
    f = f0
    while f <= f1:
        r = fn(f)
        loc, tgt = Vector(r[0]), Vector(r[1])
        roll = r[2] if len(r) > 2 else 0.0
        cam.location = loc
        cam.rotation_euler = look_rot(loc, tgt, roll)
        cam.keyframe_insert("location", frame=f)
        cam.keyframe_insert("rotation_euler", frame=f)
        if len(r) > 3 and r[3]:
            cam.data.lens = r[3]
            cam.data.keyframe_insert("lens", frame=f)
        if cam.data.dof.use_dof and cam.data.dof.focus_object is None and len(r) > 4 and r[4]:
            cam.data.dof.focus_distance = r[4]
            cam.data.dof.keyframe_insert("focus_distance", frame=f)
        f += step
    _set_interp(cam, "location", "LINEAR")
    _set_interp(cam, "rotation_euler", "LINEAR")
    _unwrap_euler(cam)


def _unwrap_euler(obj):
    ad = obj.animation_data
    if not ad or not ad.action:
        return
    for fc in _fcurves(ad.action):
        if fc.data_path == "rotation_euler":
            prev = None
            for kp in fc.keyframe_points:
                v = kp.co[1]
                if prev is not None:
                    while v - prev > math.pi:
                        v -= 2 * math.pi
                    while v - prev < -math.pi:
                        v += 2 * math.pi
                kp.co[1] = v
                kp.handle_left[1] = kp.handle_right[1] = v
                prev = v


def kelvin(k):
    """Approximate blackbody colour (linear-ish RGB) for colour temperature k."""
    t = k / 100.0
    if t <= 66:
        r = 255
        g = 99.4708025861 * math.log(t) - 161.1195681661
        b = 0 if t <= 19 else 138.5177312231 * math.log(t - 10) - 305.0447927307
    else:
        r = 329.698727446 * ((t - 60) ** -0.1332047592)
        g = 288.1221695283 * ((t - 60) ** -0.0755148492)
        b = 255
    c = [min(255, max(0, x)) / 255.0 for x in (r, g, b)]
    return tuple(x ** 2.2 for x in c)


def light(kind="AREA", loc=(0, 0, 5), energy=100, color=(1, 1, 1), target=None, size=1.0, name=None,
          spot_size=45, spot_blend=0.3, shadow=True, temp=None, volume=1.0, rot=None):
    """kind: SUN (energy = W/m2 ~1-10), AREA/POINT/SPOT (energy in W)."""
    ld = bpy.data.lights.new(name or kind.lower(), kind)
    ld.energy = energy
    ld.color = kelvin(temp) if temp else color
    ld.use_shadow = shadow
    ld.volume_factor = volume
    if kind == "AREA":
        ld.size = size
    elif kind == "SUN":
        ld.angle = math.radians(size if size != 1.0 else 1.0)
    else:
        ld.shadow_soft_size = size if kind in ("POINT", "SPOT") else ld.shadow_soft_size
    if kind == "SPOT":
        ld.spot_size = math.radians(spot_size)
        ld.spot_blend = spot_blend
    ob = link(bpy.data.objects.new(ld.name, ld))
    ob.location = loc
    if rot is not None:
        ob.rotation_euler = [math.radians(a) for a in rot]
    elif target is not None:
        look_at(ob, target)
    return ob


def sun(elevation=30, azimuth=0, energy=4, color=None, temp=5500, angle=1.0, volume=1.0):
    """Sun light. azimuth 0 = light comes FROM -Y (in front of a camera looking +Y). Degrees."""
    ld = bpy.data.lights.new("Sun", "SUN")
    ld.energy = energy
    ld.color = color if color else kelvin(temp)
    ld.angle = math.radians(angle)
    ld.volume_factor = volume
    ob = link(bpy.data.objects.new("Sun", ld))
    el, az = math.radians(elevation), math.radians(azimuth)
    d = Vector((math.sin(az) * math.cos(el), -math.cos(az) * math.cos(el), math.sin(el)))  # towards the sun
    ob.rotation_euler = (-d).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
    ob.location = d * 50
    return ob


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# World
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _world():
    w = bpy.context.scene.world
    nt = w.node_tree
    for n in list(nt.nodes):
        nt.nodes.remove(n)
    out = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeOutputWorld")
    return w, nt, out


def world_color(color=(0.02, 0.025, 0.035), strength=1.0):
    w, nt, out = _world()
    bg = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBackground")
    bg.inputs[0].default_value = (*color, 1)
    bg.inputs[1].default_value = strength
    nt.links.new(bg.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
    return bg


def world_sky(sun_elevation=20, sun_rotation=0, strength=1.0, air=1.0, dust=1.0, ozone=1.0,
              altitude=0, sun_disc=True, sun_size=0.545, sun_intensity=1.0, tint=None):
    """Nishita physical sky. sun_rotation 0 => sun toward -Y? (Blender: rotation around Z from +Y)."""
    w, nt, out = _world()
    sky = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexSky")
    sky.sky_type = "NISHITA"
    sky.sun_elevation = math.radians(sun_elevation)
    sky.sun_rotation = math.radians(sun_rotation)
    sky.air_density, sky.dust_density, sky.ozone_density = air, dust, ozone
    sky.altitude = altitude
    sky.sun_disc = sun_disc
    sky.sun_size = math.radians(sun_size)
    sky.sun_intensity = sun_intensity
    bg = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBackground")
    bg.inputs[1].default_value = strength
    if tint:
        mix = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMixRGB")
        mix.blend_type = "MULTIPLY"
        mix.inputs[0].default_value = 1
        mix.inputs[2].default_value = (*tint, 1)
        nt.links.new(sky.outputs[0], mix.inputs[1])
        nt.links.new(mix.outputs[0], bg.inputs[0])
    else:
        nt.links.new(sky.outputs[0], bg.inputs[0])
    nt.links.new(bg.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
    return sky, bg


def world_hdri(asset, strength=1.0, rotation=0.0, res="2k", tint=None, saturation=1.0, path=None,
               background_strength=None):
    """Poly Haven HDRI as world. rotation in degrees around Z. Optional tint (rgb multiply) and
    saturation. background_strength lets the visible sky differ from the lighting strength."""
    p = path or ph.hdri_path(asset, res)
    w, nt, out = _world()
    tc = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
    mp = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMapping")
    mp.inputs["Rotation"].default_value[2] = math.radians(rotation)
    env = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexEnvironment")
    env.image = bpy.data.images.load(p, check_existing=True)
    nt.links.new(tc.outputs["Generated"], mp.inputs["Vector"])
    nt.links.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], env.inputs["Vector"])
    col = env.outputs["Color"]
    if saturation != 1.0:
        hs = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeHueSaturation")
        hs.inputs["Saturation"].default_value = saturation
        nt.links.new(col, hs.inputs["Color"])
        col = hs.outputs["Color"]
    if tint:
        mix = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMixRGB")
        mix.blend_type = "MULTIPLY"
        mix.inputs[0].default_value = 1
        mix.inputs[2].default_value = (*tint, 1)
        nt.links.new(col, mix.inputs[1])
        col = mix.outputs[0]
    bg = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBackground")
    bg.inputs[1].default_value = strength
    nt.links.new(col, bg.inputs[0])
    if background_strength is not None:
        lp = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeLightPath")
        bg2 = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBackground")
        bg2.inputs[1].default_value = background_strength
        nt.links.new(col, bg2.inputs[0])
        ms = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMixShader")
        nt.links.new(lp.outputs["Is Camera Ray"], ms.inputs[0])
        nt.links.new(bg.outputs[0], ms.inputs[1])
        nt.links.new(bg2.outputs[0], ms.inputs[2])
        nt.links.new(ms.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
    else:
        nt.links.new(bg.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
    return env, bg, mp


def world_volume(*a, **k):
    raise RuntimeError("Do not use a world volume: in EEVEE Next it is infinite and blacks out the sky "
                       "and sun. Use core.atmosphere(...) or core.fog_box(...) instead.")


def atmosphere(density=0.002, color=(0.8, 0.75, 0.7), anisotropy=0.3, size=(600, 600, 150), center=(0, 0, 60),
               noise_scale=None, name="Atmosphere"):
    """Large finite fog volume for aerial perspective + god rays (with sun volume shadows). Keep
    density small (0.0005-0.01). The sky (world) stays visible through it."""
    return fog_box(center=center, size=size, density=density, color=color, anisotropy=anisotropy,
                   noise_scale=noise_scale, name=name)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Materials
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def mat(name, color=(0.8, 0.8, 0.8), rough=0.5, metal=0.0, spec=0.5, emission=None, emission_strength=0.0,
        alpha=1.0, sss=0.0, sss_radius=(1.0, 0.4, 0.2), transmission=0.0, ior=1.45, coat=0.0, sheen=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = m.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*color[:3], 1)
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    b.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
    b.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value = spec
    b.inputs["IOR"].default_value = ior
    if emission is not None:
        b.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (*emission[:3], 1)
        b.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = emission_strength
    if alpha < 1:
        b.inputs["Alpha"].default_value = alpha
        m.surface_render_method = "BLENDED"
    if sss:
        b.inputs["Subsurface Weight"].default_value = sss
        b.inputs["Subsurface Radius"].default_value = sss_radius
    if transmission:
        b.inputs["Transmission Weight"].default_value = transmission
    if coat:
        b.inputs["Coat Weight"].default_value = coat
    if sheen:
        b.inputs["Sheen Weight"].default_value = sheen
    return m


def bsdf(m):
    return m.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")


def mat_emission(name, color=(1, 0.8, 0.5), strength=10.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    nt = m.node_tree
    nt.nodes.remove(nt.nodes["Principled BSDF"])
    e = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeEmission")
    e.inputs[0].default_value = (*color, 1)
    e.inputs[1].default_value = strength
    nt.links.new(e.outputs[0], nt.nodes["Material Output"].inputs[0])
    return m


def mat_volume(name, density=0.1, color=(0.8, 0.8, 0.8), anisotropy=0.2, noise_scale=None, noise_contrast=1.0,
               emission=None, emission_strength=0.0):
    """Volume material for fog boxes / smoke. noise_scale adds wispy density variation."""
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    nt = m.node_tree
    nt.nodes.remove(nt.nodes["Principled BSDF"])
    v = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeVolumePrincipled")
    v.inputs["Color"].default_value = (*color, 1)
    v.inputs["Anisotropy"].default_value = anisotropy
    if emission:
        v.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (*emission, 1)
        v.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = emission_strength
    if noise_scale:
        tex = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
        tex.inputs["Scale"].default_value = noise_scale
        tex.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 3
        mr = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
        mr.inputs["From Min"].default_value = 0.35 + 0.1 * (noise_contrast - 1)
        mr.inputs["From Max"].default_value = 0.75
        mr.inputs["To Max"].default_value = density
        nt.links.new(tex.outputs["Fac"], mr.inputs["Value"])
        nt.links.new(mr.outputs["Result"], v.inputs["Density"])
        m["noise_node"] = tex.name
    else:
        v.inputs["Density"].default_value = density
    nt.links.new(v.outputs[0], nt.nodes["Material Output"].inputs["Volume"])
    return m


def mat_pbr(asset, scale=1.0, res="1k", projection="BOX", tint=None, rough_mult=1.0, rough_add=0.0,
            bump=1.0, name=None, hue_sat_val=None, blend=0.25):
    """Poly Haven texture set as a material. projection 'BOX' uses object coordinates (no UVs needed,
    `scale` = repeats per metre); 'UV' uses the mesh UVs (scale = UV repeat)."""
    maps = ph.texture_maps(asset, res)
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name or asset)
    m.use_nodes = True
    nt = m.node_tree
    b = nt.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    tc = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
    mp = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMapping")
    mp.inputs["Scale"].default_value = (scale, scale, scale)
    nt.links.new(tc.outputs["Object" if projection == "BOX" else "UV"], mp.inputs["Vector"])

    def img(path, noncolor=False):
        t = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexImage")
        t.image = bpy.data.images.load(path, check_existing=True)
        if noncolor:
            t.image.colorspace_settings.name = "Non-Color"
        if projection == "BOX":
            t.projection = "BOX"
            t.projection_blend = blend
        nt.links.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], t.inputs["Vector"])
        return t

    if "diff" in maps:
        d = img(maps["diff"])
        col = d.outputs["Color"]
        if hue_sat_val:
            hs = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeHueSaturation")
            hs.inputs["Hue"].default_value, hs.inputs["Saturation"].default_value, hs.inputs["Value"].default_value = hue_sat_val
            nt.links.new(col, hs.inputs["Color"])
            col = hs.outputs["Color"]
        if tint:
            mx = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMixRGB")
            mx.blend_type = "MULTIPLY"
            mx.inputs[0].default_value = 1
            mx.inputs[2].default_value = (*tint, 1)
            nt.links.new(col, mx.inputs[1])
            col = mx.outputs[0]
        nt.links.new(col, b.inputs["Base Color"])
    if "rough" in maps:
        r = img(maps["rough"], True)
        mth = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMath")
        mth.operation = "MULTIPLY_ADD"
        mth.inputs[1].default_value = rough_mult
        mth.inputs[2].default_value = rough_add
        mth.use_clamp = True
        nt.links.new(r.outputs["Color"], mth.inputs[0])
        nt.links.new(mth.outputs[0], b.inputs["Roughness"])
    if "nor" in maps and bump > 0:
        n = img(maps["nor"], True)
        nm = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeNormalMap")
        nm.inputs["Strength"].default_value = bump
        nt.links.new(n.outputs["Color"], nm.inputs["Color"])
        nt.links.new(nm.outputs["Normal"], b.inputs["Normal"])
    m["ph_maps"] = json.dumps(maps)
    return m


def assign(obj, material, slot=None):
    if obj.data.materials and slot is None:
        obj.data.materials[0] = material
    else:
        obj.data.materials.append(material)
    return obj


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Geometry
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _new_mesh_obj(name, verts, faces, coll=None):
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    me.from_pydata(verts, [], faces)
    me.update()
    return link(bpy.data.objects.new(name, me), coll)


def shade_smooth(obj, angle=None):
    for p in obj.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth = True
    if angle is not None and hasattr(obj, "modifiers"):
        try:
            bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obj
            obj.select_set(True)
            bpy.ops.object.shade_auto_smooth(angle=math.radians(angle))
        except Exception:
            pass
    return obj


def box(name="Box", size=(1, 1, 1), loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), mat_=None, bevel=0.0, coll=None):
    sx, sy, sz = [s / 2 for s in size]
    v = [(-sx, -sy, -sz), (sx, -sy, -sz), (sx, sy, -sz), (-sx, sy, -sz), (-sx, -sy, sz), (sx, -sy, sz), (sx, sy, sz), (-sx, sy, sz)]
    f = [(0, 3, 2, 1), (4, 5, 6, 7), (0, 1, 5, 4), (1, 2, 6, 5), (2, 3, 7, 6), (3, 0, 4, 7)]
    o = _new_mesh_obj(name, v, f, coll)
    o.location = loc
    o.rotation_euler = [math.radians(a) for a in rot]
    if bevel:
        bm = o.modifiers.new("bevel", "BEVEL")
        bm.width = bevel
        bm.segments = 2
    if mat_:
        assign(o, mat_)
    return o


def prim(kind, name=None, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), scale=(1, 1, 1), mat_=None, **kw):
    """bpy.ops primitive wrapper: kind in plane, cube, uv_sphere, ico_sphere, cylinder, cone, torus, circle, grid."""
    fn = getattr(bpy.ops.mesh, "primitive_%s_add" % kind)
    fn(location=loc, rotation=[math.radians(a) for a in rot], **kw)
    o = bpy.context.active_object
    o.scale = scale
    if name:
        o.name = name
    if mat_:
        assign(o, mat_)
    return o


def fbm(x, y, octaves=5, lac=2.0, gain=0.5, seed=0.0):
    a, f, s = 1.0, 1.0, 0.0
    for i in range(octaves):
        s += a * noise.noise(Vector((x * f, y * f, seed + i * 7.31)))
        a *= gain
        f *= lac
    return s


def terrain(name="Terrain", size=200.0, res=160, height=1.5, scale=0.04, seed=0.0, mat_=None,
            height_fn=None, sizey=None, coll=None):
    """Grid terrain. Height = fbm noise * height (+ height_fn(x, y) if given). Returns object with
    .height_at(x, y) helper stored in core.TERRAIN for prop placement."""
    sx, sy = size, (sizey or size)
    nx, ny = res, int(res * sy / sx)
    verts, faces = [], []
    for j in range(ny + 1):
        for i in range(nx + 1):
            x = -sx / 2 + sx * i / nx
            y = -sy / 2 + sy * j / ny
            z = fbm(x * scale, y * scale, seed=seed) * height
            if height_fn:
                z += height_fn(x, y)
            verts.append((x, y, z))
    for j in range(ny):
        for i in range(nx):
            a = j * (nx + 1) + i
            faces.append((a, a + 1, a + nx + 2, a + nx + 1))
    o = _new_mesh_obj(name, verts, faces, coll)
    shade_smooth(o)
    if mat_:
        assign(o, mat_)
    TERRAINS[name] = (sx, sy, height, scale, seed, height_fn)
    return o


TERRAINS = {}


def height_at(name, x, y):
    sx, sy, height, scale, seed, height_fn = TERRAINS[name]
    z = fbm(x * scale, y * scale, seed=seed) * height
    if height_fn:
        z += height_fn(x, y)
    return z


def golgotha_hill(peak=9.0, radius=38.0, cx=0.0, cy=0.0):
    """Height function for a rounded rocky hill (add to terrain via height_fn)."""
    def f(x, y):
        d2 = ((x - cx) ** 2 + (y - cy) ** 2) / (radius ** 2)
        return peak * math.exp(-d2 * 2.2)
    return f


def displace(obj, strength=0.2, scale=1.0, texture="CLOUDS", subdiv=0, midlevel=0.5, coords="LOCAL"):
    if subdiv:
        s = obj.modifiers.new("subdiv", "SUBSURF")
        s.levels = s.render_levels = subdiv
    t = bpy.data.textures.new(obj.name + "_disp", texture)
    if hasattr(t, "noise_scale"):
        t.noise_scale = scale
    m = obj.modifiers.new("displace", "DISPLACE")
    m.texture = t
    m.strength = strength
    m.mid_level = midlevel
    m.texture_coords = coords
    return m


def append_blend(path, names=None, kind="objects", coll=None):
    """Append datablocks from a .blend. Returns appended objects (linked to coll / scene)."""
    with bpy.data.libraries.load(path, link=False) as (src, dst):
        avail = getattr(src, kind)
        setattr(dst, kind, [n for n in avail if (names is None or n in names)])
    got = list(getattr(dst, kind))
    if kind == "objects":
        for o in got:
            if o is not None:
                link(o, coll)
    return got


def ph_model(asset, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), scale=1.0, res="1k", coll=None, name=None):
    """Append a Poly Haven model (all its mesh objects), parented to an empty you can move."""
    path = ph.model_blend(asset, res)
    objs = [o for o in append_blend(path, kind="objects", coll=coll) if o is not None]
    root = link(bpy.data.objects.new(name or asset, None), coll)
    for o in objs:
        if o.parent is None:
            o.parent = root
    root.location = loc
    root.rotation_euler = [math.radians(a) for a in rot]
    root.scale = (scale, scale, scale)
    return root, objs


def instance(src_root, loc, rot=(0, 0, 0), scale=1.0, coll=None):
    """Cheap linked duplicate of a hierarchy (meshes shared)."""
    root = link(bpy.data.objects.new(src_root.name + "_inst", None), coll)
    for ch in src_root.children:
        d = ch.copy()
        link(d, coll)
        d.parent = root
    root.location = loc
    root.rotation_euler = [math.radians(a) for a in rot]
    root.scale = (scale, scale, scale) if not isinstance(scale, (tuple, list)) else scale
    return root


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Common props
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
_WOOD = {}


def wood_material(kind="rough_wood", scale=1.2, tint=(0.75, 0.62, 0.5)):
    key = (kind, scale, tint)
    m = _WOOD.get(key)
    try:
        m = m if (m is not None and m.name in bpy.data.materials) else None
    except ReferenceError:  # material freed by a scene reset (several scenes built in one process)
        m = None
    if m is None:
        _WOOD[key] = m = mat_pbr(kind, scale=scale, tint=tint, name="wood_" + kind)
    return m


def wooden_cross(loc=(0, 0, 0), height=4.3, beam=2.0, thick=0.2, cross_at=0.78, rot_z=0, name="Cross",
                 material=None, sign=False, coll=None):
    """Rough-hewn cross. loc = base on the ground. Returns root empty; child objects 'upright',
    'beam' (and 'sign'). The crossbeam centre is at z = height*cross_at."""
    material = material or wood_material()
    root = link(bpy.data.objects.new(name, None), coll)
    up = box(name + "_upright", (thick, thick * 0.95, height), (0, 0, height / 2), mat_=material, bevel=0.01, coll=coll)
    bm = box(name + "_beam", (beam, thick * 0.9, thick * 0.85), (0, -thick * 0.05, height * cross_at), mat_=material, bevel=0.01, coll=coll)
    for o in (up, bm):
        o.parent = root
        displace(o, strength=0.012, scale=0.08, subdiv=0)
    parts = [up, bm]
    if sign:
        s = box(name + "_sign", (0.55, 0.03, 0.22), (0, -thick * 0.55, height * cross_at + 0.42),
                mat_=mat_pbr("wood_table_worn", scale=2, tint=(0.9, 0.85, 0.75), name="sign_wood"), coll=coll)
        s.parent = root
        parts.append(s)
    root.location = loc
    root.rotation_euler = (0, 0, math.radians(rot_z))
    return root


def dust_motes(center=(0, 0, 1.5), size=(6, 6, 3), count=400, radius=0.004, color=(1.0, 0.92, 0.8),
               emission=0.0, drift=(0.05, 0.02, 0.01), brownian=0.03, seed=0, coll=None, start=-60):
    """Floating dust particles (backlit specks). Uses a particle system; sets ctx bake need via caller."""
    v = []
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    cx, cy, cz = center
    for _ in range(count):
        v.append((cx + (rnd.random() - 0.5) * size[0], cy + (rnd.random() - 0.5) * size[1], cz + (rnd.random() - 0.5) * size[2]))
    em = _new_mesh_obj("dust_emitter", v, [], coll)
    sp = prim("ico_sphere", name="dust_speck", subdivisions=1, radius=radius)
    m = mat("dust", color, rough=1.0, emission=color if emission else None, emission_strength=emission)
    assign(sp, m)
    sp.hide_render = False
    sp.location = (0, 0, -1000)
    ps = em.modifiers.new("dust", "PARTICLE_SYSTEM").particle_system
    st = ps.settings
    st.count = count
    st.emit_from = "VERT"
    st.use_emit_random = False
    st.frame_start = st.frame_end = start
    st.lifetime = 100000
    st.normal_factor = 0
    st.object_align_factor = drift
    st.brownian_factor = brownian
    st.effector_weights.gravity = 0
    st.render_type = "OBJECT"
    st.instance_object = sp
    st.particle_size = 1.0
    st.size_random = 0.6
    st.physics_type = "NEWTON"
    em.show_instancer_for_render = False
    return em


def fog_box(center=(0, 0, 2), size=(20, 20, 4), density=0.03, color=(0.8, 0.78, 0.75), anisotropy=0.3,
            noise_scale=None, name="Fog", coll=None):
    o = box(name, size, center, coll=coll)
    assign(o, mat_volume(name + "_vol", density, color, anisotropy, noise_scale))
    return o


def ground_plane(size=400, mat_=None, z=0.0, name="Ground"):
    o = prim("plane", name=name, size=size, loc=(0, 0, z))
    if mat_:
        assign(o, mat_)
    return o


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Baking / misc
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def bake_all(ctx):
    """Bake particles / cloth / rigid bodies sequentially so random-access frame renders work."""
    sc = bpy.context.scene
    cache_dir = os.path.join(WORK, "cache", ctx.id)
    os.makedirs(cache_dir, exist_ok=True)
    # Step the timeline once: particle systems and cloth without disk cache get evaluated in memory.
    for f in range(sc.frame_start, sc.frame_end + 1):
        sc.frame_set(f)
    try:
        with bpy.context.temp_override(scene=sc):
            bpy.ops.ptcache.bake_all(bake=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print("bake_all warning:", e)
    sc.frame_set(1)


def save_post(ctx, path):
    data = dict(ctx.post)
    data["id"] = ctx.id
    json.dump(data, open(path, "w"), indent=1)

"""Reusable OUTDOOR environments for Psalm 22 (Blender 4.5, EEVEE Next).

    from lib import env as E
    A = E.golgotha(ctx, mood="golden")          # hill + 3 crosses + Jerusalem + sky; returns anchors dict
    A = E.judean_hills(ctx, timelapse=True)      # day -> dusk -> night time-lapse (s02a)

Building blocks: sky(mood) / sky_preset(name), night_sky(), clouds_layer(), god_rays(), dust_storm(),
scatter(), olive_tree(), dead_tree(), thorn_bush(), grass_tuft(), jerusalem(), haze controls.
Full API reference: psalm22/docs/env.md

Conventions: metres, Z up, frames 1-based. Everything heavy (decimated Poly Haven props, generated
trees) is cached in /opt/assets/env so repeated shot builds stay fast.
