            # cloth output is in object space == armature space (garments sit at identity under the rig)
            m = g.modifiers.get("WardrobeCloth")
            if m:
                g.modifiers.remove(m)
            if keep_rig:
                R = _unskin(rig, g, P)
            else:
                R = P
                am = g.modifiers.get("Armature")
                if am:
                    g.modifiers.remove(am)
            g.data.vertices.foreach_set("co", R.ravel())
            g.data.update()
            for mm in g.modifiers:
                if mm.type in ("SOLIDIFY", "SUBSURF", "MASK"):
                    mm.show_viewport = True
            # it is now a collider for the next layers
            if sequential and g is not soft[-1]:
                g.modifiers.new("WardrobeCollision", "COLLISION")
                so = next((x for x in g.modifiers if x.type == "SOLIDIFY"), None)
                g.collision.thickness_outer = 0.002 + (so.thickness if so else 0.0)
                g.collision.cloth_friction = 10
            done.append(g)
        if verbose:
            print("  [wardrobe] drape %s %.1fs" % ([x.name for x in grp], time.time() - t0), flush=True)
    for g in soft:
        m = g.modifiers.get("WardrobeCollision")
        if m:
            g.modifiers.remove(m)
    m = body.modifiers.get("WardrobeCollision")
    if m:
        body.modifiers.remove(m)
    if floor is not None:
        me = floor.data
        bpy.data.objects.remove(floor)
        bpy.data.meshes.remove(me)
    _apply_snapshot(rig, snap, 1.0)
    if ad:
        ad.action = act_save
    sc.frame_start, sc.frame_end = fs_save, fe_save
    sc.frame_set(f_save)
    print("wardrobe.drape(%s) %d garments %.1fs" % (person.body.name, len(done), time.time() - t0), flush=True)
    return done


def _floor_collider(z, center=(0, 0), size=40.0, name="wardrobe_floor"):
    fm = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    cx, cy = center
    h = size / 2
    fm.from_pydata([(cx - h, cy - h, z), (cx + h, cy - h, z), (cx + h, cy + h, z), (cx - h, cy + h, z)], [], [(0, 1, 2, 3)])
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, fm)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(ob)
    ob.modifiers.new("col", "COLLISION")
    ob.collision.thickness_outer = 0.004
    ob.collision.cloth_friction = 20
    ob.hide_render = True
    return ob


def cloth_sim(person, garments, ctx=None, preroll=20, frame_end=None, quality=5, self_collision=False, ground=None,
              bake=True):
    """Live cloth simulation for ANIMATED hero shots.

    Adds a Cloth modifier (after the Armature, pinned by the 'pin' group) to every soft garment and a
    Collision modifier to the body. The cloth cache starts `preroll` frames before frame 1 and the rig gets
    rest-pose keys at frame 1-preroll, so the cloth starts from its rest fit and is carried into the first
    pose. ground: None, a world z (temporary invisible floor collider) or a mesh object (gets a Collision
    modifier, e.g. the terrain). bake=True bakes right away (bpy.ops.ptcache.bake_all, in memory), which is
    REQUIRED for the pre-roll (scene.frame_start can't go below 0, so a sequential render from frame 1 would
    never visit it); bake=False only sets ctx.needs_bake. Call AFTER the character's animation is keyed.
    Returns the cloth modifiers."""
    rig, body = person.rig, person.body
    sc = bpy.context.scene
    B = body_info(person)
    f0 = 1 - preroll
    fe = frame_end or sc.frame_end
    for pb in rig.pose.bones:
        mode = pb.rotation_mode
        snap = (pb.location.copy(), pb.rotation_quaternion.copy(), pb.rotation_euler.copy(), pb.scale.copy())
        pb.location = (0, 0, 0)
        pb.scale = (1, 1, 1)
        pb.rotation_quaternion = (1, 0, 0, 0)
        pb.rotation_euler = (0, 0, 0)
        pb.keyframe_insert("location", frame=f0)
        pb.keyframe_insert("rotation_quaternion" if mode == "QUATERNION" else "rotation_euler", frame=f0)
        pb.location, pb.rotation_quaternion, pb.rotation_euler, pb.scale = snap
    _add_collision(body)
    if ground is not None:
        if isinstance(ground, bpy.types.Object):
            if not any(m.type == "COLLISION" for m in ground.modifiers):
                ground.modifiers.new("WardrobeCollision", "COLLISION")
        else:
            _floor_collider(float(ground), tuple(rig.matrix_world.translation[:2]))
    mods = []
    soft = [g for g in garments if g.type == "MESH" and _is_soft(g)]
    for g in soft:
        if g.vertex_groups.get("pin") is None:
            auto_pin(person, g, B)
        mods.append(_add_cloth(g, _fabric_of(g), quality, f0, fe, self_collision))
        if g is not soft[-1]:
            # inner layers collide with the outer ones (garments are built inner -> outer)
            g.modifiers.new("WardrobeCollision", "COLLISION")
            so = next((x for x in g.modifiers if x.type == "SOLIDIFY"), None)
            g.collision.thickness_outer = 0.002 + (so.thickness if so else 0.0)
            g.collision.cloth_friction = 10
    # the moving cloth can uncover skin / inner layers that were masked for the fitted rest shape
    for o in [body] + soft:
        mm = o.modifiers.get("WardrobeHide")
        if mm is not None:
            o.modifiers.remove(mm)
    if bake and mods:
        t = time.time()
        fc = sc.frame_current
        try:
            with bpy.context.temp_override(scene=sc):
                bpy.ops.ptcache.bake_all(bake=True)
        except Exception as e:
            print("wardrobe.cloth_sim bake warning:", e)
        sc.frame_set(fc)
        print("wardrobe.cloth_sim baked %d garments %d frames in %.1fs" % (len(mods), fe - f0 + 1, time.time() - t), flush=True)
    elif ctx is not None:
        ctx.needs_bake = True
    return mods

OUTFITS = ["loincloth", "tunic", "robe", "robe_rich", "mantle", "veil", "headcloth", "turban", "hood",
           "roman_soldier", "swaddle", "crown_of_thorns", "sandals"]


def _pick(colors, part, rnd, default=None, aliases=()):
    c = None
    if isinstance(colors, dict):
        for k in (part,) + tuple(aliases):
            if k in colors:
                c = colors[k]
                break
    elif colors is not None and part in ("tunic", "main") + tuple(aliases):
        c = colors
    if c is None:
        c = default if default is not None else rnd.choice(CHOICES.get(part, CHOICES["tunic"]))
    return color(c, rnd, 0.05 if isinstance(c, str) else 0.0)


def dress(person, outfit, colors=None, seed=0, detail="hero", **opts):
    """Build `outfit` (name or list of names) on `person`; returns the list of garment objects
    (parented to person.rig, deformed by its armature). See docs/wardrobe.md."""
    if isinstance(outfit, (list, tuple)):
        out = []
        names = list(outfit)
        if "robe" in names and "mantle" in names:
            names.remove("mantle")
        if ("robe" in names or "robe_rich" in names or "roman_soldier" in names) and "tunic" in names:
            names.remove("tunic")
        if "roman_soldier" in names and "sandals" in names:
            names.remove("sandals")
        # build inner layers first
        order = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(["loincloth", "swaddle", "tunic", "robe", "robe_rich", "roman_soldier", "mantle",
                                              "veil", "headcloth", "hood", "turban", "crown_of_thorns", "sandals"])}
        names.sort(key=lambda n: order.get(n, 50))
        for i, o in enumerate(names):
            out += dress(person, o, colors, seed + i * 17, detail, **(opts.get(o, {}) if isinstance(opts.get(o), dict) else {}))
        return out
    t0 = time.time()
    _T0[0] = t0
    rnd = random.Random("%s/%s" % (outfit, seed))
    B = body_info(person)
    _tick("body info")
    if detail not in ("hero", "crowd"):
        detail = "crowd"
    out = []
    o = dict(opts)
    if outfit == "tunic":
        gs, G = part_tunic(person, B, rnd, _pick(colors, "tunic", rnd), detail=detail,
                           belt_rgb=_pick(colors, "belt", rnd) if isinstance(colors, dict) and "belt" in colors else None, **o)
        out += gs
    elif outfit == "robe":
        o.setdefault("length", "ankle")
        o.setdefault("sleeves", "long" if rnd.random() < 0.5 else "elbow")
        gs, G = part_tunic(person, B, rnd, _pick(colors, "tunic", rnd, aliases=("robe",)), detail=detail, **o)
        out += gs
        gs, G = part_mantle(person, B, rnd, _pick(colors, "mantle", rnd), detail=detail, side=rnd.choice(("L", "L", "R")))
        out += gs
    elif outfit == "mantle":
        gs, G = part_mantle(person, B, rnd, _pick(colors, "mantle", rnd, aliases=("main",)), detail=detail, **o)
        out += gs
    elif outfit == "robe_rich":
        out += outfit_robe_rich(person, B, rnd, colors, detail=detail)
    elif outfit in ("veil", "headcloth", "hood"):
        gs, G = part_headcover(person, B, rnd, _pick(colors, outfit, rnd, aliases=("main",)), kind=outfit, detail=detail, **o)
        out += gs
    elif outfit == "turban":
        gs, G = part_turban(person, B, rnd, _pick(colors, "turban", rnd, "bleached", aliases=("main",)), detail=detail, **o)
        out += gs
    elif outfit == "crown_of_thorns":
        out += part_crown(person, B, rnd, detail=detail, **o)
    elif outfit == "loincloth":
        gs, G = part_loincloth(person, B, rnd, _pick(colors, "loincloth", rnd, "linen", aliases=("main",)), detail=detail, **o)
        out += gs
    elif outfit == "swaddle":
        gs, G = part_swaddle(person, B, rnd, _pick(colors, "swaddle", rnd, "white_linen", aliases=("main",)), detail=detail, **o)
        out += gs
    elif outfit == "sandals":
        out += part_sandals(person, B, rnd, _pick(colors, "sandals", rnd, rnd.choice(["leather", "dark_leather", "camel"])),
                            detail=detail, **o)
    elif outfit == "roman_soldier":
        out += outfit_roman_soldier(person, B, rnd, colors, detail=detail, **o)
    else:
        raise ValueError("unknown outfit %r (choose from %s)" % (outfit, OUTFITS))
    for g in out:
        g["outfit"] = outfit
    if hasattr(person, "garments"):
        for g in out:
            if g not in person.garments:
                person.garments.append(g)
    print("wardrobe.dress(%s, %s, %s) %d objects %.2fs" % (person.body.name, outfit, detail, len(out), time.time() - t0), flush=True)
    return out

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/shots/s00.py =====
"""s00 - Golgotha, title shot (frame 1 = the social-media thumbnail).

Three crosses with small crucified silhouettes on the skull-faced hill, seen from the plain at golden
light. The sun hangs low just right of the centre cross, partly veiled; crepuscular rays fan out of it
through the haze, towering clouds stand to the left and a dark storm front creeps in from the left
(the darkness of s01a+ is coming). Slow push-in and gentle rise. The upper-middle sky stays calm for the
'PSALM 22 / A Psalm of David' title (added by the compositor).
"""
import math
import bpy
import numpy as np
from mathutils import Vector
from lib import core as C, env as E

HDRI = "table_mountain_2_puresky"
VIS_SUN_OFF = (2.6, None)        # visible sun: degrees right of the view axis, elevation (None = HDRI's)
LAMP = (152.0, 13.0)             # sun lamp (core az, el): back-right, low -> rims + raking light on the cliff
CAM0 = ((0.0, -59.5, 7.5), (0.0, 0.6, 16.7), 70.0)    # loc, target, lens at frame 1
CAM1 = ((0.0, -53.0, 8.6), (0.0, 0.6, 17.0), 70.0)     # at the end of the tail
GOLD_MAP = [(0.0, (0.85, 0.95, 1.35)), (0.2, (1.0, 0.98, 1.05)), (0.4, (1.35, 0.95, 0.55)),
            (0.6, (1.4, 0.93, 0.45)), (0.8, (1.25, 0.97, 0.65)), (1.0, (1.05, 1.0, 0.92))]


def _dir(az, el):
    a, e = math.radians(az), math.radians(el)
    return Vector((math.sin(a) * math.cos(e), -math.cos(a) * math.cos(e), math.sin(e)))


def _az(d):
    return math.degrees(math.atan2(d.x, -d.y))


def _uniform(T, name, value, keys=None):
    """Scene-property uniform (cheap to animate). keys = [(frame, value), ...] -> linear."""
    E.scene_prop(name, value)
    if keys:
        for f, v in keys:
            E.scene_prop(name, v, f)
        E._linear_keys(bpy.context.scene)
    return E._lattr(T, name, value)


def sky_fx(S, sun_vis, rays=0.55, ray_keys=None, storm=0.0, storm_keys=None, storm_tint=(0.30, 0.27, 0.29),
           grad=0.35, grad_tint=(0.62, 0.55, 0.52), veil=0.0, gmap=None, gmix=0.75, gk=0.5, glow=0.0,
           glow_color=(1.5, 1.0, 0.55), glow_width=0.35, prefix="sfx"):
    """Camera-only sky treatment spliced in front of the env sky's background shader:
    crepuscular rays radiating from sun_vis, a graduated darkening of the upper sky, and a dark storm
    front from screen-left (edge animated through `storm_keys` = [(frame, edge)])."""
    nt = bpy.context.scene.world.node_tree
    T = E._NT(nt)
    bg = S["nodes"]["bg"]
    src = bg.inputs[0].links[0].from_socket
    tc = T.node("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
    vn = T.vmath("NORMALIZE", tc.outputs["Generated"])
    vx, vy, vz = T.sep(vn)
    s = Vector(sun_vis).normalized()
    a = s.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1))).normalized()          # screen-right around the sun
    b = a.cross(s).normalized()                           # up around the sun
    da = T.vmath("DOT_PRODUCT", vn, tuple(a))
    db = T.vmath("DOT_PRODUCT", vn, tuple(b))
    ds = T.vmath("DOT_PRODUCT", vn, tuple(s))
    col = src
    # --- crepuscular rays ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    if rays:
        # seamless: noise sampled on a circle around the sun (angle only -> radial shafts)
        q = T.vmath("NORMALIZE", T.comb(da, T.math("MULTIPLY", db, -1.0), 0.0))
        th = T.math("ARCCOSINE", T.math("MINIMUM", T.math("MAXIMUM", ds, -1.0), 1.0))
        drift = _uniform(T, prefix + "_ray_drift", 0.0, ray_keys)
        n1 = T.noise(T.vmath("ADD", T.vmath("SCALE", q, scale=2.2), T.comb(0.0, 0.0, drift)),
                     scale=1.0, detail=1.0, rough=0.5)
        n2 = T.noise(T.vmath("ADD", T.vmath("SCALE", q, scale=6.5), T.comb(3.1, 0.0, T.math("MULTIPLY", drift, 1.7))),
                     scale=1.0, detail=0.0, rough=0.5)
        r1 = T.smooth(0.36, 0.64, n1.outputs["Fac"])
        r2 = T.smooth(0.36, 0.66, n2.outputs["Fac"])
        r = T.math("ADD", T.math("MULTIPLY", r1, 0.62), T.math("MULTIPLY", r2, 0.38))
        f_in = T.smooth(0.015, 0.09, th)
        f_out = T.math("SUBTRACT", 1.0, T.smooth(0.25, 0.95, th))
        fall = T.math("MULTIPLY", f_in, f_out)
        amt = _uniform(T, prefix + "_rays", rays)
        m = T.math("ADD", 1.0, T.math("MULTIPLY", T.math("MULTIPLY", T.math("SUBTRACT", r, 0.42), fall), amt))
        warm = T.comb(m, T.math("MULTIPLY_ADD", m, 0.97, 0.03), T.math("MULTIPLY_ADD", m, 0.9, 0.1))
        col = T.mix(1.0, col, warm, blend="MULTIPLY")
    # --- veil: thin cloud streaks crossing the sun ------------------------------------------------
    if veil:
        # coordinates on a plane through the sun: (da, db) ~ angular offsets (radians)
        pv = T.comb(T.math("MULTIPLY", da, 3.0), T.math("MULTIPLY", db, 22.0), 0.0)
        nv = T.noise(pv, scale=1.0, detail=4.0, rough=0.55, dist=0.3)
        dens = T.math("MULTIPLY", T.smooth(0.46, 0.70, nv.outputs["Fac"]),
                      T.math("SUBTRACT", 1.0, T.smooth(0.03, 0.10, T.math("ABSOLUTE", db))))
        dens = T.math("MULTIPLY", dens, T.math("SUBTRACT", 1.0, T.smooth(0.10, 0.25, T.math("ABSOLUTE", da))))
        dens = T.math("MULTIPLY", dens, veil)
        vc = T.mix(T.math("MULTIPLY", dens, 0.85), col, (0.55, 0.36, 0.22), blend="MULTIPLY")
        col = vc
    # --- graduated darkening of the upper sky -------------------------------------------------
    if grad:
        g = T.math("MULTIPLY", T.smooth(0.10, 0.48, vz), grad)
        col = T.mix(g, col, tuple(grad_tint), blend="MULTIPLY")
    # --- storm front from screen-left ------------------------------------------------------------
    if storm:
        t = T.math("DIVIDE", 1.0, T.math("MAXIMUM", vz, 0.035))
        pc = T.comb(T.math("MULTIPLY", vx, t), T.math("MULTIPLY", vy, t), 0.0)
        tw = _uniform(T, prefix + "_storm_time", 0.0, None)
        pc = T.vmath("ADD", T.vmath("SCALE", pc, scale=0.9), T.comb(tw, 0.0, T.math("MULTIPLY", tw, 0.3)))
        cn = T.noise(pc, scale=1.0, detail=6.0, rough=0.6, dist=0.25).outputs["Fac"]
        edge = _uniform(T, prefix + "_storm_edge", 0.1, storm_keys)
        x = T.math("ADD", T.math("MULTIPLY", da, -1.0), T.math("MULTIPLY", vz, 0.45))
        x = T.math("ADD", x, T.math("MULTIPLY", T.math("SUBTRACT", cn, 0.5), 0.22))
        # smoothstep with an animated edge: (x - edge) / width
        u = T.math("DIVIDE", T.math("SUBTRACT", x, edge), 0.09)
        sm = T.smooth(0.0, 1.0, u)
        sm = T.math("MULTIPLY", sm, storm)
        dark = T.mix(T.smooth(0.35, 0.75, cn), tuple(storm_tint), tuple(c * 1.9 for c in storm_tint))
        sat = T.node("ShaderNodeHueSaturation")
        sat.inputs["Saturation"].default_value = 0.55
        T.link(col, sat.inputs["Color"])
        dcol = T.mix(1.0, sat.outputs["Color"], dark, blend="MULTIPLY")
        col = T.mix(sm, col, dcol)
    # --- warm glow around the sun (golden-hour air) ------------------------------------------------
    if glow:
        th2 = T.math("ARCCOSINE", T.math("MINIMUM", T.math("MAXIMUM", ds, -1.0), 1.0))
        gf = T.math("MULTIPLY", T.math("EXPONENT", T.math("MULTIPLY", th2, -1.0 / glow_width)), glow)
        col = T.mix(gf, col, tuple(glow_color), blend="MULTIPLY")
    # --- gradient map: recolour the sky by its own (display) luminance, keeping its tonal structure ----
    if gmap:
        bgv = float(bg.inputs[1].default_value)
        lum = T.node("ShaderNodeRGBToBW")
        T.link(col, lum.inputs[0])
        L = lum.outputs[0]
        Ld = T.math("MULTIPLY", L, bgv)
        x = T.math("DIVIDE", Ld, T.math("ADD", Ld, gk))
        rp = T.ramp(x, gmap, interp="B_SPLINE" if len(gmap) > 3 else "LINEAR")
        cg = T.mix(1.0, rp.outputs["Color"], T.comb(L, L, L), blend="MULTIPLY")
        col = T.mix(gmix, col, cg)
    T.link(col, bg.inputs[0])
    return T


def cull_scatter(names, pred):
    """Delete GN-scattered instances (env.scatter point clouds) of objects whose name starts with one of
    `names` where pred(x, y, z, size) is True (numpy arrays, world space). Returns the number removed."""
    import numpy as np
    removed = 0
    for ob in list(bpy.data.objects):
        if "n_instances" not in ob.keys() or not any(ob.name.startswith(n) for n in names):
            continue
        me = ob.data
        nv = len(me.vertices)
        if nv == 0:
            continue
        co = np.zeros(nv * 3, np.float32)
        me.vertices.foreach_get("co", co)
        co = co.reshape(-1, 3)
        M = np.array(ob.matrix_world)
        wc = co @ M[:3, :3].T + M[:3, 3]
        attrs = {}
        for at in me.attributes:
            if at.domain != "POINT" or at.name == "position" or at.name.startswith("."):
                continue
            if at.data_type == "FLOAT_VECTOR":
                arr = np.zeros(nv * 3, np.float32)
                at.data.foreach_get("vector", arr)
                arr = arr.reshape(-1, 3)
            elif at.data_type == "INT":
                arr = np.zeros(nv, np.int32)
                at.data.foreach_get("value", arr)
            elif at.data_type == "FLOAT":
                arr = np.zeros(nv, np.float32)
                at.data.foreach_get("value", arr)
            else:
                continue
            attrs[at.name] = (at.data_type, arr)
        size = attrs["scl"][1].max(axis=1) if "scl" in attrs else np.ones(nv, np.float32)
        keep = ~pred(wc[:, 0], wc[:, 1], wc[:, 2], size)
        k = int(keep.sum())
        if k == nv:
            continue
        removed += nv - k
        nm = bpy.data.meshes.new(me.name + "_cull")
        nm.vertices.add(k)
        nm.vertices.foreach_set("co", co[keep].ravel())
        for name, (dt, arr) in attrs.items():
            at = nm.attributes.new(name, dt, "POINT")
            if dt == "FLOAT_VECTOR":
                at.data.foreach_set("vector", arr[keep].ravel())
            else:
                at.data.foreach_set("value", arr[keep])
        nm.update()
        ob.data = nm
        ob["n_instances"] = k
        if k == 0:
            ob.hide_render = True
    return removed


def _occluded_fn(cams, edge=(-11.0, 10.2), margin_deg=2.5):
    """Predicate for cull_scatter: True where an instance is invisible from every camera key: behind
    the skull-cliff crest below the line of sight, outside the horizontal frustum, or under the frame."""
    import numpy as np

    def pred(x, y, z, size):
        hidden = np.ones(len(x), bool)
        for (loc, tgt, lens) in cams:
            cx, cy, cz = loc
            fx, fy = tgt[0] - cx, tgt[1] - cy
            yaw = math.atan2(fx, fy)
            half = math.atan(18.0 * 9.0 / 16.0 / lens) + math.radians(margin_deg)
            ang = np.arctan2(x - cx, y - cy) - yaw
            out_side = np.abs(ang) > half
            slope = (edge[1] - cz) / (edge[0] - cy)
            behind = (y > edge[0] + 0.5) & (z + 2.0 * size < cz + slope * (y - cy))
            pitch = math.atan2(tgt[2] - cz, math.hypot(fx, fy))
            low = math.atan(18.0 / lens) - pitch + math.radians(margin_deg)       # bottom ray below horizon
            d = np.hypot(x - cx, y - cy)
            under = (y < edge[0]) & ((cz - (z + 2.0 * size)) / np.maximum(d, 0.1) > math.tan(low))
            hidden &= out_side | behind | under
        return hidden
    return pred


def figures(A, lod="mid"):
    """Jesus on the centre cross, the two thieves (CROWD_MAN variants) on the side crosses."""
    from lib import characters as P
    out = []
    try:
        j = P.make_person("jesus", "JESUS_CROSS", pose=None, lod=lod, hair_strands=False)
    except Exception as e:                     # wardrobe in flux: fall back to an undressed figure
        print("s00: dressed JESUS_CROSS failed (%s) - undressed" % e)
        j = P.make_person("jesus", "JESUS_CROSS", pose=None, lod=lod, hair_strands=False, outfit=None)
    P.place_on_cross(j, A["crosses"]["center"]["root"], head="down", strain=0.55)
    P.expression(j, "anguish")
    out.append(j)
    for k, seed, side, head in (("left", 5, 1.0, "side"), ("right", 11, -1.0, "down")):
        if k not in A["crosses"]:
            continue
        kw = dict(seed=seed, pose=None, lod="far", hair_strands=False)
        try:
            t = P.make_person("thief_" + k, "CROWD_MAN", outfit=["loincloth"], **kw)
        except Exception as e:
            print("s00: dressed thief failed (%s) - undressed" % e)
            t = P.make_person("thief_" + k, "CROWD_MAN", outfit=None, **kw)
        P.place_on_cross(t, A["crosses"][k]["root"], head=head, strain=0.85, knee_side=side)
        out.append(t)
    return [simplify_person(p) for p in out]


def _simple_mat(name, color, rough=0.7, sheen=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name) or C.mat(name, color=color, rough=rough, sheen=sheen)
    E.hazify(m)
    return m


def simplify_person(p):
    """At ~50 px tall the figures are silhouettes: freeze each into one mesh (bake_static) and swap the
    hero shaders (SSS skin, layered eyes, blended lashes, hair curves) for plain opaque materials.
    Measured: the three live people cost ~19 s/frame at final quality, baked + simple ~1-2 s."""
    from lib import characters as P
    ob = P.bake_static(p, delete=True)
    for ch in list(ob.children):
        if ch.type != "MESH":
            bpy.data.objects.remove(ch, do_unlink=True)
    skin = _simple_mat("S00_Skin", (0.30, 0.19, 0.13), 0.55)
    hair = _simple_mat("S00_Hair", (0.025, 0.018, 0.013), 0.7)
    cloth = _simple_mat("S00_Cloth", (0.55, 0.48, 0.38), 0.9, sheen=0.3)
    thorn = _simple_mat("S00_Thorn", (0.10, 0.07, 0.045), 0.9)
    names = []
    for i, m in enumerate(ob.data.materials):
        n = (m.name if m else "").lower()
        names.append(n)
        if any(k in n for k in ("hair", "brow", "lash", "beard")):
            ob.data.materials[i] = hair
        elif any(k in n for k in ("thorn", "crown")):
            ob.data.materials[i] = thorn
        elif any(k in n for k in ("linen", "fabric", "cloth", "wool", "loin", "garment", "tunic", "hessian")):
            ob.data.materials[i] = cloth
        else:
            ob.data.materials[i] = skin
    print("s00: simplified %s materials: %s" % (ob.name, ", ".join(names)))
    return ob


def build(ctx):
    N = ctx.render_frames
    (l0, t0, lens0), (l1, t1, lens1) = CAM0, CAM1
    view0 = Vector(t0) - Vector(l0)
    info = E.hdri_info(HDRI)
    vis_el = VIS_SUN_OFF[1] if VIS_SUN_OFF[1] is not None else info["sun_el"]
    vis_az = _az(view0) - VIS_SUN_OFF[0]
    over = dict(hdri=HDRI, sun_el=LAMP[1], key=0.42, strength=0.38, clamp_sun=1.5, sat=1.25, tint=(1.0, 0.8, 0.55),
                sun_disk=dict(el=vis_el, size=0.75, color=(1.0, 0.86, 0.62), strength=60.0, glow=0.10))
    cams = [dict(loc=l0, target=t0, lens=lens0), dict(loc=l1, target=t1, lens=lens1)]
    A = E.golgotha(ctx, mood="golden", sun_az=vis_az, sky_over=over, view=cams, near_detail=0.0,
                   city=False, dust=False, skull=0.8)
    # boulders on the plateau would silhouette as blobs on the hill line next to the crosses
    k = cull_scatter(("EnvBoulders", "EnvTalus"), lambda x, y, z, s: (np.abs(x) < 16) & (y > -10.5) & (y < 14) & (z > 8.5))
    print("s00: culled %d plateau boulders" % k)
    # everything the camera cannot see (behind the crest, outside the narrow 70 mm frustum, under the frame)
    k = cull_scatter(("Env",), _occluded_fn([CAM0, CAM1]))
    print("s00: culled %d hidden scatter instances" % k)
    S = A["sky"]
    sun_vis = _dir(vis_az, vis_el)
    # lamp cheated to the back-right; haze glow stays on the visible sun
    S["sun"].rotation_euler = (-_dir(*LAMP)).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
    E.set_haze(sun_dir=tuple(sun_vis), sun_mix=0.9, sun_power=4.0, density=0.0014, start=20.0)
    # faint warm bounce from the sunlit plain behind the camera: models the shadowed skull cliff
    # (light-linked to the cliff + terrain only: crosses and figures stay backlit silhouettes)
    fill = C.sun(elevation=18, azimuth=-20, energy=0.22, color=(1.0, 0.78, 0.55), angle=8)
    fill.data.use_shadow = False
    fill.name = "S00Bounce"
    recv = bpy.data.collections.new("S00BounceRecv")
    for o in (A.get("cliff"), A.get("terrain")):
        if o is not None:
            recv.objects.link(o)
    fill.light_linking.receiver_collection = recv
    sky_fx(S, sun_vis, rays=0.45, veil=0.8, ray_keys=[(1, 0.0), (N, 0.35)], storm=0.9,
           storm_keys=[(1, 0.16), (N, 0.10)], storm_tint=(0.3, 0.3, 0.32), gmap=GOLD_MAP, gmix=0.8)
    E.scene_prop("sfx_storm_time", 0.0, 1)
    E.scene_prop("sfx_storm_time", 0.25, N)
    E._linear_keys(bpy.context.scene)

    figures(A)

    cam = C.camera(loc=l0, target=t0, lens=lens0, name="Cam")

    def path(f):
        u = C.ease_in_out((f - 1) / max(1, N - 1))
        loc = Vector(l0).lerp(Vector(l1), u)
        tgt = Vector(t0).lerp(Vector(t1), u)
        return (loc, tgt, 0.0)
    C.animate_camera(cam, path, 1, N)

    ctx.samples = 4
    ctx.render_opts.update({"volumetrics": "low", "shadow_scale": 0.5})
    ctx.interp = True
    ctx.post.update({"grade": "gold", "bloom": 0.42, "vignette": 0.18,
                     "title": {"ink": "dark"}})          # verified: umber title over the bright golden sky

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/shots/s01a.py =====
"""s01a - "Face on the cross": "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"

Dissolve in from s00 (bright golden wide of Golgotha). Low three-quarter close-up of Jesus on the
centre cross (JESUS_CROSS: crown of thorns, long dark hair, full beard, sweat, dust, a thread of blood at
the brow). The camera sits down-sun (the axis s01b starts on), so the veiled sun hangs above the frame
behind his head: warm rim on the hair, crown and shoulders, a soft warm key on the far side of the face
(short lighting), cool sky fill on the near side, the dark upright of the cross behind his head.
Head bowed and eyes lowered at first; on "My God, my God" the eyes lead, the head lifts to the sky and
the mouth opens as if crying out; through "why have you forsaken me?" he holds the gaze upward in
anguish while the light dims (sky: first third of the eclipse darkening, continued by s01b).
Slow push-in, shallow depth of field.
"""
import json
import math
import os
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector
from lib import core as C
from lib import env as E
from lib import characters as P

SUN_AZ, SUN_EL = 140.0, 30.0      # = s01b (the cut continues on the same axis)
SKYLIGHT = 0.12                   # world (sky dome) lighting multiplier: the lamps shape the face
CAM_AZ = 22.0                     # camera bearing around the face, degrees towards the character's RIGHT (-X)
CAM_EL = -5.0                     # degrees below the eyes
D0, D1 = 1.0, 0.8                 # camera distance (m) start -> end (push-in)
LENS0, LENS1 = 60.0, 62.0
FSTOP = 2.4
EYE_UP = 8.0                      # eye pitch limit (deg, head frame): more and the iris rolls under the lid
AIM_DZ = -0.06                    # aim point below the eyes (puts the eyes at ~0.42 H)
HAIR_N, BEARD_D = 6000, 0.75      # hero strands thinned (cost) - indistinguishable at this size
LIGHTS = dict(key=300.0, rim=320.0, fill=60.0, bounce=4.0, cross=70.0)
SHADOW_RES = 0.004               # coarse shadow texels (m): soft area shadows need no detail, hair shadows are costly
LAST = {}                         # handles for dev tools


def _s01b_dark_window():
    """Frames (in s01a's own numbering) of s01b's darkening ramp, so the cut lands exactly where s01b
    starts (35 % into the warm-overcast -> eclipse cross-fade). Mirrors s01b.build()."""
    tl = json.load(open(os.path.join(C.ROOT, "timeline.json")))
    me = next(s for s in tl["shots"] if s["id"] == "s01a")
    nb = next(s for s in tl["shots"] if s["id"] == "s01b")
    f_dark = int(1 + nb["phrases"][-1]["end"] * tl["fps"]) + 2
    f0 = int(round((1 - 0.40 * f_dark) / 0.60))
    off = me["nframes"]                 # s01b frame 1 == s01a frame nframes + 1
    return f0 + off, f_dark + off


def _sky(ctx):
    # s01b's sky (eclipse -> eclipse: bright warm thin overcast -> eclipse), shifted in time; only the
    # lighting strength of the dome differs (visible sky identical)
    over_a = dict(sun_az=SUN_AZ, sun_el=SUN_EL, key=0.36, strength=0.55 * SKYLIGHT, sun_energy=3.4,
                  tint=(1.0, 0.82, 0.6), sat=1.0, sun_tint=(1.0, 0.8, 0.56), sun_angle=1.2, haze_density=0.0005,
                  haze_tint=(1.0, 0.95, 0.88), fog=(1.0, 0.84, 0.62), exposure=0.0, grade="warm", clouds=0.55,
                  cloud_opts=dict(color=(0.8, 0.72, 0.64), shadow=(0.3, 0.25, 0.22), opacity=0.85, sun_glow=1.2,
                                  speed=(9.0, 3.0)),
                  sun_disk=dict(el=SUN_EL, size=0.9, color=(1.0, 0.86, 0.62), strength=70.0, glow=0.3))
    over_b = dict(sun_az=SUN_AZ, sun_el=SUN_EL, strength=E.SKY_PRESETS["eclipse"]["strength"] * SKYLIGHT,
                  sun_disk=dict(E.SKY_PRESETS["eclipse"]["sun_disk"], el=SUN_EL))
    f0, f1 = _s01b_dark_window()
    tr = E.sky_transition(ctx, "eclipse", "eclipse", f0, f1, over_a=over_a, over_b=over_b)
    return tr, f0, f1


def _lean(j):
    """Render-cost trims for the close-up (measured: hair strands + shadows dominate)."""
    for g in j.garments:                       # off-screen below the chest
        if "loincloth" in g.name:
            g.hide_render = True
    for m in j.body.modifiers:                 # the beard hides the jaw line; -10 % frame time
        if m.type == "SUBSURF":
            m.render_levels = 0
    try:
        old = j.parts.pop("hair_strands", None)
        if old is not None:
            bpy.data.objects.remove(old, do_unlink=True)
        P.make_hair_strands(j, count=HAIR_N, points=10, flyaways=0.0)
        old = j.parts.pop("beard", None)
        if old is not None:
            bpy.data.objects.remove(old, do_unlink=True)
        P.make_beard(j, density=BEARD_D)
    except Exception as e:                     # library in flux: keep whatever exists
        print("s01a WARNING: hair/beard rebuild failed:", e)
    # mouth: the lit MPFB teeth read as dentures/braces at this size; without them the open mouth is a
    # dark cavity (tongue kept), which reads as a cry
    if "teeth" in j.parts:
        j.parts["teeth"].hide_render = True


def _ease(a, b, f):
    return C.smoothstep(min(1.0, max(0.0, (f - a) / float(b - a))))


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# performance: head / eyes / face
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
NECK_W = (("neck01", 0.22), ("neck02", 0.24), ("neck03", 0.24), ("head", 0.30))


def _key_body(j, base, frames, fn):
    """fn(f) -> dict(pitch, tilt, turn, breath) degrees. Keys neck/head/upper spine/clavicles on top of
    the static base pose (place_on_cross)."""
    bones = [n for n, _ in NECK_W] + ["spine02", "spine01", "clavicle.L", "clavicle.R"]
    for f in frames:
        a = fn(f)
        Pz = base.copy()
        br = a.get("breath", 0.0)
        Pz.turn("spine02", bend=-0.8 * br)
        Pz.turn("spine01", bend=-1.0 * br)
        for s in "LR":
            Pz.turn("clavicle." + s, side=(-1.4 * br if s == "L" else 1.4 * br))   # shrug up
        for n, w in NECK_W:
            Pz.turn(n, bend=a["pitch"] * w, side=a.get("tilt", 0.0) * w, twist=a.get("turn", 0.0) * w)
        Pz.write(frame=f, bones=bones)


def _expr_keys(j, keys):
    """keys: [(frame, unit dict, weight)]. All units are created first so every key sets every unit."""
    allu = set()
    for _, d, _w in keys:
        allu |= set(P._expand_units(d))
    P._ensure_units(j, sorted(allu))
    for f, d, w in keys:
        P.expression(j, d, w, frame=f)


def _lights(face_c, df0, df1, N, NR, person):
    L = LIGHTS
    # key: the bright overcast above him - a big soft top-front light (cool-neutral). Lifting his face to
    # the sky turns it into this light. Spot, so it falls off on the chest; lights the person only.
    key = C.light("SPOT", face_c + Vector((0.45, -1.25, 1.55)), L["key"], color=(0.86, 0.9, 1.0),
                  target=face_c + Vector((0, 0, 0.1)), size=0.35, spot_size=34, spot_blend=1.0, name="KeySky")
    # kicker: the veiled sun from behind his left (screen right): far cheek, beard edge, hair, shoulder
    rim = C.light("SPOT", face_c + Vector((1.15, 0.28, 0.5)), L["rim"], color=(1.0, 0.72, 0.45), target=face_c,
                  size=0.25, spot_size=40, spot_blend=0.8, name="KickSun", shadow=False)
    # fill: cool sky from the camera side, broad, no shadows
    fill = C.light("SPOT", face_c + Vector((-1.5, -1.5, 0.3)), L["fill"], color=(0.62, 0.74, 1.0), target=face_c,
                   size=0.8, spot_size=36, spot_blend=1.0, name="FillSky", shadow=False)
    # warm bounce from the sunlit hill below
    bounce = C.light("AREA", face_c + Vector((-0.3, -1.0, -1.4)), L["bounce"], color=(1.0, 0.72, 0.5),
                     target=face_c, size=1.5, name="Bounce", shadow=False)
    # the wood of the cross: soft sky light only (no key), so it reads as dark weathered wood, not a cut-out
    xfill = C.light("AREA", face_c + Vector((-0.8, -1.6, 0.9)), L["cross"], color=(0.9, 0.85, 0.8),
                    target=face_c + Vector((0, 0.3, 0)), size=2.0, name="CrossFill", shadow=False)
    xr = bpy.data.collections.new("S01aCrossRecv")
    for o in bpy.data.objects:
        if o.name.startswith("Cross_center"):
            xr.objects.link(o)
    xfill.light_linking.receiver_collection = xr
    recv = bpy.data.collections.new("S01aKeyRecv")
    for o in person.objects():
        if o.type in ("MESH", "CURVES"):
            recv.objects.link(o)
    for ob in (key, rim):
        ob.light_linking.receiver_collection = recv
    # the light dims with the sky (key/kicker/bounce follow the sun, fill stays)
    for f in sorted(set((1, max(1, int(df0)), N, NR))):
        d = C.smoothstep(min(1.0, max(0.0, (f - df0) / float(df1 - df0))))
        for ob, e0, k in ((key, L["key"], 1.7), (rim, L["rim"], 1.8), (bounce, L["bounce"], 1.4)):
            ob.data.energy = e0 * max(0.0, 1.0 - k * d)
            ob.data.keyframe_insert("energy", frame=f)
        rim.data.color = Vector((1.0, 0.72, 0.45)).lerp(Vector((1.0, 0.42, 0.2)), min(1.0, 2.2 * d))
        rim.data.keyframe_insert("color", frame=f)
    key.data.shadow_maximum_resolution = SHADOW_RES
    flag = _flag(key.location, face_c + Vector((0, 0, -0.16)))
    return dict(key=key, rim=rim, fill=fill, bounce=bounce, xfill=xfill, flag=flag)


def _flag(light_pos, edge_pt, dist=0.35, w=1.2, h=0.8):
    """Camera-invisible black flag that cuts the key off below `edge_pt` (the chin): the chest falls
    into a soft shadow instead of being the brightest skin in the frame."""
    d = (Vector(light_pos) - Vector(edge_pt)).normalized()
    side = d.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1))).normalized()
    up = side.cross(d).normalized()                    # 'up' in the flag plane
    if up.z < 0:
        up = -up
    o = C.prim("plane", name="KeyFlag", size=1.0)
    o.scale = (w, h, 1.0)
    from mathutils import Matrix
    R = Matrix((side, up, d)).transposed()
    o.matrix_world = Matrix.Translation(Vector(edge_pt) + d * dist - up * (h / 2)) @ R.to_4x4() @ Matrix.Diagonal((w, h, 1, 1))
    C.assign(o, C.mat("KeyFlag_mat", (0, 0, 0), rough=1.0))
    for k in ("visible_camera", "visible_diffuse", "visible_glossy", "visible_volume_scatter", "visible_transmission"):
        setattr(o, k, False)
    return o


def build(ctx):
    N, NR = ctx.nframes, ctx.render_frames
    tr, df0, df1 = _sky(ctx)
    tr["sun"].data.use_shadow = False          # back light only (faces away from it); saves ~2 s/frame

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the centre cross of Golgotha
    H = E.golgotha_height(city=True, seed=0)
    gz = float(H(0.0, 0.6))
    cm = C.wood_material("rough_wood", scale=1.2, tint=(0.62, 0.52, 0.42))
    root = C.wooden_cross(loc=(0.0, 0.6, gz - 0.45), height=4.4 + 0.45, name="Cross_center", material=cm, sign=True)
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ Jesus
    j = P.make_person("jesus", "JESUS_CROSS", pose=None, blood=0.65, dirt=0.25, sweat=0.5)   # less grain on the big chest
    P.place_on_cross(j, root, head="level", strain=0.6)
    _lean(j)
    base = j._pose.copy()
    j.update()

    # timing from the narration ("My God, my God," 0.6-1.95 s, pause, "why have you forsaken me?" 2.4-3.9 s)
    ps = ctx.phrases[0]["start"] if ctx.phrases else 0.58
    fw = lambda sec: ctx.frame(ps + sec)
    f_cry0, f_cry1 = fw(0.05), fw(1.35)        # "My God, my God,"
    f_why0 = fw(1.85)                          # "why have you forsaken me?"
    f_lift0, f_lift1 = fw(-0.1), fw(1.75)      # head lift
    f_eye0, f_eye1 = fw(-0.25), fw(0.9)        # eyes lead the head

    def body_fn(f):
        lift = _ease(f_lift0, f_lift1, f)
        pitch = 7.0 - 34.0 * lift - 3.0 * _ease(f_lift1, NR, f)          # + = chin down
        breath = 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(2 * math.pi * (f - 1) / 58.0)        # laboured, ~2.4 s
        nz = C.shake(f, 1.0, 0.5, 7)
        return dict(pitch=pitch + 0.9 * nz.x - 0.8 * breath, tilt=-2.0 + 3.0 * lift + 0.7 * nz.y,
                    turn=-4.0 + 2.0 * lift + 0.8 * nz.z, breath=breath)
    _key_body(j, base, list(range(1, NR + 1, 2)) + ([NR] if NR % 2 == 0 else []), body_fn)

    # expressions (dicts of MakeHuman units, see characters.EXPRESSIONS)
    low = {"eyebrows-inner-up": 0.55, "eyebrows-down": 0.25, "eye-closure": 0.22, "eye-slit": 0.12,
           "mouth-depression": 0.18, "mouth-open": 0.04, "nose-elevation": 0.15, "neck-platysma": 0.2, "jaw": 4}
    cry = {"eyebrows-inner-up": 1.0, "eyebrows-down": 0.28, "eye-slit": 0.2, "eye-opened-up": 0.25,
           "mouth-open": 0.18, "mouth-retraction": 0.12, "mouth-depression": 0.12, "nose-elevation": 0.3,
           "neck-platysma": 0.5, "jaw": 8}
    ang = {"eyebrows-inner-up": 0.95, "eyebrows-down": 0.3, "eye-slit": 0.15, "eye-opened-up": 0.35,
           "nose-elevation": 0.25, "mouth-depression": 0.22, "mouth-open": 0.04, "neck-platysma": 0.32, "jaw": 4}
    keys = [(1, low, 1.0), (int(f_cry0) - 2, low, 1.0), (int(f_cry0) + 8, cry, 0.85),
            (int((f_cry0 + f_cry1) / 2), cry, 0.7), (int(f_cry1) - 2, cry, 1.0), (int(f_cry1) + 9, ang, 1.0),
            (int(f_why0) + 6, ang, 1.15), (int(f_why0) + 22, ang, 1.0), (NR, ang, 1.05)]
    _expr_keys(j, keys)
    # one slow blink in the pause
    fb = int(f_cry1 + 0.5 * (f_why0 - f_cry1)) | 1
    for f, v in ((fb - 3, 0.0), (fb, 1.0), (fb + 4, 0.0)):
        P.eyes_closed(j, v, frame=f)

    # eyes: lowered -> lifted to the sky (lead the head)
    sc = bpy.context.scene
    for f in sorted(set([1] + list(range(int(f_eye0), int(f_eye1) + 4, 4)) + [int(f_lift1), NR])):
        sc.frame_set(f)
        e = j.eye_pos()
        u = _ease(f_eye0, f_eye1, f)
        tgt_low = e + Vector((0.4, -3.0, -1.3))
        tgt_up = e + Vector((0.5, -2.0, 3.0))
        P.eyes_look(j, tgt_low.lerp(tgt_up, u), frame=f, up_limit=EYE_UP)
    sc.frame_set(1)
    e_start = j.eye_pos()
    sc.frame_set(int(f_lift1))
    e_end = j.eye_pos()
    sc.frame_set(1)

    lights = _lights((e_start + e_end) * 0.5, df0, df1, N, NR, j)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ camera
    cam_dir = Vector((-math.sin(math.radians(CAM_AZ)), -math.cos(math.radians(CAM_AZ)), 0.0))
    cam_dir = (cam_dir * math.cos(math.radians(CAM_EL)) + Vector((0, 0, math.sin(math.radians(CAM_EL))))).normalized()
    focus = bpy.data.objects.new("FocusEye", None)
    sc.collection.objects.link(focus)
    focus.parent = j.rig
    focus.parent_type = "BONE"
    focus.parent_bone = "eye.R"            # near eye (camera on the character's right)
    focus.location = (0, 0, 0)
    cam = C.camera(loc=e_start + cam_dir * D0, target=e_start, lens=LENS0, fstop=FSTOP, focus=focus)

    def path(f):
        u = C.ease_in_out(min(1.0, (f - 1) / float(NR - 1)))
        k = _ease(f_lift0 - 6, f_lift1 + 10, f)
        eye = e_start.lerp(e_end, k)
        d = D0 + (D1 - D0) * u
        loc = eye + cam_dir * d + C.shake(f, 0.004, 0.35, 3)
        return (loc, eye + Vector((0, 0, AIM_DZ)), 0.0, LENS0 + (LENS1 - LENS0) * u)
    C.animate_camera(cam, path, 1, NR)

    LAST.update(j=j, cam=cam, root=root, sky=tr, e_start=e_start, e_end=e_end, **lights)

    ctx.samples = 5
    ctx.render_opts.update({"volumetrics": "low"})
    ctx.interp = True
    ctx.post.update({"grade": "warm", "bloom": 0.22, "vignette": 0.24,
                     "end": {"grade": "eclipse", "saturation": 0.85, "vignette": 0.24, "bloom": 0.25},
                     "caption": {"y": 0.72}})

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/shots/s01b.py =====
"""s01b - "So far": "Why are you so far from saving me, so far from my cries of anguish?"

Cut in from s01a (close-up of the face on the cross as the light dims). The camera starts on a
medium-wide of the crucified figure, low on the plateau and directly down-sun, so the figure hangs
against the dimming sun; it then pulls straight away from the sun - rising and receding (log-distance,
i.e. a constant rate of shrinking) over the skull cliff until the three crosses are a speck on the hill
beneath a vast sky, standing above the city skyline. The sky keeps darkening (a veiled-sun -> eclipse
cross-fade, already ~1/3 through at the cut, complete at the end of the second phrase) and the sun ends as a
dull red disk behind clouds above the tiny crosses.
"""
import math
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector
from lib import core as C
from lib import env as E
from lib import characters as P
from lib import wardrobe as W

SUN_AZ = 140.0     # presets use 165 (over Jerusalem); 25 deg further west so the down-sun pull-back sees the
                   # skull scarp obliquely (frontal, it reads as a flat box from afar)
SUN_EL = 30.0      # a little higher than the presets (24): the disk sits well above the far crosses


def _hazify_person(p):
    seen = set()
    for o in p.objects():
        if o.type not in ("MESH", "CURVES", "CURVE"):
            continue
        for m in getattr(o.data, "materials", []) or []:
            if m is not None and m.name not in seen:
                seen.add(m.name)
                E.hazify(m)


def _dressed(p, part="loincloth"):
    return any(str(o.get("wardrobe", "")) == part or part in o.name for o in p.garments)


CENTER = Vector((0.0, 0.6, 0.0))      # env.golgotha layout: centre cross


def make_path(N, cz, sun_dir, d0, chest, top):
    """Camera path f -> (loc, target, roll, lens): pull straight away from the sun (log distance)."""
    sun_h = math.atan2(sun_dir.x, -sun_dir.y)                    # core azimuth of the sun (radians)
    d1 = 88.0
    lens0, lens1 = 34.0, 20.0
    f_end = N + 6

    def path(f):
        u = min(1.0, max(0.0, (f - 1) / float(f_end - 1)))
        # log-distance (constant shrink rate) with a soft start (cut on motion) and a long glide out
        s = 0.2 * u + 0.8 * C.smoothstep(1.0 - (1.0 - u) ** 1.6)
        d = d0 * (d1 / d0) ** s
        az = sun_h + math.radians(7.0) * (1.0 - C.smoothstep(min(1.0, s * 1.4)))   # 3/4 -> straight down-sun
        away = -Vector((math.sin(az), -math.cos(az), 0))
        loc = CENTER + away * d
        # off the edge of the plateau (the ground falls away 11 m beneath the camera, a sudden rise),
        # then sinking towards the plain so the three crosses end up above the city skyline, against the sky
        rise = 1.0 * C.smoothstep((d - d0) / 9.0)
        drop = (cz + 2.6 - 4.6) * C.smoothstep((d - 15.0) / (d1 - 15.0))
        loc.z = cz + 1.6 + rise - drop
        lens = lens0 + (lens1 - lens0) * C.smoothstep(s)
        w = C.smoothstep(min(1.0, s * 2.2))
        tgt = chest.lerp(top, w)
        # lift the aim so the crosses settle low in the frame (~0.6 H) under a vast sky
        tgt = tgt + Vector((0, 0, (loc - tgt).length * 0.17 * C.smoothstep(s)))
        loc = loc + C.shake(f, 0.008 + 0.04 * s, 0.3, 3)
        return (loc, tgt, 0.0, lens)
    return path


def build(ctx):
    N, NR = ctx.nframes, ctx.render_frames

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ environment + sky
    sun_dir = E._dir_from_az_el(SUN_AZ, SUN_EL)
    # scatter only inside the camera path's view cones (xy of the path does not depend on the hill height)
    pv = make_path(N, 11.0, sun_dir, 6.3, Vector((0, 0.6, 13.5)), Vector((0, 0.6, 14.2)))
    view = []
    for f in (1, N // 6, N // 3, N // 2, (3 * N) // 4, NR):
        loc, tgt, _, lens = pv(f)
        view.append(dict(loc=tuple(loc), target=tuple(tgt), lens=lens, margin=12, near=10))
    A = E.golgotha(ctx, mood="eclipse", grass=0.6, dust=False, near_detail=0.4, view=view)
    # The darkening is built as eclipse -> eclipse: side A is the same overcast HDRI + cloud layer, but bright,
    # warm and thin (the veiled sun at the end of s01a); side B is the env 'eclipse' preset. One HDRI and one
    # cloud pattern for both sides: the clouds thicken in place and there is only ever one sun disk
    # (the golden preset's HDRI has its own sun at 7 deg, which sky_transition shows next to the disk).
    over_a = dict(sun_az=SUN_AZ, sun_el=SUN_EL, key=0.36, strength=0.55, sun_energy=3.4, tint=(1.0, 0.82, 0.6),
                  sat=1.0, sun_tint=(1.0, 0.8, 0.56), sun_angle=1.2, haze_density=0.0005,
                  haze_tint=(1.0, 0.95, 0.88), fog=(1.0, 0.84, 0.62), exposure=0.0, grade="warm", clouds=0.55,
                  cloud_opts=dict(color=(0.8, 0.72, 0.64), shadow=(0.3, 0.25, 0.22), opacity=0.85, sun_glow=1.2,
                                  speed=(9.0, 3.0)),
                  sun_disk=dict(el=SUN_EL, size=0.9, color=(1.0, 0.86, 0.62), strength=70.0, glow=0.3))
    over_b = dict(sun_az=SUN_AZ, sun_el=SUN_EL,
                  sun_disk=dict(E.SKY_PRESETS["eclipse"]["sun_disk"], el=SUN_EL))
    # darkening already ~35 % through at the cut (s01a dims the light), complete by the end of phrase 2.
    # Two Bezier keys = smoothstep; place f0 before the shot so frame 1 sits at 0.35.
    f_dark = int(ctx.frame(ctx.phrases[-1]["end"])) + 2
    f0 = int(round((1 - 0.40 * f_dark) / 0.60))
    E.sky_transition(ctx, "eclipse", "eclipse", f0, f_dark, over_a=over_a, over_b=over_b)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the crucified
    cx = A["crosses"]
    # lod "mid" (no subdivision): the figure is medium-wide only for the first second (hero costs ~10 s/frame)
    j = P.make_person("jesus", "JESUS_CROSS", pose=None, hair_strands=False, lod="mid")
    P.place_on_cross(j, cx["center"]["root"], head="up", strain=0.65)
    try:   # settle the loincloth on the hanging pose (the skinned rest fit pokes the crossed thigh through)
        W.drape(j, [g for g in j.garments if "loincloth" in g.name], frames=25, ramp=15, ground=None)
    except Exception as e:
        print("s01b WARNING: drape failed:", e)
    P.expression(j, "anguish")
    P.eyes_look(j, j.eye_pos() + Vector((0.2, 1.0, 4.0)))
    thieves = []
    for k, seed, head, expr, ks in (("left", 4, "down", "exhausted", -1.0), ("right", 9, "side", "pain", 1.0)):
        t = P.make_person("thief_" + k, "CROWD_MAN", seed=seed, outfit=["loincloth"], outfit_colors={"loincloth": "oatmeal"},
                          pose=None, lod="mid", hair_strands=False, dirt=0.5, sweat=0.4, age_years=30 + seed)
        P.place_on_cross(t, cx[k]["root"], head=head, strain=0.75, knee_side=ks)
        P.expression(t, expr)
        thieves.append(t)
    for p in [j] + thieves:
        _hazify_person(p)
    dressed = _dressed(j) and all(_dressed(t) for t in thieves)
    if not dressed:
        print("s01b WARNING: wardrobe failed - starting wider (silhouettes only)")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ camera: pull away from the sun
    c = cx["center"]
    cz = c["base"][2]
    chest = Vector(c["chest"]) + Vector((0, 0, 0.2))
    top = Vector((c["base"][0], c["base"][1], cz + 3.2))

    ctx.interp = True

                     "caption": {"y": 0.72}})

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/shots/s02a.py =====
"""s02a - Day and night time-lapse: "My God, I cry out by day, but you do not answer,"

Time-lapse over the Judean hills from a rocky spur, low behind a lone dead tree that stands against the
sky. The afternoon sun races down across the frame towards the hills, the shadows of the tree and the
rocks swing and stretch towards the camera, clouds streak overhead, the sky burns through a blazing
dusk and goes to night with the stars coming out (14-frame dissolve tail into the Gethsemane night of
s02b). A slow motion-control slide gives parallax on the tree.
The env time-lapse sky is used as built (uniform-only animation); the cloud layer is re-tinted here so the
clouds take the sky's colour (blazing at dusk, black against the stars) instead of grey.
"""
import math
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector
from lib import core as C
from lib import env as E

VIEW_AZ = 262.0      # compass; the April sun sets at ~281 deg, so it crosses the frame right of centre


def tint_clouds_by_sky():
    """In the timelapse world, clouds are white x sky luminance (grey at sunset) and their forward-scatter
    glow points at a fixed direction. Re-wire: clouds x sky colour, glow towards env_tl_sun_dir."""
    nt = bpy.context.scene.world.node_tree
    T = E._NT(nt)
    bw = next((n for n in nt.nodes if n.type == "RGBTOBW"), None)
    if bw is None:
        return False
    sky_src = bw.inputs[0].links[0].from_socket
    # bw -> MULTIPLY_ADD chain (lum * 1.1 + 0.02) -> combine -> multiply mix; find the multiply mix
    mul = None
    for l in nt.links:
        if l.from_node == bw:
            n = l.to_node                         # math MULTIPLY (x1.1)
            for l2 in nt.links:
                if l2.from_node == n:
                    n2 = l2.to_node               # math ADD (+0.02)
                    for l3 in nt.links:
                        if l3.from_node == n2:
                            n3 = l3.to_node       # combine xyz
                            for l4 in nt.links:
                                if l4.from_node == n3 and l4.to_node.type == "MIX":
                                    mul = (l4.to_node, l4.to_socket)
    if mul is None:
        return False
    node, sock = mul
    # sky colour (night: dark, day: bright) + the sun-side glow colour of the time-lapse palette (blazing at dusk)
    glow = E._lattr(T, "env_tl_glow", (0.3, 0.25, 0.15))
    boost = T.mix(1.0, sky_src, (1.3, 1.25, 1.2), blend="MULTIPLY")
    boost = T.mix(1.0, boost, T.mix(1.0, glow, (0.55, 0.5, 0.5), blend="MULTIPLY"), blend="ADD")
    boost = T.mix(1.0, boost, (0.01, 0.01, 0.012), blend="ADD")
    nt.links.new(boost, sock)
    # silver lining / forward scatter: follow the animated sun direction
    sd = E._lattr(T, "env_tl_sun_dir", (0.0, 1.0, 0.5))
    for n in nt.nodes:
        if n.type == "VECT_MATH" and n.operation == "DOT_PRODUCT" and not n.inputs[1].is_linked:
            v = tuple(n.inputs[1].default_value)
            if abs(v[0]) < 1e-6 and abs(v[1] - 0.98) < 0.03:      # the cloud layer's fixed (0, 1, 0.2) normalised
                nt.links.new(sd, n.inputs[1])
    return True


def build(ctx):
    N, NR = ctx.nframes, ctx.render_frames
    va = math.radians(VIEW_AZ)
    fwd = Vector((math.sin(va), math.cos(va), 0))
    side = Vector((fwd.y, -fwd.x, 0))
    tp = fwd * 0.5 + side * 1.2                    # judean_hills puts the dead tree here (spur edge)
    # low on the spur, ~11 m behind the tree and left of it: the tree stands on the right third, against the sky
    base0 = tp - fwd * 6.6 - side * 3.1
    base1 = tp - fwd * 6.0 - side * 2.2
    far = tp + fwd * 400.0
    E.set_view([dict(loc=tuple(base0), target=tuple(far), lens=22, margin=12, near=14),
                dict(loc=tuple(base1), target=tuple(far), lens=22, margin=12, near=14)])
    A = E.judean_hills(ctx, timelapse=True, hour0=15.1, hour1=20.7, view_az=VIEW_AZ, clouds=0.6, olives=0.2, grass=0.3)
    E.set_view(None)
    # render cost: the sun moves every frame, so EEVEE re-renders every shadow page of every caster each frame.
    # Far olives / far rocks cast no visible shadows from here, the air box only adds a little depth (the env
    # haze shader already gives the aerial perspective).
    for o in bpy.context.scene.objects:
        if o.name.startswith(("EnvHillOlives", "EnvHillShrubs")):
            o.visible_shadow = False
        if o.name.startswith(("EnvHillAir", "EnvHillBouldersFar")):     # far boulders: invisible from this low eye
            o.hide_render = True
    A["timelapse"]["sun"].data.shadow_maximum_resolution = 0.02     # coarser pages: identical here, -1.5 s/frame
    tint_clouds_by_sky()
    gz = A["ground_z"]
    eye0 = Vector((base0.x, base0.y, gz(base0.x, base0.y) + 1.15))
    eye1 = Vector((base1.x, base1.y, gz(base1.x, base1.y) + 1.25))

    def path(f):
        u = (f - 1) / float(NR - 1)                       # constant slider speed
        loc = eye0.lerp(eye1, u)
        tgt = Vector((far.x, far.y, loc.z + 400.0 * math.tan(math.radians(6.0))))
        return (loc, tgt, 0.0, 22.0)

    cam = C.camera(loc=tuple(eye0), target=tuple(far), lens=22)
    C.animate_camera(cam, path, 1, NR)

    ctx.samples = 4
    ctx.render_opts.update({"volumetrics": "low", "shadow_scale": 0.5})
    ctx.interp = False        # time-lapse: the sky, clouds and shadows change every frame -> render 24 fps
    ctx.post.update({"grade": "neutral", "saturation": 1.05, "bloom": 0.3, "vignette": 0.2,
                     "end": {"grade": "night", "vignette": 0.28}})

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/shots/s02b.py =====
"""s02b - Gethsemane prayer: "...by night, but I find no rest."

Flashback (dissolve in from the s02a night sky). Gethsemane at night: Jesus kneels at the large prayer rock
among the gnarled olive trees, hands clasped on the rock, head bowed. Cold blue moonlight from behind him
rims his hair and shoulders and glows in the drifting mist; a soft cool "sky" key from the front picks out
his bowed face and the clasped hands. A few motes hang in the light. Slow lateral dolly across the front
of the rock (3/4 front, slightly below his eye line). Restlessness: he sways back and lifts his head a little
on a breath, then sinks forward over his hands again.
"""
import math
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from lib import core as C
from lib import env as E
from lib import characters as P
from lib import wardrobe as W

MOON_AZ, MOON_EL = 20.0, 30.0      # moon behind him (south), backlight + shafts towards the camera
GAP = 0.42                          # knees -> near edge of the rock top (m)


def _hazify_person(p):
    seen = set()
    for o in p.objects():
        if o.type not in ("MESH", "CURVES", "CURVE"):
            continue
        for m in getattr(o.data, "materials", []) or []:
            if m is not None and m.name not in seen:
                seen.add(m.name)
                try:
                    E.hazify(m)
                except Exception:
                    pass



def cull_instancers(names, cam_xy, aim_xy, half_deg, keep_r=6.0):
    """Delete GN-instancer points (env grid trees) outside a horizontal cone around the camera view
    (render-time saver: every tree instance is synced and drawn into the moon's shadow map each frame)."""
    import bmesh
    fwd = (Vector(aim_xy) - Vector(cam_xy)).normalized()
    c = math.cos(math.radians(half_deg))
    n = 0
    for name in names:
        ob = bpy.data.objects.get(name)
        if ob is None or ob.type != "MESH":
            continue
        bm = bmesh.new()
        bm.from_mesh(ob.data)
        mw = ob.matrix_world
        kill = []
        for v in bm.verts:
            p = mw @ v.co
            d = Vector((p.x - cam_xy[0], p.y - cam_xy[1]))
            if d.length > keep_r and d.normalized().dot(fwd) < c:
                kill.append(v)
        bmesh.ops.delete(bm, geom=kill, context="VERTS")
        bm.to_mesh(ob.data)
        bm.free()
        ob.data.update()
        n += len(kill)
    return n


def build(ctx):
    N, NR = ctx.nframes, ctx.render_frames
    sc = bpy.context.scene
    # cull the grove's scatter (far trees, stones, grass) to the camera cone (the rock top is at ~(0, 0.65))
    E.set_view([dict(loc=(3.7, 5.1, 1.35), target=(0.0, 0.5, 0.9), lens=85, margin=22),
                dict(loc=(2.6, 5.7, 1.35), target=(0.0, 0.5, 0.9), lens=85, margin=22)])
    A = E.olive_grove(ctx, moon_az=MOON_AZ, moon_el=MOON_EL, trees=24, motes=False, city_lights=False)
    E.set_view(None)
    # trees behind / far beside the camera: gone (moon shadows from the trees left of frame are kept)
    cull_instancers(["EnvGroveNear", "EnvGroveMid", "EnvGroveFar"], (3.1, 5.4), (0.0, 0.5), 60.0)
    gz = A["ground_z"]
    # the env's prayer rock (2.6 x 1.6 m) hides a kneeling man from any front camera: scale it to a
    # waist-high boulder (~1.45 x 1.0 m) he can lean on. It is rotated 90 deg: local X = world Y.
    rock = A["rock"]
    rock.scale = (rock.scale.x * 0.62, rock.scale.y * 0.55, rock.scale.z * 0.92)
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    E.release_bvh()
    rc = Vector(A["rock_top_center"])
    edge = None
    for k in range(80):
        y = rc.y - 0.9 + k * 0.02
        z, _ = E.ground_hit(rc.x, y, [rock])
        if z is not None and z > A["ground"](rc.x, y - 0.6) + 0.5:
            edge = Vector((rc.x, y, z))
            break
    rt = edge if edge is not None else Vector(A["rock_top"])
    print("s02b rock edge", tuple(rt))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ Jesus at the rock
    j = P.make_person("jesus", "JESUS_ROBED", pose=None)
    kx, ky = rt.x, rt.y - GAP
    kz = gz(kx, ky)
    # pivot at the knees' ground line so he can sway back on his heels without the knees sliding
    piv = bpy.data.objects.new("S02b_sway", None)
    C.link(piv)
    piv.location = (kx, ky + 0.12, kz)
    j.rig.location = (kx, ky, kz)
    j.rig.rotation_euler.z = math.pi
    j.update()
    hands = (rt.x, rt.y + 0.06, rt.z + 0.03)
    P.pose(j, "kneel_pray", rock=hands)
    try:
        W.drape(j, j.garments, frames=30, ramp=20)
    except Exception as e:
        print("s02b WARNING: drape failed:", e)
    # restless: bowed -> a breath, head lifts a little and he sways back -> sinks forward again
    f_lift = int(round(ctx.frame(0.95)))
    f_sink = int(round(ctx.frame(2.35)))
    P.key_pose(j, 1, "kneel_pray", rock=hands, head="bowed")
    P.key_pose(j, f_lift, "kneel_pray", rock=hands, head="down")
    P.key_pose(j, f_sink, "kneel_pray", rock=hands, head="bowed")
    P.key_pose(j, NR, "kneel_pray", rock=hands, head="bowed")
    P.expression(j, "sorrow", frame=1)
    P.expression(j, "anguish", weight=0.55, frame=f_lift)
    P.expression(j, "sorrow", frame=f_sink + 10)
    _hazify_person(j)
    # sway: parent the rig to the knee pivot, pitch back ~1 deg with the breath
    mw = j.rig.matrix_world.copy()
    j.rig.parent = piv
    j.rig.matrix_parent_inverse = piv.matrix_world.inverted()
    j.rig.matrix_world = mw
    # + about world X tips the top towards -Y = backwards (he faces +Y)
    for f, a in ((1, 0.0), (f_lift, 1.2), (f_sink, -0.3), (NR, 0.0)):
        piv.rotation_euler = (math.radians(a), 0, 0)
        piv.keyframe_insert("rotation_euler", frame=f)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ light
    j.update()
    head = Vector(j.head_pos())
    # soft cool "sky" key from the front-left, high (moonlight through a gap in the canopy): face, hands, rock top
    key = C.light("SPOT", loc=(head.x - 1.7, head.y + 2.4, head.z + 2.6), energy=26.0, color=(0.62, 0.74, 1.0),
                  target=(head.x, head.y + 0.1, head.z - 0.05), size=0.5, spot_size=26, spot_blend=0.8,
                  name="S02b_key", volume=0.0)
    # moon rim from behind (same direction as the scene's moon): hair, shoulders, the edge of the mantle
    md = E._dir_from_az_el(MOON_AZ, MOON_EL + 6.0)
    rim = C.light("SPOT", loc=tuple(head + md * 4.5), energy=1100.0, color=(0.7, 0.8, 1.0),
                  target=tuple(head + Vector((0, 0, -0.12))),
                  size=0.25, spot_size=12, spot_blend=0.7, name="S02b_rim", volume=0.0, shadow=False)
    # a shaft of moonlight falling through the branches into the mist behind him (seen against the dark grove)
    sh_tgt = Vector((kx - 3.6, ky - 5.2, kz))
    shaft = C.light("SPOT", loc=tuple(sh_tgt + E._dir_from_az_el(MOON_AZ + 15.0, 58.0) * 11.0), energy=4000.0,
                    color=(0.62, 0.74, 1.0), target=tuple(sh_tgt), size=0.3, spot_size=20, spot_blend=1.0,
                    name="S02b_shaft", volume=1.0, shadow=False)

    # a few motes hanging in the moonlight behind him (env motes would drift right in front of the long lens)
    E.dust_motes(center=(kx - 0.3, ky - 1.9, kz + 1.3), size=(3.6, 2.6, 1.8), count=45, radius=0.003,
                 color=(0.75, 0.85, 1.0), emission=0.5, drift=(0.04, 0.015, 0.01), turbulence=0.15, seed=7,
                 name="S02b_motes")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ camera: slow lateral dolly
    # long lens from ~6 m: the rock sits with him instead of swelling in the foreground; the grove compresses

    D, TH0, TH1 = 6.0, 38.0, 26.0
    hb = Vector((kx, ky + 0.1, 0.0))
    c0 = hb + Vector((math.sin(math.radians(TH0)), math.cos(math.radians(TH0)), 0)) * D
    c1 = hb + Vector((math.sin(math.radians(TH1)), math.cos(math.radians(TH1)), 0)) * D
    c0.z = c1.z = kz + 1.35
    aim = Vector((kx, ky + 0.35, kz + 0.92))

    def cam_path(f):
        u = C.smoothstep(0.08 + 0.84 * (f - 1) / float(NR - 1))
        loc = c0.lerp(c1, (u - C.smoothstep(0.08)) / (C.smoothstep(0.92) - C.smoothstep(0.08)))
        loc = loc + C.shake(f, 0.004, 0.3, 2)
        return (loc, aim, 0.0, 85.0, (loc - head).length)

    cam = C.camera(loc=tuple(c0), target=tuple(aim), lens=85, fstop=2.8, focus=(c0 - head).length)
    C.animate_camera(cam, cam_path, 1, NR)

    ctx.samples = 5
    ctx.render_opts.update({"volumetrics": "low", "vol_shadows": False})
    ctx.interp = True
    ctx.post.update({"grade": ["flashback", "night"], "vignette": 0.3, "bloom": 0.3})

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/shots/s03.py =====
"""s03 - "Yet you are enthroned as the Holy One; you are the one Israel praises."

Holy of Holies (symbolic flashback), built on lib/sets.holy_of_holies.
Low-key Holy Place: the great embroidered veil, raked by lamplight, a slit of light at its seam with
the glory glimpsed through it and incense curling in front. On "Yet you are enthroned" the slit widens
and the camera glides through the parting (the curtain edges slide past the frame); inside, the Ark
with two kneeling cherubim, their gilded wings rising into a pointed arch over the mercy seat, the
cherubim in silhouette rim-lit by the glory and wrapped in a glowing incense cloud. On "Israel praises"
the glory swells; then the camera rises into it and the frame blooms to near-white (flash cut to s04a).

Changes to the set made here (no lib edits): rebuilt wings (S._wing, upswept, feathers outward) instead
of the forward-arched ones that read as a heart from the front; light linking keeps the glory's pool of
light off the floor and the fills off the cherubim; altar box and censer hidden (smoke kept); darker
satin floor; calmer veil material; extra lights: wing kicker, glory-up (volume only), slit spill,
veil backlight, end whiteout.
"""
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from lib import core as C
from lib import sets as S


def _hermite(keys, f):
    """Cubic Hermite spline through [(frame, Vector)] with Catmull-Rom tangents (non-uniform)."""
    if f <= keys[0][0]:
        return Vector(keys[0][1])
    if f >= keys[-1][0]:
        return Vector(keys[-1][1])
    n = len(keys)

    def tan(i):
        if i == 0:
            return (keys[1][1] - keys[0][1]) / (keys[1][0] - keys[0][0])
        if i == n - 1:
            return (keys[-1][1] - keys[-2][1]) / (keys[-1][0] - keys[-2][0])
        return (keys[i + 1][1] - keys[i - 1][1]) / (keys[i + 1][0] - keys[i - 1][0])
    for i in range(n - 1):
        f0, p0 = keys[i]
        f1, p1 = keys[i + 1]
        if f0 <= f <= f1:
            h = f1 - f0
            t = (f - f0) / h
            t2, t3 = t * t, t * t * t
            m0, m1 = tan(i) * h, tan(i + 1) * h
            return (p0 * (2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1) + m0 * (t3 - 2 * t2 + t) + p1 * (-2 * t3 + 3 * t2) +
                    m1 * (t3 - t2))
    return Vector(keys[-1][1])


def _key_energy(light, pairs):
    for f, e in pairs:
        light.data.energy = e
        light.data.keyframe_insert("energy", frame=f)


def _link(light, objs, state):
    """Light linking (EEVEE Next): restrict `light` to / exclude it from `objs`."""
    import bpy
    col = bpy.data.collections.new("s03_rx_" + light.name)
    for o in objs:
        col.objects.link(o)
    light.light_linking.receiver_collection = col
    for co in col.collection_objects:
        co.light_linking.link_state = state


def _set_map_range_max(mat, old, new):
    for nd in mat.node_tree.nodes:
        if nd.type == "MAP_RANGE" and abs(nd.inputs["To Max"].default_value - old) < 1e-4:
            nd.inputs["To Max"].default_value = new


def build(ctx):
    import bpy
    n, N = ctx.nframes, ctx.render_frames
    p1a, p1b = ctx.phrase_frames(0)                  # "Yet you are enthroned as the Holy One;"
    p2a, p2b = ctx.phrase_frames(1)                  # "you are the one Israel praises."

    ark = hoh["ark"]
    glory = hoh["glory"]

    # ================= dressing =================
    # Cherubim wings "spread upward, overshadowing the cover" (Ex 25:20). The set's forward-arched wings read
    # as a heart from the front, so rebuild them with the set's own feathered-wing generator: the leading
    # edges rise from the shoulders into a pointed arch over the mercy seat (tips meeting high above the
    # glory) and the feathers fan outward - the kneeling cherubim and the light sit inside a gothic arch.
    lid_mat = bpy.data.materials.get("set_gold_lid")

        if w.name.startswith("cherub_wing"):
            w.hide_render = w.hide_viewport = True
    wings = []
    for chn in ("cherub_L", "cherub_R"):
        ch = ob_(chn)
        if ch is None:
            continue

            wg = S._wing("s03_wing", wb, lid_mat, spine, side=sy, chord=(0.12, 0.22, 0.24, 0.13),
                         center=(-0.7, sy * 0.25, 0.7))

    cherubim = [o for o in (ob_("cherub_L"), ob_("cherub_R")) if o] + wings
    # the incense altar is a plain box up close: keep only its smoke and ember glow (below frame); move
    # them right of the axis so the camera glides past, not through, the smoke
    for o in hoh.coll.objects:
        if o.name.startswith(("incense_altar", "altar_horn", "incense_coals")):
            o.hide_render = True
    for nm in ("altar_smoke", "altar_glow"):
        if ob_(nm):
            ob_(nm).location.x = 0.32
    # the censer's smoke column rises behind the Ark (backlit by the glory); the censer itself is hidden
    if ob_("censer"):
        ob_("censer").hide_render = True
    for nm in ("censer", "hoh_incense_column"):
        if ob_(nm):
            ob_(nm).location.x, ob_(nm).location.y = 0.75, 5.25
    # thinner Holy Place haze so the reveal reads through it
    _set_map_range_max(bpy.data.materials["set_incense_hp"], 0.05, 0.032)

    cloud = C.box("s03_glory_cloud", (2.3, 1.7, 2.0), (0.0, ark.y, 1.55), coll=hoh.coll)

                                                  rise=0.18, anisotropy=0.35, shape="sphere", falloff=0.9))
    # floor: darker, satin gold
    fm = bpy.data.materials.get("set_gold_floor")

        fm.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"].inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.5, 0.33, 0.13, 1)
        for nd in fm.node_tree.nodes:
            if nd.type == "MAP_RANGE":
                nd.inputs["To Min"].default_value = 0.38
                nd.inputs["To Max"].default_value = 0.62
    # veil: less glow through the weave, softer colours (the embroidery read as neon)
    vm = bpy.data.materials.get("set_veil")
    if vm:

        for nd in nt.nodes:

                nd.inputs[0].default_value = 0.06
        img = next((nd for nd in nt.nodes if nd.type == "TEX_IMAGE" and "color" in nd.image.name), None)

    L["room_fill"].data.energy = 5.0

    fg.data.volume_factor = 0.0
    _link(fg, floors, "INCLUDE")

    _link(L["glory_fill"], bodies, "EXCLUDE")

    wk = C.light("AREA", loc=(-1.6, 2.2, 3.8), energy=260.0, temp=4800, target=(0.0, ark.y, 1.8), size=3.0,

                 spot_size=34, spot_blend=0.7, shadow=False, name="glory_up")
    up.data.diffuse_factor = up.data.specular_factor = 0.0

    vb = C.light("AREA", loc=(0.0, 1.3, 3.2), energy=450.0, temp=4300, target=(0.0, -2.0, 3.0), size=5.0,

                    spot_size=75, spot_blend=0.5, shadow=True, name="seam_blade")
    blade.data.volume_factor = 1.6

    # ================= timing =================
    # veil: a slit (the glory seen through it), widening on "enthroned"; just wide enough to slip through

    f_open0 = p1a + 6
    f_open1 = p1b + 2
    S.animate_veil(hoh, [(1, 0.018), (int(f_open0), 0.03), (int(p1a + 0.65 * (p1b - p1a)), 0.085),
                         (int(p1b + 4), 0.13), (int(p2a + 20), 0.3), (int(p2b), 1.0)])
    _key_energy(vb, [(1, 450.0), (int(f_open0), 450.0), (int(f_open0 + 0.6 * (f_open1 - f_open0)), 0.0)])

    _key_energy(blade, [(1, 900.0), (int(f_open0 + 0.5 * (f_open1 - f_open0)), 700.0), (int(f_open1 + 20), 0.0)])
    # shadowed lights are the main render cost here: switch the slit light off once it has faded out

        blade.hide_render = h
        blade.keyframe_insert("hide_render", frame=f)
    # glory: swells through "Israel praises", then blooms to near-white (flash cut to s04a)
    f_end0 = p2b + 4
    S.set_glory(hoh, [(1, 0.8), (int(f_open0), 0.85), (int(f_open1), 1.15), (int(p2a), 1.2),
                      (int((p2a + p2b) / 2), 1.45), (int(f_end0), 1.6), (int(f_end0 + 0.45 * (n - f_end0)), 2.6),
                      (n, 9.0), (N, 9.0)])

    if gv:
        for f, sc in ((1, 1.0), (int(f_end0), 1.15), (n, 5.5)):
            gv.scale = (sc, sc, sc)
            gv.keyframe_insert("scale", frame=f)

    # the whiteout: a broad shadowless front light floods everything (wings included) in the last second
    wl = C.light("AREA", loc=(0.0, 0.6, 2.6), energy=0.0, temp=5000, target=tuple(glory), size=4.0, shadow=False,
                 name="whiteout")
    _key_energy(wl, [(1, 0.0), (int(f_end0 + 4), 0.0), (n, 2500.0)])
    _key_energy(wk, [(1, 260.0), (int(f_end0), 260.0), (n, 900.0)])

    # ================= camera =================
    # centred on the slit, gliding through the parting, a slight drift left inside for parallax, then
    # rising into the light. 28 mm, f/2.8, focus racks from the veil to the Ark as it opens.
    cam_keys = [
        (1, V(0.0, -3.1, 1.45)),
        (p1a + 24, V(0.0, -2.1, 1.5)),
        (p1b + 4, V(-0.1, 0.0, 1.62)),            # slipping through the parting
        (p2a + 15, V(-0.25, 0.35, 1.7)),
        (f_end0, V(-0.35, 0.9, 1.85)),
        (n, V(-0.15, 1.9, 2.7)),                  # rising into the light
    ]
    tgt_keys = [
        (1, V(0.0, 0.0, 2.1)),
        (p1a + 24, V(0.0, 4.5, 1.55)),
        (p1b + 4, V(0.0, 4.5, 1.3)),
        (p2a + 15, V(0.0, 4.5, 1.15)),
        (f_end0, V(0.0, 4.5, 1.15)),
        (n, V(0.0, 4.5, 1.75)),
    ]
    veil_pt = V(0.0, 0.0, 1.9)
    ark_pt = V(0.0, ark.y, 1.1)

    def focus_at(f, loc):
        k = C.smoothstep((f - f_open0) / max(1.0, (p1b - f_open0)))
        return max(0.5, (veil_pt.lerp(ark_pt, k) - loc).length)

    def path(f):
        loc = _hermite(cam_keys, f) + C.shake(f, 0.006, 0.5, 3)
        return loc, _hermite(tgt_keys, f), 0.0, 28, focus_at(f, loc)
    cam = C.camera(loc=tuple(cam_keys[0][1]), target=tuple(tgt_keys[0][1]), lens=28, fstop=2.8, focus=4.0)
    C.animate_camera(cam, path)

    # ================= render / post =================
    ctx.samples = 6
    ctx.render_opts = {"volumetrics": "low", "shadow_scale": 0.5}   # half-res shadow maps: same look, -0.5 s
    ctx.interp = True
    ctx.post.update({"grade": "gold", "temperature": 0.2, "bloom": 0.42, "vignette": 0.22,
                     "caption": {"halo": 1.2},
                     "end": {"bloom": 0.6}})
