    c_loc = Cc + Vector((0.70, -0.06, 0))                # C: right, facing -X (takes the mantle)
    sA = soldier("legA", a_loc, 0, seed=1)
    sB = soldier("legB", b_loc, 90, seed=2, skin_tone=0.6)
    sC = soldier("legC", c_loc, -90, seed=3, skin_tone=0.35)
    people = [sA, sB, sC]

    # A: shaking the bones in his fist above the far edge, throws at f_rel
    fist = rel_pt + Vector((0.0, 0.07, 0.07))
    _static(sA, drape=False, lean=50, seat=0.55, rt=fist, rhand="fist", rpron=40)
    _kp(sA, 1, lean=50, seat=0.55, rt=fist, rhand="fist", rpron=40)
    for k, f in enumerate(range(8, f_rel - 10, 6)):
        _kp(sA, f, lean=50, seat=0.55, rt=fist + Vector((0, 0.008, 0.03 * (1 if k % 2 else -1))), rhand="fist",
            rpron=40)
    _kp(sA, f_rel - 6, lean=50, seat=0.55, rt=fist + Vector((0, 0.04, 0.05)), rhand="fist", rpron=40)
    _kp(sA, f_rel, lean=58, seat=0.55, rt=rel_pt + Vector((0, 0.05, 0.04)), rhand="open", rpron=150)
    _kp(sA, f_rel + 30, lean=56, seat=0.55, rt=rel_pt + Vector((0.02, 0.07, -0.03)), rhand="relaxed", rpron=140)
    # C: drags the mantle to himself during phrase 1 (left hand = camera side)
    c0, c1, c2 = fr(p1s) + 1, fr(p1s) + 13, fr(p1s) + 36
    grab_m = Vector(mantle.location) + Vector((0.09, -0.02, 0.05))
    _static(sC, drape=False, lean=24, seat=0.5)
    _kp(sC, 1, lean=24, seat=0.5)
    _kp(sC, c0, lean=26, seat=0.5)
    _kp(sC, c1, lean=68, seat=0.5, lt=grab_m, lhand="claw", lpron=110)
    _kp(sC, c1 + 4, lean=68, seat=0.5, lt=grab_m + Vector((0, 0, -0.012)), lhand="grip", lpron=110)
    _kp(sC, c2, lean=22, seat=0.5, lt=Vector((c_loc.x - 0.24, c_loc.y - 0.16, Cc.z + 0.32)), lhand="grip", lpron=110)
    # B: rests, then snatches the tunic (the winner)
    b0 = fr(p2e) + 6
    b1 = b0 + 9
    b2 = b1 + 16
    grab_t = Vector(tunic.location) + Vector((-0.12, -0.02, 0.04))
    _static(sB, drape=False, lean=24, seat=0.6)
    _kp(sB, 1, lean=24, seat=0.6)
    _kp(sB, b0 - 4, lean=26, seat=0.6)
    _kp(sB, b1, lean=72, seat=0.6, rt=grab_t, rhand="claw", rpron=120)
    _kp(sB, b1 + 3, lean=72, seat=0.6, rt=grab_t + Vector((0, 0, -0.012)), rhand="fist", rpron=120)
    _kp(sB, b2, lean=20, seat=0.6, rt=Vector((b_loc.x + 0.2, b_loc.y - 0.06, Cc.z + 0.5)), rhand="fist", rpron=120)
    for p in people:
        for o in p.objects():
            for m in (getattr(o.data, "materials", None) or []) if o.data is not None else []:
                if m is not None:
                    E.hazify(m)
    for f in (1, f_rel, NR):
        sc.frame_set(f)
        dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
        for p in people:
            for o in p.objects():
                if o.type != "MESH" or o.hide_render:
                    continue
                ev = o.evaluated_get(dg)
                bb = [ev.matrix_world @ Vector(c) for c in ev.bound_box]
                ext = max((max(v[i] for v in bb) - min(v[i] for v in bb)) for i in range(3))
                if ext > 2.2:
                    print("s13b WARNING: hiding exploded part %s (extent %.1f m at f%d)" % (o.name, ext, f))
                    o.hide_render = True
    sc.frame_set(1)
    _child_of_hand(mantle, sC, "wrist.L", c1 + 4)
    _child_of_hand(tunic, sB, "wrist.R", b1 + 3)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ light
    # torch planted off-screen left-back: the warm, flickering key (slow flicker)
    tl = Cc + Vector((-1.2, 0.5, 0))
    tl.z = gz(tl.x, tl.y) + 1.3
    torch = C.light("POINT", tuple(tl), 48.0, color=C.kelvin(1850), size=0.08, name="TorchKey")
    tk = torch.data
    tk.keyframe_insert("energy", frame=1)
    mod = C._fcurves(tk.animation_data.action)[0].modifiers.new("NOISE")
    mod.scale, mod.strength, mod.phase = 5.0, 14.0, 3.0
    # dim red-brown sky fill from above (the eclipse day) so the shadows are not black
    C.light("AREA", tuple(Cc + Vector((0.3, -0.4, 3.0))), 22.0, color=(0.75, 0.48, 0.38), size=4.0,
            target=tuple(Cc), name="SkyFill", shadow=False)
    # rim from the dim sun behind the far soldier (linked to soldiers + props)
    recv = bpy.data.collections.new("s13b_rim")
    for p in people:
        for o in p.objects():
            if o.type in ("MESH", "CURVES"):
                recv.objects.link(o)
    for o in [tunic, mantle] + dice:
        recv.objects.link(o)
    rim = C.light("SUN", (0, 0, 20), 1.2, color=(1.0, 0.45, 0.22), name="Rim", shadow=False)
    rd = Vector((0.15, 1.0, 0.45)).normalized()
    rim.rotation_euler = (-rd).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
    rim.data.angle = math.radians(4)
    rim.light_linking.receiver_collection = recv

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ camera
    tgt0 = Vector(tunic.location) + Vector((0, -0.01, 0.012))
    loc0 = Cc + Vector((0.0, -0.66, 0.0))
    loc0.z = Cc.z + 0.44
    loc1 = loc0 + (tgt0 - loc0) * 0.24
    push_end = f_rel + 30

    def cam_fn(f):
        u = C.ease_in_out(min(1.0, (f - 1) / float(max(2, push_end - 1))))
        loc = loc0.lerp(loc1, u) + C.shake(f, 0.003, 0.5, 4)
        tgt = tgt0 + Vector((0, -0.05 * u, 0)) + C.shake(f, 0.004, 0.4, 9)
        return (loc, tgt, 0.0, 32, (tgt0 - loc).length - 0.02)

    cam = C.camera(tuple(loc0), tuple(tgt0), lens=32, fstop=2.8, focus=(tgt0 - loc0).length, name="Cam")
    C.animate_camera(cam, cam_fn, 1, NR)

    ctx.samples = 5
    ctx.render_opts.update({"volumetrics": "low"})
    ctx.interp = False
    ctx.post.update({"grade": "eclipse", "bloom": 0.22, "vignette": 0.3})

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/shots/s14a.py =====
"""s14a - Light breaks: "But you, Lord, do not be far from me. You are my strength; come quickly to help me."

The turn of the psalm. Fade up from black on the darkened Golgotha (eclipse): the centre cross with the
crucified figure stands against the dim red-brown sky. On the first phrase the clouds part around the sun:
a hole opens in the sky (world-shader mask around the sun direction), a single shaft of golden light comes
down and falls on the cross (a narrow spot light from the sun direction = the light pool + rim on the
figure, and a fake volumetric beam: an additive emissive cylinder - real volumetric god rays cost
~+12 s/frame). On the second phrase more shafts fan down over the land, the sky warms, and the camera
cranes up and tilts toward the light. The figure is only ever a backlit silhouette.
"""
import math
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector
from lib import core as C
from lib import env as E
from lib import characters as P
from lib import wardrobe as W

SUN_AZ = 165.0      # env presets (sun over Jerusalem, behind the crosses seen from the -Y side)
SUN_EL = 30.0


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
def _key_prop(idb, name, pairs, interp="BEZIER"):
    """Key a custom float property on an ID (object / scene) at [(frame, value)]."""
    for f, v in pairs:
        idb[name] = float(v)
        idb.keyframe_insert('["%s"]' % name, frame=f)
    ad = idb.animation_data
    for fc in C._fcurves(ad.action):
        if fc.data_path == '["%s"]' % name:
            for kp in fc.keyframe_points:
                kp.interpolation = interp
                if interp == "BEZIER":
                    kp.handle_left_type = kp.handle_right_type = "AUTO_CLAMPED"


def beam_material(name, color=(1.0, 0.78, 0.5), strength=1.0, seed=0.0):
    """Additive 'volumetric' shaft: Transparent + Emission on the front faces of a cylinder (local Z = axis).
    Brightness ~ the view ray's path length through the cylinder (chord / sin(angle to the axis): brighter
    when looking along the shaft, soft round cross-section), x fades at both ends x drifting streaks
    x object property 'beam' (a uniform: keyable without re-evaluating the material)."""
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    nt = m.node_tree
    for n in list(nt.nodes):
        nt.nodes.remove(n)
    T = E._NT(nt)
    out = T.node("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
    tc = T.node("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
    geo = T.node("ShaderNodeNewGeometry")
    vt = T.node("ShaderNodeVectorTransform")
    vt.vector_type = "VECTOR"
    vt.convert_from = "WORLD"
    vt.convert_to = "OBJECT"
    T.link(geo.outputs["Incoming"], vt.inputs[0])
    vx, vy, _ = T.sep(T.vmath("NORMALIZE", vt.outputs[0]))
    px, py, _ = T.sep(tc.outputs["Object"])
    vxy = T.math("SQRT", T.math("ADD", T.math("MULTIPLY", vx, vx), T.math("MULTIPLY", vy, vy)))
    crs = T.math("ABSOLUTE", T.math("SUBTRACT", T.math("MULTIPLY", px, vy), T.math("MULTIPLY", py, vx)))
    d = T.math("DIVIDE", crs, T.math("MAXIMUM", vxy, 1e-4))
    rad = T.node("ShaderNodeAttribute")
    rad.attribute_type = "OBJECT"
    rad.attribute_name = "beam_r"
    radius = rad.outputs["Fac"]
    q = T.math("SUBTRACT", 1.0, T.math("POWER", T.math("DIVIDE", d, radius), 2.0), clamp=True)
    prof = T.math("MINIMUM", T.math("DIVIDE", T.math("POWER", q, 1.5), T.math("MAXIMUM", vxy, 0.15)), 4.0)
    g = T.sep(tc.outputs["Generated"])                      # z: 0 at the ground .. 1 at the cloud base
    z = g[2]
    fade = T.math("MULTIPLY", T.smooth(0.0, 0.02, z), T.math("POWER", T.math("SUBTRACT", 1.0, z, clamp=True), 1.4))
    # streaks along the beam that slowly drift: angular stripes around the axis, wobbling along it (plain
    # math nodes - a noise texture here cost ~4 s/frame of overdraw on llvmpipe)
    ob = T.node("ShaderNodeAttribute")
    ob.attribute_type = "OBJECT"
    ob.attribute_name = "beam_t"
    pz = T.sep(tc.outputs["Object"])[2]
    ang = T.math("ARCTAN2", py, px)
    wob = T.math("MULTIPLY", T.math("SINE", T.math("ADD", T.math("MULTIPLY", pz, 0.013 + 0.004 * seed), ob.outputs["Fac"])), 1.7)
    st1 = T.math("SINE", T.math("ADD", T.math("MULTIPLY", ang, 5.0), T.math("ADD", wob, seed * 3.1)))
    st2 = T.math("SINE", T.math("ADD", T.math("MULTIPLY", ang, 11.0), T.math("SUBTRACT", seed * 1.7, wob)))
    streak = T.math("ADD", 0.72, T.math("ADD", T.math("MULTIPLY", st1, 0.2), T.math("MULTIPLY", st2, 0.12)))
    k = T.node("ShaderNodeAttribute")
    k.attribute_type = "OBJECT"
    k.attribute_name = "beam"
    amt = T.math("MULTIPLY", T.math("MULTIPLY", T.math("MULTIPLY", prof, fade), streak),
                 T.math("MULTIPLY", k.outputs["Fac"], strength))
    em = T.node("ShaderNodeEmission")
    em.inputs[0].default_value = (*color, 1)
    T.link(amt, em.inputs[1])
    tr = T.node("ShaderNodeBsdfTransparent")
    add = T.node("ShaderNodeAddShader")
    T.link(tr.outputs[0], add.inputs[0])
    T.link(em.outputs[0], add.inputs[1])
    T.link(add.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
    m.surface_render_method = "BLENDED"
    m.use_backface_culling = True
    return m


def beam(name, foot, sun_dir, radius, top_height, mat_, keys, drift=0.25):
    """Cylinder from `foot` (ground) up along sun_dir to `top_height` metres above the foot."""
    L = top_height / max(0.05, sun_dir.z)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=28, radius=radius, depth=L, end_fill_type="NOTHING")
    o = bpy.context.active_object
    o.name = name
    o.rotation_euler = sun_dir.to_track_quat("Z", "Y").to_euler()
    o.location = Vector(foot) + sun_dir * (L / 2)
    for p in o.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth = True
    o.data.materials.append(mat_)
    o.visible_shadow = False
    o.visible_diffuse = o.visible_glossy = o.visible_transmission = o.visible_volume_scatter = False
    o["beam_r"] = float(radius)
    _key_prop(o, "beam", keys)
    _show_from(o, min(f for f, v in keys if v > 0) - 1)
    sc = bpy.context.scene
    _key_prop(o, "beam_t", [(sc.frame_start, 0.0), (sc.frame_end + 1, drift * (sc.frame_end + 1 - sc.frame_start) / 24.0)],
              interp="LINEAR")
    return o


def _show_from(o, f):
    """Not rendered before frame f (an invisible blended beam / dark lamp still costs render time)."""
    if f <= 1:
        return
    o.hide_render = True
    o.keyframe_insert("hide_render", frame=1)
    o.hide_render = False
    o.keyframe_insert("hide_render", frame=f)


def sky_hole(sun_dir, seed=0.3):
    """Open a ragged hole in the darkened sky around the sun: the camera-branch mix factor of the
    sky_transition world becomes max(env_sky_mix, hole) where hole = scene props s14_hole (amount) and
    s14_hole_r (radius, radians) with a noisy edge. Lighting branch untouched."""
    nt = bpy.context.scene.world.node_tree
    ms = next(n for n in nt.nodes if n.type == "MIX_SHADER" and n.inputs[2].is_linked)
    bgc = ms.inputs[2].links[0].from_node
    cam_mix = bgc.inputs[0].links[0].from_node
    fac_src = cam_mix.inputs[0].links[0].from_socket
    T = E._NT(nt)
    tc = T.node("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
    vn = T.vmath("NORMALIZE", tc.outputs["Generated"])
    ang = T.math("ARCCOSINE", T.math("MINIMUM", T.vmath("DOT_PRODUCT", vn, tuple(sun_dir.normalized())), 1.0))
    nz = T.noise(T.vmath("ADD", vn, (seed, 0.0, 0.0)), scale=5.0, detail=2.0, rough=0.6, dist=0.4)
    angn = T.math("MULTIPLY", ang, T.math("ADD", 0.55, T.math("MULTIPLY", nz.outputs["Fac"], 0.9)))
    r = E._lattr(T, "s14_hole_r", 0.0)
    amt = E._lattr(T, "s14_hole", 0.0)
    soft = T.math("ADD", T.math("MULTIPLY", r, 0.45), 0.01)
    edge = T.math("DIVIDE", T.math("SUBTRACT", r, angn), soft)
    hole = T.math("MULTIPLY", T.smooth(-1.0, 1.0, edge), amt)
    fac = T.math("MAXIMUM", fac_src, hole)
    T.link(fac, cam_mix.inputs[0])
    return hole


def _hazify_person(p):
    seen = set()
    for o in p.objects():
        for m in getattr(o.data, "materials", []) or [] if o.data is not None else []:
            if m is not None and m.name not in seen:
                seen.add(m.name)
                E.hazify(m)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- build
def build(ctx):
    N, NR = ctx.nframes, ctx.render_frames
    fr = lambda sec: int(round(ctx.frame(sec)))
    p1s, p1e = ctx.phrases[0]["start"], ctx.phrases[0]["end"]
    p2s, p2e = ctx.phrases[1]["start"], ctx.phrases[1]["end"]
    sc = bpy.context.scene

    cams = [dict(loc=(-1.9, -9.0, 12.0), target=(0.0, 1.0, 13.5), lens=26, margin=15),
            dict(loc=(-1.6, -8.0, 14.2), target=(6.0, 60.0, 40.0), lens=24, margin=15)]
    A = E.golgotha(ctx, mood="eclipse", dust=False, grass=0.8, near_detail=0.6, view=cams)
    sun_dir = E._dir_from_az_el(SUN_AZ, SUN_EL)
    disk_a = dict(E.SKY_PRESETS["eclipse"]["sun_disk"], el=SUN_EL)
    # B: the light that breaks through - the same overcast HDRI + cloud layer, but bright and golden
    over_b = dict(sun_az=SUN_AZ, sun_el=SUN_EL, key=0.22, strength=0.45, sun_energy=1.6, tint=(1.0, 0.78, 0.5),
                  sat=1.2, sun_tint=(1.0, 0.78, 0.5), sun_angle=1.0, haze_density=0.0009,
                  haze_tint=(1.0, 0.92, 0.8), exposure=0.3, grade="warm", clouds=0.5,
                  cloud_opts=dict(color=(0.95, 0.78, 0.55), shadow=(0.3, 0.2, 0.14), opacity=0.85, sun_glow=1.2,
                                  speed=(9.0, 3.0)),
                  sun_disk=dict(el=SUN_EL, size=1.0, color=(1.0, 0.88, 0.66), strength=40.0, glow=0.2))
    # global brightening (ambient, sun lamp, haze, exposure) starts on phrase 2, ~1/4 done at the end
    g0 = fr(p2s) - 6
    g1 = g0 + int((NR - g0) / 0.3)
    E.sky_transition(ctx, "eclipse", "eclipse", g0, g1,
                     over_a=dict(sun_az=SUN_AZ, sun_el=SUN_EL, sun_disk=disk_a), over_b=over_b)
    sky_hole(sun_dir)
    sc.eevee.shadow_pool_size = "512"   # sky() lowers it to 256 MB; the far narrow spot needs more pages
    h0 = fr(p1s) + 2                 # the clouds start to part
    h1 = fr(p1e)                     # first shaft fully on the cross ("do not be far from me")
    E.scene_prop("s14_hole_r", 0.0, 1)
    E.scene_prop("s14_hole", 0.0, 1)
    _key_prop(sc, "s14_hole", [(h0 - 6, 0.0), (h1, 0.85)])
    _key_prop(sc, "s14_hole_r", [(h0 - 6, 0.01), (h1 - 4, 0.07), (fr(p2s) + 10, 0.09), (NR, 0.15)])

    # --------------------------------------------------------------------- the crosses + crucified
    cx = A["crosses"]
    c = cx["center"]
    cz = c["base"][2]
    j = P.make_person("jesus", "JESUS_CROSS", pose=None, hair_strands=False, lod="mid")   # backlit silhouette
    P.place_on_cross(j, c["root"], head="up", strain=0.7)
    try:
        W.drape(j, [g for g in j.garments if "loincloth" in g.name], frames=25, ramp=15, ground=None)
    except Exception as e:
        print("s14a WARNING: drape failed:", e)
    P.expression(j, "exhausted")
    people = [j]
    for k, seed, head, ks in (("left", 4, "down", -1.0), ("right", 9, "side", 1.0)):
        t = P.make_person("thief_" + k, "CROWD_MAN", seed=seed, outfit=["loincloth"], outfit_colors={"loincloth": "oatmeal"},
                          pose=None, lod="mid", hair_strands=False, dirt=0.5, age_years=30 + seed)
        P.place_on_cross(t, cx[k]["root"], head=head, strain=0.75, knee_side=ks)
        P.expression(t, "exhausted")
        people.append(t)
    for p in people:
        _hazify_person(p)

    # --------------------------------------------------------------------- the light
    gold = (1.0, 0.8, 0.52)
    a0, a1 = fr(p1s) + 8, fr(p1e) - 4
    # key: a narrow strong shaft light-linked to the centre cross + figure (rim / back light)
    target = Vector((c["base"][0], c["base"][1] + 0.1, cz + 2.7))
    spot_d = 160.0
    key = C.light("SPOT", tuple(target + sun_dir * spot_d), 0.0, color=gold, target=tuple(target), size=0.5,
                  name="ShaftKey", spot_size=2 * math.degrees(math.atan(2.0 / spot_d)), spot_blend=0.6)
    key.data.volume_factor = 0.0
    key.data.use_shadow = False                       # lights the backs: the camera only sees the rim anyway
    recv = bpy.data.collections.new("s14a_shaft_recv")
    for o in [ch for ch in c["root"].children] + j.objects():
        if o.type in ("MESH", "CURVES", "CURVE"):
            recv.objects.link(o)
    key.light_linking.receiver_collection = recv
    E_key = 4.5                                        # W/m2 (eclipse sun 0.35, golden sun 4.2)
    P_key = E_key * 4 * math.pi * spot_d ** 2
    C.keys(key.data, "energy", [(1, 0.0), (a0, 0.0), (a1, P_key), (NR, P_key * 1.1)])
    _show_from(key, a0)
    # the light pool on the ground (the shaft is broader than the cross): softer, casts the long cross shadow
    gtarget = Vector((c["base"][0], c["base"][1] - 1.5, cz + 0.3))
    pool = C.light("SPOT", tuple(gtarget + sun_dir * spot_d), 0.0, color=gold, target=tuple(gtarget), size=0.6,
                   name="ShaftPool", spot_size=2 * math.degrees(math.atan(2.4 / spot_d)), spot_blend=1.0)
    pool.data.volume_factor = 0.0
    pool.data.shadow_maximum_resolution = 0.01
    pool.light_linking.blocker_collection = recv      # only the cross + figure cast the long shadow (cheap)
    E_pool = 1.3
    P_pool = E_pool * 4 * math.pi * spot_d ** 2
    C.keys(pool.data, "energy", [(1, 0.0), (a0 + 4, 0.0), (a1 + 4, P_pool), (NR, P_pool * 1.2)])
    _show_from(pool, a0 + 4)
    foot = Vector((c["base"][0], c["base"][1] + 0.2, cz - 0.4))
    beam("ShaftMain", foot, sun_dir, 2.3, 260.0, beam_material("ShaftMain", color=gold, seed=0.2),
         [(1, 0.0), (a0 - 4, 0.0), (a1, 0.2), (fr(p2s), 0.17), (NR, 0.2)])
    # more rays follow (phrase 2): broad shafts fanning down over the land beyond the hill
    others = [((-38.0, 70.0), 7.0, 0), ((32.0, 120.0), 9.0, 6), ((-95.0, 190.0), 13.0, 12), ((80.0, 60.0), 8.0, 18),
              ((140.0, 210.0), 15.0, 15)]
    b0 = fr(p2s) - 4
    bm_o = beam_material("ShaftFar", color=(1.0, 0.82, 0.56), seed=1.3)
    for i, ((x, y), r, off) in enumerate(others):
        z = A["ground"](x, y)
        s0 = b0 + off
        beam("Shaft%d" % i, (x, y, z - 1.0), sun_dir, r, 320.0, bm_o,
             [(1, 0.0), (s0, 0.0), (s0 + 30, 0.1 - 0.006 * i), (NR, 0.12 - 0.006 * i)], drift=0.15)
        sp = C.light("SPOT", tuple(Vector((x, y, z)) + sun_dir * 400.0), 0.0, color=gold, target=(x, y, z),
                     size=4.0, name="ShaftPool%d" % i, spot_size=2 * math.degrees(math.atan(r * 1.2 / 400.0)),
                     spot_blend=0.85, shadow=False)
        sp.data.volume_factor = 0.0
        pw = 1.2 * 4 * math.pi * 400.0 ** 2
        C.keys(sp.data, "energy", [(1, 0.0), (s0, 0.0), (s0 + 30, pw), (NR, pw)])
        _show_from(sp, s0)

    # --------------------------------------------------------------------- camera: look up, then rise toward the light
    head = Vector(c["head"])
    c0 = Vector((-1.9, -9.0, cz + 1.0))
    c1 = Vector((-1.6, -8.0, cz + 3.2))
    d_head0 = (head + Vector((0, 0, -0.6)) - c0).normalized()
    m0, m1 = fr(p1e) - 16, NR + 12

    def path(f):
        u = C.smoothstep((f - m0) / float(m1 - m0))
        u = 0.85 * u + 0.15 * C.smoothstep((f - 1) / float(m1 - 1))        # never fully still
        loc = c0.lerp(c1, u)
        dh = (head + Vector((0, 0, -0.6 * (1 - u))) - loc).normalized()
        dv = dh.lerp(sun_dir, 0.36 * C.smoothstep(u * 1.1)).normalized()
        lens = 30.0 - 6.0 * u
        loc = loc + C.shake(f, 0.01, 0.25, 7)
        return (loc, loc + dv * 10.0, 0.0, lens)

    cam = C.camera(loc=tuple(c0), target=tuple(c0 + d_head0), lens=30)
    C.animate_camera(cam, path, 1, NR)

    ctx.samples = 5
    ctx.render_opts.update({"volumetrics": "low", "shadow_scale": 0.5})
    ctx.interp = True
    ctx.post.update({"grade": "eclipse", "bloom": 0.22, "bloom_threshold": 0.66, "halation": 0.08,
                     "end": {"grade": "warm", "exposure": 0.0, "saturation": 0.95, "bloom": 0.42,
                             "bloom_threshold": 0.6, "halation": 0.12, "vignette": 0.24}})

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/shots/s14b.py =====
"""s14b - Sword falls: "Deliver me from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dogs."

Ground level on the Golgotha plateau, moments after the light broke through (s14a). A Roman gladius lies
in the dust, receding from the lens; a soldier's hand (he crouches just out of frame) is still closed on
its grip. The edge of the cloud shadow creeps in from the left: golden light runs down the blade from the
tip to the hilt (it flares), and the hand opens and withdraws ("Deliver me from the sword"). The light
keeps spreading to the right, over the ground where the dogs of s12a lurk with glinting eyes; as it
touches them they wheel round and scatter into the remaining darkness ("...from the power of the dogs"),
the focus racking after them. Dust specks light up as the sun reaches them.

Light: the eclipse sky / ambience stays (dark), plus a golden sun from the s14a direction whose light is
masked by a huge camera-invisible 'cloud' plane high above; its ragged edge slides to the right -> a soft
moving shadow front on the ground. The soldier's body is invisible to the camera (it still casts its
shadow); a masked linked copy of the body shows only his forearm + hand.
"""
import math
import random
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from lib import core as C
from lib import env as E
from lib import assets as A
from lib import characters as P

SUN_AZ, SUN_EL = 165.0, 30.0          # core.sun convention, = s14a (the light that broke through)
VIEW_AZ = 60.0                        # compass az of the view (0 = +Y)
CAM_XY = (3.0, -4.6)
CAM_H = 0.28
LENS = 40.0
TILT = 13.0
GOLD = (1.0, 0.76, 0.46)


def _az(az):
    a = math.radians(az)
    return Vector((math.sin(a), math.cos(a), 0.0))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- custom pose
def _pose_hold(Ps, p, target=None, hand="grip", side="L", pron=150.0, flex=0.0, lean=30.0, **k):
    """Deep crouch (library crouch legs/spine) leaning forward from the hips, one palm at `target` (rig space)."""
    P._pose_crouch(Ps, p, throw=0.0)
    Ps.turn("root", bend=lean, frame_of="root")
    for s in "LR":
        Ps.turn("upperleg01." + s, bend=-lean, frame_of="root")
    if target is not None:
        lat = P._lateral(side)
        P._arm_ik(Ps, side, Vector(target), pole=(lat * 0.8 + Vector((0, 0.3, -0.6))).normalized(), pron=pron,
                  flex=flex, shrug=4)
        P._hand(Ps, side, hand)
    P._apply_head(Ps, "down", amount=0.7)


P.POSES["s14b_hold"] = _pose_hold
P.GROUNDED.add("s14b_hold")


def _arm_only(person, side="L"):
    """The camera sees only one arm: every object of the person is hidden from the camera and casts no
    shadow; linked copies of the body and of the garments, masked to the vertices weighted to the arm
    bones (upper arm .. fingertips, i.e. bare forearm/hand + mail/tunic sleeve), are camera-visible and
    cast the arm's shadow."""
    s = side
    keep = ["clavicle.", "shoulder01.", "upperarm01.", "upperarm02.", "lowerarm01.", "lowerarm02.", "wrist.",
            "metacarpal1.", "metacarpal2.", "metacarpal3.", "metacarpal4."]
    keep += ["finger%d-%d." % (i, j) for i in range(1, 6) for j in range(1, 4)]
    keep = set(k + s for k in keep)
    out = []
    for o in person.objects():
        if o.type not in ("MESH", "CURVES"):
            continue
        o.visible_camera = False
        o.visible_glossy = False
        o.visible_shadow = False
        if o.type != "MESH" or not any(m.type == "ARMATURE" for m in o.modifiers):
            continue
        gi = {g.index: g.name for g in o.vertex_groups}
        idx = [v.index for v in o.data.vertices
               if sum(g.weight for g in v.groups if gi.get(g.group) in keep) > 0.5]
        if len(idx) < 8:
            continue
        vg = o.vertex_groups.get("s14b_arm") or o.vertex_groups.new(name="s14b_arm")
        vg.add(idx, 1.0, "REPLACE")
        c = o.copy()
        o.users_collection[0].objects.link(c)
        c.name = o.name + "_arm"
        c.parent = o.parent
        c.matrix_parent_inverse = o.matrix_parent_inverse.copy()
        c.matrix_basis = o.matrix_basis.copy()
        for m in list(c.modifiers):
            if m.type == "MASK":
                c.modifiers.remove(m)
        mk = c.modifiers.new("ArmOnly", "MASK")
        mk.vertex_group = "s14b_arm"
        mk.threshold = 0.5
        c.visible_camera = True
        c.visible_glossy = True
        c.visible_shadow = False
        out.append(c)
    return out


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- cloud blocker
def _blocker(name, size=9000.0, edge_amp=0.35, seed=3):
    """Huge horizontal plane covering local +X (from a ragged edge along local Y at x~0); camera-invisible,
    casts shadows only."""
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    n = 400
    span = 200.0
    ys = [-span / 2 + span * i / n for i in range(n + 1)]
    ph = [rnd.uniform(0, 6.28) for _ in range(4)]
    edge = [edge_amp * (0.6 * math.sin(y / 9.0 + ph[0]) + 0.3 * math.sin(y / 4.3 + ph[1]) +
                        0.1 * math.sin(y / 2.1 + ph[2])) for y in ys]
    ys = [-size / 2] + ys + [size / 2]
    edge = [edge[0]] + edge + [edge[-1]]
    vin = [bm.verts.new((edge[i], y, 0.0)) for i, y in enumerate(ys)]
    vout = [bm.verts.new((size, y, 0.0)) for y in ys]
    for i in range(len(ys) - 1):
        bm.faces.new((vin[i], vin[i + 1], vout[i + 1], vout[i]))
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(o)
    o.visible_camera = False
    o.visible_diffuse = o.visible_glossy = o.visible_transmission = o.visible_volume_scatter = False
    o.data.materials.append(C.mat("cloud_block", (0.1, 0.1, 0.1), rough=1.0))
    return o


def build(ctx):
    NR = ctx.render_frames
    fps = ctx.fps
    sc = bpy.context.scene
    fr = lambda s: int(round(ctx.frame(s)))
    p1s, p1e = ctx.phrases[0]["start"], ctx.phrases[0]["end"]
    p2s, p2e = ctx.phrases[1]["start"], ctx.phrases[1]["end"]

    fwd = _az(VIEW_AZ)
    right = Vector((fwd.y, -fwd.x, 0.0))
    Cx = Vector((CAM_XY[0], CAM_XY[1], 0.0))
    view = dict(loc=(Cx.x, Cx.y, 11.0), target=tuple(Cx + fwd * 30 + Vector((0, 0, 10))), lens=LENS - 4, margin=30)
    G = E.golgotha(ctx, mood="eclipse", view=view, grass=0.8, near_detail=1.0, dust=False)
    gz = lambda x, y: float(G["ground_z"](x, y))
    Cx.z = gz(Cx.x, Cx.y)
    cam_loc = Cx + Vector((0, 0, CAM_H))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the sword (across the view, tip receding left)
    S = Cx + fwd * 0.80 - right * 0.17                     # blade centre (hilt right of centre, tip exits left)
    sdir = (-right * math.cos(math.radians(25)) + fwd * math.sin(math.radians(25))).normalized()   # hilt -> tip
    sword = A.load("gladius", loc=(0, 0, 0))
    yaw = math.atan2(sdir.y, sdir.x)
    # lie on the uneven ground: pitch to the slope between pommel and tip, lowest contact on the ground
    root0 = S - sdir * 0.355
    g_p = gz(root0.x, root0.y)
    tipxy = root0 + sdir * 0.71
    g_t = gz(tipxy.x, tipxy.y)
    pitch = math.atan2(g_t - g_p, 0.71)
    R = Matrix.Rotation(yaw, 4, "Z") @ Matrix.Rotation(-pitch, 4, "Y")
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    pts = []
    for o in A.children_recursive(sword):
        if o.type == "MESH":
            Ml = o.matrix_local if o.parent == sword else (sword.matrix_world.inverted() @ o.matrix_world)
            pts += [Ml @ v.co for v in list(o.data.vertices)[::7]]
    rz = -1e9
    for q in pts:
        w_ = R @ q
        gxy = Vector((root0.x + w_.x, root0.y + w_.y))
        rz = max(rz, gz(gxy.x, gxy.y) - w_.z)
    sword.matrix_world = Matrix.Translation((root0.x, root0.y, rz - 0.003)) @ R
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    grip_w = A.anchor(sword, "grip")
    tip_w = A.anchor(sword, "tip")
    blade_c = (grip_w + tip_w) * 0.5

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ golden sun + moving cloud edge
    sun_dir = E._dir_from_az_el(SUN_AZ, SUN_EL).normalized() if hasattr(E, "_dir_from_az_el") else None
    gold = C.sun(elevation=SUN_EL, azimuth=SUN_AZ, energy=3.2, color=GOLD, angle=1.0)
    if sun_dir is None:
        el, az = math.radians(SUN_EL), math.radians(SUN_AZ)
        sun_dir = Vector((math.sin(az) * math.cos(el), -math.cos(az) * math.cos(el), math.sin(el)))
    gold.data.shadow_maximum_resolution = 0.002
    G["sky"]["sun"].data.use_shadow = False                # the dim eclipse sun: its shadows are invisible here
    mdir = (right * math.cos(math.radians(15)) + fwd * math.sin(math.radians(15))).normalized()   # left -> right
    hb = 30.0
    sxy = Vector((sun_dir.x, sun_dir.y, 0.0))
    off = sxy * (hb / max(0.05, sun_dir.z))
    blk = _blocker("CloudEdge")
    blk.rotation_euler = (0, 0, math.atan2(mdir.y, mdir.x))
    speed = 0.84 / fps                                     # m per frame along mdir
    t_tip = fr(p1s) + 5                                    # light reaches the tip of the blade
    s_tip = (tip_w - Cx).dot(mdir)

    def front(f):                                          # mdir coordinate (rel. to the camera) of the front
        return s_tip + (f - t_tip) * speed
    for f in (1, NR):
        p0 = Cx + mdir * front(f)
        blk.location = p0 + off + Vector((0, 0, hb))
        blk.keyframe_insert("location", frame=f)
    C._set_interp(blk, "location", "LINEAR")
    t_hilt = t_tip + ((grip_w - Cx).dot(mdir) - s_tip) / speed

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the soldier: crouched right of the lens
    sol = P.make_person("soldier", "SOLDIER", lod="hero", pose=None, expression=None, hair_strands=False)
    face = (fwd * 0.55 - right * 0.85).normalized()         # facing the sword from its right
    base = grip_w + right * 0.40 - fwd * 0.04
    sol.rig.location = (base.x, base.y, gz(base.x, base.y))
    sol.rig.rotation_euler = (0, 0, math.atan2(face.x, -face.y))
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    g0 = grip_w + Vector((0, 0, 0.018))
    rel0 = int(t_hilt) + 3                                 # fingers start to open once the light is on them
    rel1 = rel0 + 9
    up1 = rel1 + 20
    P.key_pose(sol, 1, "s14b_hold", target=g0, hand="grip")
    P.key_pose(sol, rel0, "s14b_hold", target=g0, hand="grip")
    P.key_pose(sol, rel1, "s14b_hold", target=g0 + Vector((0, 0, 0.025)), hand="open")
    P.key_pose(sol, up1, "s14b_hold", target=g0 + Vector((0, 0, 0.40)) + right * 0.18 - fwd * 0.04, hand="relaxed")
    arm_objs = _arm_only(sol, "L")
    for o in sol.objects():
        for m in (getattr(o.data, "materials", None) or []) if o.data is not None else []:
            if m is not None:
                E.hazify(m)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ dogs in the right background
    rnd = random.Random(7)
    # (along fwd, along right, heading deg rel. to facing the camera, tint, scale, glow)
    dogs = [(4.2, 0.35, 25, (-0.32, -0.48, -0.66), 0.92, 0.9),
            (5.4, 0.95, -15, (-0.66, -0.68, -0.7), 1.0, 1.0),
            (6.6, -0.2, 40, (-0.5, -0.54, -0.58), 0.88, 0.8),
            (7.4, 1.6, 5, (-0.32, -0.48, -0.66), 0.95, 0.9)]
    for i, (a, b, hd, tint, scl, glow) in enumerate(dogs):
        p0 = Cx + fwd * a + right * b
        f_hit = t_tip + ((p0 - Cx).dot(mdir) - s_tip) / speed + rnd.uniform(-2, 4)
        to_cam = Cx - p0
        h0 = math.degrees(math.atan2(to_cam.x, -to_cam.y)) + hd
        arm = A.animal("dog", "prowl", loc=(p0.x, p0.y, gz(p0.x, p0.y)), rot_z=h0, speed=1.1, scale=scl,
                       offset=i * 0.37, eye_glow=glow, tint=tint, start_frame=1)
        A.set_eye_glow(arm, glow, color=(1.0, 0.86, 0.5))
        flee = (right * 0.8 + fwd * 0.6).normalized()
        flee = Vector((flee.x + rnd.uniform(-0.2, 0.2), flee.y + rnd.uniform(-0.2, 0.2), 0)).normalized()
        v_prowl = A.ground_speed("dog", "prowl", 0, 1.1) * scl / fps
        v_run = A.ground_speed("dog", "run", 0, 1.0) * scl / fps
        pos = Vector(p0)
        head = math.radians(h0)
        turn_f = int(f_hit) + 2
        flee_h = math.atan2(flee.x, -flee.y)
        while flee_h - head > math.pi:
            flee_h -= 2 * math.pi
        while flee_h - head < -math.pi:
            flee_h += 2 * math.pi
        gone = None
        for f in range(1, NR + 1):
            if f < turn_f:
                v, h = v_prowl, head
            else:
                k = min(1.0, (f - turn_f) / 7.0)
                h = head + (flee_h - head) * C.smoothstep(k)
                v = v_prowl + (v_run - v_prowl) * C.smoothstep(min(1.0, (f - turn_f) / 10.0))
            d = Vector((math.sin(h), -math.cos(h), 0))
            if f > 1:
                pos = pos + d * v
            arm.location = (pos.x, pos.y, gz(pos.x, pos.y))
            arm.rotation_euler = (0, 0, h)
            arm.keyframe_insert("location", frame=f)
            arm.keyframe_insert("rotation_euler", frame=f)
            if gone is None and (pos - Cx).length > 16.0:
                gone = f
        A.play(arm, "run", start_frame=turn_f, replace=False, blend_in=5)
        if gone:                                           # far off-screen: stop rendering it
            for o in [arm] + A.children_recursive(arm):
                o.hide_render = False
                o.keyframe_insert("hide_render", frame=gone - 1)
                o.hide_render = True
                o.keyframe_insert("hide_render", frame=gone)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ glint (specular-only, linked to the blade)
    to_cam = (cam_loc - blade_c).normalized()
    refl = Vector((-to_cam.x, -to_cam.y, to_cam.z))          # mirror direction over a flat blade
    glint = C.light("AREA", tuple(blade_c + refl * 2.5), 0.0, color=(1.0, 0.84, 0.6), size=0.5,
                    target=tuple(blade_c), name="Glint", shadow=False)
    glint.data.diffuse_factor = 0.0
    glint.data.volume_factor = 0.0
    recv = bpy.data.collections.new("s14b_blade")
    for o in A.children_recursive(sword):
        recv.objects.link(o)
    glint.light_linking.receiver_collection = recv
    t_mid = int((t_tip + t_hilt) / 2)
    C.keys(glint.data, "energy", [(1, 0.0), (t_tip - 2, 0.0), (t_mid + 2, 40.0), (t_mid + 12, 10.0), (NR, 7.0)])

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ camera: low, slow push, focus rack to the dogs
    rack0, rack1 = fr(p2s) - 4, fr(p2s) + 12
    d_grip = (grip_w - cam_loc).length

    def cam_fn(f):
        u = C.ease_in_out(min(1.0, ctx.u(f)))
        loc = cam_loc + fwd * (0.08 * u) + C.shake(f, 0.002, 0.6, 2)
        k = C.smoothstep((f - rack0) / float(rack1 - rack0))
        tgt = loc + fwd * 3.0 + Vector((0, 0, -3.0 * math.tan(math.radians(TILT - 1.5 * k)))) + right * (0.06 * k)
        fd = (d_grip - 0.08 * u) * (1 - k) + 5.3 * k
        return (loc, tgt, 0.0, LENS, fd)

    look0 = cam_loc + fwd * 3.0 + Vector((0, 0, -3.0 * math.tan(math.radians(TILT))))
    cam = C.camera(tuple(cam_loc), tuple(look0), lens=LENS, fstop=2.8, focus=d_grip, name="Cam")
    C.animate_camera(cam, cam_fn, 1, NR)

    ctx.samples = 5
    ctx.render_opts.update({"volumetrics": "low"})
    ctx.interp = False
    ctx.post.update({"grade": "eclipse", "bloom": 0.26, "vignette": 0.26,
                     "end": {"grade": "warm", "bloom": 0.36, "bloom_threshold": 0.62, "halation": 0.1}})

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/shots/s14c.py =====
"""s14c - Beasts to dust: "Rescue me from the mouth of the lions; save me from the horns of the wild oxen."

Golgotha, the light has broken. On the plateau below the three crosses stand two silhouettes made of dark
ash: a lion roaring (right) and a great wild ox tossing its horns (left), both facing the coming
light. The edge of the clouds' shadow sweeps across the ground from the right; where the golden sun
touches them they burn at the edge and crumble into ash that blows away - the lion on the first phrase,
the ox on the second; the crosses catch the light in turn. Low camera, slow push-in, finally tilting up
to the centre cross in the golden light (victory).

Light sweep: an invisible cloud-shadow occluder plane (shadow only) high above slides along `n` (screen
right -> left, perpendicular to the backlight, so the edge is a vertical plane on the beasts); its keyed
motion is solved so the shadow edge crosses each beast exactly while the ash front does.
"""
import math
import numpy as np
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector
from lib import core as C
from lib import env as E
from lib import assets as A
from lib import characters as P
from lib import fx as FX

ASH = (0.022, 0.02, 0.019)
GOLD = (1.0, 0.72, 0.36)
FLAKE_GLOW = (1.0, 0.55, 0.2)
EDGE_GLOW = 3.2
GOLD_SUN = (1.0, 0.78, 0.5)            # = s14b
SUN_AZ, SUN_EL = 165.0, 30.0           # = s14a / s14b (the light that broke through)
CAM_D0, CAM_D1 = 10.4, 9.2          # camera distance in front of the centre cross (start, end of the push)


def _ash_material(name="s14c_ash"):
    """Dark charcoal / ash statue: matte black, fine crumbly bump, slight golden sheen at grazing light."""
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    nt = m.node_tree
    b = nt.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    tc = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
    nz = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
    nz.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 38.0
    nz.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 8.0
    nz.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.7
    nt.links.new(tc.outputs["Object"], nz.inputs["Vector"])
    ramp = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position = 0.35
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color = (ASH[0] * 0.6, ASH[1] * 0.6, ASH[2] * 0.6, 1)
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position = 0.75
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color = (ASH[0] * 2.2, ASH[1] * 2.1, ASH[2] * 2.0, 1)
    nt.links.new(nz.outputs["Fac"], ramp.inputs["Fac"])
    nt.links.new(ramp.outputs["Color"], b.inputs["Base Color"])
    bump = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
    bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.45
    bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value = 0.01
    nt.links.new(nz.outputs["Fac"], bump.inputs["Height"])
    nt.links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"], b.inputs["Normal"])
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.9
    b.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value = 0.3
    b.inputs["Sheen Weight"].default_value = 0.15
    b.inputs["Sheen Roughness"].default_value = 0.5
    b.inputs["Sheen Tint"].default_value = (1.0, 0.8, 0.55, 1)
    return m


def _body(arm):
    return next(c for c in arm.children if c.type == "MESH" and not c.name.startswith("eyes"))


def _world_verts(obj):
    me = obj.data
    co = np.empty(len(me.vertices) * 3, np.float32)
    me.vertices.foreach_get("co", co)
    co = co.reshape(-1, 3)
    M = np.array(obj.matrix_world, np.float32)
    return co @ M[:3, :3].T + M[:3, 3]


def _occluder(name, n, H, L=900.0, seed=0):
    """Huge horizontal plane (local +X = motion direction n, edge at local x = wob(local y): a soft,
    slightly wavy cloud edge) casting the cloud shadow; invisible to camera/rays except shadows.
    Returns (object, wob function of the local y)."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    terms = [(k, amp, rng.uniform(0, 6.28)) for k, amp in ((0.012, 5.0), (0.05, 1.2), (0.17, 0.35))]

    def wob(y):
        return sum(amp * np.sin(np.asarray(y) * k + ph) for k, amp, ph in terms)
    ys = np.linspace(-L, L, 481)
    w = wob(ys)
    verts = [(float(a), float(y), 0.0) for a, y in zip(w, ys)] + [(2 * L, float(y), 0.0) for y in ys]
    N = len(ys)
    faces = [(i, i + 1, N + i + 1, N + i) for i in range(N - 1)]
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    me.from_pydata(verts, [], faces)
    me.update()
    o = C.link(bpy.data.objects.new(name, me))
    o.rotation_euler = (0, 0, math.atan2(n.y, n.x))
    o.location = (0, 0, H)
    o.visible_camera = False
    o.visible_diffuse = False
    o.visible_glossy = False
    o.visible_transmission = False
    o.visible_volume_scatter = False
    o.visible_shadow = True
    C.assign(o, C.mat("s14c_cloud", (0.1, 0.1, 0.1), rough=1.0))
    return o, wob



def _lean_baked(obj):
    """Distant baked figure: drop the frozen beard curves child and the skin SSS (screen-space pass)."""
    if obj is None:
        return
    for c in list(obj.children):
        if c.type == "CURVES":
            bpy.data.objects.remove(c)
    for m in obj.data.materials:
        if m and m.use_nodes:
            for n in m.node_tree.nodes:
                if n.bl_idname == "ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled" and "Subsurface Weight" in n.inputs:
                    if not n.inputs["Subsurface Weight"].is_linked:
                        n.inputs["Subsurface Weight"].default_value = 0.0

def build(ctx):
    NR = ctx.render_frames
    fps = ctx.fps
    p0, p1 = ctx.phrases[0], ctx.phrases[1]
    az = math.radians(SUN_AZ)
    hv0 = Vector((math.sin(az), -math.cos(az), 0))
    r0 = Vector((hv0.y, -hv0.x, 0))
    c0 = Vector((0.0, 0.6, 0))
    views = [dict(loc=tuple(c0 - hv0 * d + r0 * 0.3 + Vector((0, 0, 11.5))), target=tuple(c0 + Vector((0, 0, 12.5))),
                  lens=30, margin=15, near=5.0) for d in (CAM_D0, CAM_D1)]
    G = E.golgotha(ctx, mood="eclipse", dust=False, grass=0.45, bushes=0.3, rocks=0.45, near_detail=0.0, view=views)
    gz = G["ground_z"]
    cr = G["crosses"]["center"]
    base = Vector(cr["base"])
    # sky: continue the s14a/s14b transition (eclipse -> warm golden break, same overrides) to its end
    disk_a = dict(E.SKY_PRESETS["eclipse"]["sun_disk"], el=SUN_EL)
    over_b = dict(sun_az=SUN_AZ, sun_el=SUN_EL, key=0.22, strength=0.45, sun_energy=1.6, tint=(1.0, 0.84, 0.6),
                  sat=1.1, sun_tint=(1.0, 0.78, 0.5), sun_angle=1.0, haze_density=0.0009,
                  haze_tint=(1.0, 0.92, 0.8), exposure=0.3, grade="warm", clouds=0.5,
                  cloud_opts=dict(color=(0.95, 0.78, 0.55), shadow=(0.3, 0.2, 0.14), opacity=0.85, sun_glow=1.2,
                                  speed=(9.0, 3.0)),
                  sun_disk=dict(el=SUN_EL, size=1.0, color=(1.0, 0.88, 0.66), strength=40.0, glow=0.2))
    m0 = 0.72                                    # where s14b ends; fully golden ~75 % into this shot
    f1 = int(NR * 0.75)
    f0 = 1 - m0 * (f1 - 1) / (1 - m0)
    T = E.sky_transition(ctx, "eclipse", "eclipse", f0, f1, over_a=dict(sun_az=SUN_AZ, sun_el=SUN_EL, sun_disk=disk_a),
                         over_b=over_b, ease=False)
    sun = T["sun"]
    # the sun is the golden key everywhere; the cloud plane masks it (as in s14b)
    ad = sun.data.animation_data
    if ad and ad.action:
        for fc in C._fcurves(ad.action):
            if fc.data_path == "energy":
                for kp in fc.keyframe_points:
                    kp.co[1] = kp.handle_left[1] = kp.handle_right[1] = 3.2
            elif fc.data_path == "color":
                for kp in fc.keyframe_points:
                    kp.co[1] = kp.handle_left[1] = kp.handle_right[1] = GOLD_SUN[fc.array_index]
    sun.data.energy = 3.2
    sun.data.color = GOLD_SUN
    sun.data.angle = math.radians(2.5)
    sdir = Vector(T["b"]["sun_dir"]).normalized()
    hv = Vector((sdir.x, sdir.y, 0)).normalized()        # camera looks towards the sun (backlight)
    right = Vector((hv.y, -hv.x, 0))

    def at(dx, dy):                                         # layout: dx screen-right, dy towards the sun
        p = Vector((base.x, base.y, 0)) + right * dx + hv * dy
        p.z = gz(p.x, p.y)
        return p

    def yaw_facing(d):                                      # animal rot_z so its front (-Y) points along d
        return math.degrees(math.atan2(d.x, -d.y))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the figure on the cross (distant)
    j = P.make_person("jesus", "JESUS_CROSS", lod="mid", hair_strands=False)
    P.place_on_cross(j, cr["root"], head="up", strain=0.6)
    _lean_baked(P.bake_static(j, decimate=0.5))   # distant: one frozen mesh, no rig/garments/beard/SSS

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the ash beasts
    ashm = _ash_material()
    lion = A.animal("lion", "roar", loc=tuple(at(0.95, -3.6)), rot_z=yaw_facing((right * 0.7 - hv * 0.7).normalized()),
                    fur=False, scale=1.05)
    A.play(lion, "roar", start_frame=1, speed=0.001, offset=1.75)        # frozen mid-roar, jaw wide
    ox = A.animal("bull", "toss", loc=tuple(at(-1.15, -3.3)), rot_z=yaw_facing((right * 0.75 - hv * 0.66).normalized()),
                  scale=1.0)
    A.play(ox, "toss", start_frame=1, speed=0.001, offset=1.3)                # frozen: head up, horns hooking high
    for a in (lion, ox):
        for c in a.children:
            if c.name.startswith("eyes"):
                c.hide_render = True
            elif c.type == "MESH":
                c.data = c.data.copy()
                c.data.materials.clear()
                c.data.materials.append(ashm)
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the light front (cloud shadow edge)
    # The front sweeps screen right -> left (n = -right, perpendicular to the backlight), so on the beasts
    # it is a vertical plane: it reaches the lion's open mouth and the ox's horns first.
    top = G["hill_top"][2]
    H = top + 16.0
    n = -right
    Y = Vector((-n.y, n.x, 0))                              # occluder local +Y in world

    def arrival(obj):
        W = _world_verts(obj)
        return float((W @ np.array(n, np.float32)).min()), float((W @ np.array(n, np.float32)).max()), W

    def wob_at(W, wob):                                      # edge offset at the beast (sun-projected centre)
        c = Vector(W.mean(axis=0))
        q = c + sdir * ((H - c.z) / sdir.z)
        return float(wob(q.dot(Y)))

    occ, wob = _occluder("CloudShadow", n, H, seed=ctx.seed)
    lb, ob = _body(lion), _body(ox)
    la0, la1, Wl = arrival(lb)
    oa0, oa1, Wo = arrival(ob)
    wl, wo = wob_at(Wl, wob), wob_at(Wo, wob)
    fL0, fL1 = ctx.frame(p0["start"] + 0.05), ctx.frame(p0["end"] - 0.1)
    fO0, fO1 = ctx.frame(p1["start"] + 0.05), ctx.frame(p1["end"] - 0.1)
    vL = (la1 - la0) / (fL1 - fL0)
    vO = (oa1 - oa0) / (fO1 - fO0)
    # (frame, edge position along n): lit where P.n < e + wob
    # after the ox the front runs on out of frame, then stops (a static occluder lets EEVEE keep its
    # sun shadow pages -> cheaper last ~40 frames)
    fS = min(NR - 10, fO1 + 36)
    sched = [(1 - 60, la0 - wl - 60 * vL), (fL0, la0 - wl), (fL1, la1 - wl), (fO0, oa0 - wo), (fO1, oa1 - wo),
             (fS, oa1 - wo + (fS - fO1) * vO * 1.5), (NR + 40, oa1 - wo + (fS - fO1) * vO * 1.5)]
    for f, e in sched:
        occ.location = n * e + Vector((0, 0, H))
        occ.keyframe_insert("location", frame=f)
    C._set_interp(occ, "location", "LINEAR")
    # ash: the lib releases linearly along n over [min, max] of the mesh -> same schedule as the shadow edge
    wind = (-right * 1.7 + hv * 1.1 + Vector((0, 0, 1.4)))
    ash_col = (0.06, 0.052, 0.046)
    for body, (f0, f1), cnt, fs, seed in ((lb, (fL0, fL1), 14000, 0.009, 1), (ob, (fO0, fO1), 17000, 0.01, 2)):
        # pre-build the flake material under the lib's name so the gold glow lasts ~45 % of a flake's life
        nm = "FX_ash_%d_%s" % (seed, "_".join("%.2f" % c for c in tuple(ash_col) + tuple(GOLD) + (EDGE_GLOW,)))
        FX._ash_material(nm, ash_col, FLAKE_GLOW, 1.4, glow_age=0.3)   # embers: orange, not white sparks
        FX.ash_disintegrate(body, start_frame=f0, duration=(f1 - f0), direction=tuple(n), wind=tuple(wind), count=cnt,
                            flake_size=fs, life=3.0, jitter=0.12, glow_color=GOLD, glow=EDGE_GLOW, ash_color=ash_col,
                            turbulence=0.55, gravity=-0.1, seed=seed)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ camera: truck left with the light, rise
    look0 = at(0.15, -4.2) + Vector((0, 0, 0.75))           # slightly down: beasts mid-frame, crosses above
    look1 = Vector(cr["beam"]) + Vector((0, 0, 0.2))

    def cam_fn(f):
        u = C.ease_in_out(min(1.0, max(0.0, ctx.u(f))))
        b = C.ease_in_out(min(1.0, max(0.0, (f - (fO1 - 10)) / float(NR - (fO1 - 10)))))  # after the ox: tilt up
        d = CAM_D0 + (CAM_D1 - CAM_D0) * u
        loc = at(0.1 - 0.1 * u, -d) + Vector((0, 0, 1.0 + 0.35 * b))
        tgt = look0.lerp(look1, 0.55 * b)
        loc = loc + C.shake(f, 0.005, 0.45, 21)
        return (loc, tgt, 0.0, 30)

    cam = C.camera(tuple(at(0.1, -CAM_D0) + Vector((0, 0, 1.0))), tuple(look0), lens=30, name="Cam")
    C.animate_camera(cam, cam_fn, 1, NR)

    ctx.samples = 4
    ctx.render_opts.update({"volumetrics": "low", "shadow_scale": 0.5})
    ctx.interp = False
    ctx.post.update({"grade": "warm", "bloom": 0.38, "bloom_threshold": 0.62, "halation": 0.1, "caption": {"y": 0.72},
                     "end": {"grade": "gold", "bloom": 0.48}})

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/shots/s15.py =====
"""s15 - Empty tomb: "I will declare your name to my people; in the assembly I will praise you."

Resurrection morning (flash cut from the beasts turning to dust). Low in Joseph's garden at dawn: a
pale limestone cliff with a rock-cut tomb, olive trees, scrub on the ledges, dawn sky above. The
earth shakes, dust sifts from the facade and the great round stone rolls aside in its groove (0-2 s);
golden light pours through the low doorway. The camera glides in, ducks through the doorway into
the chamber and comes to rest on the grave cloths lying on the bench in a shaft of dawn light - the
tomb is empty (phrase 2).

Built on lib/sets.garden_tomb (+ env olive trees / shrubs, fx dust).
"""
import math
import random
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector, noise
from lib import core as C
from lib import sets as S
from lib import env as E
from lib import fx as FX


def _spline(pts, t):
    """Catmull-Rom through pts (list of Vectors), t in 0..1 (uniform per segment)."""
    n = len(pts) - 1
    u = max(0.0, min(1.0, t)) * n
    i = min(n - 1, int(u))
    s = u - i
    p0 = pts[max(0, i - 1)]
    p1, p2 = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
    p3 = pts[min(n, i + 2)]
    s2, s3 = s * s, s * s * s
    return 0.5 * ((2 * p1) + (-p0 + p2) * s + (2 * p0 - 5 * p1 + 4 * p2 - p3) * s2 + (-p0 + 3 * p1 - 3 * p2 + p3) * s3)


def _grid(name, nx, ny, sx, sy, z_fn=None, coll=None):
    verts, faces = [], []
    for j in range(ny + 1):
        for i in range(nx + 1):
            x = (i / nx - 0.5) * sx
            y = (j / ny - 0.5) * sy
            verts.append((x, y, z_fn(x, y) if z_fn else 0.0))
    for j in range(ny):
        for i in range(nx):
            a = j * (nx + 1) + i
            faces.append((a, a + 1, a + nx + 2, a + nx + 1))
    return C._new_mesh_obj(name, verts, faces, coll)


def _linen_mat(name="s15_linen", color=(0.80, 0.75, 0.64)):
    """Matte aged linen: ivory, rough, sheen, a little translucency, fine slub/crease bump (no regular
    weave pattern: it moires at this distance)."""
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name)
    if m:
        return m
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    nt = m.node_tree
    N, Lk = nt.nodes, nt.links
    b = N["Principled BSDF"]
    tc = N.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
    mp = N.new("ShaderNodeMapping")
    mp.inputs["Scale"].default_value = (1.0, 6.0, 1.0)       # slubs stretched along the threads
    Lk.new(tc.outputs["Object"], mp.inputs["Vector"])
    nf = N.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
    nf.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 160.0
    nf.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 3.0
    Lk.new(mp.outputs[0], nf.inputs["Vector"])
    nz = N.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")                     # uneven yarn tone + faint old stains
    nz.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 9.0
    nz.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 5.0
    Lk.new(tc.outputs["Object"], nz.inputs["Vector"])
    bump = N.new("ShaderNodeBump")
    bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.12
    bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value = 0.0005
    Lk.new(nf.outputs["Fac"], bump.inputs["Height"])
    Lk.new(bump.outputs["Normal"], b.inputs["Normal"])
    ramp = N.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position = 0.3
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color = (color[0] * 0.88, color[1] * 0.86, color[2] * 0.8, 1)
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position = 0.72
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color = (*color, 1)
    Lk.new(nz.outputs["Fac"], ramp.inputs["Fac"])
    Lk.new(ramp.outputs["Color"], b.inputs["Base Color"])
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.92
    b.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value = 0.2
    b.inputs["Sheen Weight"].default_value = 0.6
    b.inputs["Sheen Roughness"].default_value = 0.45
    b.inputs["Sheen Tint"].default_value = (1.0, 0.95, 0.85, 1)
    b.inputs["Subsurface Weight"].default_value = 0.1
    b.inputs["Subsurface Radius"].default_value = (1.0, 0.9, 0.7)
    b.inputs["Subsurface Scale"].default_value = 0.004
    return m


def _folded_sheet(name, W, L, nx, ny, r=0.012, bottom=0.56, seed=0, ripple=0.012, droop=0.0):
    """Linen sheet of width W (across X) and length L (along Y), folded once lengthwise: bottom layer, a
    soft round fold of radius r on +X, a shorter top layer coming back (free edge short of the bottom
    one). Soft cloth undulations are modelled directly (ripples running across the sheet with
    varying wavelength/amplitude, a wavy free edge, slight lift of the top layer over the fold)."""
    so = Vector((seed * 1.7, 0.3, 2.2))
    Lb = bottom * W
    Lt = W - Lb - math.pi * r
    b_ = Lb / 2.0
    verts, faces = [], []
    for j in range(ny + 1):
        t = (j / ny - 0.5) * L
        # ripple field along the length: two wave trains + noise (soft folds of linen at rest)
        ph = 2.0 * noise.noise(Vector((t * 1.1, 0.0, 3.0)) + so)
        rip = (math.sin(t * 2 * math.pi / 0.23 + ph) * 0.6 + math.sin(t * 2 * math.pi / 0.41 + 1.7 * ph) * 0.4)
        amp_t = ripple * (0.55 + 0.45 * noise.noise(Vector((t * 2.3, 1.0, 0.5)) + so))
        for i in range(nx + 1):
            s_ = i / nx * W
            u = s_ / W
            if s_ <= Lb:
                x, z = -Lb / 2 + s_, 0.0
                lay = 0.35 + 0.65 * (s_ / Lb)          # bottom layer: flatter towards its open edge
            elif s_ <= Lb + math.pi * r:
                th = -math.pi / 2 + (s_ - Lb) / r
                x, z = b_ + r * math.cos(th), r + r * math.sin(th)
                lay = 1.0
            else:
                q = (s_ - Lb - math.pi * r) / max(1e-6, Lt)
                x, z = b_ - (s_ - Lb - math.pi * r), 2 * r
                lay = 1.0 - 0.3 * q
                x += 0.025 * noise.noise(Vector((t * 4.0, 0.0, 7.0)) + so) * q      # wavy free edge
            ripple_z = max(-0.6 * r, rip * amp_t * lay * (1.0 if z > 0.5 * r else 0.45))
            z += ripple_z + 0.003 * noise.noise(Vector((t * 9.0, s_ * 7.0, 1.0)) + so)
            if z > 1.5 * r:                            # the top layer rests on ridges of the bottom one
                z = max(z, 2 * r + 0.004 * noise.noise(Vector((t * 6.0, s_ * 6.0, 4.0)) + so))
            if droop and (j == 0 or j == ny):
                z -= droop
            verts.append((x, t + 0.012 * noise.noise(Vector((s_ * 3.0, t, 2.0)) + so) * (1 - abs(2 * u - 1)), z))
    for j in range(ny):
        for i in range(nx):
            a = j * (nx + 1) + i
            faces.append((a, a + 1, a + nx + 2, a + nx + 1))
    return C._new_mesh_obj(name, verts, faces)


def _shroud(tomb):
    """Grave cloths: the long linen shroud lies folded once lengthwise along the bench in soft folds;
    the face cloth lies folded by itself at the head end (John 20:7). Procedural (no simulation)."""
    bench = tomb.objects["bench"]
    bb = [bench.matrix_world @ Vector(c) for c in bench.bound_box]
    x0, x1 = min(v.x for v in bb), max(v.x for v in bb)
    y0, y1 = min(v.y for v in bb), max(v.y for v in bb)
    top = tomb["bench"].z
    for o in list(tomb.coll.objects):
        if o.name.startswith(("grave_linen", "linen_strip", "napkin")):
            o.hide_render = True
            o.hide_viewport = True
    lin_m = _linen_mat()
    cx = (x0 + x1) / 2 - 0.04
    objs = []
    sheet = _folded_sheet("s15_shroud", 1.02, 1.8, 56, 150, r=0.016, bottom=0.57, seed=1, ripple=0.011)
    sheet.location = (cx, y0 + 1.06, top + 0.004)
    sheet.rotation_euler = (0, 0, math.radians(1.5))
    objs.append(sheet)
    nap = _folded_sheet("s15_facecloth", 0.46, 0.3, 24, 20, r=0.01, bottom=0.53, seed=2, ripple=0.004)
    nap.location = (cx + 0.06, y1 - 0.36, top + 0.004)
    nap.rotation_euler = (0, 0, math.radians(-76))
    nap.scale = (1.0, 1.0, 1.35)
    objs.append(nap)
    for i, o in enumerate(objs):
        tomb.coll.objects.link(o)
        bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.unlink(o)
        o.data.materials.append(lin_m)
        sol = o.modifiers.new("thick", "SOLIDIFY")
        sol.thickness = 0.0025
        sol.offset = 0.0
        sub = o.modifiers.new("sub", "SUBSURF")
        sub.levels = 0
        sub.render_levels = 1
        for p in o.data.polygons:
            p.use_smooth = True
    return sheet


def _lower_cliff(cliff, z0=2.9, k=0.62):
    """Lower the set's 5.5 m cliff to a ~4.3 m garden outcrop (sky visible above it)."""
    me = cliff.data
    for v in me.vertices:
        if v.co.z > z0:
            v.co.z = z0 + (v.co.z - z0) * k
    me.update()


def _hide_after(objs, f):
    for o in objs:
        o.hide_render = False
        o.keyframe_insert("hide_render", frame=1)
        o.hide_render = True
        o.keyframe_insert("hide_render", frame=f)
        o.hide_render = False


def build(ctx):
    n = ctx.nframes
    NR = ctx.render_frames
    fr = ctx.frame
    # ---------------- timing ----------------
    f_roll0 = 5                    # stone starts to move (just after the flash peak)
    f_roll1 = int(fr(2.2))         # stone at rest against the stop
    f_move0 = int(fr(0.3))
    f_move1 = int(fr(6.9))

    SUN_AZ, SUN_EL = -44.0, 9.0
    tomb = S.garden_tomb(ctx, stone_open=[(1, 0.0), (f_roll0, 0.0), (f_roll1, 1.0)], sun_elevation=SUN_EL,
                         sun_azimuth=SUN_AZ, dust_motes=True)
    cliff = tomb.objects["cliff"]
    _lower_cliff(cliff)
    # pale Jerusalem limestone: desaturate the set's warm rock materials (the dawn light adds the warmth)
    for mn, sat, val in (("set_tomb_face", 0.38, 1.16), ("set_tomb_cut", 0.14, 1.55), ("set_tomb_rock", 0.38, 1.15),
                         ("set_tomb_stone", 0.35, 1.15), ("set_tomb_ground", 0.45, 1.05)):
        for m in bpy.data.materials:
            if not m.name.startswith(mn) or not m.use_nodes:
                continue
            for nd in m.node_tree.nodes:
                if nd.bl_idname == "ShaderNodeHueSaturation":
                    nd.inputs["Saturation"].default_value = sat
                    nd.inputs["Value"].default_value = val
    sun = tomb.lights["sun"]
    sun.data.energy = 5.0
    sun.data.color = C.kelvin(4100)
    sun.data.angle = math.radians(0.8)
    cf = tomb.lights["chamber_fill"]
    cf.data.color = C.kelvin(5600)
    cf.data["base_e"] = cf.data.get("base_e", 12.0) * 0.75
    if cf.data.animation_data and cf.data.animation_data.action:
        for fc in C._fcurves(cf.data.animation_data.action):
            for kp in fc.keyframe_points:
                kp.co[1] *= 0.75
                kp.handle_left[1] *= 0.75
                kp.handle_right[1] *= 0.75
    # denser dust in the chamber -> visible sun shaft through the doorway; finer motes
    for o in tomb.coll.objects:
        if o.name.startswith("tomb_dust") and not o.name.startswith("tomb_dust_motes"):
            o.hide_render = True          # replaced by a uniform chamber haze below (the noisy one hid the shaft)
        if o.name.startswith("tomb_dust_motes"):
            for nd in o.modifiers[0].node_group.nodes:
                if nd.bl_idname == "GeometryNodeMeshIcoSphere":
                    nd.inputs["Radius"].default_value = 0.0013
            mm = bpy.data.materials.get("tomb_dust_motes_mat")
            if mm:
                C.bsdf(mm).inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.45, 0.42, 0.38, 1)
    shaft = tomb.lights["dawn_shaft"]
    # the real sun now shines through the doorway: keep the spot as a gentle booster along the same line
    lin = tomb["linen"]
    sdir = Vector((math.sin(math.radians(SUN_AZ)) * math.cos(math.radians(SUN_EL)),
                   -math.cos(math.radians(SUN_AZ)) * math.cos(math.radians(SUN_EL)),
                   math.sin(math.radians(SUN_EL))))           # towards the sun
    _shroud(tomb)
    ch = tomb["chamber"]
    haze = C.fog_box(center=(ch.x + 0.25, ch.y - 0.15, 0.75), size=(3.3, 3.25, 2.2), density=0.2,
                     color=(0.95, 0.9, 0.84), anisotropy=-0.15, name="s15_chamber_haze", coll=tomb.coll)
    haze.visible_shadow = False
    # the exterior air box costs ~7 CPU-s/frame for no visible gain at 5-10 m: drop it; the chamber haze is
    # only needed once the doorway is close
    for o in tomb.coll.objects:
        if o.name.startswith("tomb_haze"):
            o.hide_render = True
    haze.hide_render = True
    haze.keyframe_insert("hide_render", frame=1)
    haze.hide_render = False
    haze.keyframe_insert("hide_render", frame=int(ctx.frame(2.6)))
    # re-aim the set's booster spot along the real sun ray through the doorway
    door_c = tomb["door_center"] + Vector((0, 0.1, -0.1))
    shaft.location = door_c + sdir * 2.2
    C.look_at(shaft, door_c - sdir)
    shaft.data.spot_size = math.radians(24)
    shaft.data.volume_factor = 3.0

    # ---------------- vegetation: olive trees, scrub on the outcrop, spring grass ----------------
    rnd = random.Random(15)
    olive_a = E.olive_tree(seed=4, age=1.1, size=0.95, lod=0)
    olive_b = E.olive_tree(seed=7, age=0.8, size=0.8, lod=1)
    veg = [E.place(olive_a, (-4.6, -2.4, -0.05), rot=(0, 0, 40)),
           E.place(olive_b, (5.2, -3.9, -0.05), rot=(0, 0, 200))]
    bushes = [E.thorn_bush(seed=k, size=0.9 + 0.25 * k, leafy=1.0) for k in range(3)]
    E.add_ground(cliff)
    veg.append(E.scatter(bushes, terrain=cliff, count=260, region=(-9, -1, 9, 9), seed=3, scale=(0.6, 1.3),
                         align=0.4, max_slope=55, zrange=(2.0, 8.0), sink=0.05, name="s15_cliff_scrub"))
    gr_dry = E.grass_protos("dry", n=4, height=0.3)
    gr_green = E.grass_protos("green", n=4, height=0.28)
    veg.append(E.scatter(gr_dry + gr_green, terrain=cliff, count=900, region=(-9, -1, 9, 9), seed=4,
                         scale=(0.7, 1.4), align=0.6, max_slope=60, zrange=(1.5, 8.0), name="s15_cliff_grass",
                         shadows=False))
    gnd = tomb.objects["ground"]
    E.add_ground(gnd)
    veg.append(E.scatter(gr_green + gr_dry, terrain=gnd, count=1000, region=(-7, -8, 7, -0.7), seed=5,
                         scale=(0.6, 1.3), align=0.5, exclude=[(0.0, -0.6, 0.8), (1.3, -0.6, 1.4)],
                         weights=[1, 1, 1, 1, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6], name="s15_ground_grass", shadows=False))

    # ---------------- earthquake dust ----------------
    FX.dust_burst((0.55, -0.45, 0.04), f_roll0 + 3, size=0.85, color=(0.8, 0.72, 0.62), count=18, grains=160,
                  wind=(0.5, -0.35, 0.05), floor=0.0, opacity=0.6, seed=5)
    FX.dust_burst((2.25 + 0.95, -0.4, 0.06), f_roll1 - 2, size=0.6, color=(0.8, 0.72, 0.62), count=12,
                  grains=100, wind=(0.4, -0.3, 0.05), floor=0.0, opacity=0.55, seed=6)

    # ---------------- camera ----------------
    bz = tomb["bench"].z
    L = [Vector(v) for v in ((-2.9, -5.2, 0.5), (-1.7, -3.1, 0.66), (-0.35, -1.3, 0.82), (0.0, 0.0, 0.92),
                              (-0.12, 0.62, 1.08), (-0.26, 1.08, 1.24), (-0.3, 1.2, 1.3))]
    T = [Vector(v) for v in ((0.15, 0.0, 1.5), (0.15, 0.2, 1.05), (0.12, 1.4, 0.85), (0.5, 2.5, 0.6),
                              (0.9, 2.55, 0.5), (1.18, 2.3, bz + 0.04), (1.2, 2.28, bz + 0.02))]
    # arc-length parameterisation of the spline so the speed follows `prof` only
    NS = 400
    us = [i / NS for i in range(NS + 1)]
    pts = [_spline(L, u) for u in us]
    acc = [0.0]
    for i in range(NS):
        acc.append(acc[-1] + (pts[i + 1] - pts[i]).length)
    tot = acc[-1]

    def u_at(sn):
        d = sn * tot
        lo, hi = 0, NS
        while hi - lo > 1:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            if acc[mid] < d:
                lo = mid
            else:
                hi = mid
        t = (d - acc[lo]) / max(1e-9, acc[hi] - acc[lo])
        return us[lo] + (us[hi] - us[lo]) * t

    def prof(t):
        # already gliding at the cut, steady, then a long gentle settle inside the chamber
        return 1.0 - (1.0 - t) ** 1.8 if t < 1 else 1.0

    def path(f):
        t = max(0.0, min(1.0, (f - 1) / float(f_move1 - 1)))
        u = u_at(prof(t))
        loc = _spline(L, u)
        tgt = _spline(T, u)
        # earthquake: strong at the cut, decays over ~1.8 s
        q = max(0.0, 1.0 - (f - 1) / fr(1.8)) ** 2
        loc = loc + C.shake(f, amp=0.03 * q, freq=9.0, seed=2) + C.shake(f, amp=0.004, freq=0.5, seed=7)
        lz = 24.0 + 6.0 * C.smoothstep(max(0.0, min(1.0, (t - 0.62) / 0.38)))     # 24 -> 30 mm inside
        return loc, tgt, 0.0, lz

    cam = C.camera(loc=L[0], target=T[0], lens=24, name="s15_cam")      # no DOF: wide lens, ~4 CPU-s/frame saved
    C.animate_camera(cam, path)
    f_door = None
    for f in range(1, NR + 1):
        loc = path(f)[0]
        if f_door is None and loc.y > 0.2:
            f_door = f
    f_door = f_door or NR
    # aperture opens up for the close interior (shallow DOF on the cloths)

    # ---------------- interior light ----------------
    # once inside, the exterior is behind the camera: drop the (shadowed, noisy) sky fill + exterior plants
    skf = tomb.lights["sky_fill"]
    e0 = skf.data.energy
    skf.data.keyframe_insert("energy", frame=max(1, f_door - 6))
    skf.data.energy = e0 * 0.12
    skf.data.keyframe_insert("energy", frame=f_door + 8)
    _hide_after(veg, f_door + 8)
    # warm bounce off the sunlit grave cloths / floor (no GI in EEVEE): soft, shadowless
    bnc = C.light("AREA", loc=(lin.x - 0.25, lin.y - 0.6, bz + 0.05), energy=0.0, temp=3900,
                  target=(lin.x - 1.5, lin.y - 0.2, bz + 1.0), size=1.4, name="s15_cloth_bounce", shadow=False)
    bnc.data.volume_factor = 0.0
    bnc.data.keyframe_insert("energy", frame=f_roll0 + 10)
    bnc.data.energy = 12.0
    bnc.data.keyframe_insert("energy", frame=f_roll1 + 20)

    ee = bpy.context.scene.eevee
    ee.use_volume_custom_range = True          # froxel slices where the shaft is (default 100 m wastes them)
    ee.volumetric_start = 0.1
    ee.volumetric_end = 16.0
    ee.volumetric_sample_distribution = 0.85
    ctx.samples = 4
    ctx.interp = True
    ctx.render_opts = {"volumetrics": "low", "shadow_scale": 0.5}
    ctx.post = {"grade": "dawn", "bloom": 0.3, "caption": {"y": 0.72, "halo": 1.2}}

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/shots/s16b.py =====
"""s16b - Scarred hand: "For he has not despised or scorned the suffering of the afflicted one;"

Close-up (dissolve from the praising multitude at sunrise). The risen Christ (white robe) lifts his
right hand towards us: during the first phrase the hand turns and opens, palm towards the camera, in
low warm sunrise light; on "the suffering of the afflicted one" the camera eases in on the healed
nail wound in the palm - a pale, puckered, long-closed scar (no blood). The sun stands behind him,
rimming fingers, sleeve and shoulder; dust motes glitter in the backlight; his robe and face are a
soft blur behind the hand (85 mm, f/2).
"""
import math
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector
from lib import core as C
from lib import characters as P
from lib import env as E
from lib import sets as S

SIDE = "R"          # character's right hand (screen left of his body)


def _show_pose_fn():
    """Custom pose 's16b_show': stand relaxed + one forearm raised, palm turned to `face` (world dir in
    rig space), fingers along `up`. Searches pronation / wrist flexion so the palm normal matches."""
    _Pose = P._Pose

    def fn(Pp, p, target=None, side="R", hand="open", face=(0, -1, 0), up=(0, 0, 1), pole=None, curl=1.0, **k):
        P._pose_stand(Pp, p, relaxed=True)
        s = side
        base = Pp.copy()
        face = Vector(face).normalized()
        upv = Vector(up).normalized()
        pole = Vector(pole) if pole is not None else Vector((-0.6 if s == "R" else 0.6, 0.4, -1.0))
        best = None
        for pron in range(-40, 200, 8):
            for flex in (-50, -40, -30, -20, -10, 0, 10, 20):
                Q = base.copy()
                P._arm_ik(Q, s, Vector(target), pole=pole, pron=pron, flex=flex, shrug=4)
                pn = Q.carry("wrist." + s, Q.an["palm" + s]).normalized()
                fd = Q.ydir("wrist." + s)
                err = (1 - pn.dot(face)) * 1.0 + (1 - fd.dot(upv)) * 0.6
                if best is None or err < best[0]:
                    best = (err, pron, flex)
        _, pron, flex = best
        # refine
        for dp in (-6, -3, 0, 3, 6):
            for dfl in (-6, -3, 0, 3, 6):
                Q = base.copy()
                P._arm_ik(Q, s, Vector(target), pole=pole, pron=pron + dp, flex=flex + dfl, shrug=4)
                pn = Q.carry("wrist." + s, Q.an["palm" + s]).normalized()
                fd = Q.ydir("wrist." + s)
                err = (1 - pn.dot(face)) * 1.0 + (1 - fd.dot(upv)) * 0.6
                if err < best[0]:
                    best = (err, pron + dp, flex + dfl)
        _, pron, flex = best
        P._arm_ik(Pp, s, Vector(target), pole=pole, pron=pron, flex=flex, shrug=4)
        P._hand(Pp, s, hand, amount=curl)
        print("s16b pose: pron %.0f flex %.0f err %.3f" % (pron, flex, best[0]))
    return fn


class _NM:
    """Tiny shader-math builder (scalars / vectors as sockets or constants)."""

    def __init__(self, nt):
        self.nt, self.N, self.L = nt, nt.nodes, nt.links

    def _in(self, sock, v):
        if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
            sock.default_value = v
        elif isinstance(v, (tuple, list, Vector)):
            sock.default_value = tuple(v)
        else:
            self.L.new(v, sock)

    def m(self, op, a, b=0.0, c=None, clamp=False):
        n = self.N.new("ShaderNodeMath")
        n.operation = op
        n.use_clamp = clamp
        self._in(n.inputs[0], a)
        self._in(n.inputs[1], b)
        if c is not None:
            self._in(n.inputs[2], c)
        return n.outputs[0]

    def v(self, op, a, b=None, out=0):
        n = self.N.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
        n.operation = op
        self._in(n.inputs[0], a)
        if b is not None:
            self._in(n.inputs[1], b)
        return n.outputs[out]

    def dot(self, a, b):
        return self.v("DOT_PRODUCT", a, b, out="Value")

    def smooth(self, x, lo, hi):
        """smoothstep(lo, hi, x) (lo > hi gives the inverted ramp)."""
        n = self.N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
        n.interpolation_type = "SMOOTHSTEP"
        self._in(n.inputs["Value"], x)
        n.inputs["From Min"].default_value = lo
        n.inputs["From Max"].default_value = hi
        return n.outputs[0]

    def mix(self, fac, a, b, blend="MIX"):
        n = self.N.new("ShaderNodeMix")
        n.data_type = "RGBA"
        n.blend_type = blend
        self._in(n.inputs["Factor"], fac)
        self._in(n.inputs[6], a)
        self._in(n.inputs[7], b if isinstance(b, bpy.types.NodeSocket) else (*b, 1.0))
        return n.outputs[2]


def _hand_frame(person, side="R"):
    """Rest-space (body object space) frame of the palm: palm-surface centre S, back-surface centre Sb,
    axis A (wrist -> knuckles), palm normal Np, B (towards the thumb), palm length."""
    import numpy as np
    s = side
    b = person.rig.data.bones
    wr = Vector(b["wrist." + s].head_local)
    kn = Vector(b["metacarpal2." + s].tail_local)
    kn5 = Vector(b["metacarpal4." + s].tail_local)
    th = Vector(b["finger1-1." + s].head_local)
    pc = (wr + (kn + kn5) * 0.5) * 0.5
    A = ((kn + kn5) * 0.5 - wr).normalized()
    an = getattr(person, "_anat", None) or {}
    Np = Vector(an.get("palm" + s, (0, 0, 0)))
    co = person._co
    w = person._w["body"] > 0.5
    rel = co - np.array(pc)
    d = np.linalg.norm(rel, axis=1)
    near = w & (d < 0.05)
    if Np.length < 0.5:      # fallback: principal thinnest axis of the hand verts
        pts = rel[near]
        _, _, vt = np.linalg.svd(pts - pts.mean(0))
        Np = Vector(vt[2])
    Np = (Np - A * Np.dot(A)).normalized()
    npn = np.array(Np)
    along = rel @ npn
    perp = np.linalg.norm(rel - along[:, None] * npn[None, :], axis=1)
    cand = near & (along > 0.0)
    i = int(np.argmin(np.where(cand, perp, 1e9)))
    S = Vector(co[i])
    cand = near & (along < 0.0)
    i = int(np.argmin(np.where(cand, perp, 1e9)))
    Sb = Vector(co[i])
    B = Np.cross(A).normalized()
    if B.dot(th - pc) < 0:
        B = -B
    L = (kn - wr).length
    return S, Sb, A, Np, B, L


def _scar_and_creases(person, side="R"):
    """Per-pixel (rest_position based) palm detail for the hero close-up:
    * the healed nail wound in the palm centre: a pale, slightly shiny, puckered round scar with a raised
      pinkish rim and radiating tension creases (no blood) - plus a smaller matching mark on the back;
    * the main palmar flexion creases (heart/head/life lines, wrist + finger-base creases) so the palm
      reads as a palm."""
    m = person.body.active_material
    if m is None or not m.use_nodes:
        return
    S, Sb, A, Np, B, L = _hand_frame(person, side)
    print("s16b palm frame: S", tuple(round(x, 4) for x in S), "L %.3f" % L)
    nt = m.node_tree
    M = _NM(nt)
    bsdf = next(n for n in nt.nodes if n.bl_idname == "ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
    ra = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeAttribute")
    ra.attribute_type = "GEOMETRY"
    ra.attribute_name = "rest_position"
    P_ = ra.outputs["Vector"]
    rel = M.v("SUBTRACT", P_, tuple(S))
    u = M.dot(rel, tuple(A))
    v = M.dot(rel, tuple(B))
    w = M.dot(rel, tuple(Np))
    nz = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
    nz.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 320.0
    nz.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 3.0
    M._in(nz.inputs["Vector"], P_)
    jit = M.m("MULTIPLY", M.m("SUBTRACT", nz.outputs["Fac"], 0.5), 0.0028)
    palm_side = M.smooth(w, -0.007, -0.002)
    # ---- scar (palm) ----
    ang = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMath")
    ang.operation = "ARCTAN2"
    M._in(ang.inputs[0], v)
    M._in(ang.inputs[1], u)
    d = M.m("ADD", M.m("SQRT", M.m("ADD", M.m("POWER", M.m("DIVIDE", u, 1.15), 2.0), M.m("POWER", v, 2.0))), jit)
    # irregular, slightly star-shaped outline of a healed puncture
    n2 = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")              # irregular outline (low frequency)
    n2.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 140.0
    n2.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 2.0
    M._in(n2.inputs["Vector"], P_)
    d = M.m("MULTIPLY", d, M.m("ADD", 1.0, M.m("MULTIPLY", M.m("SUBTRACT", n2.outputs["Fac"], 0.5), 0.9)))
    core = M.m("MULTIPLY", M.smooth(d, 0.0066, 0.0036), palm_side)
    ring = M.m("MULTIPLY", M.m("MULTIPLY", M.smooth(d, 0.0038, 0.0078), M.smooth(d, 0.0135, 0.0078)), palm_side)
    rad = M.m("MULTIPLY", M.m("POWER", M.m("SINE", M.m("ADD", M.m("MULTIPLY", ang.outputs[0], 9.0),
                                                       M.m("MULTIPLY", nz.outputs["Fac"], 9.0))), 4.0),
              M.smooth(d, 0.016, 0.006))
    rad = M.m("MULTIPLY", rad, palm_side)
    # ---- back-of-hand mark ----
    relb = M.v("SUBTRACT", P_, tuple(Sb))
    ub, vb, wb = M.dot(relb, tuple(A)), M.dot(relb, tuple(B)), M.dot(relb, tuple(-Np))
    db = M.m("ADD", M.m("SQRT", M.m("ADD", M.m("POWER", M.m("DIVIDE", ub, 1.15), 2.0), M.m("POWER", vb, 2.0))), jit)
    back_side = M.smooth(wb, -0.007, -0.002)
    coreb = M.m("MULTIPLY", M.smooth(db, 0.0048, 0.0028), back_side)
    ringb = M.m("MULTIPLY", M.m("MULTIPLY", M.smooth(db, 0.0028, 0.0055), M.smooth(db, 0.0095, 0.0055)), back_side)
    core = M.m("MAXIMUM", core, coreb)
    ring = M.m("MAXIMUM", ring, ringb)
    # ---- palmar creases (normalised palm coords) ----
    U = M.m("DIVIDE", u, L)
    V = M.m("DIVIDE", v, L)

    cw = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
    cw.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 60.0
    cw.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 2.0
    M._in(cw.inputs["Vector"], P_)
    wob = M.m("MULTIPLY", M.m("SUBTRACT", cw.outputs["Fac"], 0.5), 0.03)

    def crease(dist, width, lo, hi, x, fade=0.06):
        width *= 1.7
        line = M.smooth(M.m("ABSOLUTE", M.m("ADD", dist, wob)), width, 0.0)
        span = M.m("MULTIPLY", M.smooth(x, lo, lo + fade), M.smooth(x, hi, hi - fade))
        return M.m("MULTIPLY", line, span)
    # heart line: from the pinky edge (V=-0.5, U=0.24) rising towards between index/middle (V=0.1, U=0.38)
    t1 = M.m("DIVIDE", M.m("ADD", V, 0.5), 0.6)
    f1 = M.m("ADD", 0.24, M.m("MULTIPLY", 0.14, M.m("POWER", M.m("MAXIMUM", t1, 0.0), 1.6)))
    c1 = crease(M.m("SUBTRACT", U, f1), 0.012, -0.52, 0.12, V)
    # head line: from the thumb/index side (V=0.36, U=0.26) slanting down to the pinky side (V=-0.38, U=0.02)
    f2 = M.m("ADD", 0.02, M.m("MULTIPLY", 0.24, M.m("DIVIDE", M.m("ADD", V, 0.38), 0.74)))
    c2 = crease(M.m("SUBTRACT", U, f2), 0.011, -0.4, 0.38, V)
    # life line: arc around the thenar eminence, from (U=0.25, V=0.34) to the wrist (U=-0.45, V=0.12)
    t3 = M.m("DIVIDE", M.m("SUBTRACT", 0.25, U), 0.7)
    f3 = M.m("SUBTRACT", 0.34, M.m("MULTIPLY", 0.3, M.m("SINE", M.m("MULTIPLY", M.m("MAXIMUM", t3, 0.0), 1.9))))
    c3 = crease(M.m("SUBTRACT", V, f3), 0.012, -0.46, 0.27, U)
    # wrist creases + finger-base creases
    c4 = crease(M.m("SUBTRACT", U, -0.5), 0.009, -0.5, 0.45, V)
    c5 = crease(M.m("SUBTRACT", U, -0.56), 0.008, -0.45, 0.4, V)
    c6 = crease(M.m("SUBTRACT", U, M.m("ADD", 0.56, M.m("MULTIPLY", V, -0.08))), 0.01, -0.5, 0.2, V)
    cr = M.m("MAXIMUM", M.m("MAXIMUM", M.m("MAXIMUM", c1, c2), M.m("MAXIMUM", c3, c4)), M.m("MAXIMUM", c5, c6))
    cr = M.m("MULTIPLY", cr, M.m("MULTIPLY", palm_side, M.smooth(d, 0.006, 0.011)))   # not across the scar
    # ---- colour ----
    src = bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].links[0].from_socket
    col = M.mix(M.m("MULTIPLY", cr, 0.16), src, (0.72, 0.52, 0.46), "MULTIPLY")
    col = M.mix(M.m("MULTIPLY", ring, 0.5), col, (0.8, 0.56, 0.54), "MULTIPLY")
    col = M.mix(M.m("MULTIPLY", core, 0.42), col, (0.78, 0.55, 0.52))
