    col = M.mix(M.m("MULTIPLY", rad, 0.15), col, (0.82, 0.64, 0.6), "MULTIPLY")
    nt.links.new(col, bsdf.inputs["Base Color"])
    # ---- roughness: glossy scar tissue ----
    if bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].is_linked:
        r0 = bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].links[0].from_socket
    else:
        r0 = bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value
    r = M.m("SUBTRACT", r0, M.m("MULTIPLY", M.m("MAXIMUM", core, M.m("MULTIPLY", ring, 0.5)), 0.1))
    nt.links.new(r, bsdf.inputs["Roughness"])
    # ---- relief ----
    h = M.m("SUBTRACT", M.m("MULTIPLY", ring, 0.6), M.m("MULTIPLY", core, 0.45))
    h = M.m("ADD", h, M.m("MULTIPLY", rad, 0.35))
    h = M.m("ADD", h, M.m("MULTIPLY", M.m("MULTIPLY", nz.outputs["Fac"], core), 0.5))
    h = M.m("SUBTRACT", h, M.m("MULTIPLY", cr, 0.9))
    bump = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
    bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.6
    bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value = 0.0009
    nt.links.new(h, bump.inputs["Height"])
    if bsdf.inputs["Normal"].is_linked:
        nt.links.new(bsdf.inputs["Normal"].links[0].from_socket, bump.inputs["Normal"])
    nt.links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"], bsdf.inputs["Normal"])


def _mote_material(name="s16b_mote"):
    """Backlit dust: translucent (glows when the sun is behind it) + faint emission."""
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    nt = m.node_tree
    nt.nodes.remove(nt.nodes["Principled BSDF"])
    tr = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBsdfTranslucent")
    tr.inputs["Color"].default_value = (1.0, 0.85, 0.6, 1)
    df = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBsdfDiffuse")
    df.inputs["Color"].default_value = (0.25, 0.22, 0.18, 1)
    mx = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeAddShader")
    nt.links.new(tr.outputs[0], mx.inputs[0])
    nt.links.new(df.outputs[0], mx.inputs[1])
    nt.links.new(mx.outputs[0], nt.nodes["Material Output"].inputs["Surface"])
    return m


def build(ctx):
    NR = ctx.render_frames
    n = ctx.nframes
    fr = ctx.frame
    p1s, p1e = ctx.phrase_frames(0)
    p2s, p2e = ctx.phrase_frames(1)

    # ---------------- sky / sun (sunrise, behind him, screen left: clears his shoulder) ----------------
    sky = None                     # built below, once the sun direction (behind the hand) is known

    # ---------------- the risen Christ ----------------
    if "s16b_show" not in P.POSES:
        P.POSES["s16b_show"] = _show_pose_fn()
    j = P.make_person("jesus", "JESUS_RISEN", hair_strands=False, pose=None,
                      outfit_opts={"robe": {"sleeves": "3q"}})       # white linen sleeve at the bottom of frame
    j.rig.location = (0, 0, 0)
    j.update()
    sh = j.bone_world("upperarm01.R")
    # blessing: the right hand lifted in front of / above the shoulder, palm towards us (Luke 24:50)
    tgt = sh + Vector((0.06, -0.27, 0.45))            # lifted high, in front of / above the head
    cam_pos = tgt + Vector((-0.05, -0.82, -0.36))     # below and in front: looking up into the palm, sky behind
    face0 = (cam_pos - tgt).normalized()
    up0 = (Vector((0, 0, 1)) - face0 * face0.z).normalized()     # fingers up, perpendicular to the palm normal
    up0 = (up0 + Vector((0.12, 0, 0))).normalized()
    up0 = (up0 - face0 * up0.dot(face0)).normalized()
    t0 = tgt + Vector((0.0, 0.06, -0.2))
    face_in = Vector((0.75, -0.6, -0.1)).normalized()
    P.key_pose(j, 1, "s16b_show", target=t0, side="R", hand="relaxed", curl=0.9, face=face_in,
               up=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), ground=False)
    f_open = int(p1e - 4)
    P.key_pose(j, f_open, "s16b_show", target=tgt, side="R", hand="relaxed", curl=0.2, face=face0, up=up0,
               ground=False)
    P.key_pose(j, NR, "s16b_show", target=tgt + Vector((0.0, -0.012, 0.008)), side="R", hand="relaxed", curl=0.15,
               face=face0, up=up0, ground=False)
    P.expression(j, "peace")
    _scar_and_creases(j, "R")
    for key in ("teeth", "tongue", "beard"):           # chin/mouth stay below the frame
        o = j.parts.get(key)
        if o is not None:
            o.hide_render = True

    # ---------------- camera ----------------
    aim1 = tgt + Vector((0.0, 0.0, 0.04))
    aim0 = (t0 + tgt) * 0.5 + Vector((0.0, 0.0, 0.02))
    cam = C.camera(loc=cam_pos, target=aim0, lens=70, fstop=2.0, focus=(cam_pos - tgt).length, name="s16b_cam")
    c0, c1 = cam_pos + (cam_pos - tgt) * 0.08, tgt + (cam_pos - tgt) * 0.8

    def path(f):
        u = C.ease_in_out(max(0.0, min(1.0, (f - 1) / float(NR - 1))))
        ua = C.ease_in_out(max(0.0, min(1.0, (f - 1) / float(f_open + 10))))
        loc = c0.lerp(c1, u) + C.shake(f, amp=0.002, freq=0.3, seed=3)
        return loc, aim1 + (aim0 - aim1) * 0.25 * (1.0 - ua)
    C.animate_camera(cam, path)
    for f in range(1, NR + 1, 4):
        loc, t = path(f)
        ua = C.ease_in_out(max(0.0, min(1.0, (f - 1) / float(f_open))))
        cam.data.dof.focus_distance = (t0.lerp(tgt, ua) - loc).length - 0.008
        cam.data.dof.keyframe_insert("focus_distance", frame=f)

    # ---------------- sky: the sun stands just behind the lifted hand ----------------
    axis = (tgt - cam_pos).normalized()
    rgt = axis.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1))).normalized()
    upv = rgt.cross(axis).normalized()
    sdir = (axis + rgt * -0.05 + upv * 0.06).normalized()           # ~4.5 deg up-left of the palm centre
    sun_el = math.degrees(math.asin(sdir.z))
    sun_az = math.degrees(math.atan2(sdir.x, -sdir.y))
    sky = E.sky(mood="sunrise", sun_az=sun_az, ctx=ctx, sun_el=sun_el, strength=0.5, bg=0.75, tint=(1.0, 0.74, 0.5))
    sun = sky["sun"]
    sun.data.energy = 3.0
    # warm halo around the (unseen) sun disc: camera-only emissive billboard far behind the hand
    gc = cam_pos + sdir * 60.0
    halo = C.prim("plane", name="s16b_sunhalo", loc=tuple(gc), size=40.0)
    halo.rotation_euler = C.look_rot(gc, cam_pos)
    halo.visible_shadow = False
    halo.visible_diffuse = False
    halo.visible_glossy = False
    halo.visible_volume_scatter = False
    hm = bpy.data.materials.new("s16b_halo")
    hm.use_nodes = True
    hm.surface_render_method = "BLENDED"
    nt = hm.node_tree
    nt.nodes.remove(nt.nodes["Principled BSDF"])
    tc = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
    gr = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexGradient")
    gr.gradient_type = "SPHERICAL"
    mp = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMapping")
    mp.inputs["Scale"].default_value = (0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
    nt.links.new(tc.outputs["Object"], mp.inputs["Vector"])
    nt.links.new(mp.outputs[0], gr.inputs["Vector"])
    pw = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMath")
    pw.operation = "POWER"
    pw.inputs[1].default_value = 3.0
    nt.links.new(gr.outputs["Fac"], pw.inputs[0])
    em = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeEmission")
    em.inputs["Color"].default_value = (1.0, 0.6, 0.28, 1)
    sm = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMath")
    sm.operation = "MULTIPLY"
    sm.inputs[1].default_value = 3.5
    nt.links.new(pw.outputs[0], sm.inputs[0])
    nt.links.new(sm.outputs[0], em.inputs["Strength"])
    tr = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBsdfTransparent")
    ad = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeAddShader")
    nt.links.new(em.outputs[0], ad.inputs[0])
    nt.links.new(tr.outputs[0], ad.inputs[1])
    nt.links.new(ad.outputs[0], nt.nodes["Material Output"].inputs["Surface"])
    C.assign(halo, hm)

    # ---------------- light ----------------
    # warm bounce (gold reflector) raking the palm from screen right: close + narrow so the robe stays darker
    bl = C.light("AREA", loc=tuple(tgt + Vector((0.38, -0.42, -0.32))), energy=10.0, temp=4300, target=tuple(tgt),
                 size=0.4, name="s16b_bounce", shadow=False)
    bl.data.spread = math.radians(50)
    fl = C.light("AREA", loc=tuple(tgt + Vector((-0.3, -0.6, -0.3))), energy=1.5, temp=5200, target=tuple(tgt),
                 size=0.6, name="s16b_fill", shadow=False)
    fl.data.spread = math.radians(60)
    # dust motes: translucent, so the ones in the sun behind the hand glitter
    mo = S.dust(center=tuple(tgt + Vector((0.02, -0.1, -0.05))), size=(0.5, 0.7, 0.6), count=230, radius=0.0011,
                color=(1.0, 0.9, 0.75), emission=0.0, speed=0.04, amp=0.06, seed=4, name="s16b_motes")
    mm = _mote_material()
    for nd in mo.modifiers[0].node_group.nodes:
        if nd.bl_idname == "GeometryNodeSetMaterial":
            nd.inputs["Material"].default_value = mm

    ctx.samples = 5
    ctx.render_opts = {"volumetrics": "low"}
    ctx.interp = True
    ctx.post = {"grade": "warm", "bloom": 0.36, "bloom_threshold": 0.62, "exposure": -0.08, "contrast": 1.06,
                "saturation": 0.94, "vignette": 0.24}

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/shots/s16c.py =====
"""s16c - "His face in the light": "he has not hidden his face from him / but has listened to his cry for help."

Dissolve in from s16b (the nail-scarred open hand in warm sunlight). Bookend of s01a: the same low
three-quarter close-up, mirrored (camera on his left), of the risen Jesus (JESUS_RISEN: clean, white
robe, no crown). Dawn: at first his face rests in the cool shade of the morning sky, eyes closed, head a
little bowed. The sun clears the last cloud bank: a soft edge of warm, low sunlight washes down over his
face from the brow to the beard ("he has not hidden his face"), his eyes open into the light and lift
with a slight lift of the head; on "but has listened to his cry for help" a quiet smile. The background
is the cool blue-violet morning sky away from the sun (warm face against cool sky). Slow push-in,
shallow depth of field.
"""
import math
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector
from lib import core as C
from lib import env as E
from lib import characters as P

SUN_AZ, SUN_EL = -32.0, 10.0      # low morning sun, in front of him on his right (screen left): short lighting
CAM_AZ = -28.0                    # camera bearing around the face, degrees towards the character's RIGHT (-: his left)
CAM_EL = -10.0
D0, D1 = 0.92, 0.74
LENS0, LENS1 = 60.0, 62.0
FSTOP = 2.4
AIM_DZ = -0.06
SUN_E = 4.0                       # sun lamp W/m2 once clear of the cloud
SUN_RGB = (1.0, 0.78, 0.56)       # warm gold (the HDRI's measured sunrise colour turns skin orange)
EDGE = (0.5, -0.3)                # sunlight edge relative to the eyes (m, along 'up'): start -> end of the sweep
OCC_DIST, OCC_SUN_ANGLE = 6.0, 3.0  # cloud card distance (m) and sun angular diameter (deg) -> ~0.3 m penumbra
LIGHTS = dict(fill=45.0, rim=40.0, bounce=6.0)
SKYLIGHT = 0.5                    # sky dome lighting (visible sky unchanged)
HAIR_N, BEARD_D = 6000, 0.75
ROBE_K = 0.6
LAST = {}


def _lean(j):
    """Render-cost trims for the close-up (hair strands + shadows dominate the frame time)."""
    for g in j.garments:
        if "sandal" in g.name:
            g.hide_render = True
    for m in j.body.modifiers:
        if m.type == "SUBSURF":
            m.render_levels = 0
    try:
        old = j.parts.pop("hair_strands", None)
        if old is not None:
            bpy.data.objects.remove(old, do_unlink=True)
        P.make_hair_strands(j, count=HAIR_N, points=10, flyaways=0.0)
        old = j.parts.pop("beard", None)
        if old is not None:
            bpy.data.objects.remove(old, do_unlink=True)
        P.make_beard(j, density=BEARD_D)
    except Exception as e:
        print("s16c WARNING: hair/beard rebuild failed:", e)
    for k in ("teeth", "tongue"):              # lips stay closed: the lit teeth showed as a white line
        if k in j.parts:
            j.parts[k].hide_render = True
    for g in j.garments:                       # bleached robe -> soft cream: no blown-out white under the face
        if "sandal" not in g.name:
            g.color = (g.color[0] * ROBE_K, g.color[1] * ROBE_K * 0.98, g.color[2] * ROBE_K * 0.94, 1.0)


def _ease(a, b, f):
    return C.smoothstep(min(1.0, max(0.0, (f - a) / float(b - a))))


NECK_W = (("neck01", 0.22), ("neck02", 0.24), ("neck03", 0.24), ("head", 0.30))


def _key_body(j, base, frames, fn):
    bones = [n for n, _ in NECK_W] + ["spine02", "spine01", "clavicle.L", "clavicle.R"]
    for f in frames:
        a = fn(f)
        Pz = base.copy()
        br = a.get("breath", 0.0)
        Pz.turn("spine02", bend=-0.5 * br)
        Pz.turn("spine01", bend=-0.6 * br)
        for s in "LR":
            Pz.turn("clavicle." + s, side=(-0.8 * br if s == "L" else 0.8 * br))
        for n, w in NECK_W:
            Pz.turn(n, bend=a["pitch"] * w, side=a.get("tilt", 0.0) * w, twist=a.get("turn", 0.0) * w)
        Pz.write(frame=f, bones=bones)


def _expr_keys(j, keys):
    allu = set()
    for _, d, _w in keys:
        allu |= set(P._expand_units(d))
    allu |= {"eye-left-closure", "eye-right-closure"}
    P._ensure_units(j, sorted(allu))
    for f, d, w in keys:
        P.expression(j, d, w, frame=f)


def _occluder(face, sun_dir, f0, f1, sun):
    """The last cloud bank in front of the sun, as a camera-invisible opaque card with a wavy top edge
    standing OCC_DIST m towards the sun. It sinks so the edge of sunlight sweeps down over his face
    (brow -> beard) between f0 and f1. Opaque geometry + the sun's angular size give a clean soft
    penumbra (OCC_DIST * sun angle ~ 0.3 m); a dithered alpha edge was noisy (bad for 12 fps + RIFE)."""
    import numpy as np
    s = Vector(sun_dir).normalized()
    side = s.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1))).normalized()
    up = side.cross(s).normalized()
    if up.z < 0:
        up, side = -up, -side
    n = 48
    xs = np.linspace(-4.0, 4.0, n)
    top = 0.05 * np.sin(xs * 2.3 + 0.7) + 0.03 * np.sin(xs * 5.1 + 2.0)      # wavy cloud edge (m)
    verts, faces = [], []
    for i, x in enumerate(xs):
        verts.append((float(x), float(top[i]), 0.0))
        verts.append((float(x), -7.0, 0.0))
    for i in range(n - 1):
        a0, b0, a1, b1 = 2 * i, 2 * i + 1, 2 * i + 2, 2 * i + 3
        faces.append((a0, b0, b1, a1))
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("SunCloud")
    me.from_pydata(verts, [], faces)
    o = bpy.data.objects.new("SunCloud", me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(o)
    C.assign(o, C.mat("SunCloud_mat", (0, 0, 0), rough=1.0))
    for k in ("visible_camera", "visible_diffuse", "visible_glossy", "visible_volume_scatter", "visible_transmission"):
        setattr(o, k, False)
    from mathutils import Matrix
    R = Matrix((side, up, s)).transposed().to_4x4()
    centre = Vector(face) + s * OCC_DIST
    for f, e in ((f0, EDGE[0]), (f1, EDGE[1])):
        o.matrix_world = Matrix.Translation(centre + up * e) @ R
        o.keyframe_insert("location", frame=f)
        o.keyframe_insert("rotation_euler", frame=f)
    sun.data.angle = math.radians(OCC_SUN_ANGLE)
    return o


def build(ctx):
    N, NR = ctx.nframes, ctx.render_frames
    S = E.sky("sunrise", sun_az=SUN_AZ, ctx=ctx, sun_el=SUN_EL, sun_energy=SUN_E, clouds=0.45,
              strength=SKYLIGHT,
              cloud_opts=dict(color=(1.0, 0.86, 0.74), shadow=(0.42, 0.36, 0.42), opacity=0.8, sun_glow=1.6,
                              speed=(5.0, 1.5)))
    sun = S["sun"]
    sun.data.color = SUN_RGB
    sun_dir = Vector(S["sun_dir"])

    j = P.make_person("jesus", "JESUS_RISEN", pose=None)
    P.pose(j, "stand", head="level")
    _lean(j)
    base = j._pose.copy()
    j.update()

    # narration: "he has not hidden his face from him" 0.28-2.50 s, "but has listened to his cry for help." 2.80-5.04 s
    ph = ctx.phrases if ctx.phrases else [dict(start=0.28, end=2.5), dict(start=2.8, end=5.04)]
    fr = lambda sec: ctx.frame(sec)
    f_wash0, f_wash1 = fr(ph[0]["start"] + 0.55), fr(ph[0]["end"] - 0.15)          # light sweeps over the face
    f_open0, f_open1 = fr(ph[0]["start"] + 1.35), fr(ph[0]["start"] + 1.85)        # eyes open on "his face"
    f_lift0, f_lift1 = fr(ph[0]["end"] - 0.3), fr(ph[1]["start"] + 1.6)
    f_smile0, f_smile1 = fr(ph[1]["start"] + 0.5), fr(ph[1]["end"] + 0.2)

    def body_fn(f):
        lift = _ease(f_lift0, f_lift1, f)
        breath = 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(2 * math.pi * (f - 1) / 92.0)       # calm, ~3.8 s
        nz = C.shake(f, 1.0, 0.35, 11)
        return dict(pitch=9.0 - 21.0 * lift - 2.0 * _ease(f_lift1, NR, f) + 0.5 * nz.x - 0.5 * breath,
                    tilt=2.0 - 4.0 * lift + 0.4 * nz.y, turn=-2.0 - 12.0 * lift + 0.5 * nz.z, breath=breath)
    _key_body(j, base, list(range(1, NR + 1, 2)) + ([NR] if NR % 2 == 0 else []), body_fn)

    rest = {"eye-closure": 1.0, "eyebrows-inner-up": 0.15, "mouth-corner-puller": 0.12, "mouth-compression": 0.3}
    awake = {"eye-closure": 0.06, "eyebrows-up": 0.12, "eyebrows-inner-up": 0.15, "eye-opened-up": 0.08,
             "mouth-corner-puller": 0.18, "mouth-compression": 0.3}
    smile = {"eye-closure": 0.04, "eye-slit": 0.1, "eyebrows-up": 0.08, "eyebrows-inner-up": 0.1, "eye-opened-up": 0.06,
             "mouth-corner-puller": 0.42, "mouth-elevation": 0.06, "mouth-compression": 0.25}
    keys = [(1, rest, 1.0), (int(f_open0), rest, 1.0), (int(f_open1), awake, 1.0), (int(f_smile0), awake, 1.0),
            (int(f_smile1), smile, 1.0), (NR, smile, 1.0)]
    _expr_keys(j, keys)
    # a soft blink later on (alive)
    fb = int(f_smile1 + 14) | 1
    if fb + 4 < NR:
        for f, v in ((fb - 3, smile["eye-closure"]), (fb, 1.0), (fb + 4, smile["eye-closure"])):
            P.eyes_closed(j, v, frame=f)

    sc = bpy.context.scene
    for f in sorted(set([1, int(f_open0)] + list(range(int(f_open0), int(f_lift1) + 4, 4)) + [NR])):
        sc.frame_set(f)
        e = j.eye_pos()
        u = _ease(f_open0, f_lift1, f)
        tgt_rest = e + Vector((-0.6, -3.0, -0.6))
        tgt_up = e + Vector((-1.0, -3.0, 1.3))                          # towards the light, up
        P.eyes_look(j, tgt_rest.lerp(tgt_up, u), frame=f, up_limit=7.0)
    sc.frame_set(1)
    e_start = j.eye_pos()
    sc.frame_set(int(f_lift1))
    e_end = j.eye_pos()
    sc.frame_set(1)
    face_c = (e_start + e_end) * 0.5

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ light
    occ = _occluder(face_c, sun_dir, f_wash0, f_wash1, sun)
    for f, k in ((1, 0.55), (int(f_wash0), 0.7), (int(f_wash1), 1.0)):     # cloud thinning
        sun.data.energy = SUN_E * k
        sun.data.keyframe_insert("energy", frame=f)
    L = LIGHTS
    # cool morning sky on the shadow side (camera side), soft
    fill = C.light("SPOT", face_c + Vector((1.5, -1.2, 0.5)), L["fill"], color=(0.6, 0.72, 1.0),
                   target=face_c + Vector((0, 0, 0.06)), size=0.8, spot_size=30, spot_blend=1.0, name="FillSky",
                   shadow=False)
    # bright sky behind his left shoulder: separates hair and cheek from the background
    rim = C.light("AREA", face_c + Vector((1.0, 1.0, 0.7)), L["rim"], color=(0.85, 0.82, 1.0), target=face_c,
                  size=1.0, name="RimSky", shadow=False)
    bounce = C.light("AREA", face_c + Vector((-0.6, -1.0, -1.3)), L["bounce"], color=(1.0, 0.75, 0.55),
                     target=face_c, size=1.5, name="Bounce", shadow=False)
    for f, k in ((1, 0.35), (int(f_wash0), 0.45), (int(f_wash1), 1.0)):     # ground bounce follows the sun
        bounce.data.energy = L["bounce"] * k
        bounce.data.keyframe_insert("energy", frame=f)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ camera
    cam_dir = Vector((-math.sin(math.radians(CAM_AZ)), -math.cos(math.radians(CAM_AZ)), 0.0))
    cam_dir = (cam_dir * math.cos(math.radians(CAM_EL)) + Vector((0, 0, math.sin(math.radians(CAM_EL))))).normalized()
    focus = bpy.data.objects.new("FocusEye", None)
    sc.collection.objects.link(focus)
    focus.parent = j.rig
    focus.parent_type = "BONE"
    focus.parent_bone = "eye.L" if CAM_AZ < 0 else "eye.R"       # the near eye
    cam = C.camera(loc=e_start + cam_dir * D0, target=e_start, lens=LENS0, fstop=FSTOP, focus=focus)

    def path(f):
        u = C.ease_in_out(min(1.0, (f - 1) / float(NR - 1)))
        k = _ease(f_lift0 - 6, f_lift1 + 10, f)
        eye = e_start.lerp(e_end, k)
        d = D0 + (D1 - D0) * u
        loc = eye + cam_dir * d + C.shake(f, 0.003, 0.3, 5)
        return (loc, eye + Vector((0, 0, AIM_DZ)), 0.0, LENS0 + (LENS1 - LENS0) * u)
    C.animate_camera(cam, path, 1, NR)

    LAST.update(j=j, cam=cam, sun=sun, occ=occ, fill=fill, rim=rim, bounce=bounce, e_start=e_start, e_end=e_end)

    ctx.samples = 5
    ctx.render_opts.update({"volumetrics": "low"})
    ctx.interp = True
    ctx.post.update({"grade": "dawn", "bloom": 0.3, "vignette": 0.2,
                     "end": {"grade": ["dawn", "glory"], "bloom": 0.38, "vignette": 0.18}})

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/shots/s18a.py =====
"""s18a - Ends of the earth: "All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord, and all the
families of the nations will bow down before him,"

Earth from orbit at night. The camera hangs ~3000 km above West Africa looking east along the dark
globe: city lights of the Maghreb, the Nile and the Levant, the curved limb with its thin blue/orange
atmosphere. On "remember" the glow on the eastern limb swells and the sun bursts over the horizon
above the Persian Gulf (sunburst via the Blender compositor glare). On "turn to the Lord" morning light
pours west over Iran, Arabia, the Levant and Egypt; through "all the families of the nations" the camera
rises and pulls back, the terminator sweeps on across Africa and Europe and the shot ends on a bright,
sunlit Middle East / Africa / Europe (dissolve to s18b, kneeling nations at dawn).

Built on lib/fx.earth_from_space (globe, clouds, night lights, atmosphere, stars). This file adds:
 * its own terminator sweep (re-keys the lib's `sun_lon` nodes + sun lamp; slow approach, crest at a
   chosen frame, accelerating sweep afterwards),
 * a visible sun disc + corona in the world shader (camera rays only),
 * a forward-scattering limb-glow shell (the bright halo where the sun is about to rise),
 * its own camera (quaternion keys every frame) aimed at the sunrise point, then at the globe,
 * compositor fog-glow + streak glare driven by the sun disc only.
"""
import math
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix, Quaternion
from lib import core as C
from lib import fx as FX

R = 6.371
FOCUS = (35.0, 30.0)        # globe root orientation (lib convention: this lon/lat faces -Y)
DECL = -8.0                 # sub-solar latitude: puts the sunrise point over the Persian Gulf for this camera
LENS = 32.0
CREST_SEC = 3.15            # sun clears the limb (end of "remember")
# terminator sweep speed (deg of longitude per frame): slow approach -> fast sweep -> ease out
RATE = dict(r0=0.12, r1=0.42, r2=0.25, ra=80, rb=115, rc=185, rd=235)
# camera: distance (radii) and sub-camera point (lon, lat) start -> end
CAM = dict(d0=1.45, d1=2.7, da=90, lon0=-8.0, lat0=28.0, lon1=22.0, lat1=22.0,
           qx=0.56, qy=0.32,                 # where the sunrise point sits in frame (0..1, y down)
           end_lon=22.0, end_lat=22.0, end_off=0.0,    # late aim: point inside the globe
           wa=95, roll0=-7.0, roll1=0.0)
NIGHT_CROP = ("/opt/assets/earth/dnb_2012_crop_w40e90_s20n66.jpg", (-40.0, 90.0, -20.0, 66.0))  # 13500-px Black Marble crop


def _ease(x):
    x = min(1.0, max(0.0, x))
    return 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(math.pi * x)


def _sharper_night(m):
    """Overlay a 13500-px Black Marble crop (Europe / Africa / Middle East) on the lib's 3600-px night
    map: the close orbital view at the start resolves single cities. Falls back silently if missing."""
    import os
    path, (lo0, lo1, la0, la1) = NIGHT_CROP
    nt = m.node_tree
    night = next((n for n in nt.nodes if n.type == "TEX_IMAGE" and n.image and "dnb" in n.image.name), None)
    if night is None or not os.path.exists(path):
        print("s18a: night crop not used")
        return
    nb = FX.NB(nt)
    uv = night.inputs["Vector"].links[0].from_socket
    # global equirect uv -> crop uv
    cuv = nb.v("MULTIPLY_ADD", uv, (360.0 / (lo1 - lo0), 180.0 / (la1 - la0), 1.0),
               (-(180.0 + lo0) / (lo1 - lo0), -(90.0 + la0) / (la1 - la0), 0.0))
    crop = FX._img(nb, path, cuv, ext="CLIP")
    sx = nb.sep(cuv)
    inside = nb.mul(nb.mul(nb.smooth(nb.out(sx, "X"), 0.0, 0.04), nb.sub(1.0, nb.smooth(nb.out(sx, "X"), 0.96, 1.0))),
                    nb.mul(nb.smooth(nb.out(sx, "Y"), 0.0, 0.05), nb.sub(1.0, nb.smooth(nb.out(sx, "Y"), 0.95, 1.0))))
    links = [l for l in nt.links if l.from_socket == night.outputs["Color"]]
    mixed = nb.mixc(inside, nb.out(night, "Color"), nb.out(crop, "Color"))
    for l in links:
        to = l.to_socket
        nt.links.remove(l)
        nt.links.new(mixed, to)


def build(ctx):
    N = ctx.render_frames
    nf = ctx.nframes
    fc = int(round(ctx.frame(CREST_SEC)))

    e = FX.earth_from_space(ctx, focus=FOCUS, declination=DECL, camera=False, stars=1.0,
                            night_strength=4.5, sun_energy=4.5, cloud_spin=0.8)
    Rg = (Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(FOCUS[1]), 3, "X") @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(-90 - FOCUS[0]), 3, "Z"))

    def geo(lon, lat, r=1.0):
        lo, la = math.radians(lon), math.radians(lat)
        return Rg @ Vector((math.cos(la) * math.cos(lo), math.cos(la) * math.sin(lo), math.sin(la))) * r

    cd, sd = math.cos(math.radians(DECL)), math.sin(math.radians(DECL))
    _sharper_night(e.globe.active_material)
    # faint moonlight so the night hemisphere has shape (clouds / coasts barely readable)
    moon = C.sun(elevation=0, azimuth=0, energy=0.12, color=(0.5, 0.62, 1.0), angle=0.5)
    moon.data.use_shadow = False
    moon.rotation_euler = (-geo(-40.0, 42.0)).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ terminator sweep (own timing)
    def rate(f):
        r = RATE["r0"] + (RATE["r1"] - RATE["r0"]) * _ease((f - RATE["ra"]) / (RATE["rb"] - RATE["ra"]))
        return r + (RATE["r2"] - RATE["r1"]) * _ease((f - RATE["rc"]) / (RATE["rd"] - RATE["rc"]))
    cum = [0.0]
    for f in range(2, N + 1):
        cum.append(cum[-1] + 0.5 * (rate(f - 1) + rate(f)))

    def cam_pos(f):
        u = (f - 1) / (nf - 1)
        d = CAM["d0"] + (CAM["d1"] - CAM["d0"]) * _ease((f - CAM["da"]) / (nf - CAM["da"]))
        k = _ease(u)
        return geo(CAM["lon0"] + (CAM["lon1"] - CAM["lon0"]) * k, CAM["lat0"] + (CAM["lat1"] - CAM["lat0"]) * k, d * R)

    def sun_dir(f, L0):
        a = math.radians(L0 - cum[min(f, N) - 1] + 90.0)
        return Rg @ Vector((math.cos(a) * cd, math.sin(a) * cd, sd))

    def above_limb(f, L0):
        P = cam_pos(f)
        S = sun_dir(f, L0)
        return math.acos(max(-1, min(1, S.dot(-P.normalized())))) - math.asin(R / P.length)

    # sunrise longitude at frame 1 such that the sun clears the limb exactly at frame fc
    grid = [x * 0.5 for x in range(-120, 400)]
    lo = hi = None
    prev = above_limb(fc, grid[0])
    for x0, x1 in zip(grid, grid[1:]):
        v1 = above_limb(fc, x1)
        if prev > 0 and v1 <= 0:
            lo, hi = x0, x1
            break
        prev = v1
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if above_limb(fc, mid) > 0:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    L0 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    print("s18a: sunrise lon %.1f -> %.1f, crest frame %d" % (L0, L0 - cum[-1], fc))

    mats = [e.globe.active_material, e.atmosphere.active_material]
    for f in range(1, N + 1):
        a = math.radians(L0 - cum[f - 1] + 90.0)
        for m in mats:
            s = m.node_tree.nodes["sun_lon"].outputs[0]
            s.default_value = a
            s.keyframe_insert("default_value", frame=f)
        Lw = Rg @ Vector((math.cos(a) * cd, math.sin(a) * cd, sd))
        e.sun.rotation_euler = (-Lw).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
        e.sun.keyframe_insert("rotation_euler", frame=f)
    for m in mats:
        FX._set_fcurves_linear(m.node_tree, "sun_lon", extrapolate=False)
    C._set_interp(e.sun, "rotation_euler", "LINEAR")
    e.sun_lon = lambda f: math.radians(L0 - cum[max(1, min(N, int(f))) - 1] + 90.0)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ sun disc + corona in the world
    wnt = bpy.context.scene.world.node_tree
    nb = FX.NB(wnt)
    bg = next(n for n in wnt.nodes if n.type == "BACKGROUND")
    star_col = bg.inputs["Color"].links[0].from_socket
    sdir = nb.n("ShaderNodeCombineXYZ")
    sdir.name = sdir.label = "sun_dir"
    starfade = nb.n("ShaderNodeValue")
    starfade.name = starfade.label = "star_fade"
    vdir = nb.v("SCALE", nb.v("NORMALIZE", nb.out(nb.n("ShaderNodeNewGeometry"), "Incoming")), scale=-1.0)
    mu = nb.v("DOT_PRODUCT", vdir, nb.out(sdir))
    rad = math.radians(0.42)                          # disc radius (a touch larger than life)
    disc = nb.smooth(mu, math.cos(rad * 1.25), math.cos(rad * 0.8))
    mu0 = nb.m("MAXIMUM", mu, 0.0)
    corona = nb.add(nb.mul(nb.m("POWER", mu0, 9000.0), 30.0), nb.mul(nb.m("POWER", mu0, 600.0), 1.6))
    sun_rgb = nb.v("ADD", nb.v("SCALE", (1.0, 0.93, 0.82), scale=nb.mul(disc, 400.0)),
                   nb.v("SCALE", (1.0, 0.8, 0.55), scale=corona))
    cam_only = nb.out(nb.n("ShaderNodeLightPath"), "Is Camera Ray")
    sun_gain = nb.n("ShaderNodeValue")
    sun_gain.name = sun_gain.label = "sun_gain"
    sun_rgb = nb.v("SCALE", sun_rgb, scale=nb.out(sun_gain))
    col = nb.v("ADD", nb.v("SCALE", star_col, scale=nb.out(starfade)), nb.v("SCALE", sun_rgb, scale=cam_only))
    nb.links.new(col, bg.inputs["Color"])

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ forward-scatter limb glow shell
    Rs = R * 1.045
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=128, ring_count=64, radius=Rs)
    halo = bpy.context.active_object
    halo.name = "Earth_halo"
    halo.data.shade_smooth()
    FX._parent(halo, e.root)
    hm, hb, hout = FX._new_mat("s18a_halo")
    geom = hb.n("ShaderNodeNewGeometry")
    inc = hb.out(geom, "Incoming")
    cosn = hb.m("ABSOLUTE", hb.v("DOT_PRODUCT", hb.out(geom, "Normal"), inc))
    b = hb.m("SQRT", hb.m("MAXIMUM", hb.sub(1.0, hb.mul(cosn, cosn)), 0.0))
    k = R / Rs
    h = hb.div(hb.sub(b, k), 1.0 - k)                 # 0 at the solid limb, 1 at the shell edge, < 0 over the disc
    prof = hb.mul(hb.m("EXPONENT", hb.mul(hb.m("MAXIMUM", h, 0.0), -6.0)), hb.smooth(h, -0.06, 0.0))
    prof = hb.mul(prof, hb.sub(1.0, hb.smooth(h, 0.8, 1.0)))
    hsd = hb.n("ShaderNodeCombineXYZ")
    hsd.name = hsd.label = "sun_dir"
    hmu = hb.v("DOT_PRODUCT", hb.v("SCALE", hb.v("NORMALIZE", inc), scale=-1.0), hb.out(hsd))
    hmu0 = hb.m("MAXIMUM", hmu, 0.0)
    phase = hb.add(hb.add(hb.mul(hb.m("POWER", hmu0, 7.0), 0.9), hb.mul(hb.m("POWER", hmu0, 60.0), 5.0)),
                   hb.mul(hb.m("POWER", hmu0, 900.0), 40.0))
    # only atmosphere that the sun actually reaches (shell point near / past the terminator)
    lit = hb.smooth(hb.v("DOT_PRODUCT", hb.out(geom, "Normal"), hb.out(hsd)), -0.42, 0.05)
    warm = hb.mixc(hb.smooth(h, 0.0, 0.35), (1.0, 0.42, 0.13), (1.0, 0.78, 0.5))
    warm = hb.mixc(hb.m("POWER", hmu0, 400.0), warm, (1.0, 0.92, 0.8))
    glow = hb.v("SCALE", warm, scale=hb.mul(hb.mul(prof, phase), lit))
    # thin green-blue airglow line around the whole limb (defines the night limb against space)
    ag = hb.mul(hb.sub(1.0, hb.smooth(hb.m("ABSOLUTE", hb.sub(h, 0.22)), 0.0, 0.1)), hb.smooth(h, 0.0, 0.05))
    glow = hb.v("ADD", glow, hb.v("SCALE", (0.16, 0.42, 0.3), scale=hb.mul(ag, 0.22)))
    em = hb.n("ShaderNodeEmission", {"Color": glow, "Strength": 1.0})
    tr = hb.n("ShaderNodeBsdfTransparent")
    hb.links.new(hb.out(hb.n("ShaderNodeAddShader", {0: em, 1: tr})), hout.inputs["Surface"])
    FX._blended(hm, backface=False)
    C.assign(halo, hm)
    FX._no_shadow(halo)

    # key the world-space sun direction (world + halo) and the star fade
    for f in range(1, N + 1):
        S = sun_dir(f, L0)
        for node in (sdir, hsd):
            for i, c in enumerate(S):
                node.inputs[i].default_value = c
                node.inputs[i].keyframe_insert("default_value", frame=f)
        # stars fade as the sun clears the limb (eye / exposure adaptation)
        starfade.outputs[0].default_value = 1.0 - 0.85 * C.smoothstep((f - (fc - 30)) / 45.0)
        starfade.outputs[0].keyframe_insert("default_value", frame=f)
    for tree in (wnt, hm.node_tree):
        FX._set_fcurves_linear(tree, "sun_dir", extrapolate=False)
    FX._set_fcurves_linear(wnt, "star_fade", extrapolate=False)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ camera
    Pc = cam_pos(fc)
    Sc = sun_dir(fc, L0)
    c_ = Pc.normalized()
    t_ = (Sc - Sc.dot(c_) * c_).normalized()
    g_ = math.acos(R / Pc.length)
    Q = (math.cos(g_) * c_ + math.sin(g_) * t_) * R          # sunrise point on the limb at the crest
    north = Rg @ Vector((0, 0, 1))
    fy = LENS / 18.0
    ax = math.atan((CAM["qx"] - 0.5) * 2 * (9 / 16) / fy)
    ay = math.atan((0.5 - CAM["qy"]) * 2 / fy)

    def aim(P, target, up):
        fwd = (target - P).normalized()
        x = fwd.cross(up).normalized()
        y = x.cross(fwd)
        f2 = Quaternion(y, ax) @ fwd
        f2 = Quaternion(f2.cross(up).normalized(), -ay) @ f2
        return f2.normalized()

    cam = C.camera((0, -R * 3, 0), (0, 0, 0), lens=LENS, clip_end=R * 40)
    cam.data.clip_start = R * 0.01
    cam.rotation_mode = "QUATERNION"
    prevq = None
    for f in range(1, N + 1):
        P = cam_pos(f)
        upr = P.normalized()
        w = _ease((f - CAM["wa"]) / (nf - CAM["wa"]))
        F1 = aim(P, Q, upr)
        F2 = (geo(CAM["end_lon"], CAM["end_lat"], R * CAM["end_off"]) - P).normalized()
        F = (F1 * (1 - w) + F2 * w).normalized()
        up = (upr * (1 - w) + north * w).normalized()
        x = F.cross(up).normalized()
        y = x.cross(F)
        m = Matrix((x, y, -F)).transposed()
        q = m.to_quaternion()
        roll = CAM["roll0"] + (CAM["roll1"] - CAM["roll0"]) * w
        q = q @ Quaternion((0, 0, 1), math.radians(roll))
        if prevq is not None and q.dot(prevq) < 0:
            q.negate()
        prevq = q.copy()
        cam.location = P
        cam.rotation_quaternion = q
        cam.keyframe_insert("location", frame=f)
        cam.keyframe_insert("rotation_quaternion", frame=f)
    C._set_interp(cam, "location", "LINEAR")
    C._set_interp(cam, "rotation_quaternion", "LINEAR")

    # the compositor glare only sees in-frame pixels: fade the sun disc as it nears the frame edge so
    # the starburst dies away smoothly instead of popping off when the disc leaves the frame
    gsock = sun_gain.outputs[0]
    for f in range(1, N + 1):
        bpy.context.scene.frame_set(f)
        v = cam.matrix_world.to_3x3().inverted() @ sun_dir(f, L0)
        g = 0.0
        if v.z < 0:
            xi = 0.5 + (v.x / -v.z) * fy / (2 * 9 / 16)
            yi = 0.5 - (v.y / -v.z) * fy / 2
            margin = min(xi, 1 - xi, yi, 1 - yi)
            g = 0.05 + 0.95 * C.smoothstep((margin + 0.01) / 0.24)
        gsock.default_value = g
        gsock.keyframe_insert("default_value", frame=f)
    bpy.context.scene.frame_set(1)
    FX._set_fcurves_linear(wnt, "sun_gain", extrapolate=False)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ compositor glare (sun only)
    sc = bpy.context.scene
    sc.use_nodes = True
    ct = sc.node_tree
    for n in list(ct.nodes):
        ct.nodes.remove(n)
    rl = ct.nodes.new("CompositorNodeRLayers")
    fog = ct.nodes.new("CompositorNodeGlare")
    fog.glare_type = "BLOOM"
    fog.quality = "MEDIUM"
    fog.inputs["Threshold"].default_value = 8.0
    fog.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.5
    fog.inputs["Size"].default_value = 0.8
    st = ct.nodes.new("CompositorNodeGlare")
    st.glare_type = "STREAKS"
    st.quality = "MEDIUM"
    st.inputs["Threshold"].default_value = 60.0
    st.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.16
    st.inputs["Streaks"].default_value = 8
    st.inputs["Streaks Angle"].default_value = math.radians(14)
    st.inputs["Fade"].default_value = 0.86
    out = ct.nodes.new("CompositorNodeComposite")
    ct.links.new(rl.outputs["Image"], fog.inputs["Image"])
    ct.links.new(fog.outputs["Image"], st.inputs["Image"])
    ct.links.new(st.outputs["Image"], out.inputs["Image"])
    sc.render.use_compositing = True

    ctx.samples = 6
    ctx.interp = True      # slow, coherent motion; RIFE validated on the sunburst (32 dB @3spp, warp_err < 3.6)
    ctx.render_opts.update({"volumetrics": "low"})
    ctx.post.update({"grade": "space", "bloom": 0.35, "bloom_threshold": 0.62, "halation": 0.1,
                     "vignette": 0.12, "caption": {"halo": 1.15},
                     "end": {"exposure": 0.12, "temperature": 0.12}})

===== FILE: psalm22/blender/shots/s20a.py =====
"""s20a - "Posterity will serve him; future generations will be told about the Lord."

Night by a small campfire (sets.camp_night). A grandfather (ELDER) sits on a low boulder with an open
Psalm scroll across his lap, his right hand resting on it; in his left hand a lit clay oil lamp (fx.flame)
lights his beard and the scroll. A young boy (CHILD) sits on a stone at his side, turned towards him,
listening in awe. On "future generations will be told" the old man reaches the lamp across; the boy
cups both hands under it, takes it and draws it to his chest - the little flame now lights HIS face -
while the old man withdraws his hand to his knee and watches him with a quiet smile.
Fire in the left foreground (soft, out of focus), sparks rising, dark hills and stars behind, cool moon
rim from behind.

Lamp hand-off: the lamp carries two Child Of constraints (grandfather's wrist.L / boy's wrist.R) whose
inverse matrices are computed from the keyed pose states at the hand-off frame, then switched with
CONSTANT influence keys at that frame - so it sits in each hand exactly and never jumps.
Fire + sparks + flame flicker -> 24 fps (no interp).
"""
import math
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
from lib import core as C, sets as S, fx as FX, assets as A
from lib import characters as P

ARM_KEYS = ("clavicle", "shoulder", "upperarm", "lowerarm", "wrist", "finger", "metacarpal")


def _yaw_to(d):
    return math.atan2(d[0], -d[1])


def _find(sub):
    for o in bpy.data.objects:
        if sub in o.name:
            return o
    return None


def _ground_z(gnd, x, y):
    """Height of the camp ground mesh at (x, y) (object ray cast)."""
    if gnd is None:
        return 0.0
    mi = gnd.matrix_world.inverted()
    o = mi @ Vector((x, y, 5.0))
    d = (mi.to_3x3() @ Vector((0, 0, -1))).normalized()
    hit, loc, n, i = gnd.ray_cast(o, d)
    return (gnd.matrix_world @ loc).z if hit else 0.0


def _bones_for(St):
    return [n for n in St.names if n.startswith(ARM_KEYS)] + list(P.SPINE)


def _reset_fingers(St, s):
    for i in range(1, 6):
        for j in range(1, 4):
            n = "finger%d-%d.%s" % (i, j, s)
            if n in St.rot:
                St.rot[n] = Matrix.Identity(3)
    St._c.clear()


def arm_state(p, base, hands, lean=0.0, twist=0.0):
    """Copy of the static (seated) pose with arms IK'd to world targets.
    hands: {side: dict(T=world point (palm centre), pole=rig-space elbow dir, pron, flex, shape)}"""
    St = base.copy()
    if lean or twist:
        P._spine_bend(St, bend=lean, twist=twist)
    for s, h in hands.items():
        T = P._to_rig_space(p, h["T"])
        lat = 1.0 if s == "L" else -1.0
        pole = Vector(h.get("pole", (0.6 * lat, 0.3, -1.0)))
        _reset_fingers(St, s)
        P._arm_ik(St, s, T, pole, pron=h.get("pron", 0.0), flex=h.get("flex", 0.0), dev=h.get("dev", 0.0))
        P._hand(St, s, h.get("shape", "relaxed"))
    return St


def key_state(p, St, frames):
    names = _bones_for(St)
    for f in frames:
        St.write(frame=f, bones=names)


def bone_world(p, St, bone):
    return p.rig.matrix_world @ St.pm(bone)


def seat_under(p, seat, gz, back=0.03):
    """Fit a set boulder under a seated person's buttocks (top = lowest skinned point near the hips)."""
    import numpy as np
    p.update()
    mw = p.rig.matrix_world
    pts = P.lbs_points(p)
    W = np.array([tuple(mw @ Vector(q)) for q in pts[::2]])
    hip = (p.bone_world("upperleg01.L") + p.bone_world("upperleg01.R")) * 0.5
    d = np.hypot(W[:, 0] - hip.x, W[:, 1] - hip.y)
    m = (d < 0.13) & (W[:, 2] < hip.z)
    top = float(W[m, 2].min()) if m.any() else hip.z - 0.08
    if seat is None:
        return top
    seat.location.z = gz - 0.03
    bb = [seat.matrix_world.to_3x3() @ Vector(c) for c in seat.bound_box]
    hz = max(v.z for v in bb) - min(v.z for v in bb)
    seat.scale.z *= (top + 0.004 - (gz - 0.03)) / max(hz, 1e-3)
    fwd = (mw.to_3x3() @ Vector((0, -1, 0)))
    seat.location.x = hip.x - fwd.x * back
    seat.location.y = hip.y - fwd.y * back
    return top


def build(ctx):
    N = ctx.render_frames
    nf = ctx.nframes
    st = S.camp_night(ctx, fire_size=0.6, fire_energy=0.62, seed=41)
    gnd = _find("camp_ground")

    # ---------------- layout (fire at the origin, camera from -Y) ----------------
    g_pos = Vector((0.0, 0.95))
    c_pos = Vector((0.68, 0.64))
    g_fwd = Vector((0.5, -0.866))                   # grandfather turned towards camera-right (the boy)
    c_fwd = Vector((-0.5, -0.85)).normalized()     # boy turned towards him
    gz_g = _ground_z(gnd, g_pos.x, g_pos.y - 0.4)
    gz_c = _ground_z(gnd, c_pos.x - 0.15, c_pos.y - 0.25)

    # ---------------- people ----------------
    G = P.make_person("elder", "ELDER", pose=None, expression=None)
    G.rig.location = (g_pos.x, g_pos.y, gz_g)
    G.rig.rotation_euler.z = _yaw_to(g_fwd)
    Ch = P.make_person("child", "CHILD", pose=None, expression=None)
    Ch.rig.location = (c_pos.x, c_pos.y, gz_c)
    Ch.rig.rotation_euler.z = _yaw_to(c_fwd)
    for p, gz in ((G, gz_g), (Ch, gz_c)):
        p.update()
        P.pose(p, "sit", ground_z=gz)
    gs = _find("grandfather_seat")
    if gs is not None:
        gs.scale.x *= 0.72
        gs.scale.y *= 0.75
    seat_under(G, gs, gz_g)
    seat_under(Ch, _find("child_seat"), gz_c)
    baseG = G._pose.copy()
    baseC = Ch._pose.copy()

    gy = G.rig.rotation_euler.z
    g_left = Vector((math.cos(gy), math.sin(gy), 0.0))      # grandfather's left (character +X rotated by his yaw)
    g_f3 = Vector((g_fwd.x, g_fwd.y, 0.0))

    # ---------------- scroll across the grandfather's lap ----------------
    hipG = (G.bone_world("upperleg01.L") + G.bone_world("upperleg01.R")) * 0.5
    kneeG = (G.bone_world("lowerleg01.L") + G.bone_world("lowerleg01.R")) * 0.5
    lap = hipG.lerp(kneeG, 0.55)
    lap.z = max(hipG.z, kneeG.z) + 0.075
    scroll = A.load("scroll", open_width=0.2)
    sc_s = 0.78
    ez = g_f3.normalized()
    ey = Vector((0, 0, -1))
    ex = ey.cross(ez)
    R = Matrix((ex, ey, ez)).transposed()
    scroll.matrix_world = Matrix.Translation(lap - R @ Vector((0, 0, 0.26 * sc_s)) + Vector((0, 0, 0.02))) \
        @ R.to_4x4() @ Matrix.Scale(sc_s, 4)
    scroll_right = lap + (-g_left) * 0.13 + Vector((0, 0, 0.03))     # his right roller

    # ---------------- lamp positions ----------------
    lamp_hold = Vector((g_pos.x, g_pos.y, 0)) + g_f3 * 0.27 + g_left * 0.07
    lamp_hold.z = gz_g + 0.80
    lamp_hand = Vector((0.36, 0.66, gz_g + 0.74))                   # the hand-off point
    lamp_child = Vector((c_pos.x, c_pos.y, 0)) + Vector((c_fwd.x, c_fwd.y, 0)) * 0.24 + Vector((-0.04, 0.02, 0))
    lamp_child.z = gz_c + 0.60
    kneeGL = G.bone_world("lowerleg01.L")
    kneeGR = G.bone_world("lowerleg01.R")

    # timing (24 fps): phrase 2 "future generations will be told..." starts ~ f67
    p2 = ctx.phrase_frames(1)[0] if len(ctx.phrases) > 1 else 67
    f_ext0, f_ext1 = int(p2 - 4), int(p2 + 24)              # grandfather reaches out
    f_c0, f_c1 = int(p2 + 8), int(p2 + 29)                  # boy's hands come up
    H = int(p2 + 33)                                        # hand-off (parent switch)
    f_w0, f_w1 = H + 4, H + 28                              # grandfather withdraws
    f_d0, f_d1 = H + 6, H + 34                              # boy draws the lamp to his chest

    # grandfather: right hand on the scroll throughout, left hand holds/extends/withdraws
    up = Vector((0, 0, 1))
    right_on_scroll = dict(T=scroll_right, pron=95, flex=8, shape="relaxed", pole=(-0.7, 0.4, -1.0))
    hold = dict(T=lamp_hold - up * 0.018, pron=-5, flex=-8, shape="cup", pole=(0.7, 0.35, -1.0))
    reach = dict(T=lamp_hand - up * 0.018, pron=-8, flex=-12, shape="cup", pole=(0.8, 0.2, -0.8))
    rest = dict(T=kneeGL + Vector((0, 0, 0.06)) + g_f3 * 0.02, pron=95, flex=5, shape="relaxed", pole=(0.7, 0.5, -1.0))
    GA = arm_state(G, baseG, {"L": hold, "R": right_on_scroll})
    GB = arm_state(G, baseG, {"L": reach, "R": right_on_scroll}, lean=7)
    GCs = arm_state(G, baseG, {"L": rest, "R": right_on_scroll}, lean=2)
    key_state(G, GA, [1, f_ext0])
    key_state(G, GB, [f_ext1, f_w0])
    key_state(G, GCs, [f_w1, N])

    # boy: hands on knees -> cupped under the lamp -> lamp at his chest
    kL, kR = Ch.bone_world("lowerleg01.L"), Ch.bone_world("lowerleg01.R")
    c_left = Vector((math.cos(Ch.rig.rotation_euler.z), math.sin(Ch.rig.rotation_euler.z), 0))
    knees = {"L": dict(T=kL + Vector((0, 0, 0.04)), pron=95, shape="relaxed", pole=(0.8, 0.5, -1.0)),
             "R": dict(T=kR + Vector((0, 0, 0.04)), pron=95, shape="relaxed", pole=(-0.8, 0.5, -1.0))}
    under = {"R": dict(T=lamp_hand - up * 0.03 - c_left * 0.035, pron=5, flex=-6, shape="cup", pole=(-0.7, 0.3, -1.0)),
             "L": dict(T=lamp_hand - up * 0.035 + c_left * 0.04 + Vector((0, 0, 0)), pron=5, flex=-6, shape="cup",
                       pole=(0.7, 0.3, -1.0))}
    chest = {"R": dict(T=lamp_child - up * 0.03 - c_left * 0.035, pron=5, flex=-8, shape="cup", pole=(-0.6, 0.4, -1.0)),
             "L": dict(T=lamp_child - up * 0.035 + c_left * 0.04, pron=5, flex=-8, shape="cup", pole=(0.6, 0.4, -1.0))}
    CA = arm_state(Ch, baseC, knees)
    CB = arm_state(Ch, baseC, under, lean=6)
    CC = arm_state(Ch, baseC, chest, lean=3)
    key_state(Ch, CA, [1, f_c0])
    key_state(Ch, CB, [f_c1, f_d0])
    key_state(Ch, CC, [f_d1, N])

    # ---------------- the lamp (parent switch at H) ----------------
    lamp, lflame, _ = S.oil_lamp(loc=(0, 0, 0), light=False, flicker=0, name="handoff_lamp")
    lflame.hide_render = True
    lflame.hide_viewport = True
    fl = FX.flame(loc=tuple(S.LAMP_TIP + Vector((0.002, 0, -0.002))), size=0.034, flicker=1.0, seed=7,
                  light_energy=9.0, light_radius=0.006, parent=lamp, name="HandoffFlame")
    noz = Vector((-0.35, -1.0, 0)).normalized()             # nozzle (+X local) towards the camera side
