    os.makedirs(os.path.join(work, "comp"), exist_ok=True)
    specimen(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else os.path.join(work, "comp", "caption_specimen.png"))

===== FILE: psalm22/comp/composite.py =====
"""Psalm 22 - compositor: frames -> grade -> transitions -> film look -> upscale -> captions -> video.

Usage (see docs/comp.md):
  python comp/composite.py                         # whole film -> $WORK/comp/mezz.mp4 (10-bit) + final encode
  python comp/composite.py --no-encode             # only the 10-bit mezzanine
  python comp/composite.py --stills 0,1500,6200 --stills-dir /tmp/st   # PNG stills of global frames
  python comp/composite.py --direct out.mp4 --shots s00,s01a            # quick single-pass preview with audio
  python comp/composite.py --frames 0-479 --mezz /tmp/m.mp4 --no-encode

Frame sources per shot: $WORK/frames/<shot>/<quality>/NNNN.png (1-based shot frames, nframes + tail).
Per frame the best quality that has exactly that frame wins (final > draft > preview); missing frames
are interpolated (cross-blend) between the nearest rendered frames of the best-covering quality, so
sparse test renders already play as an animatic.  Shots with no frames get a labelled placeholder card.
Grading hints come from post.json next to the frames (newest one wins) - keys in docs/comp.md.
"""
import argparse, bisect, json, math, os, subprocess, sys, time
import multiprocessing as mp
from collections import OrderedDict

import numpy as np
import cv2
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
WORK = os.environ.get("WORK", "/opt/work/psalm22")
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import captions as CAP  # noqa: E402

cv2.setNumThreads(1)
QUALITIES = ("final", "draft", "preview")
DISSOLVE = 14
FLASH_PRE, FLASH_POST = 3, 10          # frames of white bloom before / after a flash cut
FB_OUT, FB_IN = 6, 9                   # fade_black: frames down / frames up
LUMA = np.array([0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722], np.float32)
_LUMA_M = LUMA.reshape(1, 3)
# BT.709 R'G'B' -> Y', Cb, Cr (unscaled)
_YUV_M = np.array([[0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722],
                   [-0.2126 / 1.8556, -0.7152 / 1.8556, 0.9278 / 1.8556],
                   [0.7874 / 1.5748, -0.7152 / 1.5748, -0.0722 / 1.5748]], np.float32)


def luma(F):
    """Fast BT.709 luma of a float32 RGB image (cv2.transform beats numpy matmul here)."""
    return cv2.transform(F, _LUMA_M)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# grading parameters
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOOK_DEFAULT = {          # gentle global film look (every shot unless post.json overrides)
    "bloom": 0.16, "bloom_threshold": 0.70, "bloom_radius": 1.0,
    "halation": 0.06, "vignette": 0.16, "sharpen": 0.35, "grain": 0.0,
}
GRADE_DEFAULT = {
    "exposure": 0.0, "contrast": 1.0, "pivot": 0.45, "saturation": 1.0,
    "temperature": 0.0, "tint": 0.0, "lift": 0.0, "gamma": 1.0, "gain": 1.0,
    "shadows": 0.0, "highlights": 0.0,
}
PRESETS = {
    "neutral": {},
    "warm": {"temperature": 0.25, "saturation": 1.04, "highlights": [0.02, 0.01, -0.012], "bloom": 0.22},
    "gold": {"temperature": 0.45, "tint": 0.03, "saturation": 1.08, "gain": [1.04, 1.0, 0.9],
             "highlights": [0.03, 0.015, -0.02], "bloom": 0.4, "bloom_threshold": 0.62, "halation": 0.12},
    "cool": {"temperature": -0.3, "saturation": 0.92, "shadows": [-0.01, 0.0, 0.025]},
    "night": {"exposure": -0.25, "temperature": -0.55, "tint": -0.05, "saturation": 0.72, "contrast": 1.06,
              "shadows": [-0.005, 0.005, 0.03], "bloom": 0.25, "bloom_threshold": 0.55},
    "eclipse": {"exposure": -0.15, "temperature": 0.15, "saturation": 0.62, "contrast": 1.12,
                "gain": [1.04, 0.93, 0.86], "shadows": [0.012, 0.0, -0.005], "vignette": 0.3},
    "flashback": {"lift": 0.035, "contrast": 0.92, "saturation": 0.86, "temperature": 0.18,
                  "bloom": 0.38, "bloom_threshold": 0.6, "vignette": 0.26},
    "glory": {"exposure": 0.12, "temperature": 0.3, "saturation": 1.04, "lift": 0.015,
              "bloom": 0.5, "bloom_threshold": 0.58, "halation": 0.14},
    "bleak": {"saturation": 0.6, "temperature": -0.12, "contrast": 1.08, "vignette": 0.24},
    "dawn": {"temperature": 0.2, "tint": 0.05, "saturation": 1.05, "shadows": [0.0, 0.0, 0.02],
             "highlights": [0.03, 0.01, -0.01], "bloom": 0.3},
    "dusk": {"temperature": 0.35, "tint": 0.06, "exposure": -0.1, "shadows": [-0.005, 0.0, 0.02], "bloom": 0.28},
    "candle": {"temperature": 0.55, "saturation": 1.05, "exposure": -0.05, "bloom": 0.35,
               "bloom_threshold": 0.55, "halation": 0.12, "vignette": 0.3},
    "space": {"contrast": 1.1, "saturation": 1.05, "temperature": -0.05, "bloom": 0.3,
              "bloom_threshold": 0.6, "vignette": 0.1},
}
NUM_KEYS = set(LOOK_DEFAULT) | set(GRADE_DEFAULT)


def resolve_post(post):
    """post.json dict -> (params at shot start, params at shot end)."""
    p = dict(GRADE_DEFAULT)
    p.update(LOOK_DEFAULT)
    names = post.get("grade") or []
    if isinstance(names, str):
        names = [names]
    for n in names:
        p.update(PRESETS.get(n, {}))
    for k, v in post.items():
        if k in NUM_KEYS:
            p[k] = v
    p["grain"] = min(float(p.get("grain") or 0), 0.03)
    e = dict(p)
    for k, v in (post.get("end") or {}).items():
        if k in NUM_KEYS:
            e[k] = v
        elif k == "grade":
            for n in ([v] if isinstance(v, str) else v):
                e.update(PRESETS.get(n, {}))
    return p, e


def lerp_params(a, b, w):
    if w <= 0 or a is b:
        return a
    out = {}
    for k, va in a.items():
        vb = b.get(k, va)
        if isinstance(va, (list, tuple)) or isinstance(vb, (list, tuple)):
            out[k] = list(np.asarray(va, np.float32) * (1 - w) + np.asarray(vb, np.float32) * w)
        elif isinstance(va, (int, float)) and isinstance(vb, (int, float)):
            out[k] = va * (1 - w) + vb * w
        else:
            out[k] = vb if w >= 0.5 else va
    return out


def vec3(v):
    return np.asarray(v if isinstance(v, (list, tuple, np.ndarray)) else [v] * 3, np.float32)


def grade(F, p):
    """Per-shot grade on a display-referred float RGB image (in place where possible)."""
    t, tn, ex = float(p["temperature"]), float(p["tint"]), float(p["exposure"])
    g_lin = np.array([1 + 0.16 * t, 1 - 0.10 * tn, 1 - 0.16 * t], np.float32)
    g_lin = g_lin / float(g_lin @ LUMA) * (2.0 ** ex)
    gain = vec3(p["gain"]) * g_lin ** (1 / 2.2)            # linear gain == display gain^(1/2.2)
    lift = vec3(p["lift"])
    if np.any(gain != 1):
        F *= gain
    if np.any(lift != 0):
        F *= (1 - lift)
        F += lift
    gam = vec3(p["gamma"])
    if np.any(gam != 1):
        np.maximum(F, 0, out=F)
        F[:] = np.power(F, 1.0 / gam)
    c = float(p["contrast"])
    if c != 1:
        pv = float(p["pivot"])
        F -= pv
        F *= c
        F += pv
    sh, hi = vec3(p["shadows"]), vec3(p["highlights"])
    if np.any(sh != 0) or np.any(hi != 0):
        L = np.clip(luma(F), 0, 1)[..., None]
        F += sh * (1 - L) ** 2 + hi * L * L
    s = float(p["saturation"])
    if s != 1:
        L = luma(F)[..., None]
        F -= L
        F *= s
        F += L
    np.maximum(F, 0, out=F)
    m = F > 0.86
    if m.any():
        F[m] = 0.86 + 0.14 * np.tanh((F[m] - 0.86) / 0.14)
    return F


def bloom_layer(F540, p, flash=0.0):
    """Bloom + halation glow (small res, float RGB) or None."""
    amt = float(p["bloom"]) + 1.4 * flash
    hal = float(p["halation"])
    if amt <= 0.001 and hal <= 0.001:
        return None
    h, w = F540.shape[:2]
    small = cv2.resize(F540, (w // 4, h // 4), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
    L = luma(small)
    thr = float(p["bloom_threshold"]) * (1 - 0.45 * flash)
    # display-referred input: only the top of the range blooms (squared knee), so bright skies
    # keep their contrast while sun discs, glints and flames glow
    k = np.clip((L - thr) / max(0.05, 1.0 - thr), 0, 1)
    k *= k
    bright = small * k[..., None]
    r = float(p["bloom_radius"])
    b1 = cv2.GaussianBlur(bright, (0, 0), 2.2 * r)
    s2 = cv2.resize(bright, (w // 8, h // 8), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
    b2 = cv2.resize(cv2.GaussianBlur(s2, (0, 0), 4.5 * r), (w // 4, h // 4), interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
    glow = (0.5 * b1 + 0.5 * b2) * (amt * 1.6)
    if hal > 0.001:
        hl = cv2.GaussianBlur(bright, (0, 0), 1.0) * np.array([1.0, 0.42, 0.18], np.float32)
        glow += hl * hal
    return glow


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# frame sources
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Source:
    def __init__(self, shot, quality="auto", rw=540, rh=960):
        self.shot = shot
        self.id = shot["id"]
        self.rw, self.rh = rw, rh
        base = os.path.join(WORK, "frames", self.id)
        qs = QUALITIES if quality == "auto" else (quality,)
        self.avail = {}
        posts = []
        for q in qs:
            d = os.path.join(base, q)
            if not os.path.isdir(d):
                continue
            fr = sorted(int(n[:-4]) for n in os.listdir(d) if n.endswith(".png") and n[:-4].isdigit())
            if fr:
                self.avail[q] = fr
            pj = os.path.join(d, "post.json")
            if os.path.exists(pj):
                posts.append((os.path.getmtime(pj), pj))
        self.post = {}
        if posts:
            try:
                self.post = json.load(open(max(posts)[1]))
            except Exception:
                self.post = {}
        self.sets = {q: set(v) for q, v in self.avail.items()}
        self.placeholder = not self.avail
        self.cover = None
        if self.avail:
            N = shot["render_frames"]

            def maxgap(fr):
                pts = [0] + [f for f in fr if f <= N] + [N + 1]
                return max(b - a for a, b in zip(pts, pts[1:]))
            self.cover = min(self.avail, key=lambda q: (maxgap(self.avail[q]), QUALITIES.index(q)))
        self.params = resolve_post(self.post)

    def describe(self):
        if self.placeholder:
            return "placeholder"
        return ", ".join("%s:%d" % (q, len(v)) for q, v in self.avail.items()) + " (cover %s)" % self.cover

    def plan(self, f):
        """-> [(quality, frame, weight)]"""
        for q in QUALITIES:
            if q in self.sets and f in self.sets[q]:
                return [(q, f, 1.0)]
        fr = self.avail[self.cover]
        i = bisect.bisect_left(fr, f)
        if i == 0:
            return [(self.cover, fr[0], 1.0)]
        if i >= len(fr):
            return [(self.cover, fr[-1], 1.0)]
        a, b = fr[i - 1], fr[i]
        w = (f - a) / float(b - a)
        return [(self.cover, a, 1 - w), (self.cover, b, w)]

    def path(self, q, f):
        return os.path.join(WORK, "frames", self.id, q, "%04d.png" % f)


_raw_cache = OrderedDict()


def load_png(path, rw, rh):
    v = _raw_cache.get(path)
    if v is not None:
        _raw_cache.move_to_end(path)
        return v
    im = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED)
    if im is None:
        raise IOError("cannot read " + path)
    scale = 65535.0 if im.dtype == np.uint16 else 255.0
    if im.ndim == 2:
        im = np.repeat(im[..., None], 3, axis=2)
    im = im[..., :3][..., ::-1].astype(np.float32) * np.float32(1.0 / scale)
    if im.shape[1] != rw or im.shape[0] != rh:
        interp = cv2.INTER_CUBIC if im.shape[1] < rw else cv2.INTER_AREA
        im = np.clip(cv2.resize(im, (rw, rh), interpolation=interp), 0, 1)
    _raw_cache[path] = im
    if len(_raw_cache) > 6:
        _raw_cache.popitem(last=False)
    return im


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# placeholder cards
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PALETTES = [  # (keywords, top rgb, bottom rgb, glow rgb)
    (("space", "earth seen"), (0.02, 0.03, 0.07), (0.05, 0.08, 0.16), (0.5, 0.6, 0.9)),
    (("night", "moonlight", "torch", "fire", "darkness", "dark hills"), (0.05, 0.07, 0.14), (0.12, 0.12, 0.18), (0.55, 0.62, 0.85)),
    (("storm", "menace", "terror", "dust storm", "lions", "bulls", "hunted", "dusk"), (0.22, 0.12, 0.08), (0.10, 0.06, 0.05), (0.8, 0.45, 0.25)),
    (("gold", "glory", "sunrise", "dawn", "lamp", "warm", "holy", "triumph", "jubilant"), (0.85, 0.66, 0.38), (0.45, 0.30, 0.16), (1.0, 0.85, 0.55)),
    (("sea", "water"), (0.30, 0.50, 0.58), (0.10, 0.20, 0.26), (0.7, 0.9, 1.0)),
    (("harsh white sun", "dry", "potsherd", "desolate", "vast"), (0.78, 0.74, 0.66), (0.50, 0.42, 0.33), (1, 1, 0.95)),
]
DEFAULT_PAL = ((0.50, 0.45, 0.40), (0.25, 0.21, 0.18), (0.95, 0.85, 0.7))


def palette_for(shot):
    txt = (shot.get("mood", "") + " " + shot.get("visual", "") + " " + shot.get("title", "")).lower()
    best, score = DEFAULT_PAL, 0
    for kws, a, b, c in PALETTES:
        s = sum(txt.count(k) for k in kws)
        if s > score:
            best, score = (a, b, c), s
    return best


_ph_cache = {}


def placeholder_card(shot, rw, rh):
    if shot["id"] in _ph_cache:
        return _ph_cache[shot["id"]]
    top, bot, glow = palette_for(shot)
    y = np.linspace(0, 1, rh, dtype=np.float32)[:, None, None]
    F = np.asarray(top, np.float32) * (1 - y) + np.asarray(bot, np.float32) * y
    F = np.broadcast_to(F, (rh, rw, 3)).copy()
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:rh, 0:rw].astype(np.float32)
    r = np.sqrt(((xx - rw * 0.5) / (rw * 0.55)) ** 2 + ((yy - rh * 0.40) / (rh * 0.35)) ** 2)
    F += (np.exp(-r * r * 1.6) * 0.22)[..., None] * np.asarray(glow, np.float32)
    img = Image.fromarray((np.clip(F, 0, 1) * 255).astype(np.uint8))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    lum = float(np.mean(np.asarray(top) * LUMA.sum()))
    ink = (40, 32, 24) if lum > 0.55 else (235, 228, 215)
    f1 = CAP.get_font("caps", 26)
    f2 = CAP.get_font("body", 30)
    f3 = CAP.get_font("alt", 17)
    d.text((rw / 2, 70), "%s  ·  %s" % (shot["id"].upper(), shot.get("block", "")), font=f1, fill=ink, anchor="ms")
    d.text((rw / 2, 112), shot.get("title", ""), font=f2, fill=ink, anchor="ms")
    words, lines, cur = shot.get("visual", "").split(), [], ""
    for w_ in words:
        t = (cur + " " + w_).strip()
        if f3.getlength(t) > rw - 80:
            lines.append(cur)
            cur = w_
        else:
            cur = t
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines[:12]):
        d.text((40, 150 + i * 22), ln, font=f3, fill=ink)
    d.text((rw / 2, 150 + min(12, len(lines)) * 22 + 30), "[ placeholder — not rendered yet ]  " + shot.get("mood", ""),
           font=CAP.get_font("italic", 18), fill=ink, anchor="ms")
    card = np.asarray(img, np.float32) / 255.0
    _ph_cache[shot["id"]] = (card, ink)
    return _ph_cache[shot["id"]]


def placeholder_frame(shot, f, rw, rh):
    card, ink = placeholder_card(shot, rw, rh)
    F = card.copy()
    # timing bar + frame counter (top area, away from captions)
    u = (f - 1) / max(1, shot["nframes"] - 1)
    col = np.asarray(ink, np.float32) / 255.0
    y0 = 24
    F[y0:y0 + 2, 30:rw - 30] = F[y0:y0 + 2, 30:rw - 30] * 0.6 + col * 0.4
    x1 = 30 + int((rw - 60) * min(1.0, u))
    F[y0 - 2:y0 + 4, 30:x1] = col
    patch = Image.new("L", (160, 22), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(patch).text((0, 0), "f %d / %d%s" % (f, shot["nframes"], " tail" if f > shot["nframes"] else ""),
                                font=CAP.get_font("alt", 16), fill=255)
    a = (np.asarray(patch, np.float32) / 255.0)[..., None]
    F[32:54, 30:190] = F[32:54, 30:190] * (1 - a) + col * a
    return F


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# film
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Film:
    def __init__(self, quality="auto", captions=True, burnin=False, timeline=None, phrases=None):
        self.tl = timeline or json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, "timeline.json")))
        self.fps = self.tl["fps"]
        self.rw, self.rh = self.tl.get("render_resolution", [540, 960])
        self.W, self.H = self.tl.get("final_resolution", [720, 1280])
        self.shots = self.tl["shots"]
        self.N = self.tl["total_frames"]
        self.sources = [Source(s, quality, self.rw, self.rh) for s in self.shots]
        self.shot_of = np.zeros(self.N, np.int32)
        for k, s in enumerate(self.shots):
            self.shot_of[s["start_frame"]:s["start_frame"] + s["nframes"]] = k
        self.flash = np.zeros(self.N, np.float32)
        self.black = np.zeros(self.N, np.float32)
        for k, s in enumerate(self.shots):
            c = s["start_frame"]
            if k == 0 or c <= 0:
                continue                      # never a transition at the very start
            tr = s.get("transition_in", "cut")
            if tr == "flash":
                for i in range(-FLASH_PRE, FLASH_POST + 1):
                    g = c + i
                    if 0 < g < self.N:
                        v = math.exp(-((i + 0.3) / 1.6) ** 2) if i < 0 else math.exp(-i / 3.2)
                        self.flash[g] = max(self.flash[g], v)
            elif tr == "fade_black":
                for i in range(FB_OUT):
                    g = c - FB_OUT + i
                    if g > 0:
                        x = (i + 1) / FB_OUT
                        self.black[g] = max(self.black[g], x * x * (3 - 2 * x))
                for i in range(FB_IN):
                    g = c + i
                    x = 1 - i / FB_IN
                    self.black[g] = max(self.black[g], x * x * (3 - 2 * x))
        # end of film: fade the end card + picture out
        ff = int(CAP.ENDCARD["final_fade"] * self.fps)
        for i in range(ff):
            g = self.N - ff + i
            x = (i + 1) / ff
            self.black[g] = max(self.black[g], x * x * (3 - 2 * x) * 0.97)
        self.vig = self._vignette()
        self._vig_cache = {}
        self.captions = None
        if captions:
            if phrases is None:
                phrases = load_phrases()
            ph = phrases["phrases"] if isinstance(phrases, dict) else phrases
            s0 = self.shots[0]
            title_end = min((s0["start_frame"] + s0["nframes"]) / self.fps - 0.15,
                            ph[0]["start"] - 0.5 if ph else 99)
            self.captions = CAP.CaptionTrack(ph, self.N / self.fps, title_end=title_end, hints=self.hints_at)
            self.captions.fps = self.fps
            self.captions.ref_fn = lambda g: self.frame(g, overlays=False)
            last = self.sources[-1].post.get("endcard", {}) if self.sources else {}
            self.captions.endcard_ink = last.get("ink", "auto") if isinstance(last, dict) else "auto"
        self.burnin = burnin
        self._graded = OrderedDict()

    def _vignette(self):
        yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:self.H, 0:self.W].astype(np.float32)
        r = np.sqrt(((xx - self.W / 2) / (self.W * 0.62)) ** 2 + ((yy - self.H * 0.47) / (self.H * 0.60)) ** 2)
        v = np.clip((r - 0.45) / 0.75, 0, 1)
        return (v * v * (3 - 2 * v)).astype(np.float32)

    def _vig_factor(self, v):
        v = round(float(v), 3)
        f = self._vig_cache.get(v)
        if f is None:
            if len(self._vig_cache) > 8:
                self._vig_cache.clear()
            f = self._vig_cache[v] = (1 - np.float32(v) * self.vig)[..., None].astype(np.float32)
        return f

    def hints_at(self, t):
        g = min(self.N - 1, max(0, int(round(t * self.fps))))
        return self.sources[self.shot_of[g]].post

    def params(self, k, f):
        a, b = self.sources[k].params
        if a is b or a == b:
            return a
        n = self.shots[k]["nframes"]
        return lerp_params(a, b, min(1.0, max(0.0, (f - 1) / max(1, n - 1))))

    def graded(self, k, f):
        key = (k, f)
        v = self._graded.get(key)
        if v is not None:
            return v
        src = self.sources[k]
        shot = self.shots[k]
        if src.placeholder:
            F = placeholder_frame(shot, f, self.rw, self.rh)
        else:
            plan = src.plan(f)
            if len(plan) == 1:
                F = load_png(src.path(plan[0][0], plan[0][1]), self.rw, self.rh).copy()
            else:
                (qa, fa, wa), (qb, fb, wb) = plan
                F = load_png(src.path(qa, fa), self.rw, self.rh) * np.float32(wa) + \
                    load_png(src.path(qb, fb), self.rw, self.rh) * np.float32(wb)
        F = grade(F, self.params(k, f))
        self._graded[key] = F
        if len(self._graded) > 4:
            self._graded.popitem(last=False)
        return F

    def frame(self, g, overlays=True):
        """Global frame index (0-based) -> float32 (H,W,3) display RGB."""
        k = int(self.shot_of[g])
        s = self.shots[k]
        f = g - s["start_frame"] + 1
        F = self.graded(k, f)
        p = self.params(k, f)
        if k > 0 and s.get("transition_in") == "dissolve" and f <= DISSOLVE:
            prev = self.shots[k - 1]
            pf = prev["nframes"] + f
            # tail frames that were not rendered fall back to holds / interpolation inside Source.plan
            w = (f - 0.5) / DISSOLVE
            w = w * w * (3 - 2 * w)
            P = self.graded(k - 1, pf)
            F = P * np.float32(1 - w) + F * np.float32(w)
            p = lerp_params(self.params(k - 1, pf), p, w)
        flash, black = float(self.flash[g]), float(self.black[g])
        glow = bloom_layer(F, p, flash)
        U = cv2.resize(F, (self.W, self.H), interpolation=cv2.INTER_LANCZOS4)
        sh = float(p.get("sharpen", 0.35))
        if sh > 0:                                   # unsharp mask: U + sh*(U - blur(U))
            B = cv2.GaussianBlur(U, (0, 0), 1.0)
            U *= np.float32(1 + sh)
            B *= np.float32(sh)
            U -= B
        np.clip(U, 0, 1, out=U)
        if glow is not None:                         # screen blend: U + G - U*G
            G = cv2.resize(glow, (self.W, self.H), interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
            np.clip(G, 0, 1, out=G)
            UG = U * G
            U += G
            U -= UG
        v = float(p.get("vignette", 0))
        if v > 0:
            U *= self._vig_factor(v)
        if flash > 0:
            U *= np.float32(1 - 0.9 * flash)
            U += np.float32(0.9 * flash)
        gr = float(p.get("grain", 0))
        if gr > 0:
            rng = np.random.default_rng(g)
            n = rng.standard_normal((self.H // 2, self.W // 2), dtype=np.float32)
            n = cv2.resize(n, (self.W, self.H), interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)   # soft, luma-only grain
            U += n[..., None] * np.float32(gr)
        if self.captions is not None and overlays:
            self.captions.render(U, g / self.fps)
        if black > 0:
            U *= np.float32(1 - black)
        if self.burnin:
            self._burnin(U, g, k, f)
        return np.clip(U, 0, 1, out=U)

    def _burnin(self, U, g, k, f):
        src = self.sources[k]
        tag = "placeholder" if src.placeholder else "+".join(sorted({q for q, _, _ in src.plan(f)}))
        txt = "%s f%d  g%d  %05.2fs  %s" % (self.shots[k]["id"], f, g, g / self.fps, tag)
        im = Image.new("L", (330, 20), 0)
        ImageDraw.Draw(im).text((2, 1), txt, font=CAP.get_font("alt", 15), fill=255)
        a = (np.asarray(im, np.float32) / 255.0)[..., None]
        R = U[8:28, 8:338]
        R *= (1 - 0.5 * np.clip(a * 4, 0, 1))
        R += a * 0.95


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# output conversion
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def to_yuv420(F, bits=10, dither=0.0, seed=0):
    """float RGB (display, 0..1) -> planar BT.709 limited-range YUV 4:2:0 bytes."""
    YUV = cv2.transform(F, _YUV_M)
    Y = YUV[..., 0]
    C2 = YUV[0::2, 0::2, 1:] + YUV[1::2, 0::2, 1:]          # 2x2 box average (centre-sited)
    C2 += YUV[0::2, 1::2, 1:]
    C2 += YUV[1::2, 1::2, 1:]
    C2 *= np.float32(0.25)
    Cb, Cr = C2[..., 0], C2[..., 1]
    if bits == 10:
        ys, yo, cs, co, top, dt = 876.0, 64.0, 896.0, 512.0, 1023, np.uint16
    else:
        ys, yo, cs, co, top, dt = 219.0, 16.0, 224.0, 128.0, 255, np.uint8
    Yq = Y * np.float32(ys) + np.float32(yo)
    Bq = Cb * np.float32(cs) + np.float32(co)
    Rq = Cr * np.float32(cs) + np.float32(co)
    if dither > 0:
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        for P in (Yq, Bq, Rq):     # TPDF dither, +-dither LSB
            P += (rng.random(P.shape, dtype=np.float32) - rng.random(P.shape, dtype=np.float32)) * np.float32(dither)
    out = []
    for P in (Yq, Bq, Rq):
        np.rint(P, out=P)
        np.clip(P, 0, top, out=P)
        out.append(P.astype(dt).tobytes())
    return b"".join(out)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# multiprocessing
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
_film = None
_job = {}


def _init(opts):
    global _film, _job
    cv2.setNumThreads(1)
    _job = opts
    _film = Film(quality=opts["quality"], captions=opts["captions"], burnin=opts["burnin"])


def _work(rng):
    g0, g1 = rng
    out = []
    for g in range(g0, g1):
        F = _film.frame(g)
        if _job["fmt"] == "rgb24":
            out.append((F * 255 + 0.5).astype(np.uint8).tobytes())
        else:
            out.append(to_yuv420(F, _job["bits"], _job["dither"], seed=g))
    return b"".join(out)


def chunks(film, frames, size=12):
    """Split sorted global frames into contiguous chunks that do not cross shots."""
    out = []
    cur = []
    for g in frames:
        if cur and (g != cur[-1] + 1 or len(cur) >= size or film_shot(film, g) != film_shot(film, cur[0])):
            out.append((cur[0], cur[-1] + 1))
            cur = []
        cur.append(g)
    if cur:
        out.append((cur[0], cur[-1] + 1))
    return out


def film_shot(film, g):
    return int(film.shot_of[g])


def load_phrases():
    for name in ("phrases.json",):
        p = os.path.join(WORK, "audio", name)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return json.load(open(p))
    return {"phrases": []}


def find_audio():
    for name in ("mix.wav", "narration.wav"):
        p = os.path.join(WORK, "audio", name)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return p
    return None


def parse_frames(spec, film):
    if not spec:
        return list(range(film.N))
    out = []
    for part in spec.split(","):
        if "-" in part:
            a, b = part.split("-")
            out += list(range(int(a), min(film.N - 1, int(b)) + 1))
        else:
            out.append(int(part))
    return sorted(set(g for g in out if 0 <= g < film.N))


def run(args):
    t_start = time.time()
    film = Film(quality=args.quality, captions=not args.no_captions, burnin=args.burnin)
    for s, src in zip(film.shots, film.sources):
        if args.verbose or not src.placeholder:
            print("  %-5s %s" % (s["id"], src.describe()))
    if args.shots:
        ids = args.shots.split(",")
        frames = []
        for s in film.shots:
            if s["id"] in ids:
                frames += list(range(s["start_frame"], s["start_frame"] + s["nframes"]))
        frames = sorted(set(frames))
    elif args.stills:
        frames = parse_frames(args.stills, film)
    else:
        frames = parse_frames(args.frames, film)
    W, H, fps = film.W, film.H, film.fps
    opts = {"quality": args.quality, "captions": not args.no_captions, "burnin": args.burnin,
            "fmt": "yuv", "bits": 10, "dither": 0.0}

    if args.stills:
        os.makedirs(args.stills_dir, exist_ok=True)
        for g in frames:
            F = film.frame(g)
            p = os.path.join(args.stills_dir, "g%05d.png" % g)
            Image.fromarray((F * 255 + 0.5).astype(np.uint8)).save(p)
            print(p)
        return

    t0 = frames[0] / fps
    dur = len(frames) / fps
    if args.direct:
        opts.update(bits=8, dither=0.6)
        audio = None if args.no_audio else (args.audio or find_audio())
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
               "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-s", "%dx%d" % (W, H), "-r", str(fps), "-i", "-"]
        if audio:
            cmd += ["-ss", "%.3f" % t0, "-t", "%.3f" % dur, "-i", audio]
        cmd += ["-map", "0:v"] + (["-map", "1:a", "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "96k"] if audio else [])
        cmd += ["-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", args.preset or "fast", "-crf", str(args.crf or 21),
                "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-profile:v", "high", "-movflags", "+faststart",
                "-colorspace", "bt709", "-color_primaries", "bt709", "-color_trc", "bt709", "-color_range", "tv",
                "-t", "%.3f" % dur, args.direct]
        out_path = args.direct
    else:
        out_path = args.mezz or os.path.join(WORK, "comp", "mezz.mp4")
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path), exist_ok=True)
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
               "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p10le", "-s", "%dx%d" % (W, H), "-r", str(fps), "-i", "-",
               "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", args.mezz_preset, "-crf", str(args.mezz_crf),
               "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p10le", "-x264-params", "keyint=48:min-keyint=1",
               "-colorspace", "bt709", "-color_primaries", "bt709", "-color_trc", "bt709", "-color_range", "tv",
               out_path]
    ff = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
    jobs = chunks(film, frames, args.chunk)
    done = 0
    tl = time.time()
    workers = max(1, args.workers)
    print("compositing %d frames (%.1fs from %.2fs) with %d workers -> %s" % (len(frames), dur, t0, workers, out_path))
    if workers == 1:
        _init(opts)
        it = map(_work, jobs)
        pool = None
    else:
        ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
        pool = ctx.Pool(workers, initializer=_init, initargs=(opts,))
        it = pool.imap(_work, jobs)
    try:
        for (g0, g1), data in zip(jobs, it):
            ff.stdin.write(data)
            done += g1 - g0
            if time.time() - tl > 10 or done == len(frames):
                el = time.time() - t_start
                print("  %5d/%d frames  %.1f fps  elapsed %.0fs  eta %.0fs" %
                      (done, len(frames), done / el, el, (len(frames) - done) / max(1e-6, done / el)), flush=True)
                tl = time.time()
    finally:
        if pool:
            pool.close()
            pool.join()
        ff.stdin.close()
        ff.wait()
    el = time.time() - t_start
    print("composite done: %d frames in %.1fs (%.2f fps) -> %s (%.1f MB)" %
          (len(frames), el, len(frames) / el, out_path, os.path.getsize(out_path) / 1e6))
    if ff.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit("ffmpeg failed")
    if not args.direct and not args.no_encode:
        import encode
        ea = ["--mezz", out_path]
        if args.out:
            ea += ["--out", args.out]
        if args.audio:
            ea += ["--audio", args.audio]
        if frames[0] > 0:
            ea += ["--audio-offset", "%.3f" % t0]
        encode.main(ea + (args.encode_args.split() if args.encode_args else []))


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--quality", default="auto", choices=("auto",) + QUALITIES)
    ap.add_argument("--frames", help="global 0-based frames, e.g. 0-479 or 0-100,2000-2100")
    ap.add_argument("--shots", help="comma list of shot ids")
    ap.add_argument("--stills", help="global frames to write as PNG (no video)")
    ap.add_argument("--stills-dir", default=os.path.join(WORK, "comp", "stills"))
    ap.add_argument("--mezz", help="mezzanine path (default $WORK/comp/mezz.mp4)")
    ap.add_argument("--mezz-crf", type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument("--mezz-preset", default="veryfast")
    ap.add_argument("--direct", help="single-pass preview mp4 instead of mezzanine")
    ap.add_argument("--crf", type=int)
    ap.add_argument("--preset")
    ap.add_argument("--out", help="final mp4 (passed to encode.py)")
    ap.add_argument("--audio")
    ap.add_argument("--no-audio", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--no-encode", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--encode-args", help="extra args for encode.py, quoted")
    ap.add_argument("--no-captions", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--burnin", action="store_true", help="debug overlay: shot/frame/source")
    ap.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=min(4, os.cpu_count() or 1))
    ap.add_argument("--chunk", type=int, default=12)
    ap.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    run(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

===== FILE: psalm22/comp/encode.py =====
"""Psalm 22 - delivery encode: 10-bit mezzanine (from composite.py) + audio -> size-capped MP4.

  python comp/encode.py                                  # $WORK/comp/mezz.mp4 -> $WORK/comp/psalm22.mp4 (H.264)
  python comp/encode.py --codec hevc                     # HEVC/x265 two-pass, hvc1 tag -> psalm22_hevc.mp4
  python comp/encode.py --codec both --metrics           # both + SSIM/PSNR against the mezzanine
  python comp/encode.py --mezz M.mkv --out O.mp4 --audio A.wav --max-mb 15 --margin 0.045

Video: H.264 High@4.0, yuv420p 8-bit, 720x1280, 24 fps, two-pass ABR with the bitrate computed from the
duration so that video + audio + container stay under --max-mb (default 15 MB = 15,000,000 bytes) with
--margin headroom; pass 2 is re-run at a lower rate if the file still comes out too big.
10 -> 8 bit conversion uses zimg with a light dither (--dither, default 'ordered') to fight banding in dark
gradients; x264 runs with aq-mode 3 (dark-scene bias), which matters more than the dither at this rate.
Audio: AAC-LC 48 kHz, 64 kbps mono / 80 kbps stereo (or --abr), padded/trimmed to the video length.
+faststart; the first frame is an IDR (x264 always opens with one; verified with ffprobe).
"""
import argparse, json, os, subprocess, sys, time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
WORK = os.environ.get("WORK", "/opt/work/psalm22")

X264_PARAMS = ("keyint=240:min-keyint=24:scenecut=40:aq-mode=3:aq-strength=0.9:"
               "rc-lookahead=60:bframes=4:b-adapt=2:ref=4:deblock=0,0:psy-rd=1.0,0.10")
X265_PARAMS = ("keyint=240:min-keyint=24:aq-mode=3:aq-strength=0.9:rc-lookahead=40:bframes=4:"
               "no-sao=1:deblock=-1,-1:psy-rd=1.5:psy-rdoq=1.0")
COLOR = ["-colorspace", "bt709", "-color_primaries", "bt709", "-color_trc", "bt709", "-color_range", "tv"]


def run(cmd, quiet=True):
    t = time.time()
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE if quiet else None, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        sys.stderr.write(r.stderr[-3000:])
        raise SystemExit("command failed: " + " ".join(cmd[:12]))
    return r, time.time() - t


def probe(path):
    r, _ = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_streams", "-show_format", "-of", "json", path])
    return json.loads(r.stdout)


def video_info(path):
    j = probe(path)
    v = next(s for s in j["streams"] if s["codec_type"] == "video")
    num, den = (int(x) for x in v.get("r_frame_rate", "24/1").split("/"))
    fps = num / den
    dur = float(v.get("duration") or j["format"]["duration"])
    nb = int(v["nb_frames"]) if v.get("nb_frames") else int(round(dur * fps))
    return {"fps": fps, "frames": nb, "duration": nb / fps, "w": v["width"], "h": v["height"]}


def find_audio():
    for name in ("mix.wav", "narration.wav"):
        p = os.path.join(WORK, "audio", name)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return p
    return None


def encode_audio(src, dst, duration, offset=0.0, kbps=None):
    """AAC-LC; returns (bytes, kbps, channels)."""
    ch = 2
    if src:
        a = next((s for s in probe(src)["streams"] if s["codec_type"] == "audio"), None)
        ch = min(2, int(a.get("channels", 2))) if a else 2
    kbps = kbps or (64 if ch == 1 else 80)
    if src:
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y"]
        if offset > 0:
            cmd += ["-ss", "%.3f" % offset]
        cmd += ["-i", src, "-af", "apad", "-t", "%.3f" % duration, "-ac", str(ch), "-ar", "48000",
                "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "%dk" % kbps, dst]
    else:   # silent track keeps players/platforms happy
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-f", "lavfi", "-i",
               "anullsrc=r=48000:cl=mono", "-t", "%.3f" % duration, "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "32k", dst]
        ch, kbps = 1, 32
    run(cmd)
    return os.path.getsize(dst), kbps, ch


def vfilter(dither, w=720, h=1280):
    """10-bit mezzanine -> 8-bit 4:2:0 with zimg dithering ('none'|'ordered'|'random'|'error_diffusion')."""
    if dither == "sws":
        return "format=yuv420p"
    return ("zscale=w=%d:h=%d:dither=%s:filter=lanczos:matrixin=709:matrix=709:transferin=709:transfer=709:"
            "primariesin=709:primaries=709:rangein=limited:range=limited,format=yuv420p" % (w, h, dither))


def video_args(codec, kbps, preset, pass_no, logbase, maxrate=True):
    if codec == "h264":
        a = ["-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", preset or "slow", "-b:v", "%dk" % kbps,
             "-profile:v", "high", "-level:v", "4.0", "-x264-params", X264_PARAMS,
             "-pass", str(pass_no), "-passlogfile", logbase]
        if maxrate:
            a += ["-maxrate", "%dk" % int(kbps * 3), "-bufsize", "%dk" % int(kbps * 6)]
        return a
    p = X265_PARAMS + ":pass=%d:stats=%s.x265stats" % (pass_no, logbase)
    return ["-c:v", "libx265", "-preset", preset or "medium", "-b:v", "%dk" % kbps,
            "-x265-params", p, "-tag:v", "hvc1", "-profile:v", "main"]


def two_pass(mezz, audio_m4a, out, codec, kbps, preset, dither, logbase, info, skip_pass1=False):
    vf = vfilter(dither, info["w"], info["h"])
    t1 = 0.0
    if not skip_pass1:
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-i", mezz, "-vf", vf, "-an",
               "-r", "%g" % info["fps"]] + video_args(codec, kbps, preset, 1, logbase) + ["-f", "null", os.devnull]
        if codec == "hevc":
            cmd = [c for c in cmd if c not in ("-tag:v", "hvc1")]
        _, t1 = run(cmd)
    cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-i", mezz]
    if audio_m4a:
        cmd += ["-i", audio_m4a]
    cmd += ["-map", "0:v:0"] + (["-map", "1:a:0", "-c:a", "copy"] if audio_m4a else [])
    cmd += ["-vf", vf, "-r", "%g" % info["fps"], "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p"] + \
        video_args(codec, kbps, preset, 2, logbase) + COLOR + \
        ["-movflags", "+faststart", "-metadata", "title=Psalm 22", "-metadata:s:v", "language=eng",
         "-t", "%.4f" % info["duration"], out]
    _, t2 = run(cmd)
    return t1, t2


def first_frame_is_idr(path):
    r, _ = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-read_intervals", "%+#1",
                "-show_entries", "frame=key_frame,pict_type,pts_time", "-of", "json", path])
    fr = json.loads(r.stdout).get("frames", [])
    return bool(fr) and int(fr[0].get("key_frame", 0)) == 1 and fr[0].get("pict_type") == "I"


def metrics(dist, ref, seconds=None):
    """SSIM (all) and PSNR(Y) of `dist` vs the 10-bit mezzanine (both compared in 10-bit)."""
    lim = ["-t", "%.2f" % seconds] if seconds else []
    sync = "format=yuv420p10le,settb=1/24,setpts=N"          # pair frames by index, not by timestamp
    cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-nostats", "-y"] + lim + ["-i", dist] + lim + ["-i", ref, "-lavfi",
           "[0:v]%s,split[a][c];[1:v]%s,split[b][d];[a][b]ssim;[c][d]psnr" % (sync, sync),
           "-f", "null", "-"]
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    ssim = psnr = None
    for ln in r.stderr.splitlines():
        if "SSIM" in ln and "All:" in ln:
            ssim = float(ln.split("All:")[1].split()[0])
        if "PSNR" in ln and "y:" in ln:
            psnr = float(ln.split("y:")[1].split()[0])
    return ssim, psnr


def encode(mezz, out, codec="h264", audio=None, audio_offset=0.0, max_mb=15.0, margin=0.045,
           preset=None, dither="ordered", abr=None, do_metrics=False, metrics_seconds=None, verbose=True):
    info = video_info(mezz)
    dur = info["duration"]
    tmp = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(out)), ".enc_" + os.path.basename(out))
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(out)), exist_ok=True)
    m4a = tmp + ".m4a"
    a_bytes, a_kbps, ch = encode_audio(audio, m4a, dur, audio_offset, abr)
    limit = max_mb * 1e6
    target = limit * (1 - margin)
    overhead = 40000 + info["frames"] * 12           # moov/stts/stsz/stco + mdat headers, generous
    kbps = int((target - a_bytes - overhead) * 8 / dur / 1000)
    if verbose:
        print("encode %s: %d frames %.2fs  audio %s %dk %dch = %.0f kB  -> video %d kbps (target %.2f MB, limit %.2f MB)" %
              (codec, info["frames"], dur, os.path.basename(audio) if audio else "silence", a_kbps, ch,
               a_bytes / 1e3, kbps, target / 1e6, limit / 1e6))
    t0 = time.time()
    t1, t2 = two_pass(mezz, m4a, out, codec, kbps, preset, dither, tmp, info)
    size = os.path.getsize(out)
    tries = 0
    while size > limit * 0.995 and tries < 3:
        kbps = int(kbps * (limit * 0.97 - a_bytes - overhead) / max(1, size - a_bytes - overhead))
        print("  %.2f MB is over the limit -> pass 2 again at %d kbps" % (size / 1e6, kbps))
        _, t2b = two_pass(mezz, m4a, out, codec, kbps, preset, dither, tmp, info, skip_pass1=True)
        t2 += t2b
        size = os.path.getsize(out)
        tries += 1
    res = {"codec": codec, "out": out, "bytes": size, "mb": round(size / 1e6, 3), "video_kbps": kbps,
           "audio_kbps": a_kbps, "duration": round(dur, 3), "pass1_s": round(t1, 1), "pass2_s": round(t2, 1),
           "total_kbps": round(size * 8 / dur / 1000, 1), "first_frame_idr": first_frame_is_idr(out),
           "dither": dither}
    if do_metrics:
        ssim, psnr = metrics(out, mezz, metrics_seconds)
        res.update(ssim=ssim, psnr_y=psnr)
    for f in os.listdir(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(out))):
        if f.startswith(".enc_" + os.path.basename(out)):
            try:
                os.remove(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(out)), f))
            except OSError:
                pass
    if verbose:
        print("  -> %s  %.3f MB  (%.0f kbps total)  pass1 %.0fs pass2 %.0fs  first-frame IDR: %s%s" %
              (out, size / 1e6, res["total_kbps"], t1, t2, res["first_frame_idr"],
               ("  SSIM %.4f PSNR-Y %.2f dB" % (res["ssim"], res["psnr_y"])) if do_metrics and res.get("ssim") else ""))
    return res


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--mezz", default=os.path.join(WORK, "comp", "mezz.mp4"))
    ap.add_argument("--out", help="output mp4 (default $WORK/comp/psalm22.mp4; _hevc suffix for HEVC)")
    ap.add_argument("--audio", help="audio file (default $WORK/audio/mix.wav, else narration.wav)")
    ap.add_argument("--audio-offset", type=float, default=0.0, help="seconds to skip in the audio (partial renders)")
    ap.add_argument("--no-audio", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--codec", default="h264", choices=("h264", "hevc", "both"))
    ap.add_argument("--max-mb", type=float, default=15.0, help="hard size limit in MB (1e6 bytes)")
    ap.add_argument("--margin", type=float, default=0.045, help="safety margin below the limit")
    ap.add_argument("--preset", help="x264 preset (default slow) / x265 preset (default medium)")
    ap.add_argument("--dither", default="ordered", choices=("none", "ordered", "random", "error_diffusion", "sws"))
    ap.add_argument("--abr", type=int, help="audio kbps (default 64 mono / 80 stereo)")
    ap.add_argument("--metrics", action="store_true", help="SSIM/PSNR vs the mezzanine")
    ap.add_argument("--metrics-seconds", type=float)
    ap.add_argument("--json", help="write results json here")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    audio = None if a.no_audio else (a.audio or find_audio())
    base = a.out or os.path.join(WORK, "comp", "psalm22.mp4")
    results = []
    for codec in (("h264", "hevc") if a.codec == "both" else (a.codec,)):
        out = base if codec == "h264" or a.codec == "hevc" else base.replace(".mp4", "_hevc.mp4")
        results.append(encode(a.mezz, out, codec, audio, a.audio_offset, a.max_mb, a.margin,
                              a.preset if (a.codec != "both" or codec == "h264") else None, a.dither, a.abr,
                              a.metrics, a.metrics_seconds))
    if a.json:
        json.dump(results, open(a.json, "w"), indent=1)
    return results


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

===== FILE: psalm22/comp/interp.py =====
#!/opt/venv/bin/python
"""Psalm 22 - CPU frame interpolation (RIFE, IFNet v4.26) for half-rate renders.

Render a slow shot at 12 fps (odd frames only), then synthesise the even frames:

    psalm22/blender/run.sh --shot s05 --quality final --frames odd
    /opt/venv/bin/python psalm22/comp/interp.py --shot s05 --quality final

The missing frames are written next to the rendered ones as NNNN.png (same naming, same
8-bit RGB PNG), so the compositor needs no change. Generally: every missing frame f in 1..N whose
nearest rendered neighbours a < f < b are at most --max-gap apart is interpolated at t=(f-a)/(b-a)
(so 1-of-3 renders work too); a missing trailing (or leading) frame is extrapolated from the last two
rendered frames along the estimated motion (fallback: --edge hold duplicates the last frame).

Other modes:
    interp.py --shot s00 --quality draft --validate      # hide even frames of a full-rate render,
                                                         # re-create them in a scratch dir, PSNR/SSIM
    interp.py --pair a.png b.png --out mid.png [--t 0.5] # one pair
    interp.py --shot s05 --dry-run                       # print the plan only

Python API:
    from interp import Interpolator, fill_shot
    ip = Interpolator()                       # loads /opt/assets/rife/v4.26/flownet.pkl
    mid = ip.interpolate(a, b, 0.5)           # uint8 HxWx3 numpy arrays in/out
    fill_shot("s05", "final")                 # what the CLI does

Docs: psalm22/docs/interp.md. Model: RIFE / Practical-RIFE v4.26 by hzwer et al. (MIT).
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import zipfile
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, PngImagePlugin

# Shared 4-core box: spinning OpenMP workers collapse when Blender/ffmpeg also run (measured at load ~20:
# 20 s/frame with the default policy vs 1.3 s/frame PASSIVE). Must be set before torch is imported.
_TORCH_PREIMPORTED = "torch" in sys.modules
os.environ.setdefault("OMP_WAIT_POLICY", "PASSIVE")
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)                                  # .../psalm22
WORK = os.environ.get("WORK", "/opt/work/psalm22")
RIFE_DIR = os.environ.get("RIFE_DIR", "/opt/assets/rife")
FRAME_RE = re.compile(r"^(\d{4,})\.png$")
TAG = "Interp"                                                # PNG tEXt key marking generated frames
MANIFEST = "interp.json"

MODELS = {
    "v4.26": {
        "file": "v4.26/flownet.pkl",
        "sha256": "45c7f74156704769dc9f85cfcaf8552e1e926f9399dcfa3a553dee88fac6f53f",
        "url": "https://huggingface.co/hzwer/RIFE/resolve/main/RIFEv4.26_0921.zip",
        "member": "RIFEv4.26_0921/flownet.pkl",
    },
}
DEFAULT_MODEL = "v4.26"


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IFNet v4.25/v4.26 (re-implementation of Practical-RIFE train_log/IFNet_HDv3.py, MIT licence)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _conv(cin, cout, k=3, s=1, p=1):
    return nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(cin, cout, k, s, p, bias=True), nn.LeakyReLU(0.2, True))


class Head(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn0 = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, 3, 2, 1)
        self.cnn1 = nn.Conv2d(16, 16, 3, 1, 1)
        self.cnn2 = nn.Conv2d(16, 16, 3, 1, 1)
        self.cnn3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(16, 4, 4, 2, 1)
        self.relu = nn.LeakyReLU(0.2, True)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.relu(self.cnn0(x))
        x = self.relu(self.cnn1(x))
        x = self.relu(self.cnn2(x))
        return self.cnn3(x)


class ResConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, 1, 1)
        self.beta = nn.Parameter(torch.ones((1, c, 1, 1)))
        self.relu = nn.LeakyReLU(0.2, True)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.relu(self.conv(x) * self.beta + x)


class IFBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, c):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv0 = nn.Sequential(_conv(cin, c // 2, 3, 2, 1), _conv(c // 2, c, 3, 2, 1))
        self.convblock = nn.Sequential(*[ResConv(c) for _ in range(8)])
        self.lastconv = nn.Sequential(nn.ConvTranspose2d(c, 4 * 13, 4, 2, 1), nn.PixelShuffle(2))

    def forward(self, x, flow, scale, dtype):
        """x, flow: fp32. Convs run in `dtype` (fp32 or bf16); flow/mask maths stay fp32."""
        x = F.interpolate(x, scale_factor=1. / scale, mode="bilinear", align_corners=False)
        if flow is not None:
            flow = F.interpolate(flow, scale_factor=1. / scale, mode="bilinear", align_corners=False) / scale
            x = torch.cat((x, flow), 1)
        x = x.to(dtype).contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
        tmp = self.lastconv(self.convblock(self.conv0(x))).float()
        tmp = F.interpolate(tmp, scale_factor=scale, mode="bilinear", align_corners=False)
        return tmp[:, :4] * scale, tmp[:, 4:5], tmp[:, 5:]


_GRID = {}


def warp(img, flow):
    """Backward-warp img (B,C,H,W) by flow (B,2,H,W) in pixels (Practical-RIFE model/warplayer.py)."""
    B, _, H, W = flow.shape
    k = (B, H, W)
    if k not in _GRID:
        gx = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, W).view(1, 1, 1, W).expand(B, -1, H, -1)
        gy = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, H).view(1, 1, H, 1).expand(B, -1, -1, W)
        _GRID[k] = torch.cat([gx, gy], 1)
    f = torch.cat([flow[:, 0:1] / ((W - 1.0) / 2.0), flow[:, 1:2] / ((H - 1.0) / 2.0)], 1)
    g = (_GRID[k] + f).permute(0, 2, 3, 1)
    return F.grid_sample(img.float(), g, mode="bilinear", padding_mode="border", align_corners=True)


class IFNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.block0 = IFBlock(7 + 8, c=192)
        self.block1 = IFBlock(8 + 4 + 8 + 8, c=128)
        self.block2 = IFBlock(8 + 4 + 8 + 8, c=96)
        self.block3 = IFBlock(8 + 4 + 8 + 8, c=64)
        self.block4 = IFBlock(8 + 4 + 8 + 8, c=32)
        self.encode = Head()
        self.dtype = torch.float32

    def forward(self, img0, img1, timestep, scale_list=(16, 8, 4, 2, 1)):
        """img0/img1: (B,3,H,W) fp32 in [0,1], H,W multiples of 64/scale. timestep: (B,1,1,1).
        Returns merged (B,3,H,W), flow (B,4,H,W) [F_t->0, F_t->1], mask (B,1,H,W), w0, w1."""
        dt = self.dtype
        t = timestep.float().expand(-1, 1, img0.shape[2], img0.shape[3])
        f0 = self.encode(img0.to(dt).contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)).float()
        f1 = self.encode(img1.to(dt).contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)).float()
        blocks = (self.block0, self.block1, self.block2, self.block3, self.block4)
        flow = mask = feat = None
        w0, w1 = img0, img1
        for i, blk in enumerate(blocks):
            if flow is None:
                flow, mask, feat = blk(torch.cat((img0, img1, f0, f1, t), 1), None, scale_list[i], dt)
            else:
                wf0 = warp(f0, flow[:, :2])
                wf1 = warp(f1, flow[:, 2:4])
                fd, mask, feat = blk(torch.cat((w0, w1, wf0, wf1, t, mask, feat), 1), flow, scale_list[i], dt)
                flow = flow + fd
            w0 = warp(img0, flow[:, :2])
            w1 = warp(img1, flow[:, 2:4])
        m = torch.sigmoid(mask)
        return w0 * m + w1 * (1 - m), flow, m, w0, w1


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# weights
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _sha256(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def ensure_weights(model=DEFAULT_MODEL):
    """Return the local path of the model's flownet.pkl, downloading it (from the author's
    HuggingFace repo hzwer/RIFE) into RIFE_DIR on first use."""
    spec = MODELS[model]
    dst = os.path.join(RIFE_DIR, spec["file"])
    if os.path.exists(dst):
        return dst
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
    dl = os.path.join(RIFE_DIR, "dl", model)
    os.makedirs(dl, exist_ok=True)
    zpath = os.path.join(dl, os.path.basename(spec["url"]))
    if not os.path.exists(zpath):
        print("[interp] downloading", spec["url"], flush=True)
        subprocess.run(["curl", "-sSL", "--fail", "-o", zpath + ".part", spec["url"]], check=True)
        os.replace(zpath + ".part", zpath)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zpath) as z, z.open(spec["member"]) as src, open(dst + ".part", "wb") as out:
        shutil.copyfileobj(src, out)
    got = _sha256(dst + ".part")
    if got != spec["sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("checksum mismatch for %s: %s" % (spec["member"], got))
    os.replace(dst + ".part", dst)
    return dst


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# inference wrapper
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _to_tensor(a):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.ascontiguousarray(a)).permute(2, 0, 1).float().div_(255.0)


def _to_u8(x):
    return x.clamp(0, 1).mul(255.0).round().byte().permute(1, 2, 0).numpy()


class Interpolator:
    """RIFE v4.26 on CPU. All images are uint8 HxWx3 (RGB) numpy arrays."""

    def __init__(self, model=DEFAULT_MODEL, threads=None, precision="bf16", scale=1.0):
        if not threads and _TORCH_PREIMPORTED and os.environ.get("OMP_WAIT_POLICY", "").upper() != "PASSIVE":
            # torch was loaded before us with spinning OpenMP workers: on a busy box 4 threads can be ~10x
            # slower than 1 (measured 10.9 s vs 1.1 s/frame at load 12). Import interp first, or export
            # OMP_WAIT_POLICY=PASSIVE, to use all cores safely.
            try:
                busy = os.getloadavg()[0] > (os.cpu_count() or 4)
            except OSError:
                busy = True
            threads = 1 if busy else None
            print("[interp] note: torch imported before interp without OMP_WAIT_POLICY=PASSIVE; threads=%s"
                  % (threads or torch.get_num_threads()), file=sys.stderr)
        if threads:
            torch.set_num_threads(int(threads))
        try:
            torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
        except RuntimeError:
            pass
        self.model_name = model
        self.scale = float(scale)
        self.precision = precision
        net = IFNet()
        sd = torch.load(ensure_weights(model), map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
        sd = {k[7:] if k.startswith("module.") else k: v for k, v in sd.items()}
        own = net.state_dict()
        net.load_state_dict({k: v for k, v in sd.items() if k in own}, strict=True)
        net.eval()
        if precision == "bf16":
            net.to(torch.bfloat16)
            net.dtype = torch.bfloat16
        self.net = net.to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
        self.mult = max(64, int(round(64 / self.scale)))
        self.scale_list = tuple(s / self.scale for s in (16, 8, 4, 2, 1))

    def _pad(self, x):
        h, w = x.shape[-2:]
        ph, pw = (-h) % self.mult, (-w) % self.mult
        return F.pad(x, (0, pw, 0, ph), mode="replicate") if (ph or pw) else x

    @torch.inference_mode()
    def run(self, img0, img1, ts):
        """Batched core: img0/img1 uint8 HxWx3, ts list of timesteps in (0,1).
        Returns dict(merged=[uint8...], flow=(B,4,H,W) tensor, err=[mean abs diff of the two warps])."""
        h, w = img0.shape[:2]
        a = self._pad(_to_tensor(img0)[None])
        b = self._pad(_to_tensor(img1)[None])
        B = len(ts)
        a, b = a.expand(B, -1, -1, -1), b.expand(B, -1, -1, -1)
        t = torch.tensor(ts, dtype=torch.float32).view(B, 1, 1, 1)
        merged, flow, m, w0, w1 = self.net(a, b, t, self.scale_list)
        merged, flow = merged[..., :h, :w], flow[..., :h, :w]
        d = (w0 - w1)[..., :h, :w].abs().mean(1)                     # (B,H,W) warp disagreement
        err = [{"mean": float(d[i].mean() * 255), "p99": float(torch.quantile(d[i].flatten()[::7], 0.99) * 255)}
               for i in range(B)]
        return {"merged": [_to_u8(merged[i]) for i in range(B)], "flow": flow, "err": err}

    def interpolate(self, img0, img1, t=0.5):
        return self.run(img0, img1, [t])["merged"][0]

    @torch.inference_mode()
    def extrapolate(self, other, anchor, d):
        """Predict the frame d intervals beyond `anchor`, continuing the motion other -> anchor
        (d=0.5 for one frame past the last of two frames 2 apart). Flow is estimated at the
        midpoint (best-trained timestep); anchor is backward-warped by -d * velocity."""
        r = self.run(other, anchor, [0.5])
        fl = r["flow"]
        vel = fl[:, 2:4] - fl[:, 0:2]                               # displacement other->anchor
        out = warp(_to_tensor(anchor)[None], -d * vel)
        return _to_u8(out[0]), r["err"][0]


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# planning / shot filling
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def frame_dir(shot, quality):
    return os.path.join(WORK, "frames", shot, quality)


def shot_length(shot):
    try:
        tl = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, "timeline.json")))
        for s in tl["shots"]:
            if s["id"] == shot:
                return int(s["render_frames"])
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
        pass
    return None


def list_frames(d):
    out = {}
    if os.path.isdir(d):
        for name in os.listdir(d):
            m = FRAME_RE.match(name)
            if m:
                out[int(m.group(1))] = os.path.join(d, name)
    return out


def is_generated(path):
    try:
        with Image.open(path) as im:
            return TAG in im.info
    except OSError:
        return False


def make_plan(src_frames, n, max_gap=2, edge="extrapolate"):
    """src_frames: sorted list of rendered frame numbers. Returns (jobs, unfillable).
    job = ("interp", a, b, [(f, t), ...]) or ("extrap", f, anchor, other, d) or ("hold", f, anchor)."""
    have = sorted(f for f in src_frames if 1 <= f <= n)
    hs = set(have)
    jobs, bad = [], []
    if len(have) == 0:
        return jobs, list(range(1, n + 1))
    for a, b in zip(have, have[1:]):
        if b - a < 2:
            continue
        if b - a > max_gap:
            bad.extend(range(a + 1, b))
            continue
        jobs.append(("interp", a, b, [(f, (f - a) / (b - a)) for f in range(a + 1, b)]))
    lead = [f for f in range(1, have[0])]
    tail = [f for f in range(have[-1] + 1, n + 1)]
    for fs, anchor, nb in ((tail, have[-1], have[-2] if len(have) > 1 else None),
                           (lead, have[0], have[1] if len(have) > 1 else None)):
        if not fs:
            continue
        if len(fs) > max_gap - 1:
            bad.extend(fs)
            continue
        for f in fs:
            if edge == "extrapolate" and nb is not None:
                jobs.append(("extrap", f, anchor, nb, abs(f - anchor) / abs(anchor - nb)))
            else:
                jobs.append(("hold", f, anchor))
    assert not (hs & {f for j in jobs for f in _targets(j)})
    return jobs, sorted(bad)


def _targets(job):
    return [f for f, _ in job[3]] if job[0] == "interp" else [job[1]]


def _sources(job):
    return [job[1], job[2]] if job[0] == "interp" else ([job[2], job[3]] if job[0] == "extrap" else [job[2]])


def _load(path):
    with Image.open(path) as im:
        return np.array(im.convert("RGB"))


def _save(path, arr, note, level):
    info = PngImagePlugin.PngInfo()
    info.add_text(TAG, note)
    tmp = path + ".tmp"                                         # not *.png: invisible to frame globs
    Image.fromarray(arr).save(tmp, format="PNG", pnginfo=info, compress_level=level)
    os.replace(tmp, path)                                       # atomic: compositor never sees half files


def psnr(a, b):
    mse = np.mean((a.astype(np.float64) - b.astype(np.float64)) ** 2)
    return 99.0 if mse == 0 else 10 * np.log10(255.0 ** 2 / mse)


def detail(a):
    """High-frequency energy (std of the 4-neighbour Laplacian of luma) - compares sharpness/noise."""
    y = a.astype(np.float32) @ np.array([0.299, 0.587, 0.114], np.float32)
    lap = 4 * y[1:-1, 1:-1] - y[:-2, 1:-1] - y[2:, 1:-1] - y[1:-1, :-2] - y[1:-1, 2:]
    return float(lap.std())


def ssim(a, b):
    """Mean SSIM over RGB (11x11 gaussian, sigma 1.5, data range 255)."""
    x = torch.from_numpy(np.ascontiguousarray(a)).permute(2, 0, 1)[:, None].float()
    y = torch.from_numpy(np.ascontiguousarray(b)).permute(2, 0, 1)[:, None].float()
    g = torch.exp(-((torch.arange(11) - 5.0) ** 2) / (2 * 1.5 ** 2))
    g = g / g.sum()

    def f(z):                                                   # separable 11x11 gaussian, valid region
        return F.conv2d(F.conv2d(z, g.view(1, 1, 1, 11)), g.view(1, 1, 11, 1))
    mx, my = f(x), f(y)
    sxx, syy, sxy = f(x * x) - mx * mx, f(y * y) - my * my, f(x * y) - mx * my
    c1, c2 = (0.01 * 255) ** 2, (0.03 * 255) ** 2
    s = ((2 * mx * my + c1) * (2 * sxy + c2)) / ((mx * mx + my * my + c1) * (sxx + syy + c2))
    return float(s.mean())


def fill_shot(shot=None, quality="final", src=None, out=None, n=None, max_gap=2, edge="extrapolate",
              force=False, dry_run=False, validate=False, threads=None, precision="bf16", scale=1.0,
              model=DEFAULT_MODEL, compress=3, ip=None, log=print):
    """Fill the missing frames of a half-rate render. Returns a summary dict.

    src/out default to WORK/frames/<shot>/<quality>/. Rendered frames are never overwritten; frames
    this tool generated earlier (PNG tag 'Interp') are regenerated when a source frame is newer, or
    always with force=True. validate=True: treat src as a full-rate render, use only odd frames as
    input, write the evens to `out` (default WORK/dev/interp/validate/<shot>_<quality>) and score
    them against the real ones."""
    t_start = time.time()
    src = src or frame_dir(shot, quality)
    if validate:
        out = out or os.path.join(WORK, "dev", "interp", "validate", "%s_%s" % (shot or "x", quality))
    out = out or src
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
    found = list_frames(src)
    if not found:
        raise SystemExit("[interp] no NNNN.png frames in %s" % src)
    if validate:
        n = n or max(found)                                    # extent of the full-rate reference render
    n = n or (shot_length(shot) if shot else None) or max(found)
    truth = {}
    if validate:
        truth = {f: p for f, p in found.items() if f % 2 == 0}
        found = {f: p for f, p in found.items() if f % 2 == 1}
    # rendered frames = in src and not produced by us
    rendered, regen = {}, set()
    for f, p in found.items():
        if not validate and is_generated(p):
            regen.add(f)
        else:
            rendered[f] = p
    jobs, bad = make_plan(sorted(rendered), n, max_gap, edge)
    outs = list_frames(out)
    todo, protected = [], []
    for j in jobs:
        need = False
        for f in _targets(j):
            p = outs.get(f)
            if p is None or validate:
                need = True
            elif f in regen or is_generated(p):
                newest = max(os.path.getmtime(rendered[s]) for s in _sources(j))
                need = need or force or os.path.getmtime(p) < newest
            else:
                protected.append(f)    # a real render already sits in --out: never overwrite it
        if need:
            todo.append(j)
    if protected:
        log("[interp] keeping %d real rendered frames in %s: %s" % (len(protected), out, _ranges(sorted(protected))))
    protected = set(protected)
    nt = sum(len(_targets(j)) for j in todo)
    log("[interp] %s: %d rendered frames of %d, %d to synthesise (%d jobs), %d unfillable%s"
        % (src, len(rendered), n, nt, len(todo), len(bad), " (validate -> %s)" % out if validate else ""))
    if bad:
        log("[interp] WARNING: cannot fill frames (gap > %d or no neighbours): %s" % (max_gap, _ranges(bad)))
    summary = {"src": src, "out": out, "n": n, "rendered": len(rendered), "generated": [], "unfillable": bad,
               "model": "rife-" + model, "precision": precision}
    if dry_run:
        for j in todo:
            log("   ", j)
        return summary
    if not todo:
        return summary
    ip = ip or Interpolator(model, threads=threads, precision=precision, scale=scale)
    cache = {}
    pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(3)

    def get(f):
        if f not in cache:
            cache[f] = pool.submit(_load, rendered[f])
        return cache[f]

    records, writes, t_net = [], [], 0.0
    for idx, j in enumerate(todo):
        for f in _sources(j):
            get(f)
        if idx + 1 < len(todo):                                 # prefetch the next job's inputs
            for f in _sources(todo[idx + 1]):
                get(f)
        imgs = [get(f).result() for f in _sources(j)]
        t0 = time.time()
        if j[0] == "interp":
            _, a, b, ft = j
            r = ip.run(imgs[0], imgs[1], [t for _, t in ft])
            results = [(f, r["merged"][i], "rife-%s t=%.4f %04d %04d" % (model, t, a, b), r["err"][i])
                       for i, (f, t) in enumerate(ft)]
        elif j[0] == "extrap":
            _, f, anc, nb, d = j
            img, e = ip.extrapolate(imgs[1], imgs[0], d)
            results = [(f, img, "rife-%s extrapolate d=%.3f from %04d %04d" % (model, d, nb, anc), e)]
        else:
            _, f, anc = j
            results = [(f, imgs[0], "hold %04d" % anc, {"mean": 0.0, "p99": 0.0})]
        t_net += time.time() - t0
        for f, img, note, e in results:
            if f in protected:
                continue
            path = os.path.join(out, "%04d.png" % f)
            writes.append(pool.submit(_save, path, img, note, compress))
            rec = {"frame": f, "kind": j[0], "note": note, "warp_err": round(e["mean"], 3),
                   "warp_err_p99": round(e["p99"], 2)}
            if validate and f in truth:
                gt = _load(truth[f])
                rec["psnr"] = round(psnr(img, gt), 3)
                rec["ssim"] = round(ssim(img, gt), 5)
                rec["detail_ratio"] = round(detail(img) / max(1e-6, detail(gt)), 4)
                if j[0] == "interp":
                    blend = ((imgs[0].astype(np.uint16) + imgs[1]) // 2).astype(np.uint8)
                    rec["psnr_blend"] = round(psnr(blend, gt), 3)
                    rec["psnr_dup"] = round(psnr(imgs[0], gt), 3)
            records.append(rec)
            log("[interp] %04d %-7s warp_err %.2f%s" % (f, j[0], e["mean"],
                ("  PSNR %.2f dB  SSIM %.4f" % (rec["psnr"], rec["ssim"])) if "psnr" in rec else ""))
        live = set(f for jj in todo[idx + 1: idx + 3] for f in _sources(jj))
        for f in [k for k in cache if k not in live]:
            del cache[f]
    for w in writes:
        w.result()
    pool.shutdown()
    dt = time.time() - t_start
    summary.update(generated=[r["frame"] for r in records], seconds=round(dt, 1),
                   sec_per_frame=round(dt / max(1, len(records)), 3), net_sec_per_frame=round(t_net / max(1, len(records)), 3),
                   threads=torch.get_num_threads(), frames=records)
    if validate:
        for k in ("psnr", "ssim", "detail_ratio", "psnr_blend", "psnr_dup"):
            v = [r[k] for r in records if k in r and r["kind"] == "interp"]
            if v:
                summary[k + "_mean"] = round(float(np.mean(v)), 4)
                summary[k + "_min"] = round(float(np.min(v)), 4)
    mpath = os.path.join(out, MANIFEST)
    if not validate and os.path.exists(mpath):                  # merge with earlier runs (partial regen)
        try:
            old = {r["frame"]: r for r in json.load(open(mpath)).get("frames", [])}
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            old = {}
        new = {r["frame"] for r in records}
        keep = [r for f, r in old.items() if f not in new and is_generated(os.path.join(out, "%04d.png" % f))]
        allr = sorted(keep + records, key=lambda r: r["frame"])
        summary["frames"] = allr
        summary["generated"] = [r["frame"] for r in allr]
        summary["last_run_frames"] = sorted(new)
    errs = [r["warp_err"] for r in summary["frames"] if r["kind"] == "interp"]
    if errs:
        summary["warp_err_mean"] = round(float(np.mean(errs)), 3)
        summary["warp_err_max"] = round(float(np.max(errs)), 3)
        summary["warp_err_p90"] = round(float(np.percentile(errs, 90)), 3)
    with open(mpath + ".tmp", "w") as fh:
        json.dump(summary, fh, indent=1)
    os.replace(mpath + ".tmp", mpath)
    log("[interp] done: %d frames in %.1fs (%.2fs/frame, net %.2fs/frame, %d threads)%s"
        % (len(records), dt, summary["sec_per_frame"], summary["net_sec_per_frame"], summary["threads"],
           ("  mean PSNR %.2f dB SSIM %.4f (blend %.2f, dup %.2f)" % (summary.get("psnr_mean", 0), summary.get("ssim_mean", 0),
            summary.get("psnr_blend_mean", 0), summary.get("psnr_dup_mean", 0))) if validate else ""))
    if summary.get("warp_err_max", 0) > 6:
        log("[interp] NOTE: high warp disagreement (max %.1f/255) - inspect frames %s; consider rendering this "
            "shot at 24 fps" % (summary["warp_err_max"],
                                _ranges(sorted(r["frame"] for r in records if r["warp_err"] > 6))))
    return summary


def _ranges(fs):
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(fs):
        j = i
        while j + 1 < len(fs) and fs[j + 1] == fs[j] + 1:
            j += 1
        out.append(str(fs[i]) if i == j else "%d-%d" % (fs[i], fs[j]))
        i = j + 1
    return ",".join(out)


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="RIFE frame interpolation for half-rate (odd-frame) renders.")
    ap.add_argument("--shot", help="shot id; frames in WORK/frames/<shot>/<quality>/")
    ap.add_argument("--quality", default="final")
    ap.add_argument("--src", help="override source frame dir")
    ap.add_argument("--out", help="write synthesised frames here instead of the source dir")
    ap.add_argument("--n", type=int, help="shot length (default: timeline render_frames, else last frame)")
    ap.add_argument("--max-gap", type=int, default=2, help="largest rendered-frame spacing to bridge (2 = odd frames)")
    ap.add_argument("--edge", choices=("extrapolate", "hold"), default="extrapolate",
                    help="trailing/leading missing frame: motion-extrapolate (default) or duplicate")
    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="regenerate all previously generated frames")
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--validate", action="store_true", help="score against a full-rate render (see docstring)")
    ap.add_argument("--threads", type=int, default=None, help="torch threads (default: all cores)")
    ap.add_argument("--precision", choices=("bf16", "fp32"), default="bf16")
    ap.add_argument("--scale", type=float, default=1.0, help="RIFE flow scale (1.0 for 540x960)")
    ap.add_argument("--model", default=DEFAULT_MODEL, choices=sorted(MODELS))
    ap.add_argument("--compress", type=int, default=3, help="PNG zlib level for written frames")
    ap.add_argument("--pair", nargs=2, metavar=("A", "B"), help="interpolate a single pair to --out")
    ap.add_argument("--t", type=float, default=0.5)
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if a.pair:
        if not a.out:
            ap.error("--pair needs --out file.png")
        ip = Interpolator(a.model, threads=a.threads, precision=a.precision, scale=a.scale)
        t0 = time.time()
        r = ip.run(_load(a.pair[0]), _load(a.pair[1]), [a.t])
        _save(a.out, r["merged"][0], "rife-%s t=%.4f pair" % (a.model, a.t), a.compress)
        print("[interp] wrote %s in %.2fs (warp_err %.2f)" % (a.out, time.time() - t0, r["err"][0]["mean"]))
        return 0
    if not (a.shot or a.src):
        ap.error("need --shot (or --src)")
    s = fill_shot(a.shot, a.quality, src=a.src, out=a.out, n=a.n, max_gap=a.max_gap, edge=a.edge, force=a.force,
                  dry_run=a.dry_run, validate=a.validate, threads=a.threads, precision=a.precision,
                  scale=a.scale, model=a.model, compress=a.compress)
    return 1 if s["unfillable"] else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
